This file is a merged representation of a subset of the codebase, containing specifically included files and files not matching ignore patterns, combined into a single document by Repomix.
The content has been processed where comments have been removed, line numbers have been added.

# File Summary

## Purpose
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A header with the file path (## File: path/to/file)
  b. The full contents of the file in a code block

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

## Notes
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: Explore.Blazor/**/*, Explore.Blazor.Client/**/*, Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests/**/*, Explore.ServiceDefaults/**/*, docs/**/*, _bmad-output/**/*, .claude/**/*, .opencode/**/*, .taskmaster/**/*, dev/active/**/*, CLAUDE.md, README.md
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: **/*.log, .opencode/command/**/*, .claude/commands/**/*, .claude/hooks/**/*
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Code comments have been removed from supported file types
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

# Files

## File: dev/active/mudblazor-migration-v9/v9 Migration Guide from v8.md
````markdown
   1: MudBlazor version 9.0.0 brings significant *breaking changes. This migration guide will help you upgrade from v8 to v9.
   2: 
   3: Note: Please limit discussion strictly to migration or reporting errors in this guide. For general feedback about version 9.0.0, use the appropriate discussion channels.
   4: 
   5: Warning
   6: 
   7: Many obsolete APIs marked for removal in v8 have been removed in v9. The compiler will NOT always catch these changes at compile time if you're using dynamic invocation or reflection. Ensure thorough testing after migration.
   8: 
   9: Converters: Complete Rework
  10: The converter system has been completely redesigned for better performance, type safety, and extensibility. This is one of the most significant breaking changes in v9.
  11: 
  12: Removed:
  13: 
  14: Converter<T, U> class
  15: Converter<T> class
  16: DefaultConverter (old implementation)
  17: BoolConverter (old implementation)
  18: DateConverter
  19: NumericConverter.AreEqual method
  20: Converters static class
  21: Replaced with:
  22: 
  23: IConverter<TInput, TOutput> interface
  24: ICultureAwareConverter<TInput, TOutput> interface
  25: IReversibleConverter<TInput, TOutput> interface
  26: DefaultConverter<T> (new implementation)
  27: BoolConverter<T> (new implementation)
  28: RangeConverter<T>
  29: DeferredConverter<TInput, TOutput>
  30: EmptyConverter<TInput, TOutput>
  31: ConversionResult<T> for error handling
  32: ConverterExtensions for fluent API
  33: Conversions static class for common conversions
  34: Breaking Changes:
  35: 
  36: Custom converters must implement interfaces:
  37: Before (v8):
  38: 
  39: public class MyConverter : Converter<MyType>
  40: {
  41:     public MyConverter()
  42:     {
  43:         SetFunc = value => value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
  44:         GetFunc = str => MyType.Parse(str);
  45:     }
  46: }
  47: After (v9):
  48: 
  49: public class MyConverter : IReversibleConverter<MyType, string>
  50: {
  51:     public string Convert(MyType input)
  52:     {
  53:         // ...
  54:     }
  55: 
  56:     public MyType ConvertBack(string input)
  57:     {
  58:         // ...
  59:     }
  60: }
  61: Inline converters
  62: Before (v8):
  63: 
  64: private Converter<ConverterElement?> _elementConverter = new Converter<ConverterElement?>
  65: {
  66: 	SetFunc = value => value?.ToString(),
  67: 	GetFunc = text => new ConverterElement { Name = text }
  68: };
  69: After (v9):
  70: 
  71: private IConverter<ConverterElement?, string?> _elementConverter = Conversions
  72: 	.From((ConverterElement? value) => value?.ToString(),
  73: 		text => new ConverterElement { Name = text });
  74: Component Converter property changes:
  75: Components like MudTextField<T>, MudNumericField<T>, etc. still have a Converter property, but it now expects the new converter types. The framework provides automatic conversion for most built-in types.
  76: 
  77: GetDefaultConverter() method added (PR #12365):
  78: All components inheriting from MudFormComponent must now implement a GetDefaultConverter() method instead of setting the converter in the constructor. This provides compile-time safety and allows wrapper components to use null for the Converter parameter.
  79: 
  80: ❌ Before (v8):
  81: 
  82: public class MyInput : MudFormComponent<MyType, string>
  83: {
  84:     public MyInput()
  85:     {
  86:         Converter = new DefaultConverter<MyType>
  87:         {
  88:             Culture = GetCulture,
  89:             Format = GetFormat
  90:         };
  91:     }
  92: }
  93: ✅ After (v9):
  94: 
  95: public class MyInput : MudFormComponent<MyType, string>
  96: {
  97:     // Constructor no longer sets Converter
  98: 
  99:     protected override IConverter<MyType?, string?> GetDefaultConverter()
 100:     {
 101:         return new DefaultConverter<MyType>
 102:         {
 103:             Culture = GetCulture,
 104:             Format = GetFormat
 105:         };
 106:     }
 107: }
 108: Key changes:
 109: 
 110: Converter parameter is now nullable: You can set Converter to null, and the component will use GetDefaultConverter() as fallback
 111: Compile-time safety: Forgetting to implement GetDefaultConverter() now causes a compile error instead of a runtime exception
 112: Better for wrappers: Wrapper components no longer need to explicitly pass a converter if they want default behavior
 113: Important: The Converter parameter is checked first. If it's null, GetDefaultConverter() is called once and cached. Use GetConverter() method (not the Converter property) when you need to access the active converter in component logic.
 114: 
 115: Example accessing the converter:
 116: 
 117: // ❌ Don't access Converter directly if it might be null
 118: var converter = Converter; // May be null!
 119: 
 120: // ✅ Use GetConverter() which handles the fallback
 121: var converter = GetConverter(); // Always returns non-null
 122: Migration tip: If you created custom converters, you'll need to rewrite them to implement the new interfaces. See PR #12177 for detailed examples. If you inherit from MudFormComponent, implement GetDefaultConverter() (PR #12365).
 123: 
 124: Remove All Obsolete/Deprecated Code
 125: All code marked with [Obsolete] or [Deprecated] in v8 has been removed in v9.
 126: 
 127: Removed from DialogService:
 128: 
 129: Show(Type) - use ShowAsync(Type)
 130: Show<T>() - use ShowAsync<T>()
 131: ShowMessageBox() - use ShowMessageBoxAsync()
 132: ShowForm<T>() - use ShowFormAsync<T>()
 133: Close() - use CloseAsync()
 134: Removed from MudDataGrid:
 135: 
 136: ExpandAllGroups() - use ExpandAllGroupsAsync
 137: CollapseAllGroups() - use CollapseAllGroupsAsync
 138: Removed from MudSelect:
 139: 
 140: Clear - use ClearAsync
 141: Removed from MudTabs:
 142: 
 143: ActivatePanel - use ActivatePanelAsync
 144: Removed from MudMenu:
 145: 
 146: Stylename
 147: Removed from ElementReferenceExtensions:
 148: 
 149: MudDetachBlurEventWithJS - use Use mudElementRef.removeOnBlurEvent via js invoke instead
 150: More details: #12142
 151: 
 152: MudGlobal: Theming Properties Removed
 153: All theming-related properties have been removed from MudGlobal. These experimental properties created maintenance burden and blurred the boundary between behavioral and visual concerns. Use CSS variables, theme configuration, or explicit component parameters instead.
 154: 
 155: Removed from MudGlobal:
 156: 
 157: MudGlobal.Rounded (static property)
 158: MudGlobal.ButtonDefaults.Color (default: Color.Default)
 159: MudGlobal.ButtonDefaults.Variant (default: Variant.Text)
 160: MudGlobal.InputDefaults.ShrinkLabel (default: false)
 161: MudGlobal.InputDefaults.Variant (default: Variant.Text)
 162: MudGlobal.InputDefaults.Margin (default: Margin.None)
 163: MudGlobal.LinkDefaults.Color (default: Color.Primary)
 164: MudGlobal.LinkDefaults.Typo (default: Typo.body1)
 165: MudGlobal.LinkDefaults.Underline (default: Underline.Hover)
 166: MudGlobal.GridDefaults.Spacing (default: 6)
 167: MudGlobal.StackDefaults.Spacing (default: 3)
 168: MudGlobal.PopoverDefaults.Elevation (default: 8)
 169: Retained non-theming properties in MudGlobal:
 170: 
 171: DialogDefaults.DefaultFocus
 172: MenuDefaults.HoverDelay
 173: PopoverDefaults.ModalOverlay
 174: TooltipDefaults.Delay/Duration
 175: TransitionDefaults.Delay/Duration
 176: UnhandledExceptionHandler
 177: Components affected:
 178: All affected components now use hard-coded defaults matching the previous MudGlobal default values:
 179: 
 180: MudButton, MudIconButton, MudToggleIconButton - now default to Color.Default and Variant.Text
 181: MudBaseInput and all derived inputs (MudTextField, MudNumericField, etc.) - now default to Variant.Text, Margin.None, and ShrinkLabel = false
 182: MudLink - now defaults to Color.Primary, Typo.body1, and Underline.Hover
 183: MudGrid - now defaults to Spacing = 6
 184: MudStack - now defaults to Spacing = 3
 185: MudPopover - now defaults to Elevation = 8
 186: MudPicker and all derived pickers - now default to Elevation = 8 for the popover
 187: Components with Square/Rounded parameters (MudAlert, MudAvatar, MudAvatarGroup, MudCard, MudDataGrid, MudExpansionPanels, MudNavMenu, MudPaper, MudPicker, MudPopover, MudProgressCircular, MudProgressLinear, MudSimpleTable, MudTable, MudTabs) - no longer respect MudGlobal.Rounded
 188: Migration:
 189: Users relying on global theming should migrate to:
 190: 
 191: Explicit component parameters - Set properties directly on each component
 192: Theme tokens - Use theme configuration for colors, typography, and shape
 193: Wrapper components - Create app-specific wrapper components for shared styling
 194: CSS - Apply custom styles via CSS classes or variables
 195: Example migration:
 196: 
 197: Before (v8):
 198: 
 199: // Program.cs or Startup.cs
 200: MudGlobal.ButtonDefaults.Variant = Variant.Filled;
 201: MudGlobal.InputDefaults.Variant = Variant.Outlined;
 202: After (v9) - Option 1: Explicit parameters:
 203: 
 204: <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled">Click Me</MudButton>
 205: <MudTextField Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 206: After (v9) - Option 2: Wrapper component:
 207: 
 208: @* AppButton.razor *@
 209: <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="@Class" @attributes="AdditionalAttributes">
 210:     @ChildContent
 211: </MudButton>
 212: 
 213: @code {
 214:     [Parameter] public string? Class { get; set; }
 215:     [Parameter] public RenderFragment? ChildContent { get; set; }
 216:     [Parameter(CaptureUnmatchedValues = true)] 
 217:     public IDictionary<string, object>? AdditionalAttributes { get; set; }
 218: }
 219: More details: #12141
 220: 
 221: DialogService
 222: ShowMessageBox Renamed
 223: Replace ShowMessageBox with ShowMessageBoxAsync:
 224: 
 225: More details: #12292
 226: 
 227: Dialog.DefaultFocus Moved
 228: MudGlobal.DialogDefaults.DefaultFocus has been moved to MudDialogProvider.
 229: 
 230: Before (v8):
 231: 
 232: MudGlobal.DialogDefaults.DefaultFocus = DefaultFocus.FirstChild;
 233: After (v9):
 234: 
 235: <MudDialogProvider DefaultFocus="DefaultFocus.FirstChild" />
 236: Or set it via DialogOptions:
 237: 
 238: var options = new DialogOptions { DefaultFocus = DefaultFocus.FirstChild };
 239: More details: #12297
 240: 
 241: MudTheme: Palette Type Changes
 242: PaletteLight and PaletteDark are now of type Palette instead of their specific types.
 243: 
 244: Before (v8):
 245: 
 246: PaletteLight PaletteLight { get; set; }
 247: PaletteDark PaletteDark { get; set; }
 248: After (v9):
 249: 
 250: Palette PaletteLight { get; set; }
 251: Palette PaletteDark { get; set; }
 252: This should have minimal impact as both derive from Palette.
 253: 
 254: More details: #12148
 255: 
 256: Transition Defaults Moved
 257: Popover transition defaults moved from MudGlobal to PopoverOptions.
 258: 
 259: Before (v8):
 260: 
 261: MudGlobal.PopoverDefaults.TransitionDuration = 300;
 262: After (v9):
 263: 
 264: builder.Services.AddMudServices(config =>
 265: {
 266:     config.PopoverOptions.TransitionDuration = 300;
 267: });
 268: More details: #12300
 269: 
 270: MudMenu: MenuContext Replaces IActivatable
 271: MudMenu.ActivatorContent now receives a MenuContext parameter instead of using IActivatable via cascading value. The MenuContext provides explicit async methods (OpenAsync, CloseAsync, ToggleAsync, CloseAllAsync) for controlling menus.
 272: 
 273: Breaking Changes:
 274: 
 275: ActivatorContent signature changed from RenderFragment? to RenderFragment<MenuContext>?
 276: Menu is no longer opened implicitly - You must explicitly call context methods in event handlers
 277: IActivatable.Activate method removed from MudMenu
 278: Root div event handlers only fire for default activators (Button, Icon, Label)
 279: MenuContext API:
 280: 
 281: public sealed class MenuContext
 282: {
 283:     public Task OpenAsync(EventArgs? args = null);
 284:     public Task CloseAsync();
 285:     public Task ToggleAsync(EventArgs? args = null);
 286:     public Task CloseAllAsync();
 287: }
 288: Migration Examples:
 289: 
 290: ❌ Before (v8) - Implicit activation:
 291: 
 292: <MudMenu>
 293:     <ActivatorContent>
 294:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled">Open Menu</MudButton>
 295:     </ActivatorContent>
 296:     <ChildContent>
 297:         <MudMenuItem>Item 1</MudMenuItem>
 298:     </ChildContent>
 299: </MudMenu>
 300: ✅ After (v9) - Explicit context usage:
 301: 
 302: <MudMenu>
 303:     <ActivatorContent>
 304:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="@context.ToggleAsync">Open Menu</MudButton>
 305:     </ActivatorContent>
 306:     <ChildContent>
 307:         <MudMenuItem>Item 1</MudMenuItem>
 308:     </ChildContent>
 309: </MudMenu>
 310: Left Click:
 311: 
 312: <MudMenu ActivationEvent="MouseEvent.LeftClick">
 313:     <ActivatorContent>
 314:         <MudChip OnClick="@(() => context.ToggleAsync())">Click Me</MudChip>
 315:     </ActivatorContent>
 316: </MudMenu>
 317: Right Click:
 318: 
 319: <MudMenu ActivationEvent="MouseEvent.RightClick">
 320:     <ActivatorContent>
 321:         <div @oncontextmenu="@context.ToggleAsync" @oncontextmenu:preventDefault="true">
 322:             <MudChip>Right Click Me</MudChip>
 323:         </div>
 324:     </ActivatorContent>
 325: </MudMenu>
 326: Mouse Over:
 327: 
 328: <MudMenu ActivationEvent="MouseEvent.MouseOver">
 329:     <ActivatorContent>
 330:         <div @onpointerenter="@context.OpenAsync" @onpointerleave="@context.CloseAsync">
 331:             <MudChip>Hover Over Me</MudChip>
 332:         </div>
 333:     </ActivatorContent>
 334: </MudMenu>
 335: Positioned at Cursor:
 336: 
 337: <MudMenu PositionAtCursor="true">
 338:     <ActivatorContent>
 339:         @* Pass event args to OpenAsync/ToggleAsync for cursor positioning *@
 340:         <div @onclick="@context.ToggleAsync" style="cursor: pointer">
 341:             <MudCard>
 342:                 <MudCardContent>Click anywhere on this card</MudCardContent>
 343:             </MudCard>
 344:         </div>
 345:     </ActivatorContent>
 346: </MudMenu>
 347: Non-interactive Activators:
 348: 
 349: For non-interactive elements like MudAvatar, wrap them in a div with event handlers:
 350: 
 351: <MudMenu>
 352:     <ActivatorContent>
 353:         <div @onclick="@context.ToggleAsync" style="cursor: pointer">
 354:             <MudAvatar>
 355:                 <MudImage Src="avatar.jpg" />
 356:             </MudAvatar>
 357:         </div>
 358:     </ActivatorContent>
 359: </MudMenu>
 360: More details: #12145

 362: MudFormComponent & MudBaseInput: API Changes
 363: The API had inconsistent naming between MudFormComponent and MudBaseInput that has been fixed for consistency.
 364: 
 365: MudFormComponent: Error and ErrorId Two-Way Bindable
 366: Error and ErrorId are now two-way bindable parameters.
 367: 
 368: New capability (v9):
 369: 
 370: <MudTextField @bind-Error="myError" @bind-ErrorId="myErrorId" />
 371: More details: #12138, #12140
 372: 
 373: Method Naming Changes
 374: Several methods have been renamed for consistency:
 375: 
 376: Reset() → ResetAsync() (was already marked async)
 377: Validate() → ValidateAsync() (if async)
 378: ReadValue() → ReadValue (property-style, no parentheses)
 379: More details: #12147, #12310
 380: 
 381: WriteValueAsync and SetValueAsync Renamed
 382: Breaking Changes (PR #12312):
 383: 
 384: MudFormComponent.WriteValueAsync renamed to SetValueAsync then to SetValueCoreAsync:
 385: To match the ReadValue property pattern (Read/Set), WriteValueAsync was renamed, then later renamed again with Core suffix.
 386: 
 387: ❌ Before (v8):
 388: 
 389: protected internal virtual T? ReadValue { get; }
 390: protected virtual Task WriteValueAsync(T? value)
 391: ✅ After (v9 - Final):
 392: 
 393: protected internal virtual T? ReadValue { get; }
 394: protected virtual Task SetValueCoreAsync(T? value)  // was WriteValueAsync → SetValueAsync → SetValueCoreAsync
 395: MudBaseInput.SetValueAsync(T?, bool, bool) renamed to SetValueAndUpdateTextAsync:
 396: To mirror the existing SetTextAndUpdateValueAsync method and avoid conflict with the base SetValueAsync method.
 397: 
 398: SetTextAsync renamed to SetTextCoreAsync:
 399: For consistency with the Core suffix pattern.
 400: 
 401: ❌ Before (v8):
 402: 
 403: // Text API
 404: protected internal string? ReadText { get; }
 405: protected Task SetTextAsync(string? text);
 406: protected Task SetTextAndUpdateValueAsync(string? text, bool updateValue = true);
 407: 
 408: // Value API (inconsistent)
 409: protected internal T? ReadValue { get; }
 410: protected Task SetValueAsync(T? value, bool updateText = true, bool force = false);
 411: ✅ After (v9 - Final):
 412: 
 413: // Text API
 414: protected internal string? ReadText { get; }
 415: protected Task SetTextCoreAsync(string? text);  // was SetTextAsync
 416: protected Task SetTextAndUpdateValueAsync(string? text, bool updateValue = true);
 417: 
 418: // Value API
 419: protected internal T? ReadValue { get; }
 420: protected virtual Task SetValueCoreAsync(T? value);  // was WriteValueAsync → SetValueAsync
 421: protected Task SetValueAndUpdateTextAsync(T? value, bool updateText = true, bool force = false);  // was SetValueAsync(T?, bool, bool)
 422: Migration:
 423: 
 424: If you override WriteValueAsync in a custom component:
 425: 
 426: ❌ Before (v8):
 427: 
 428: protected override Task WriteValueAsync(MyType? value)
 429: {
 430:     _value = value;
 431:     return Task.CompletedTask;
 432: }
 433: ✅ After (v9):
 434: 
 435: protected override Task SetValueCoreAsync(MyType? value)
 436: {
 437:     _value = value;
 438:     return Task.CompletedTask;
 439: }
 440: If you call SetValueAsync(value, updateText, force) in a custom input:
 441: 
 442: ❌ Before (v8):
 443: 
 444: await SetValueAsync(newValue, updateText: true, force: false);
 445: ✅ After (v9):
 446: 
 447: await SetValueAndUpdateTextAsync(newValue, updateText: true, force: false);
 448: If you were calling SetTextAsync internally:
 449: 
 450: ❌ Before (v8):
 451: 
 452: await SetTextAsync(newText);
 453: ✅ After (v9):
 454: 
 455: await SetTextCoreAsync(newText);
 456: All are protected APIs, so external impact should be minimal. Only affects custom components that inherit from MudFormComponent or MudBaseInput and override these methods.
 457: 
 458: More details: #12312, #12489
 459: 
 460: MudSelect
 461: SelectedValues Changed to IReadOnlyCollection
 462: Before (v8):
 463: 
 464: ICollection<T> SelectedValues { get; set; }
 465: After (v9):
 466: 
 467: IReadOnlyCollection<T> SelectedValues { get; set; }
 468: More details: #12619

 470: EventListener / EventManager Removed

 472:

 474: 
 475: IEventListener / EventListener
 476: IEventListenerFactory / EventListenerFactory
 477: IEventManager
 478: WebEventJsonContext
 479: More details: #12532

 481: Range and DateRange: Setters Removed
 482: Range<T>.Start, Range<T>.End, DateRange.Start, and DateRange.End properties no longer have setters. These classes should now be treated as immutable to ensure proper GetHashCode() behavior and thread safety.
 483: 
 484: Breaking Changes:
 485: 
 486: Range<T> properties are now read-only (init-only)
 487: DateRange properties are now read-only (init-only)
 488: Must create new instances instead of mutating existing ones
 489: Complete API Changes:
 490: 
 491: ❌ Before (v8):
 492: 
 493: public class Range<T>
 494: {
 495:     public T? Start { get; set; }  // Had setter
 496:     public T? End { get; set; }    // Had setter
 497: }
 498: 
 499: public class DateRange : Range<DateTime?>
 500: {
 501:     // Inherited mutable properties
 502: }
 503: ✅ After (v9):
 504: 
 505: public class Range<T> : IEquatable<Range<T>?>
 506: {
 507:     public T? Start { get; }  // No setter
 508:     public T? End { get; }    // No setter
 509:     
 510:     public Range() : this(default, default) { }
 511:     public Range(T? start, T? end) { Start = start; End = end; }
 512: }
 513: 
 514: public class DateRange : Range<DateTime?>, IEquatable<DateRange?>
 515: {
 516:     public DateRange() : this(null, null) { }
 517:     public DateRange(DateTime? start, DateTime? end) : base(start, end) { }
 518: }
 519: Migration:
 520: 
 521: ❌ Before (v8) - Mutating existing instances:
 522: 
 523: // Direct mutation
 524: var range = new DateRange();
 525: range.Start = DateTime.Today;
 526: range.End = DateTime.Today.AddDays(7);
 527: 
 528: // Or modifying .Start/.End properties
 529: dateRange.Start = newStartDate;
 530: dateRange.End = newEndDate;
 531: ✅ After (v9) - Creating new instances:
 532: 
 533: // Option 1: Constructor
 534: var range = new DateRange(DateTime.Today, DateTime.Today.AddDays(7));
 535: 
 536: // Option 2: Replace entire instance
 537: dateRange = new DateRange(newStartDate, newEndDate);
 538: 
 539: // For custom Range<T>
 540: var customRange = new Range<int>(1, 100);
 541: More details: #12319
 542: 
 543: New Analyzers
 544: Three new Roslyn analyzers enforce ParameterState best practices:
 545: 
 546: MUD0010: Warning when reading a ParameterState property directly outside constructors
 547: MUD0011: Error when writing to a ParameterState property
 548: MUD0012: Warning when accessing ParameterState properties from outside the component (with code fix to use GetState())
 549: Example:
 550: 
 551: public class MyComponent{
 552:     private readonly ParameterState<int> _valueState;
 553: 
 554:     // ... Init of _valueState in ctor
 555: 
 556:     [Parameter, ParameterState]
 557:     public int Value { get; set; }
 558: }
 559: 
 560: 
 561: // MUD0010: Don't read ParameterState properties directly
 562: var value = Value; // ❌ Warning
 563: var value = _valueState.Value; // ✅ OK
 564: 
 565: // MUD0011: Error when writing to a ParameterState property
 566: Value = 10; // ❌ Warning
 567: _valueState.SetValueAsync(10); // ✅ OK
 568: 
 569: public MyComponent()
 570: {
 571:     var value = this.Value; // ✅ OK in constructor
 572: }
 573: 
 574: public override Task SetParametersAsync(ParameterView parameters)
 575: {
 576:     Value = 10; // ✅ OK in SetParametersAsync
 577: }
 578: 
 579: // MUD0012: External access
 580: myComponent.Value; // ❌ Warning
 581: 
 582: // Use GetState() instead
 583: myComponent.GetState(x => x.Value); // ✅ OK, c
 584: More details: #12197, #12203, #12205
 585: 
 586: MudStepper
 587: IStepContext: New Public API for Step State Management
 588: Previously, MudStepper exposed MudStep components directly through RenderFragment parameters and public properties. This had two major problems:
 589: 
 590: Writable parameters: Consumers could write directly to step parameters, causing unexpected side effects
 591: Parameter state synchronization: Properties like Completed, Skipped, Disabled, and HasError use ParameterState, requiring consumers to use @bind-* or call .GetState() to see changes
 592: IStepContext eliminates these issues by providing a read-only interface for step state and controlled mutation methods.
 593: 
 594: Breaking Changes:
 595: 
 596: MudStepper.Steps changed from IReadOnlyList<MudStep> to IReadOnlyList<IStepContext>:
 597: ❌ Before (v8):
 598: 
 599: public IReadOnlyList<MudStep> Steps { get; }
 600: 
 601: // Direct property access could miss ParameterState updates
 602: var isCompleted = stepper.Steps[0].Completed; // May not reflect latest state
 603: ✅ After (v9):
 604: 
 605: public IReadOnlyList<IStepContext> Steps { get; }
 606: 
 607: // IStepContext properties are always current
 608: var isCompleted = stepper.Steps[0].Completed; // Always up-to-date
 609: MudStepper.ActiveStep changed from MudStep? to IStepContext?:
 610: ❌ Before (v8):
 611: 
 612: public MudStep? ActiveStep { get; }
 613: ✅ After (v9):
 614: 
 615: public IStepContext? ActiveStep { get; }
 616: Template parameters changed to use IStepContext:
 617: All stepper templates now receive IStepContext instead of MudStep:
 618: 
 619: RenderFragment<MudStep>? TitleTemplate → RenderFragment<IStepContext>? TitleTemplate
 620: RenderFragment<MudStep>? LabelTemplate → RenderFragment<IStepContext>? LabelTemplate
 621: RenderFragment<MudStep>? ConnectorTemplate → RenderFragment<IStepContext>? ConnectorTemplate
 622: IStepContext Contract:
 623: 
 624: public interface IStepContext
 625: {
 626:     // Read-only state properties
 627:     string? Title { get; }
 628:     bool Completed { get; }
 629:     bool Disabled { get; }
 630:     bool HasError { get; }
 631:     bool Skipped { get; }
 632:     bool Skippable { get; }
 633:     bool IsActive { get; }
 634: 
 635:     // Controlled mutation methods
 636:     Task SetHasErrorAsync(bool value, bool refreshParent = true);
 637:     Task SetCompletedAsync(bool value, bool refreshParent = true);
 638:     Task SetDisabledAsync(bool value, bool refreshParent = true);
 639:     Task SetSkippedAsync(bool value, bool refreshParent = true);
 640: }
 641: Migration:
 642: 
 643: Most code accessing step state will just work because IStepContext exposes the same properties.
 644: 
 645: If you were using .GetState() to read step properties (no longer needed):
 646: 
 647: ❌ Before (v8):
 648: 
 649: <MudChip Color="@GetColor(step.GetState(s => s.Completed))">
 650:     @step.Title
 651: </MudChip>
 652: ✅ After (v9):
 653: 
 654: @* IStepContext properties are always current *@
 655: <MudChip Color="@GetColor(step.Completed)">
 656:     @step.Title
 657: </MudChip>
 658: Benefits:
 659: 
 660: ✅ No more manual .GetState() calls needed
 661: ✅ Step state is always synchronized
 662: ✅ Prevents accidental writes to step parameters
 663: More details: #12212
 664: 
 665: MudChart: Complete Type Unification + INumber Support
 666: MudChart underwent a massive refactor to unify inconsistencies, add INumber<T> support (no longer restricted to double), introduce two new chart types (Radar, Rose), and enable combination charts. This is one of the largest breaking changes in v9.
 667: 
 668: Key Changes:
 669: 
 670: INumber<T> Support - Charts now support any numeric type (int, decimal, float, etc.) instead of only double
 671: Unified Data Model - All charts use ChartSeries and ChartData<T> instead of raw arrays or custom structs
 672: Type-Specific Options - AxisChartOptions and generic ChartOptions replaced with specific types (BarChartOptions, LineChartOptions, etc.)
 673: Base Class Reorganization - Clearer separation between axis charts (MudAxisChartBase) and radial charts (MudRadialChartBase)
 674: Consistent Parameter Naming - XAxisLabels, InputLabels, etc. unified to ChartLabels
 675: New Chart Types - Radar and Rose charts added
 676: Combination Charts - Multiple chart types can be overlaid (e.g., Bar + Line)
 677: Breaking Changes - Removed Classes:
 678: 
 679: Removed	Replacement
 680: AxisChartOptions	Type-specific options: BarChartOptions, LineChartOptions, TimeSeriesChartOptions, etc.
 681: ChartOptions	Type-specific options: PieChartOptions, DonutChartOptions, RadarChartOptions, etc.
 682: MudTimeSeriesChart	<MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Line"> or <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.TimeSeries">
 683: MudCategoryChartBase	MudAxisChartBase or MudRadialChartBase
 684: MudCategoryAxisChartBase	MudAxisChartBase
 685: TimeSeriesChartSeries	ChartSeries + ChartData<T>
 686: NodeChartOptions	SankeyChartOptions
 687: Breaking Changes - Parameter Renames:
 688: 
 689: Old Parameter	New Parameter	Applies To
 690: XAxisLabels	ChartLabels	All chart types
 691: XAxisChartOptions	Type-specific options (BarChartOptions, etc.)	All chart types
 692: InputData	ChartSeries	Pie, Donut charts
 693: InputLabels	ChartLabels	Pie, Donut charts
 694: CircleDonutRatio	DonutRingRatio	DonutChartOptions
 695: StackedBarWidthRatio	BarWidthRatio	StackedBarChartOptions
 696: DataMarkerTooltipTitleFormat	TooltipTitleFormat	ChartSeries
 697: ShowDataMarkers	ShowDataMarkers	Moved to LineChartOptions and TimeSeriesChartOptions
 698: LineDisplayType	LineDisplayType	Moved to SeriesDisplayOverrides
 699: FillOpacity	FillOpacity	Moved to SeriesDisplayOverrides and DefaultRadialChartOptions
 700: TimeSeriesChartSeries.TimeValue	TimeValue	TimeSeries in ChartData
 701: Nodes & Edges	ChartSeries	Sankey chart (nodes auto-generated)
 702: Available Chart-Specific Options:
 703: 
 704: BarChartOptions
 705: LineChartOptions
 706: HeatMapChartOptions
 707: DonutChartOptions
 708: PieChartOptions
 709: StackedBarChartOptions
 710: RadarChartOptions
 711: RoseChartOptions
 712: TimeSeriesChartOptions
 713: SankeyChartOptions
 714: Migration Examples:
 715: 
 716: Data Model Migration
 717: ❌ Before (v8) - Raw double arrays:
 718: 
 719: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Pie" 
 720:           InputData="@data" 
 721:           InputLabels="@labels" />
 722: 
 723: @code {
 724:     private double[] data = { 25, 50, 25 };
 725:     private string[] labels = { "A", "B", "C" };
 726: }
 727: ✅ After (v9) - ChartSeries with INumber support:
 728: 
 729: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Pie" 
 730:           ChartSeries="@series" 
 731:           ChartLabels="@labels" />
 732: 
 733: @code {
 734:     private List<ChartSeries<double>> series = new()
 735:     {
 736:         new ChartSeries<double>
 737:         {
 738:             Data = new double[] { 25, 50, 25 }.AsChartDataSet()
 739:         }
 740:     };
 741:     private string[] labels = { "A", "B", "C" };
 742: }
 743: Tip: Use AsChartDataSet() extension method to convert T[] → List<ChartData<T>> for easy migration:
 744: 
 745: double[] values = { 1.5, 2.3, 3.7 };
 746: var chartData = values.AsChartDataSet(); // List<ChartData<double>>
 747: INumber Support - Use Any Numeric Type
 748: ✅ After (v9) - Use int, decimal, etc.:
 749: 
 750: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Bar" ChartSeries="@series" />
 751: 
 752: @code {
 753:     private List<ChartSeries<int>> series = new()
 754:     {
 755:         new ChartSeries<int>
 756:         {
 757:             Name = "Sales",
 758:             Data = new int[] { 100, 200, 150, 300 }.AsChartDataSet()  // int instead of double
 759:         }
 760:     };
 761: }
 762: // Decimal for financial data
 763: decimal[] revenue = { 1000.50m, 2500.75m, 1800.25m };
 764: var series = new ChartSeries 
 765: { 
 766:     Data = revenue.AsChartDataSet() 
 767: };
 768: Chart Options Migration
 769: ❌ Before (v8) - Generic AxisChartOptions:
 770: 
 771: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Bar" 
 772:           XAxisChartOptions="@chartOptions" />
 773: 
 774: @code {
 775:     private AxisChartOptions chartOptions = new()
 776:     {
 777:         YAxisTicks = 10,
 778:         YAxisFormat = "N0"
 779:     };
 780: }
 781: ✅ After (v9) - Type-specific options:
 782: 
 783: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Bar" 
 784:           ChartOptions="@barOptions" />
 785: 
 786: @code {
 787:     private BarChartOptions barOptions = new()
 788:     {
 789:         YAxisTicks = 10,
 790:         YAxisFormat = "N0",
 791:         BarWidthRatio = 0.8  // Bar-specific option
 792:     };
 793: }
 794: TimeSeriesChart Migration
 795: ❌ Before (v8) - Dedicated component:
 796: 
 797: <MudTimeSeriesChart ChartType="ChartType.Line" 
 798:                     ChartSeries="@timeSeriesData" />
 799: 
 800: @code {
 801:     private List<TimeSeriesChartSeries> timeSeriesData = new()
 802:     {
 803:         new TimeSeriesChartSeries
 804:         {
 805:             Name = "Temperature",
 806:             TimeValue = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1),
 807:             Value = 20.5
 808:         }
 809:     };
 810: }
 811: ✅ After (v9) - Use MudChart with ChartData:
 812: 
 813: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.TimeSeries" 
 814:           ChartSeries="@series"
 815:           ChartOptions="@timeOptions" />
 816: 
 817: @code {
 818:     private List<ChartSeries<double>> series = new()
 819:     {
 820:         new ChartSeries<double>
 821:         {
 822:             Name = "Temperature",
 823:             Data = new List<ChartData<double>>
 824:             {
 825:                 new() { TimeValue = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1), Value = 20.5 },
 826:                 new() { TimeValue = new DateTime(2024, 1, 2), Value = 22.3 }
 827:             }
 828:         }
 829:     };
 830:     
 831:     private TimeSeriesChartOptions timeOptions = new()
 832:     {
 833:         ShowDataMarkers = true
 834:     };
 835: }
 836: Combination/Mixed Charts (New Feature)
 837: ✅ After (v9) - Overlay multiple chart types:
 838: 
 839: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Bar" ChartSeries="@mixedSeries" />
 840: 
 841: @code {
 842:     private List<ChartSeries<double>> mixedSeries = new()
 843:     {
 844:         new ChartSeries<double>
 845:         {
 846:             Name = "Revenue",
 847:             ChartType = ChartType.Bar,  // Bars
 848:             Data = new double[] { 100, 150, 120 }.AsChartDataSet()
 849:         },
 850:         new ChartSeries<double>
 851:         {
 852:             Name = "Target",
 853:             ChartType = ChartType.Line,  // Line overlay
 854:             Data = new double[] { 110, 140, 130 }.AsChartDataSet()
 855:         }
 856:     };
 857: }
 858: New Chart Types
 859: Radar Chart:
 860: 
 861: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Radar" 
 862:           ChartSeries="@radarSeries"
 863:           ChartLabels="@radarLabels" />
 864: Rose Chart:
 865: 
 866: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Rose" 
 867:           ChartSeries="@roseSeries"
 868:           ChartLabels="@roseLabels" />
 869: Sankey Chart Migration
 870: ❌ Before (v8) - Explicit nodes:
 871: 
 872: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Sankey"
 873:           Nodes="@nodes"
 874:           Edges="@edges" />
 875: ✅ After (v9) - Nodes auto-generated from series:
 876: 
 877: <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.Sankey"
 878:           ChartSeries="@sankeyData" />
 879: 
 880: @code {
 881:     private List<ChartSeries<int>> sankeyData = new()
 882:     {
 883:         new ChartSeries<int>
 884:         {
 885:             // Edges define the flow; nodes are generated automatically
 886:             Data = new List<ChartData<int>>
 887:             {
 888:                 new() { Source = "A", Target = "B", Value = 10 },
 889:                 new() { Source = "B", Target = "C", Value = 5 }
 890:             }
 891:         }
 892:     };
 893: }
 894: New Features:
 895: 
 896: ✅ Show values within Pie Chart segments
 897: ✅ Bar and Stacked Bar chart justification options
 898: ✅ Combination charts (Bar + Line overlay)
 899: ✅ Interchangeable chart types
 900: ✅ Tooltip customization (TooltipTemplate, TooltipPositionFunc)
 901: ✅ Radar and Rose chart types
 902: ✅ Series visibility toggling for all chart types
 903: ✅ Stacked Bar charts support negative values
 904: ✅ Dynamic chart scaling on visibility changes
 905: ✅ Dynamic font scaling for HeatMap cell values
 906: ✅ HeatMap tooltips match other chart styles
 907: 
 908: Migration Checklist:
 909: 
 910: 
 911: Replace double[] arrays with ChartData<T> using AsChartDataSet()
 912: 
 913: Replace AxisChartOptions/ChartOptions with type-specific options
 914: 
 915: Rename XAxisLabels → ChartLabels
 916: 
 917: Rename InputData → ChartSeries (Pie/Donut)
 918: 
 919: Replace MudTimeSeriesChart with <MudChart ChartType="ChartType.TimeSeries">
 920: 
 921: Update TimeSeriesChartSeries to ChartSeries + ChartData<T>
 922: 
 923: Move ShowDataMarkers, LineDisplayType, FillOpacity to chart options
 924: 
 925: Update Sankey charts to use ChartSeries (nodes auto-generated)
 926: 
 927: Consider using INumber<T> types (int, decimal) instead of double where appropriate
 928: More details: #11458

 930: MudChat - Component Removal
 931: Status: Breaking Change - Entire Component Family Removed
 932: 
 933: The entire MudChat component family has been completely removed from MudBlazor v9 and moved to the MudX extension library. This is part of MudBlazor's strategy to focus on core components and manage resources effectively.
 934: 
 935: Removed Components
 936: All chat-related components have been removed:
 937: 
 938: // ❌ REMOVED - No longer available in MudBlazor v9

 940: <MudChatBubble />
 941: <MudChatHeader />
 942: <MudChatFooter />
 943: Removed Types

 945: 
 946: // ❌ REMOVED
 947: ChatBubblePosition
 948: ChatArrowPosition

 956: MudTreeView - ITreeItemData Interface and Children Collection Changes
 957: Status: Breaking Change - API Type Changes
 958: 
 959: MudTreeView now uses a new ITreeItemData<T> interface and changes the Children property from a mutable collection to read-only.
 960: 
 961: API Changes
 962: MudTreeView Properties:
 963: 
 964: // ❌ Old (v8)
 965: public IReadOnlyCollection<TreeItemData<T>>? Items { get; set; }
 966: public RenderFragment<TreeItemData<T>>? ItemTemplate { get; set; }
 967: public Func<TreeItemData<T>, Task<bool>>? FilterFunc { get; set; }
 968: 
 969: // ✅ New (v9)
 970: public IReadOnlyCollection<ITreeItemData<T>>? Items { get; set; }
 971: public RenderFragment<ITreeItemData<T>>? ItemTemplate { get; set; }
 972: public Func<ITreeItemData<T>, Task<bool>>? FilterFunc { get; set; }
 973: MudTreeViewItem Properties:
 974: 
 975: // ❌ Old (v8)
 976: public IReadOnlyCollection<TreeItemData<T?>>? Items { get; set; }
 977: public EventCallback<IReadOnlyCollection<TreeItemData<T?>>?> ItemsChanged { get; set; }
 978: 
 979: // ✅ New (v9)
 980: public IReadOnlyCollection<ITreeItemData<T?>>? Items { get; set; }
 981: public EventCallback<IReadOnlyCollection<ITreeItemData<T?>>?> ItemsChanged { get; set; }
 982: 3. Update Children Manipulation (Now Read-Only):
 983: 
 984: // ❌ Old (v8) - Direct mutation
 985: var item = new TreeItemData<string> { Text = "Parent" };
 986: item.Children = new List<TreeItemData<string>>();
 987: item.Children.Add(new TreeItemData<string> { Text = "Child" });
 988: 
 989: // ✅ New (v9) - Create new list, assign read-only collection
 990: var item = new TreeItemData<string> { Text = "Parent" };
 991: var children = new List<TreeItemData<string>>
 992: {
 993:     new TreeItemData<string> { Text = "Child" }
 994: };
 995: item.Children = children;
 996: More details: #12090
 997: 
 998: MudDataGrid: ServerData CancellationToken Support
 999: Status: Breaking Change - Method Signature Changed
1000: 
1001: The ServerData function signature now requires a CancellationToken parameter. This enables automatic cancellation of pending data loads when users rapidly navigate pages or change filters, preventing unnecessary API calls and race conditions.
1002: 
1003: Breaking Changes
1004: ServerData Signature Changed:
1005: 
1006: // ❌ Old (v8)
1007: public Func<GridState<T>, Task<GridData<T>>> ServerData { get; set; }
1008: 
1009: // ✅ New (v9)
1010: public Func<GridState<T>, CancellationToken, Task<GridData<T>>> ServerData { get; set; }
1011: CssBuilder and StyleBuilder
1012: CssBuilder and StyleBuilder are now declared as readonly struct for better performance by avoiding hidden defensive copies.
1013: 
1014: Warning
1015: 
1016: Breaking Change: default(CssBuilder) and default(StyleBuilder) will now throw NullReferenceException at runtime and are no longer supported.
1017: 
1018: Migration required if you were using:
1019: 
1020: ❌ Don't use:
1021: 
1022: var cssBuilder = default(CssBuilder);
1023: cssBuilder.AddClass("my-class"); // NullReferenceException!
1024: 
1025: var styleBuilder = default(StyleBuilder);
1026: styleBuilder.AddStyle("color", "red"); // NullReferenceException!
1027: ✅ Use instead:
1028: 
1029: // Option 1: Use constructor
1030: var cssBuilder = new CssBuilder();
1031: cssBuilder.AddClass("my-class");
1032: 
1033: var styleBuilder = new StyleBuilder();
1034: styleBuilder.AddStyle("color", "red");
1035: 
1036: // Option 2: Use static factory methods
1037: var cssBuilder = CssBuilder.Default()
1038:     .AddClass("my-class");
1039: 
1040: var styleBuilder = StyleBuilder.Default()
1041:     .AddStyle("color", "red");
1042: 
1043: // Option 3: Use builder pattern (recommended)
1044: var classes = new CssBuilder("base-class")
1045:     .AddClass("additional-class", when: someCondition)
1046:     .Build();
1047: 
1048: var styles = new StyleBuilder("display", "flex")
1049:     .AddStyle("color", color.ToString())
1050:     .Build();
1051: More details: #12598
1052: 
1053: MudFileUpload - IActivator Removal and Default Behavior
1054: Status: Breaking Change - Activation Pattern Changed
1055: 
1056: MudFileUpload no longer implements IActivator. The ActivationContent parameter has been replaced with CustomContent, and the activation behavior has changed.
1057: 
1058: Breaking Changes
1059: 1. ActivationContent Renamed to CustomContent:
1060: 
1061: // ❌ Old (v8)
1062: <MudFileUpload>
1063:     <ActivationContent>
1064:         <MudButton>Select File</MudButton>
1065:     </ActivationContent>
1066: </MudFileUpload>
1067: 
1068: // ✅ New (v9)
1069: <MudFileUpload>
1070:     <CustomContent Context="fileUpload">
1071:         <MudButton OnClick="@fileUpload.OpenFilePickerAsync">Select File</MudButton>
1072:     </CustomContent>
1073: </MudFileUpload>
1074: 2. Activate Method Removed:
1075: 
1076: // ❌ Old (v8)
1077: MudFileUpload fileUpload;
1078: 
1079: await fileUpload.Activate(args);
1080: 
1081: // ✅ New (v9)
1082: MudFileUpload fileUpload;
1083: 
1084: await fileUpload.OpenFilePickerAsync();
1085: 3. CustomContent No Longer Auto-Opens Picker:
1086: 
1087: Caution
1088: 
1089: In v8, ActivationContent automatically opened the file picker when clicked. In v9, CustomContent requires you to manually call OpenFilePickerAsync() via an OnClick handler.
1090: 
1091: @* ❌ Old (v8) - Automatic activation *@
1092: <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile">
1093:     <ActivationContent>
1094:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary">
1095:             Select File
1096:         </MudButton>
1097:     </ActivationContent>
1098: </MudFileUpload>
1099: 
1100: @* ✅ New (v9) - Manual activation required *@
1101: <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile">
1102:     <CustomContent Context="fileUpload">
1103:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" 
1104:                    OnClick="@fileUpload.OpenFilePickerAsync">
1105:             Select File
1106:         </MudButton>
1107:     </CustomContent>
1108: </MudFileUpload>
1109: New Features and Improvements
1110: 1. Default File List Rendering:
1111: 
1112: If SelectedTemplate is not provided, MudFileUpload now renders a default file list automatically:
1113: 
1114: @* Simple usage - Shows default file list *@
1115: <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile" 
1116:                @bind-Files="_files" 
1117:                MaximumFileCount="10" />
1118: 
1119: @* Hide default file list *@
1120: <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile" 
1121:                @bind-Files="_files">
1122:     <SelectedTemplate></SelectedTemplate>
1123: </MudFileUpload>
1124: 2. Built-in Drag and Drop:
1125: 
1126: MudFileUpload now has native drag-and-drop support:
1127: 
1128: <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile" 
1129:                @bind-Files="_files"
1130:                DragAndDrop="true"
1131:                Dragging="@_isDragging">
1132:     <CustomContent Context="fileUpload">
1133:         <MudText>Drag files here or click to browse</MudText>
1134:     </CustomContent>
1135: </MudFileUpload>
1136: 
1137: @code {
1138:     private IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile> _files = new List<IBrowserFile>();
1139:     private bool _isDragging;
1140: }
1141: 3. New Public Methods:
1142: 
1143: // Get list of filenames
1144: IReadOnlyList<string> filenames = fileUpload.GetFilenames();
1145: 
1146: // Remove specific file by name
1147: await fileUpload.RemoveFile("document.pdf");
1148: 
1149: // Open file picker programmatically
1150: await fileUpload.OpenFilePickerAsync();
1151: Migration Examples
1152: Example 1: Simple File Upload with Custom Button
1153: 
1154: @* ❌ Old (v8) *@
1155: <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile" @bind-Files="_files">
1156:     <ActivationContent>
1157:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary">
1158:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Upload" Class="mr-2" />
1159:             Upload File
1160:         </MudButton>
1161:     </ActivationContent>
1162:     <SelectedTemplate>
1163:         @if (_files != null)
1164:         {
1165:             <MudText>Selected: @_files.Name</MudText>
1166:         }
1167:     </SelectedTemplate>
1168: </MudFileUpload>
1169: 
1170: @* ✅ New (v9) *@
1171: <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile" @bind-Files="_files">
1172:     <CustomContent Context="fileUpload">
1173:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" 
1174:                    Color="Color.Primary"
1175:                    OnClick="@fileUpload.OpenFilePickerAsync">
1176:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Upload" Class="mr-2" />
1177:             Upload File
1178:         </MudButton>
1179:     </CustomContent>
1180:     <SelectedTemplate>
1181:         @if (_files != null)
1182:         {
1183:             <MudText>Selected: @_files.Name</MudText>
1184:         }
1185:     </SelectedTemplate>
1186: </MudFileUpload>
1187: Example 2: Drag and Drop with Custom Zone
1188: 
1189: @* New in v9 - Built-in drag and drop *@
1190: <MudFileUpload T="IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile>" 
1191:                @bind-Files="_files"
1192:                DragAndDrop="true"
1193:                Dragging="@_isDragging"
1194:                MaximumFileCount="5">
1195:     <CustomContent Context="fileUpload">
1196:         <MudPaper Outlined="true" 
1197:                   Class="@(_isDragging ? "mud-primary-text" : "")"
1198:                   Style="min-height: 200px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;">
1199:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
1200:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CloudUpload" Size="Size.Large" />
1201:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
1202:                     Drag files here or 
1203:                     <MudLink OnClick="@fileUpload.OpenFilePickerAsync">click to browse</MudLink>
1204:                 </MudText>
1205:             </MudStack>
1206:         </MudPaper>
1207:     </CustomContent>
1208: </MudFileUpload>
1209: 
1210: @code {
1211:     private IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile> _files = new List<IBrowserFile>();
1212:     private bool _isDragging;
1213: }
1214: Example 3: Using Default File List
1215: 
1216: @* New in v9 - Default rendering without SelectedTemplate *@
1217: <MudFileUpload T="IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile>" 
1218:                @bind-Files="_files"
1219:                MaximumFileCount="10" />
1220: 
1221: @* The above automatically renders:
1222:    - A button to select files
1223:    - A list of selected files
1224:    - Remove buttons for each file
1225: *@
1226: Example 4: Programmatic File Removal
1227: 
1228: <MudFileUpload @ref="_fileUpload" 
1229:                T="IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile>" 
1230:                @bind-Files="_files" />
1231: 
1232: <MudButton OnClick="RemoveFirstFile">Remove First File</MudButton>
1233: 
1234: @code {
1235:     private MudFileUpload<IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile>> _fileUpload;
1236:     private IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile> _files = new List<IBrowserFile>();
1237: 
1238:     private async Task RemoveFirstFile()
1239:     {
1240:         var filenames = _fileUpload.GetFilenames();
1241:         if (filenames.Any())
1242:         {
1243:             await _fileUpload.RemoveFile(filenames.First());
1244:         }
1245:     }
1246: }
1247: Summary of Changes
1248: v8	v9
1249: <ActivationContent>	<CustomContent Context="fileUpload">
1250: Auto-opens picker on click	Manual OnClick="@fileUpload.OpenFilePickerAsync" required
1251: Activate(args) method	OpenFilePickerAsync() method
1252: No default file list	Default file list rendered if SelectedTemplate is empty
1253: No built-in drag & drop	DragAndDrop="true" parameter
1254: No drag state tracking	Dragging parameter
1255: No file management API	GetFilenames(), RemoveFile() methods
1256: More details: #10487
1257: 
1258: Modal Default Changed (#12101)
1259: The default value of the Modal parameter for popover-based components
1260: has changed from true to false.
1261: 
1262: Impact: - Popovers no longer block background interaction by
1263: default. - Applications relying on modal overlay behavior must now opt
1264: in explicitly.
1265: 
1266: If you want the previous behavior, explicitly set:
1267: 
1268: <MudMenu Modal="true">
1269: Popover Flipping Behavior (#12298)
1270: Popover Configuration Consolidated (#12286)
1271: Popover Overflow Behavior (#12411)
1272: Popover flipping behavior is now controlled exclusively through
1273: PopoverOptions with a default of FlipAlways.
1274: 
1275: Impact: - Popovers now flip more aggressively to remain within the
1276: viewport. - Visual placement behavior may differ from previous versions.
1277: Impact: - MudGlobal.PopoverDefaults has been removed. -
1278: Impact: - Flipping behavior must be configured through
1279: PopoverOptions
1280: Impact: - Component-level flipping configuration is no longer
1281: supported.
1282: 
1283: Configure flipping via Program.cs or where you add your MudServices:
1284: 
1285:             services.AddMudServices(config =>
1286:             {
1287:                 config.SnackbarConfiguration.PositionClass = Defaults.Classes.Position.BottomLeft;
1288:                 config.PopoverOptions.OverflowBehavior = OverflowBehavior.FlipNever;
1289:             });
1290: Other Changes
1291: PopoverOptions.Mode: PopoverOptions.Mode / PopoverMode was removed. #12596
1292: MudSelect: SelectOption(object?) method parameter type changed from object? to T?. #12623
1293: MudBaseInput: TextUpdateSuppression parameter removed from all derived components. #12306
1294: MudBaseInput: ForceUpdate() method removed from all derived input components. #12542
1295: MudSelect: WaitForRender() method removed. #12541
1296: MudSelect: Open parameter now supports two-way binding with @bind-Open. #12589
1297: MudCollapse: Content now rendered inside a <span> element for better structure. #12590
1298: MudColorPicker: Fixed support for null color values and improved throttling. #12567
1299: MudDialogContainer: OnMouseUp event handler renamed to OnMouseUpAsync and is now private. #12514
1300: MudThemeProvider: ObserveSystemThemeChange parameter renamed to ObserveSystemDarkModeChange for consistency. Removed obsolete methods: GetSystemPreference(), WatchSystemPreference(), and SystemPreferenceChanged() (use GetSystemDarkModeAsync(), WatchSystemDarkModeAsync(), and SystemDarkModeChangedAsync() instead). #12022
1301: MudLink: Typo parameter now defaults to Typo.inherit (was Typo.body1) to automatically match surrounding text typography. #12094
1302: MudSnackbar: Snackbars with action buttons now require interaction by default (won't auto-dismiss) following Material Design 3 guidelines. Explicitly set RequireInteraction to override this behavior. #12108
1303: MudTabs: TabPanelClass renamed to TabButtonsClass (applies to all tab buttons). PanelClass renamed to TabPanelsClass (applies to panel wrapper). MudTabPanel: Class now only applies to the button element; added new PanelClass property to style the panel element. #12156
1304: Masking API: MaskChar converted to immutable readonly struct (use constructor). RegexMask.Delimiters → DelimiterCharacters. IMask.Mask and IMask.Text now non-nullable. BaseMask protected fields now private (use protected properties/methods). #12314
1305: IScrollListener: Changed from IDisposable to IAsyncDisposable - use await DisposeAsync() instead of Dispose(). Added ReportRateMs property (default: 10ms) to control scroll reporting rate. Added GetCurrentScrollDataAsync() method to get current scroll position without user input. Added ScrollEventArgs.ClientHeight and ScrollEventArgs.ClientWidth properties. IScrollListenerFactory.Create() now has overload with reportRateMs parameter. #12183
````

````razor
 1: @page "/Error"
 2: @using System.Diagnostics
 3: 
 4: <PageTitle>Error</PageTitle>
 5: 
 6: <h1 class="text-danger">Error.</h1>
 7: <h2 class="text-danger">An error occurred while processing your request.</h2>
 8: 
 9: @if (ShowRequestId)
10: {
11:     <p>
12:         <strong>Request ID:</strong> <code>@RequestId</code>
13:     </p>
14: }
15: 
16: <h3>Development Mode</h3>
17: <p>
18:     Swapping to <strong>Development</strong> environment will display more detailed information about the error that occurred.
19: </p>
20: <p>
21:     <strong>The Development environment shouldn't be enabled for deployed applications.</strong>
22:     It can result in displaying sensitive information from exceptions to end users.
23:     For local debugging, enable the <strong>Development</strong> environment by setting the <strong>ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT</strong> environment variable to <strong>Development</strong>
24:     and restarting the app.
25: </p>
26: 
27: @code{
28:     [CascadingParameter]
29:     private HttpContext? HttpContext { get; set; }
30: 
31:     private string? RequestId { get; set; }
32:     private bool ShowRequestId => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(RequestId);
33: 
34:     protected override void OnInitialized() =>
35:         RequestId = Activity.Current?.Id ?? HttpContext?.TraceIdentifier;
36: }
````
