## File: docs/RENDER_POLICIES.md
````markdown
  1: # Render Policies
  2: 
  3: > **Policy-Based UI Rendering Architecture**
  4: >
  5: > This document describes how the platform manages Blazor render modes dynamically
  6: > based on policies, not hardcoded configurations.
  7: 
  8: **Last Updated**: January 2026
  9: 
 10: ---
 11: 
 12: ## Overview
 13: 
 14: The platform uses a **Policy-Based Render Mode System** that separates technical implementation (Server, WebAssembly, Auto) from business decisions (which pages need which level of interactivity). This enables Instance Admins to optimize resource usage without code changes.
 15: 
 16: ---
 17: 
 18: ## The Problem
 19: 
 20: ### Traditional Approach Issues
 21: 
 22: - Render modes hardcoded per component
 23: - Changing modes requires code deployment
 24: - One-size-fits-all doesn't match varied tenant needs
 25: - Resource optimization is developer-driven, not operations-driven
 26: 
 27: ### Policy-Based Solution
 28: 
 29: - Pages classified by logical type, not technical mode
 30: - Policies map logical types to render modes
 31: - Instance Admin controls the mapping
 32: - Tenant Admin may override (if permitted)
 33: 
 34: ---
 35: 
 36: ## Page Classification System
 37: 
 38: ### Logical Page Types
 39: 
 40: Pages are tagged with a logical classification, independent of render technology:
 41: 
 42: | Type | Characteristics | Examples |
 43: |------|-----------------|----------|
 44: | **Content** | Read-heavy, cacheable, SEO-important | Listings, blogs, public profiles |
 45: | **Operational** | Interactive, form-heavy, real-time updates | Dashboards, editors, admin panels |
 46: | **Transactional** | Critical operations, payment flows | Checkout, registration completion |
 47: | **Static** | Rarely changes, no interactivity | About, legal, help pages |
 48: 
 49: ### Classification Guidelines
 50: 
 51: | Criteria | Content | Operational |
 52: |----------|---------|-------------|
 53: | User interaction | Low | High |
 54: | Data freshness | Can be stale | Must be current |
 55: | SEO importance | High | Low |
 56: | Server load | Low per view | Higher per session |
 57: 
 58: ---
 59: 
 60: ## Render Mode Options
 61: 
 62: ### Available Modes
 63: 
 64: | Mode | Description | Best For |
 65: |------|-------------|----------|
 66: | **Static** | Pre-rendered, no interactivity | Content pages, SEO |
 67: | **Server** | SignalR connection, server-side execution | Operational pages, complex logic |
 68: | **WebAssembly** | Client-side execution | Offline capability, reduced server load |
 69: | **Auto** | Server initially, transitions to WASM | Best of both worlds |
 70: 
 71: ### Mode Trade-offs
 72: 
 73: | Factor | Static | Server | WASM | Auto |
 74: |--------|--------|--------|------|------|
 75: | Initial load | ⚡ Fastest | Fast | Slow | Fast |
 76: | Interactivity | ❌ None | ✅ Full | ✅ Full | ✅ Full |
 77: | Server resources | ⚡ Minimal | ⬆️ Higher | ⚡ Minimal | Medium |
 78: | Offline support | ❌ No | ❌ No | ✅ Yes | ⚡ Partial |
 79: | SEO | ✅ Best | ✅ Good | ⚠️ Challenging | ✅ Good |
 80: 
 81: ---
 82: 
 83: ## Policy Definition
 84: 
 85: ### Resolution Matrix
 86: 
 87: Instance Admin defines how page types map to render modes:
 88: 
 89: | Policy Name | Content | Operational | Transactional | Use Case |
 90: |-------------|---------|-------------|---------------|----------|
 91: | **Performance Saver** | Static | WASM | Server | Free tier, low server cost |
 92: | **Premium Fast** | Static | Server | Server | Paid tier, responsiveness priority |
 93: | **Modern Edge** | Auto | Auto | Auto | Modern devices, best UX |
 94: | **Compatibility** | Static | Server | Server | Legacy browser support |
 95: 
 96: ### Policy Assignment
 97: 
 98: | Level | Can Assign | Constraints |
 99: |-------|------------|-------------|
100: | System Default | Implicit | Fallback only |
101: | Instance | Instance Admin | Any combination |
102: | Tenant | Tenant Admin | Within allowed set |
103: 
104: ---
105: 
106: ## Implementation Architecture
107: 
108: ### Policy Resolution Flow
109: 
110: 1. **Page Request** → User navigates to page
111: 2. **Type Lookup** → System identifies page's logical type
112: 3. **Policy Check** → Resolver queries current policy
113: 4. **Mode Selection** → Policy maps type to render mode
114: 5. **Rendering** → Page renders with selected mode
115: 
116: ### Policy Service Interface
117: 
118: The policy service answers: "Given this page type and context, what render mode should be used?"
119: 
120: **Inputs**:
121: - Page type (Content, Operational, etc.)
122: - Tenant context (if any)
123: - Device hints (optional)
124: - User preferences (optional)
125: 
126: **Output**:
127: - Render mode to apply
128: 
129: ### Dynamic Wrapper Component
130: 
131: A wrapper component at the layout level:
132: 1. Reads the policy for the current page type
133: 2. Applies the resolved render mode
134: 3. Renders the actual page content
135: 
136: ---
137: 
138: ## Configuration Model
139: 
140: ### Instance-Level Settings
141: 
142: | Setting | Values | Default |
143: |---------|--------|---------|
144: | Default Policy | Policy name | "Modern Edge" |
145: | Allow Tenant Override | Boolean | true |
146: | Allowed Tenant Policies | Policy list | All |
147: 
148: ### Tenant-Level Settings
149: 
150: | Setting | Values | Constraint |
151: |---------|--------|------------|
152: | Active Policy | Policy name | Must be in allowed set |
153: | Custom Mappings | Type → Mode | If customization enabled |
154: 
155: ---
156: 
157: ## Optimization Strategies
158: 
159: ### Resource-Based Policies
160: 
161: | Tenant Tier | Recommended Policy | Rationale |
162: |-------------|-------------------|-----------|
163: | Free | Performance Saver | Minimize server usage |
164: | Standard | Modern Edge | Balanced experience |
165: | Premium | Premium Fast | Best responsiveness |
166: | Enterprise | Custom | Tailored to needs |
167: 
168: ### Time-Based Policies
169: 
170: Policies can vary by time of day or load conditions:
171: 
172: | Condition | Policy | Rationale |
173: |-----------|--------|-----------|
174: | Peak hours | Performance Saver | Reduce server strain |
175: | Off-peak | Premium Fast | Better UX when capacity available |
176: | High load | Performance Saver | Graceful degradation |
177: 
178: ---
179: 
180: ## Migration Path
181: 
182: ### From Hardcoded to Policy-Based
183: 
184: 1. **Audit** - Document current render mode per component
185: 2. **Classify** - Assign logical type to each page
186: 3. **Create Baseline** - Define policy matching current behavior
187: 4. **Implement Wrapper** - Add policy resolution to layout
188: 5. **Test** - Verify equivalent behavior
189: 6. **Enable Policies** - Expose policy selection to admins
190: 7. **Optimize** - Create additional policies for different scenarios
191: 
192: ---
193: 
194: ## Related Documentation
195: 
196: - **[BLAZOR.md](BLAZOR.md)** - Blazor architecture overview
197: - **[MULTI_TENANCY.md](MULTI_TENANCY.md)** - Tenant configuration
198: - **[ADMIN_HIERARCHY.md](ADMIN_HIERARCHY.md)** - Policy authority
199: 
200: ## Implementation Reference
201: 
202: For code patterns:
203: - **`blazor-bff-patterns`** skill - BFF and rendering
204: - **`blazor-ui-conventions`** skill - Component patterns
````

## File: docs/semantic_versioning/CHANGELOG.md
````markdown
  1: # Changelog — ISLAMU Event Platform
  2: 
  3: > All notable changes to this project are documented in semantic version files.
  4: > This project follows [Semantic Versioning 2.0.0](https://semver.org/).
  5: >
  6: > **Pre-1.0 Convention**: Major version zero (0.y.z) indicates initial development. The public API may change at any time and should not be considered stable. This release is intended for beta testing, early adopters, and feedback gathering.
  7: 
  8: **Last Updated:** 2026-02-13
  9: 
 10: ---
 11: 
 12: ## Version History
 13: 
 14: | Version | Title | Released | Status |
 15: |---------|-------|----------|--------|
 16: | [v0.1.0](v0.1.0.md) | First Public Release (Beta) | TBD | 🚀 **CURRENT** |
 17: 
 18: ---
 19: 
 20: ## Versioning Policy
 21: 
 22: ### Current Phase: Pre-1.0 Beta (0.1.0)
 23: 
 24: **What does 0.1.0 mean?**
 25: - **First publicly-usable release** ready for beta testing and early adopter feedback
 26: - **Major version zero (0.y.z)** signals: "Initial development — anything may change"
 27: - **API not yet stable**: Breaking changes may occur in any release before 1.0.0
 28: - **Production use at your own risk**: While feature-complete, the public API is not guaranteed stable
 29: 
 30: **Recommended version**: 0.1.0 (not 0.0.1) per [Semantic Versioning best practices](https://semver.org/)
 31: 
 32: ### Progression to 1.0.0
 33: 
 34: The project will reach **v1.0.0** when:
 35: 1. ✅ The public REST API surface is stable and documented *(complete)*
 36: 2. ✅ Core event management features are production-ready *(complete)*
 37: 3. ✅ Multi-tenancy and organization workflows are validated *(complete)*
 38: 4. ⏳ Federation endpoints (ATProto/ActivityPub) are operational *(Phase 2 planned)*
 39: 5. ⏳ Production deployment validated with real tenants *(in progress)*
 40: 6. ⏳ Test coverage meets minimum thresholds across all 7 test projects *(in progress)*
 41: 7. ⏳ Public beta feedback incorporated *(awaiting beta users)*
 42: 
 43: **Timeline**: v1.0.0 targeted for Q2 2026 after federation implementation and public beta validation.
 44: 
 45: ---
 46: 
 47: ## Categories Used
 48: 
 49: | Emoji | Category | Description |
 50: |-------|----------|-------------|
 51: | 🚀 | Features | New functionality |
 52: | 🔒 | Security | Authentication, authorization, vulnerability fixes |
 53: | 🔄 | Refactor | Code improvements without behavior change |
 54: | 🐛 | Fixes | Bug fixes |
 55: | 🎨 | Styling | UI/UX and CSS changes |
 56: | 🧪 | Testing | Test additions or improvements |
 57: | 📦 | Dependencies | Dependency additions or updates |
 58: | 🔧 | Chore | Tooling, CI, configuration |
 59: 
 60: ---
 61: 
 62: ## Technology Stack (v0.1.0)
 63: 
 64: | Component | Technology | Version |
 65: |-----------|------------|---------|
 66: | Runtime | .NET | 10.0 |
 67: | Orchestration | .NET Aspire | Latest |
 68: | Frontend | Blazor | Server + WebAssembly (InteractiveAuto) |
 69: | UI Components | MudBlazor | Latest |
 70: | Database | PostgreSQL + PostGIS | 16+ |
 71: | ORM | Entity Framework Core | 10 |
 72: | Authentication | Keycloak | OIDC/OAuth 2.0 |
 73: | Authorization | Cerbos | PDP |
 74: | Secrets | Infisical | Latest |
 75: | API Docs | Scalar + Swagger/NSwag | Latest |
 76: | Logging | Serilog | Latest |
 77: | Telemetry | OpenTelemetry | Latest |
 78: | Federation | ATProto / ActivityPub | Phase 1 (data models only) |
 79: 
 80: ---
 81: 
 82: ## Feature Checklist
 83: 
 84: ### ✅ Implemented in v0.1.0
 85: - [x] Event Management (CRUD, sessions, registration, advanced filtering)
 86: - [x] Organization Management (CRUD, members, roles, reviews)
 87: - [x] User Management & Authentication (Keycloak OIDC, BFF pattern)
 88: - [x] Multi-Tenancy (single-tenant and SaaS deployment modes)
 89: - [x] Fine-Grained Authorization (Cerbos PDP, resource-level policies)
 90: - [x] Secrets Management (Infisical with environment variable fallback)
 91: - [x] Object Storage (S3-compatible with presigned URLs)
 92: - [x] Email Service (SMTP with resilience pipelines)
 93: - [x] Event Aspects (Islamic module, Tech module, modular extensibility)
 94: - [x] HATEOAS REST API (Level 3, HAL+JSON, 18 link policies)
 95: - [x] Blazor Frontend MVP (44 pages, MudBlazor components)
 96: - [x] API Documentation (Scalar + Swagger with OpenAPI 3.0)
 97: - [x] Soft Delete & Audit Trail (full audit with who/when deleted)
 98: - [x] Query Specifications (33 parameters, fluent builder, module-conditional)
 99: - [x] Multi-Level Caching (Output + HybridCache)
100: - [x] Observability (Serilog + OpenTelemetry + PLG stack)
101: - [x] CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions + Docker + ATCR)
102: - [x] Test Coverage (7 test projects, TUnit, bUnit, architecture tests)
103: 
104: ### ⏳ Planned for 1.0.0
105: - [ ] Federation Endpoints (WebFinger, Actor endpoints, Inbox/Outbox)
106: - [ ] Federation Protocol Logic (ATProto PDS, AppView indexing)
107: - [ ] ActivityPub Bridge (ATProto ↔ ActivityPub gateway)
108: - [ ] DID Resolution (PLC/DNS-based)
109: - [ ] HTTP Signatures (federation authentication)
110: - [ ] Moderation System (content review workflows)
111: - [ ] Mobile Optimization (responsive design improvements)
112: - [ ] Real-Time Notifications (SignalR, push notifications)
113: - [ ] Rate Limiting (sliding window per IP/user)
114: - [ ] Security Headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
115: 
116: ---
117: 
118: ## Semantic Versioning References
119: 
120: ### Official Resources
121: - [Semantic Versioning 2.0.0](https://semver.org/) — Official semver specification
122: - [Best Practices for 0.y.z Versioning](https://talent500.com/blog/semantic-versioning-explained-guide/) — Starting with 0.1.0
123: - [Software Versioning on Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Software_versioning) — Historical context
124: 
125: ### Key Takeaways
126: 1. **Start with 0.1.0** (not 0.0.1) for first public release
127: 2. **Major version zero** (0.y.z) signals initial development
128: 3. **API instability expected** until 1.0.0
129: 4. **Minor version bumps** (0.y.0) indicate new features
130: 5. **Patch version bumps** (0.y.z) indicate bug fixes
131: 6. **Pre-release labels** (0.1.0-beta.1) for testing builds
132: 
133: ---
134: 
135: **Ready for beta testing and early adopter feedback. API may change before 1.0.0 stable release.**
````

````csharp
199:     {

201:             .FirstOrDefault(b => b.TextContent.Contains(text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
202:

208:         button.Click();
````

````csharp
371:             _responseFactory = responseFactory;
372:         }
373: 
374:         protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
375:         {
376:             return Task.FromResult(_responseFactory(request));
````

````csharp
362:             {

364:             }
365:         };
````

````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Sidebar layout component for Group Admin Settings. *@

 48:             @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))

 53:             <MudGrid Spacing="4">

 89: @code {
 90:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
 91:     public Guid GroupId { get; set; }
 92: 
 93:     private GroupAdminDetailsModel? _group;
 94:     private UpdateGroupDto _model = new() { FullName = string.Empty };
 95:     private GroupBrandingSettings _branding = new();
 96:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 97:     private bool _isSaving;
 98:     private string? _errorMessage;
 99:     private string _currentSection = "profile";
100: 
101:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
102:     {
103:         await LoadGroupAsync();
104:     }
105: 
106:     private async Task LoadGroupAsync()
107:     {
108:         _isLoading = true;
109:         _errorMessage = null;
110:         try
111:         {
112:             _group = await GroupService.GetGroupDetailsAsync(GroupId);
113:             if (_group != null)
114:             {
115:                 _model = new UpdateGroupDto
116:                 {
117:                     FullName = _group.FullName,
118:                     Description = _group.Description,
119:                     MetadataJson = _group.MetadataJson
120:                 };
121:                 _branding = GroupBrandingMetadataHelper.Parse(_group.MetadataJson);
122:             }
123:         }
124:         catch (Exception ex)
125:         {
126:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load group settings: {ex.Message}";
127:         }
128:         finally
129:         {
130:             _isLoading = false;
131:         }
132:     }
133: 
134:     private async Task SaveAsync()
135:     {
136:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.FullName))
137:         {
138:             _errorMessage = "Group name is required.";
139:             return;
140:         }
141: 
142:         _isSaving = true;
143:         _errorMessage = null;
144:         try
145:         {
146:             _model.MetadataJson = GroupBrandingMetadataHelper.Upsert(_model.MetadataJson, _branding);
147:             var response = await GroupService.UpdateGroupAsync(GroupId, _model);
148: 
149:             if (response?.Success == true)
150:             {
151:                 Snackbar.Add("Group settings saved.", Severity.Success);
152:                 await LoadGroupAsync();
153:                 return;
154:             }
155: 
156:             _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response?.Message)
157:                 ? "Failed to save group settings."
158:                 : response!.Message;
159:         }
160:         catch (Exception ex)
161:         {
162:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to save group settings: {ex.Message}";
163:         }
164:         finally
165:         {
166:             _isSaving = false;
167:         }
168:     }
169: 
170:     private string? GetAvatarUri()
171:     {
172:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_branding.PictureUrl))
173:         {
174:             return _branding.PictureUrl.Trim();
175:         }
176: 
177:         return _group?.ActorProfilePictureUri;
178:     }
179: 
180:     private void SelectSection(string section)
181:     {
182:         _currentSection = section;
183:     }
184: 
185:     private string GetNavItemClass(string section)
186:     {
187:         return _currentSection == section ? "settings-nav-active" : "";
188:     }
189: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Group/GroupMembersSection.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Group member management section for inviting, role updates, and removals. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Allows actions only to GroupCreator and GroupAdmin members of the current group. *@
  3: 
  4: @using System.Security.Claims
  5: @using MudBlazor
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  7: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers
  8: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  9: 
 10: @inject IGroupService GroupService
 11: @inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
 12: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 13: @inject IDialogService DialogService
 14: 
 15: <div class="settings-section">
 16:     <div class="settings-section-header">
 17:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Group Members</MudText>
 18:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">
 19:             Add new members and manage group roles.
 20:         </MudText>
 21:     </div>
 22: 
 23:     @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))
 24:     {
 25:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-4">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     @if (_isLoading)
 29:     {
 30:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />
 31:     }
 32:     else
 33:     {
 34:         @if (_canManage)
 35:         {
 36:             <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 mb-4 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
 37:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Class="mb-3" Style="font-weight: 600;">Invite Member</MudText>
 38:                 <MudGrid Spacing="2">
 39:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 40:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_inviteEmail"
 41:                                       Label="Member Email"
 42:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 43:                                       InputType="InputType.Email"
 44:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 45:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" />
 46:                     </MudItem>
 47:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 48:                         <MudSelect T="int"
 49:                                    Label="Role"
 50:                                    Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 51:                                    @bind-Value="_inviteRole">
 52:                             @foreach (var role in RoleHelper.GetAssignableGroupRoles())
 53:                             {
 54:                                 <MudSelectItem Value="@role.Id">@role.Name</MudSelectItem>
 55:                             }
 56:                         </MudSelect>
 57:                     </MudItem>
 58:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="2" Class="d-flex align-center">
 59:                         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 60:                                    Color="Color.Primary"
 61:                                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.PersonAdd"
 62:                                    OnClick="InviteMemberAsync"
 63:                                    Disabled="_isInviting"
 64:                                    FullWidth="true">
 65:                             @(_isInviting ? "Inviting..." : "Invite")
 66:                         </MudButton>
 67:                     </MudItem>
 68:                 </MudGrid>
 69:             </MudPaper>
 70:         }
 71:         else
 72:         {
 73:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true" Class="mb-4">
 74:                 You can view members, but only group administrators can make changes.
 75:             </MudAlert>
 76:         }
 77: 
 78:         <MudTable Items="_members" Hover="true" Striped="true" Elevation="0">
 79:             <HeaderContent>
 80:                 <MudTh>Member</MudTh>
 81:                 <MudTh>Email</MudTh>
 82:                 <MudTh>Role</MudTh>
 83:                 @if (_canManage)
 84:                 {
 85:                     <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Actions</MudTh>
 86:                 }
 87:             </HeaderContent>
 88:             <RowTemplate>
 89:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Member">
 90:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2">
 91:                         <MudAvatar Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 92:                             @GetInitial(context)
 93:                         </MudAvatar>
 94:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">@(context.UserFullName ?? context.UserEmail ?? "Unknown")</MudText>
 95:                     </div>
 96:                 </MudTd>
 97:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Email">
 98:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@context.UserEmail</MudText>
 99:                 </MudTd>
100:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Role">
101:                     <MudChip T="string"
102:                              Color="@RoleHelper.GetGroupRoleColor(context.RoleId)"
103:                              Size="Size.Small"
104:                              Variant="Variant.Filled">
105:                         @RoleHelper.GetGroupRoleName(context.RoleId)
106:                     </MudChip>
107:                 </MudTd>
108:                 @if (_canManage)
109:                 {
110:                     <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Style="text-align:right">
111:                         @if (context.Id.HasValue)
112:                         {
113:                             <MudStack Row="true" Spacing="1" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center">
114:                                 <MudSelect T="int"
115:                                            Value="@GetPendingRole(context)"
116:                                            ValueChanged="@((value) => SetPendingRole(context, value))"
117:                                            Dense="true"
118:                                            Disabled="@IsCreator(context)"
119:                                            Variant="Variant.Outlined"
120:                                            Style="min-width: 150px;">
121:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@RoleHelper.GroupCreator">Creator</MudSelectItem>
122:                                     @foreach (var role in RoleHelper.GetAssignableGroupRoles())
123:                                     {
124:                                         <MudSelectItem Value="@role.Id">@role.Name</MudSelectItem>
125:                                     }
126:                                 </MudSelect>
127:                                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Save"
128:                                                Color="Color.Primary"
129:                                                Disabled="@(!IsRoleChanged(context) || IsCreator(context) || _busyMemberId == context.Id)"
130:                                                OnClick="@(() => SaveRoleAsync(context))"
131:                                                Title="Save role" />
132:                                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
133:                                                Color="Color.Error"
134:                                                Disabled="@(IsCreator(context) || _busyMemberId == context.Id)"
135:                                                OnClick="@(() => RemoveMemberAsync(context))"
136:                                                Title="Remove member" />
137:                             </MudStack>
138:                         }
139:                     </MudTd>
140:                 }
141:             </RowTemplate>
142:             <NoRecordsContent>
143:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true">
144:                     No members found for this group.
145:                 </MudAlert>
146:             </NoRecordsContent>
147:         </MudTable>
148:     }
149: </div>
150: 
151: @code {
152:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
153:     public Guid GroupId { get; set; }
154: 
155:     private readonly List<GroupMemberDto> _members = [];
156:     private readonly Dictionary<Guid, int> _pendingRoles = [];
157:     private bool _isLoading = true;
158:     private bool _isInviting;
159:     private bool _canManage;
160:     private string? _errorMessage;
161:     private Guid? _currentUserId;
162:     private Guid? _busyMemberId;
163: 
164:     private string _inviteEmail = string.Empty;
165:     private int _inviteRole = RoleHelper.GroupMember;
166: 
167:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
168:     {
169:         await LoadAsync();
170:     }
171: 
172:     private async Task LoadAsync()
173:     {
174:         _isLoading = true;
175:         _errorMessage = null;
176:         try
177:         {
178:             var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
179:             _currentUserId = ExtractUserId(authState.User);
180: 
181:             _members.Clear();
182:             _members.AddRange(await GroupService.GetGroupMembersAsync(GroupId));
183: 
184:             _pendingRoles.Clear();
185:             foreach (var member in _members.Where(m => m.Id.HasValue))
186:             {
187:                 _pendingRoles[member.Id!.Value] = member.RoleId ?? RoleHelper.GroupMember;
188:             }
189: 
190:             var me = _members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == _currentUserId);
191:             _canManage = RoleHelper.CanManageGroup(me?.RoleId);
192:         }
193:         catch (Exception ex)
194:         {
195:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load members: {ex.Message}";
196:         }
197:         finally
198:         {
199:             _isLoading = false;
200:         }
201:     }
202: 
203:     private async Task InviteMemberAsync()
204:     {
205:         if (!_canManage)
206:         {
207:             return;
208:         }
209: 
210:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_inviteEmail))
211:         {
212:             Snackbar.Add("Email is required.", Severity.Warning);
213:             return;
214:         }
215: 
216:         _isInviting = true;
217:         _errorMessage = null;
218:         try
219:         {
220:             var response = await GroupService.AddGroupMemberAsync(new AddGroupMemberDto
221:             {
222:                 GroupId = GroupId,
223:                 Email = _inviteEmail.Trim(),
224:                 Role = _inviteRole
225:             });
226: 
227:             if (response?.Success == true)
228:             {
229:                 Snackbar.Add("Member added successfully.", Severity.Success);
230:                 _inviteEmail = string.Empty;
231:                 _inviteRole = RoleHelper.GroupMember;
232:                 await LoadAsync();
233:                 return;
234:             }
235: 
236:             _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response?.Message)
237:                 ? "Failed to add member."
238:                 : response!.Message;
239:         }
240:         catch (Exception ex)
241:         {
242:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to add member: {ex.Message}";
243:         }
244:         finally
245:         {
246:             _isInviting = false;
247:         }
248:     }
249: 
250:     private async Task SaveRoleAsync(GroupMemberDto member)
251:     {
252:         if (!_canManage || !member.Id.HasValue)
253:         {
254:             return;
255:         }
256: 
257:         _busyMemberId = member.Id.Value;
258:         _errorMessage = null;
259:         try
260:         {
261:             var response = await GroupService.UpdateGroupMemberRoleAsync(new UpdateGroupMemberRoleDto
262:             {
263:                 Id = member.Id.Value,
264:                 Role = GetPendingRole(member)
265:             });
266: 
267:             if (response?.Success == true)
268:             {
269:                 Snackbar.Add("Member role updated.", Severity.Success);
270:                 await LoadAsync();
271:                 return;
272:             }
273: 
274:             _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response?.Message)
275:                 ? "Failed to update member role."
276:                 : response!.Message;
277:         }
278:         catch (Exception ex)
279:         {
280:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to update member role: {ex.Message}";
281:         }
282:         finally
283:         {
284:             _busyMemberId = null;
285:         }
286:     }
287: 
288:     private async Task RemoveMemberAsync(GroupMemberDto member)
289:     {
290:         if (!_canManage || !member.Id.HasValue)
291:         {
292:             return;
293:         }
294: 
295:         var confirmed = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
296:             "Remove Member",
297:             $"Are you sure you want to remove {(member.UserEmail ?? member.UserFullName ?? "this member")} from the group?",
298:             yesText: "Remove",
299:             cancelText: "Cancel");
300: 
301:         if (confirmed != true)
302:         {
303:             return;
304:         }
305: 
306:         _busyMemberId = member.Id.Value;
307:         _errorMessage = null;
308:         try
309:         {
310:             var response = await GroupService.DeleteGroupMemberAsync(member.Id.Value);
311:             if (response?.Success == true)
312:             {
313:                 Snackbar.Add("Member removed.", Severity.Success);
314:                 await LoadAsync();
315:                 return;
316:             }
317: 
318:             _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response?.Message)
319:                 ? "Failed to remove member."
320:                 : response!.Message;
321:         }
322:         catch (Exception ex)
323:         {
324:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to remove member: {ex.Message}";
325:         }
326:         finally
327:         {
328:             _busyMemberId = null;
329:         }
330:     }
331: 
332:     private int GetPendingRole(GroupMemberDto member)
333:     {
334:         if (!member.Id.HasValue)
335:         {
336:             return member.RoleId ?? RoleHelper.GroupMember;
337:         }
338: 
339:         if (_pendingRoles.TryGetValue(member.Id.Value, out var pending))
340:         {
341:             return pending;
342:         }
343: 
344:         var current = member.RoleId ?? RoleHelper.GroupMember;
345:         _pendingRoles[member.Id.Value] = current;
346:         return current;
347:     }
348: 
349:     private void SetPendingRole(GroupMemberDto member, int roleId)
350:     {
351:         if (!member.Id.HasValue)
352:         {
353:             return;
354:         }
355: 
356:         _pendingRoles[member.Id.Value] = roleId;
357:     }
358: 
359:     private bool IsRoleChanged(GroupMemberDto member)
360:     {
361:         return member.Id.HasValue
362:             && _pendingRoles.TryGetValue(member.Id.Value, out var pending)
363:             && pending != (member.RoleId ?? RoleHelper.GroupMember);
364:     }
365: 
366:     private static bool IsCreator(GroupMemberDto member)
367:     {
368:         return member.RoleId == RoleHelper.GroupCreator;
369:     }
370: 
371:     private static string GetInitial(GroupMemberDto member)
372:     {
373:         var value = member.UserFullName ?? member.UserEmail;
374:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? "?" : value[..1].ToUpperInvariant();
375:     }
376: 
377:     private static Guid? ExtractUserId(ClaimsPrincipal user)
378:     {
379:         var raw = user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
380:             ?? user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
381:             ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
382: 
383:         return Guid.TryParse(raw, out var id) ? id : null;
384:     }
385: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Group/GroupProfileSection.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Editable profile and white-label branding section for group administration. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Updates group name, description, picture URL, and banner style metadata. *@
  3: 
  4: @using MudBlazor
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers
  7: 
  8: <div class="settings-section">
  9:     <div class="settings-section-header">
 10:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Profile & Branding</MudText>
 11:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">
 12:             Configure group identity, member-facing details, and white-label visuals.
 13:         </MudText>
 14:     </div>
 15: 
 16:     <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 17:         <MudItem xs="12">
 18:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="Model.FullName"
 19:                           Label="Group Name"
 20:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 21:                           Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 22:                           AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Groups"
 23:                           Required="true"
 24:                           RequiredError="Group name is required" />
 25:         </MudItem>
 26: 
 27:         <MudItem xs="12">
 28:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="Model.Description"
 29:                           Label="Description"
 30:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 31:                           Lines="4" />
 32:         </MudItem>
 33: 
 34:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 35:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="Branding.PictureUrl"
 36:                           Label="Picture URL"
 37:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 38:                           Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 39:                           AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Image" />
 40:         </MudItem>
 41: 
 42:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 43:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="Branding.BannerColor"
 44:                           Label="Banner Color"
 45:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 46:                           InputType="InputType.Color" />
 47:         </MudItem>
 48: 
 49:         <MudItem xs="12">
 50:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="Branding.BannerMediaUrl"
 51:                           Label="Banner Media URL"
 52:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 53:                           Placeholder="https://... (image or GIF)" />
 54:         </MudItem>
 55: 
 56:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 57:             <MudSelect T="string"
 58:                        Label="Banner Effect"
 59:                        Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 60:                        @bind-Value="Branding.BannerEffect">
 61:                 <MudSelectItem Value="@("None")">None</MudSelectItem>
 62:                 <MudSelectItem Value="@("SoftOverlay")">Soft Overlay</MudSelectItem>
 63:                 <MudSelectItem Value="@("StrongOverlay")">Strong Overlay</MudSelectItem>
 64:                 <MudSelectItem Value="@("Blur")">Blur</MudSelectItem>
 65:             </MudSelect>
 66:         </MudItem>
 67:     </MudGrid>
 68: 
 69:     <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
 70: 
 71:     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Class="mb-2">Preview</MudText>
 72:     <MudPaper Elevation="0"
 73:               Class="pa-6 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default"
 74:               Style="@GetPreviewStyle()">
 75:         <MudStack Row="true" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2">
 76:             @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Branding.PictureUrl))
 77:             {
 78:                 <MudAvatar Size="Size.Large" Rounded="true">
 79:                     <MudImage Src="@Branding.PictureUrl" Alt="Group picture preview" ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" />
 80:                 </MudAvatar>
 81:             }
 82:             else
 83:             {
 84:                 <MudAvatar Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" Rounded="true">
 85:                     @(Model.FullName.Length > 0 ? Model.FullName[..1].ToUpperInvariant() : "G")
 86:                 </MudAvatar>
 87:             }
 88:             <div>
 89:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700; color: white;">@Model.FullName</MudText>
 90:                 @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Description))
 91:                 {
 92:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);">@Model.Description</MudText>
 93:                 }
 94:             </div>
 95:         </MudStack>
 96:     </MudPaper>
 97: 
 98:     <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd" Class="mt-4">
 99:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
100:                    Color="Color.Primary"
101:                    OnClick="@(() => OnSave.InvokeAsync())"
102:                    Disabled="IsSaving"
103:                    StartIcon="@(_isSavingIcon)">
104:             @(IsSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Group Settings")
105:         </MudButton>
106:     </MudStack>
107: </div>
108: 
109: @code {
110:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
111:     public UpdateGroupDto Model { get; set; } = null!;
112: 
113:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
114:     public GroupBrandingSettings Branding { get; set; } = null!;
115: 
116:     [Parameter]
117:     public bool IsSaving { get; set; }
118: 
119:     [Parameter]
120:     public EventCallback OnSave { get; set; }
121: 
122:     private string _isSavingIcon => IsSaving
123:         ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassEmpty
124:         : Icons.Material.Filled.Save;
125: 
126:     private string GetPreviewStyle()
127:     {
128:         return GroupBrandingMetadataHelper.BuildBannerStyle(Branding, "#334155");
129:     }
130: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Instance/InstanceBrandingSection.razor
````razor
 1: @* ABOUTME: Renders default branding fields for the Instance Admin Settings sidebar. *@

10:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">

14:     <MudStack Spacing="3">
15:         <MudTextField Label="Brand Display Name"

19:         <MudTextField Label="Brand Logo URL"

36:         <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="Model.LockTenantBrandLogoUrl" Color="Color.Primary">
37:             Lock tenant brand logo
38:         </MudSwitch>
39: 
40:         <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="Model.LockTenantBrandFaviconUrl" Color="Color.Primary">
41:             Lock tenant brand favicon
42:         </MudSwitch>
43: 
44:         <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="Model.LockTenantBrandCustomCssUrl" Color="Color.Primary">
45:             Lock tenant custom CSS URL
46:         </MudSwitch>
47:     </MudStack>
48: </div>
49: 
50: @code {
51:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
52:     public InstanceGovernanceSettingsModel Model { get; set; } = null!;
53: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Instance/InstanceStorageSection.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Renders S3-compatible object storage configuration fields for Instance Admin Settings. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Includes endpoint, bucket, credentials, region, path style, and connection test button. *@
  3: 
  4: @using MudBlazor
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  6: 
  7: <div class="settings-section">
  8:     <div class="settings-section-header">
  9:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Object Storage (S3-Compatible)</MudText>
 10:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">
 11:             Configure S3-compatible object storage for file uploads, images, and media.
 12:             If settings are provided via a secret manager (e.g., Infisical), those values are used automatically and do not need to be entered here.
 13:         </MudText>
 14:     </div>
 15:     <MudStack Spacing="3">
 16:         <MudTextField Label="S3 Endpoint"
 17:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 18:                       @bind-Value="Model.S3Endpoint"
 19:                       Placeholder="https://fsn1.your-objectstorage.com"
 20:                       HelperText="S3-compatible endpoint URL (e.g., Hetzner, MinIO, AWS)" />
 21: 
 22:         <MudTextField Label="Public Endpoint (Optional)"
 23:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 24:                       @bind-Value="Model.S3PublicEndpoint"
 25:                       Placeholder="https://public.your-objectstorage.com"
 26:                       HelperText="Public endpoint for presigned URLs, if different from internal endpoint" />
 27: 
 28:         <MudTextField Label="Bucket Name"
 29:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 30:                       @bind-Value="Model.S3BucketName" />
 31: 
 32:         <MudTextField Label="Access Key ID"
 33:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 34:                       @bind-Value="Model.S3AccessKeyId" />
 35: 
 36:         <MudTextField Label="Secret Access Key"
 37:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 38:                       @bind-Value="Model.S3SecretAccessKey"
 39:                       InputType="InputType.Password" />
 40: 
 41:         <MudTextField Label="Region"
 42:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 43:                       @bind-Value="Model.S3Region"
 44:                       Placeholder="fsn1"
 45:                       HelperText="S3 region identifier (e.g., fsn1 for Hetzner, us-east-1 for AWS)" />
 46: 
 47:         <MudSwitch T="bool" @bind-Value="Model.S3ForcePathStyle" Color="Color.Primary">
 48:             Force path-style URLs (required by most non-AWS S3 providers)
 49:         </MudSwitch>
 50: 
 51:         <MudNumericField T="int" Label="Upload URL Expiration (minutes)"
 52:                          Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 53:                          @bind-Value="Model.S3UploadUrlExpirationMinutes"
 54:                          Min="1"
 55:                          Max="1440"
 56:                          HelperText="Presigned upload URL expiration time (1–1440 minutes)" />
 57: 
 58:         <MudDivider Class="my-2" />
 59: 
 60:         <MudStack Row="true" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2">
 61:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 62:                        Color="Color.Info"
 63:                        OnClick="TestConnectionAsync"
 64:                        Disabled="_isTesting"
 65:                        StartIcon="@(_isTesting ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassEmpty : Icons.Material.Filled.NetworkCheck)">
 66:                 @(_isTesting ? "Testing..." : "Test Connection")
 67:             </MudButton>
 68: 
 69:             @if (_testResult != null)
 70:             {
 71:                 <MudAlert Severity="@(_testResult.Success ? Severity.Success : Severity.Error)"
 72:                           Dense="true"
 73:                           NoIcon="false"
 74:                           Class="flex-grow-1">
 75:                     @_testResult.Message
 76:                 </MudAlert>
 77:             }
 78:         </MudStack>
 79:     </MudStack>
 80: </div>
 81: 
 82: @code {
 83:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
 84:     public InstanceStorageSettingsModel Model { get; set; } = null!;
 85: 
 86:     [Parameter]
 87:     public IInstanceOnboardingService? OnboardingService { get; set; }
 88: 
 89:     private bool _isTesting;
 90:     private StorageConnectionTestResult? _testResult;
 91: 
 92:     private async Task TestConnectionAsync()
 93:     {
 94:         if (OnboardingService == null)
 95:         {
 96:             return;
 97:         }
 98: 
 99:         _isTesting = true;
100:         _testResult = null;
101:         StateHasChanged();
102: 
103:         _testResult = await OnboardingService.TestStorageConnectionAsync();
104:         _isTesting = false;
105:     }
106: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Organization/OrganizationAdminSettingsLayout.razor
````razor
 1: @* ABOUTME: Sidebar layout component for Organization Admin Settings. *@
 2: @* ABOUTME: Provides Google-style sidebar navigation for organization profile, members, and verification. *@
 3: 
 4: @using MudBlazor
 5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 6: 
 7: @inject IOrganizationService OrganizationService
 8: 
 9: <div class="settings-layout">
10:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="py-8">
11:         @if (_isLoading)
12:         {
13:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Class="py-12">
14:                 <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
15:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">Loading organization settings...</MudText>
16:             </MudStack>
17:         }
18:         else if (_organization is null)
19:         {
20:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Class="mb-4">Organization not found.</MudAlert>
21:         }
22:         else
23:         {
24:             <!-- Header -->
25:             <div class="settings-header mb-8">
26:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">@_organization.FullName</MudText>
27:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-2">Organization settings and management</MudText>
28:             </div>
29: 
30:             <!-- Main Layout: Sidebar + Content -->
31:             <MudGrid Spacing="4">
32:                 <!-- Sidebar Navigation -->
33:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="3">
34:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="settings-sidebar pa-0 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
35:                         <MudList T="string" Dense="false" DisablePadding="true">
36:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business"
37:                                          Text="Profile"
38:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("profile")"
39:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("profile"))" />
40:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People"
41:                                          Text="Members"
42:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("members")"
43:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("members"))" />
44:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.VerifiedUser"
45:                                          Text="Verification"
46:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("verification")"
47:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("verification"))" />
48:                         </MudList>
49:                     </MudPaper>
50:                 </MudItem>
51: 
52:                 <!-- Content Area -->
53:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="9">
54:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="settings-content pa-6 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
55:                         @if (_currentSection == "profile")
56:                         {
57:                             <OrganizationProfileSection OrganizationId="OrganizationId" />
58:                         }
59:                         else if (_currentSection == "members")
60:                         {
61:                             <OrganizationMembersSection OrganizationId="OrganizationId" />
62:                         }
63:                         else if (_currentSection == "verification")
64:                         {
65:                             <OrganizationVerificationSection OrganizationId="OrganizationId" />
66:                         }
67:                     </MudPaper>
68:                 </MudItem>
69:             </MudGrid>
70:         }
71:     </MudContainer>
72: </div>
73: 
74: @code {
75:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
76:     public Guid OrganizationId { get; set; }
77: 
78:     private OrganizationDto? _organization;
79:     private bool _isLoading = true;
80:     private string _currentSection = "profile";
81: 
82:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
83:     {
84:         _organization = await OrganizationService.GetOrganizationByIdAsync(OrganizationId);
85:         _isLoading = false;
86:     }
87: 
88:     private void SelectSection(string section)
89:     {
90:         _currentSection = section;
91:     }
92: 
93:     private string GetNavItemClass(string section)
94:     {
95:         return _currentSection == section ? "settings-nav-active" : "";
96:     }
97: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Organization/OrganizationVerificationSection.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Displays the organization's current verification/approval status with a colored badge. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Part of the Organization Admin Settings sidebar layout. Read-only for non-admin users. *@
  3: 
  4: @using MudBlazor
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  6: @inject IOrganizationService OrganizationService
  7: 
  8: <div class="settings-section">
  9:     <div class="settings-section-header">
 10:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Verification Status</MudText>
 11:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">
 12:             Your organization's approval and verification standing.
 13:         </MudText>
 14:     </div>
 15: 
 16:     @if (_loading)
 17:     {
 18:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />
 19:     }
 20:     else if (_organization is null)
 21:     {
 22:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true">
 23:             Verification status could not be loaded.
 24:         </MudAlert>
 25:     }
 26:     else
 27:     {
 28:         <MudStack Spacing="3">
 29:             <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
 30:                 <MudStack Spacing="3">
 31:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
 32:                         <MudIcon Icon="@GetStatusIcon()" Color="@GetStatusColor()" Size="Size.Medium" />
 33:                         <div>
 34:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Style="font-weight: 600;">
 35:                                 @GetStatusLabel()
 36:                             </MudText>
 37:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">
 38:                                 @(_organization.ApprovalStatusFullName ?? "Unknown status")
 39:                             </MudText>
 40:                         </div>
 41:                         <MudSpacer />
 42:                         <MudChip T="string"
 43:                                  Color="@GetStatusColor()"
 44:                                  Size="Size.Small"
 45:                                  Variant="Variant.Filled">
 46:                             @GetStatusLabel()
 47:                         </MudChip>
 48:                     </div>
 49: 
 50:                     <MudDivider />
 51: 
 52:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
 53:                         @GetStatusDescription()
 54:                     </MudText>
 55:                 </MudStack>
 56:             </MudPaper>
 57: 
 58:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Info">
 59:                 Verification is managed by platform administrators. Verified organizations receive a badge
 60:                 on their public profile and gain access to additional features.
 61:             </MudAlert>
 62:         </MudStack>
 63:     }
 64: </div>
 65: 
 66: @code {
 67:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
 68:     public Guid OrganizationId { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     private const int StatusPending = 1;
 71:     private const int StatusApproved = 2;
 72:     private const int StatusRejected = 3;
 73: 
 74:     private OrganizationDto? _organization;
 75:     private bool _loading = true;
 76: 
 77:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 78:     {
 79:         _loading = true;
 80:         try
 81:         {
 82:             _organization = await OrganizationService.GetOrganizationByIdAsync(OrganizationId);
 83:         }
 84:         finally
 85:         {
 86:             _loading = false;
 87:         }
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     private string GetStatusLabel() => _organization?.ApprovalStatusId switch
 91:     {
 92:         StatusPending => "Pending",
 93:         StatusApproved => "Approved",
 94:         StatusRejected => "Rejected",
 95:         _ => "Unknown"
 96:     };
 97: 
 98:     private Color GetStatusColor() => _organization?.ApprovalStatusId switch
 99:     {
100:         StatusPending => Color.Warning,
101:         StatusApproved => Color.Success,
102:         StatusRejected => Color.Error,
103:         _ => Color.Default
104:     };
105: 
106:     private string GetStatusIcon() => _organization?.ApprovalStatusId switch
107:     {
108:         StatusPending => Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassTop,
109:         StatusApproved => Icons.Material.Filled.Verified,
110:         StatusRejected => Icons.Material.Filled.Cancel,
111:         _ => Icons.Material.Filled.HelpOutline
112:     };
113: 
114:     private string GetStatusDescription() => _organization?.ApprovalStatusId switch
115:     {
116:         StatusPending => "Your organization is currently under review. This process typically takes a few business days.",
117:         StatusApproved => "Your organization has been verified and approved. A verification badge is displayed on your public profile.",
118:         StatusRejected => "Your organization's verification request was not approved. Please contact support for more information.",
119:         _ => "The current verification status could not be determined."
120:     };
121: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Tenant/TenantBrandingSection.razor
````razor
 1: @* ABOUTME: Renders tenant branding fields for the Tenant Admin Settings sidebar. *@
 2: @* ABOUTME: Includes brand name, logo, favicon, and custom CSS URL fields with instance-level lock support. *@
 3: 
 4: @using MudBlazor
 5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 6: 
 7: <div class="settings-section">
 8:     <div class="settings-section-header">
 9:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Branding</MudText>
10:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">
11:             Customize your tenant's brand identity including display name, logo, and styling.
12:         </MudText>
13:     </div>
14:     <MudStack Spacing="3">
15:         @if (HasLockedFields)
16:         {
17:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Dense="true">
18:                 Some fields are locked by instance-level policies.
19:             </MudAlert>
20:         }
21: 
22:         <MudTextField Label="Brand Display Name"
23:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
24:                       @bind-Value="Model.BrandDisplayName"
25:                       Disabled="@(!Model.CanOverrideBrandDisplayName)" />
26: 
27:         <MudTextField Label="Brand Logo URL"
28:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
29:                       @bind-Value="Model.BrandLogoUrl"
30:                       Disabled="@(!Model.CanOverrideBrandLogoUrl)" />
31: 
32:         <MudTextField Label="Brand Favicon URL"
33:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
34:                       @bind-Value="Model.BrandFaviconUrl"
35:                       Disabled="@(!Model.CanOverrideBrandFaviconUrl)" />
36: 
37:         <MudTextField Label="Custom CSS URL"
38:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
39:                       @bind-Value="Model.BrandCustomCssUrl"
40:                       Disabled="@(!Model.CanOverrideBrandCustomCssUrl)"
41:                       HelperText="Optional advanced override for tenant-level custom stylesheet." />
42:     </MudStack>
43: </div>
44: 
45: @code {
46:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
47:     public TenantPolicySettingsModel Model { get; set; } = null!;
48: 
49:     private bool HasLockedFields =>
50:         !Model.CanOverrideBrandDisplayName ||
51:         !Model.CanOverrideBrandLogoUrl ||
52:         !Model.CanOverrideBrandFaviconUrl ||
53:         !Model.CanOverrideBrandCustomCssUrl;
54: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Tenant/TenantDomainSection.razor
````razor
 1: @* ABOUTME: Renders domain and home page settings for the Tenant Admin Settings sidebar. *@
 2: @* ABOUTME: Includes preferred home page, subdomain, and custom domain fields with instance-level lock support. *@
 3: 
 4: @using MudBlazor
 5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 6: 
 7: <div class="settings-section">
 8:     <div class="settings-section-header">
 9:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Domain & Navigation</MudText>
10:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">
11:             Configure your tenant's home page preference, subdomain, and custom domain.
12:         </MudText>
13:     </div>
14:     <MudStack Spacing="3">
15:         <MudSelect T="string"
16:                    Label="Preferred Home Page"
17:                    @bind-Value="Model.PreferredHomePage"
18:                    Variant="Variant.Outlined"
19:                    Disabled="@(!Model.CanOverrideHomePagePreference)">
20:             <MudSelectItem Value="@("EventList")">Event List</MudSelectItem>
21:             <MudSelectItem Value="@("LandingPage")">Landing Page</MudSelectItem>
22:         </MudSelect>
23: 
24:         <MudTextField Label="Subdomain"
25:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
26:                       @bind-Value="Model.Subdomain"
27:                       Disabled="@(!Model.CanOverrideSubdomain)"
28:                       HelperText="@($"{Model.Subdomain}.{Model.InstanceBaseDomain}")" />
29: 
30:         <MudTextField Label="Custom Domain"
31:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
32:                       @bind-Value="Model.CustomDomain"
33:                       Disabled="@(!Model.CanOverrideCustomDomain)"
34:                       Placeholder="custom.yourdomain.com" />
35:     </MudStack>
36: </div>
37: 
38: @code {
39:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
40:     public TenantPolicySettingsModel Model { get; set; } = null!;
41: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Tenant/TenantPoliciesSection.razor
````razor
 1: @* ABOUTME: Renders event and organization policy settings for the Tenant Admin Settings sidebar. *@
 2: @* ABOUTME: Includes user submission, approval, and verification switches with instance-level lock support. *@
 3: 
 4: @using MudBlazor
 5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 6: 
 7: <div class="settings-section">
 8:     <div class="settings-section-header">
 9:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Event & Organization Policies</MudText>
10:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">

12:         </MudText>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/TenantNavigationDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
 2: @using FluentValidation
 3: @using MudBlazor
 4: 
 5: <MudDialog>
 6:     <TitleContent>
 7:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
 8:             <MudIcon Icon="@(_isEdit ? Icons.Material.Filled.Edit : Icons.Material.Filled.Add)" Class="mr-3 mb-n1" />
 9:             @(_isEdit ? "Edit Navigation Link" : "Create Navigation Link")
10:         </MudText>
11:     </TitleContent>
12:     <DialogContent>
13:         <MudForm @ref="form" @bind-IsValid="success" Model="linkDto">
14:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="linkDto.Label" 
15:                           Label="Label" 
16:                           For="@(() => linkDto.Label)" 
17:                           Required="true" 
18:                           RequiredError="Label is required." 
19:                           Placeholder="e.g., About Us" />
20:             
21:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="linkDto.Url" 
22:                           Label="URL" 
23:                           For="@(() => linkDto.Url)" 
24:                           Required="true" 
25:                           RequiredError="URL is required." 
26:                           Placeholder="e.g., https://example.com/about" />
27:             
28:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="linkDto.Icon" 
29:                           Label="Icon (Material Design)" 
30:                           Placeholder="Leave empty to use default Link icon" 
31:                           HelperText="e.g., Icons.Material.Filled.Info" />
32:             
33:             <MudCheckBox T="bool" @bind-Checked="linkDto.OpenInNewTab" 
34:                          Label="Open in new tab" 
35:                          Color="Color.Primary" />
36:         </MudForm>
37:     </DialogContent>
38:     <DialogActions>
39:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
40:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">@(_isEdit ? "Update" : "Create")</MudButton>
41:     </DialogActions>
42: </MudDialog>
43: 
44: @code {
45:     [CascadingParameter]
46:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
47: 
48:     [Parameter]
49:     public TenantNavigationLinkDto? ExistingLink { get; set; }
50: 
51:     private MudForm form = null!;
52:     private bool success;
53:     private bool _isEdit;
54:     private CreateTenantNavigationLinkDto linkDto = new();
55: 
56:     protected override void OnInitialized()
57:     {
58:         _isEdit = ExistingLink != null;
59:         
60:         if (_isEdit && ExistingLink != null)
61:         {
62:             linkDto.Label = ExistingLink.Label;
63:             linkDto.Url = ExistingLink.Url;
64:             linkDto.Icon = ExistingLink.Icon;
65:             linkDto.OpenInNewTab = ExistingLink.OpenInNewTab;
66:         }
67:     }
68: 
69:     private async Task Submit()
70:     {
71:         await form.Validate();
72:         if (form.IsValid)
73:         {
74:             if (_isEdit && ExistingLink != null)
75:             {
76:                 var updateDto = new UpdateTenantNavigationLinkDto
77:                 {
78:                     Id = ExistingLink.Id,
79:                     Label = linkDto.Label,
80:                     Url = linkDto.Url,
81:                     Icon = linkDto.Icon,
82:                     OpenInNewTab = linkDto.OpenInNewTab
83:                 };
84:                 DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Ok(updateDto));
85:             }
86:             else
87:             {
88:                 DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Ok(linkDto));
89:             }
90:         }
91:     }
92: 
93:     private void Cancel() => DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Cancel());
94: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/AnalyticsInitializer.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 2: @inject IPublicExperienceService PublicExperienceService
 3: @inject IAnalyticsInterop AnalyticsInterop
 4: @inject ILogger<AnalyticsInitializer> Logger
 5: 
 6: @code {
 7:     private bool _initialized;
 8: 
 9:     protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
10:     {
11:         if (!firstRender || _initialized)
12:         {
13:             return;
14:         }
15: 
16:         _initialized = true;
17: 
18:         try
19:         {
20:             var settings = await PublicExperienceService.GetSettingsAsync();
21:             if (settings is null)
22:             {
23:                 return;
24:             }
25: 
26:             await AnalyticsInterop.InitAsync(
27:                 settings.AnalyticsProvider,
28:                 settings.AnalyticsEnabled,
29:                 settings.AnalyticsPublicApiKey,
30:                 settings.AnalyticsEndpointUrl);
31:         }
32:         catch (Exception ex)
33:         {
34:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Analytics initializer failed");
35:         }
36:     }
37: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/ErrorState.razor
````razor
 1: @* ABOUTME: Shared error state component for displaying API errors with retry capability. *@
 2: @* ABOUTME: Used across all pages for consistent error presentation. *@
 3: 
 4: @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ErrorMessage))
 5: {
 6:     <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" 
 7:               Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
 8:               Class="mb-4"
 9:               ShowCloseIcon="true"
10:               CloseIconClicked="OnDismiss">
11:         @ErrorMessage
12:     </MudAlert>
13:     
14:     @if (OnRetry.HasDelegate)
15:     {
16:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" 
17:                    Color="Color.Primary" 
18:                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Refresh"
19:                    OnClick="OnRetry"
20:                    Class="mb-4">
21:             @RetryText
22:         </MudButton>
23:     }
24: }
25: 
26: @code {
27:     [Parameter] public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }
28:     [Parameter] public EventCallback OnRetry { get; set; }
29:     [Parameter] public string RetryText { get; set; } = "Try Again";
30:     
31:     private void OnDismiss()
32:     {
33:         ErrorMessage = null;
34:     }
35: }
````

````csharp
 47:     public GenderSegregationMode? SelectedGenderMode { get; set; }
 48:     public bool? IncludesQuranRecitation { get; set; }
 49:     public PrayerTime? SelectedReferencePrayer { get; set; }
 50:     public int? SelectedIslamicPrimaryLanguageId { get; set; }
 51:     public bool? HasIslamicAspect { get; set; }
 52: 
 53: 
 54:     public SkillLevel? SelectedSkillLevel { get; set; }
 55:     public bool? IsCodingCompetition { get; set; }
 56:     public bool? IsHackathon { get; set; }
 57:     public bool? RequiresLaptop { get; set; }
 58:     public string? TechStackTag { get; set; }
 59:     public bool? HasTechAspect { get; set; }
 60: 
 61:     private bool _isIslamicExpanded;
 62:     private bool _isTechExpanded;
 63: 
 64:     private async Task OnFilterChange()
 65:     {
 66:         await OnFilterChanged.InvokeAsync();
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     private async Task ClearAllFilters()
 70:     {
 71:         SelectedDate = "";
 72:         SearchTerm = null;
 73:         SelectedCategoryId = null;
 74:         SelectedLocationId = null;
 75:         SelectedFormatId = null;
 76:         SelectedMadhabId = null;
 77:         SelectedRegistrationModeId = null;
 78:         SelectedLanguageId = null;
 79:         SelectedTagId = null;
 80:         SelectedEventTypeId = null;
 81:         SelectedAudienceGenderId = null;
 82:         SelectedAudienceAgeId = null;
 83:         SelectedEventStatusId = null;
 84:         SelectedSortBy = "date";
 85:         SortDescending = true;
 86: 
 87:         SelectedGenderMode = null;
 88:         IncludesQuranRecitation = null;
 89:         SelectedReferencePrayer = null;
 90:         SelectedIslamicPrimaryLanguageId = null;
 91:         HasIslamicAspect = null;
 92: 
 93:         SelectedSkillLevel = null;
 94:         IsCodingCompetition = null;
 95:         IsHackathon = null;
 96:         RequiresLaptop = null;
 97:         TechStackTag = null;
 98:         HasTechAspect = null;
 99: 
100:         await OnFilterChanged.InvokeAsync();
101:     }
102: 
103:     private int GetActiveFilterCount()
104:     {
105:         int count = 0;
106:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedDate)) count++;
107:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchTerm)) count++;
108:         if (SelectedCategoryId.HasValue) count++;
109:         if (SelectedLocationId.HasValue) count++;
110:         if (SelectedFormatId.HasValue) count++;
111:         if (SelectedMadhabId.HasValue) count++;
112:         if (SelectedRegistrationModeId.HasValue) count++;
113:         if (SelectedLanguageId.HasValue) count++;
114:         if (SelectedTagId.HasValue) count++;
115:         if (SelectedEventTypeId.HasValue) count++;
116:         if (SelectedAudienceGenderId.HasValue) count++;
117:         if (SelectedAudienceAgeId.HasValue) count++;
118:         if (SelectedEventStatusId.HasValue) count++;
119: 
120:         if (SelectedGenderMode.HasValue) count++;
121:         if (IncludesQuranRecitation.HasValue) count++;
122:         if (SelectedReferencePrayer.HasValue) count++;
123:         if (SelectedIslamicPrimaryLanguageId.HasValue) count++;
124:         if (HasIslamicAspect.HasValue) count++;
125: 
126:         if (SelectedSkillLevel.HasValue) count++;
127:         if (IsCodingCompetition.HasValue) count++;
128:         if (IsHackathon.HasValue) count++;
129:         if (RequiresLaptop.HasValue) count++;
130:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(TechStackTag)) count++;
131:         if (HasTechAspect.HasValue) count++;
132: 
133:         return count;
134:     }
135: }
````
