````markdown
120: ## 5. Layer Placeholders
121: 
122: ### Namespace Patterns
123: 
124: | Placeholder | Expands To |
125: |-------------|------------|
126: | `{Project.Domain.Namespace}` | `{Project}.Domain` |
127: | `{Project.Application.Namespace}` | `{Project}.Application` |
128: | `{Project.Application.Features.Namespace}` | `{Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}` |
129: | `{Project.Persistence.Namespace}` | `{Project}.Persistence` |
130: | `{Project.API.Namespace}` | `{Project}.API` |
131: 
132: ### File Path Patterns
133: 
134: | Placeholder | Example Path |
135: |-------------|--------------|
136: | `{Entity.Command.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/` |
137: | `{Entity.Query.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/` |
138: | `{Entity.Handler.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/` |
139: | `{Entity.Dto.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/` |
140: | `{Entity.Validator.Path}` | `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/` |
141: | `{Entity.Repository.Path}` | `{Project}.Persistence/Repositories/` |
142: | `{Entity.Controller.Path}` | `{Project}.API/Controllers/` |
143: 
144: ---
145: 
146: ## 6. CQRS Placeholders
147: 
148: ### Commands
149: 
150: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
151: |-------------|------------|---------|
152: | `Create{Entity}Command` | Create command class | `CreateEventCommand` |
153: | `Update{Entity}Command` | Update command class | `UpdateEventCommand` |
154: | `Delete{Entity}Command` | Delete command class | `DeleteEventCommand` |
155: | `Create{Entity}CommandHandler` | Create handler | `CreateEventCommandHandler` |
156: 
157: ### Queries
158: 
159: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
160: |-------------|------------|---------|
161: | `Get{Entity}ListRequest` | List query | `GetEventListRequest` |
162: | `Get{Entity}DetailsRequest` | Details query | `GetEventDetailsRequest` |
163: | `Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}Request` | Filter query | `GetEventsByOrganizationRequest` |
164: 
165: ### DTOs
166: 
167: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
168: |-------------|------------|---------|
169: | `{Entity}Dto` | Full details DTO | `EventDto` |
170: | `{Entity}ListDto` | List view DTO | `EventListDto` |
171: | `Create{Entity}Dto` | Create payload | `CreateEventDto` |
172: | `Update{Entity}Dto` | Update payload | `UpdateEventDto` |
173: 
174: ### Validators
175: 
176: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
177: |-------------|------------|---------|
178: | `Create{Entity}DtoValidator` | Create validator | `CreateEventDtoValidator` |
179: | `Update{Entity}DtoValidator` | Update validator | `UpdateEventDtoValidator` |
180: 
181: ### Repositories
182: 
183: | Placeholder | Expands To | Example |
184: |-------------|------------|---------|
185: | `I{Entity}Repository` | Repository interface | `IEventRepository` |
186: | `{Entity}Repository` | Repository implementation | `EventRepository` |
187: 
188: ---
189: 
190: ## 7. Substitution Examples
191: 
192: ### Example 1: Event Management System
193: 
194: **Substitutions:**
195: ```
196: {Project}        = Explore
197: {Entity}         = Event
198: {Entities}       = Events
199: {RelatedEntity}  = Organization
200: {LookupEntity}   = EventType
201: {IdType}         = Guid
202: {LookupIdType}   = int
203: ```
204: 
205: **Template Code:**
206: ```csharp
207: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
208: 
209: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
210: {
211:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
212:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity}Repository _{relatedEntity}Repository;
213: 
214:     // ...
215: }
216: ```
217: 
218: **Becomes:**
219: ```csharp
220: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events.Handlers.Commands;
221: 
222: public class CreateEventCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEventCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
223: {
224:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
225:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;
226: 
227:     // ...
228: }
229: ```
230: 
231: ### Example 2: E-Commerce System
232: 
233: **Substitutions:**
234: ```
235: {Project}        = ECommerce
236: {Entity}         = Order
237: {Entities}       = Orders
238: {RelatedEntity}  = Customer
239: {ChildEntity}    = OrderItem
240: {LookupEntity}   = OrderStatus
241: {IdType}         = Guid
242: {LookupIdType}   = int
243: ```
244: 
245: **Template Code:**
246: ```csharp
247: public class {Entity}Repository : GenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>, I{Entity}Repository
248: {
249:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}By{RelatedEntity}({IdType} {relatedEntity}Id)
250:     {
251:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
252:             .Include(e => e.{ChildEntities})
253:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
254:             .Where(e => e.{RelatedEntity}Id == {relatedEntity}Id)
255:             .ToListAsync();
256:     }
257: }
258: ```
259: 
260: **Becomes:**
261: ```csharp
262: public class OrderRepository : GenericRepository<Order, Guid>, IOrderRepository
263: {
264:     public async Task<List<Order>> GetOrdersByCustomer(Guid customerId)
265:     {
266:         return await _dbContext.Orders
267:             .Include(e => e.OrderItems)
268:             .Include(e => e.OrderStatus)
269:             .Where(e => e.CustomerId == customerId)
270:             .ToListAsync();
271:     }
272: }
273: ```
274: 
275: ---
276: 
277: ## 8. Best Practices
278: 
279: ### When Creating New Documentation
280: 
281: 1. **Always use placeholders** for entity-specific names
282: 2. **Provide substitution tables** at the top of each document
283: 3. **Include concrete examples** in "Implementation Example" sections
284: 4. **Mark project-specific sections** clearly
285: 
286: ### Substitution Table Template
287: 
288: Add this to any document that uses placeholders:
289: 
290: ```markdown
291: ## Placeholder Substitutions
292: 
293: | Placeholder | Replace With |
294: |-------------|--------------|
295: | `{Project}` | Your solution name |
296: | `{Entity}` | Your main entity |
297: | `{Entities}` | Plural form |
298: | `{RelatedEntity}` | Related entity for FK |
299: | `{IdType}` | `Guid` (recommended) or `int` |
300: ```
301: 
302: ### Naming Conventions
303: 
304: | Type | Convention | Example |
305: |------|------------|---------|
306: | Entity | PascalCase, singular | `Event`, `Order` |
307: | DbSet | PascalCase, plural | `Events`, `Orders` |
308: | Repository | I{Entity}Repository | `IEventRepository` |
309: | Controller | {Entity}Controller | `EventController` |
310: | DTO | {Entity}Dto, {Entity}ListDto | `EventDto`, `EventListDto` |
311: | Command | {Verb}{Entity}Command | `CreateEventCommand` |
312: | Query | Get{Entity}*Request | `GetEventListRequest` |
313: | Handler | {Command/Query}Handler | `CreateEventCommandHandler` |
314: | Validator | {Dto}Validator | `CreateEventDtoValidator` |
315: 
316: ---
317: 
318: ## Design Principles Reference
319: 
320: These principles guide all documentation and should be followed when implementing:
321: 
322: ### SOLID Principles
323: 
324: | Principle | Application |
325: |-----------|-------------|
326: | **S**ingle Responsibility | Each handler handles one command/query |
327: | **O**pen/Closed | Use interfaces for extension |
328: | **L**iskov Substitution | Repositories implement interfaces correctly |
329: | **I**nterface Segregation | Small, focused repository interfaces |
330: | **D**ependency Inversion | Depend on abstractions (interfaces) |
331: 
332: ### Clean Architecture
333: 
334: | Rule | Enforcement |
335: |------|-------------|
336: | Dependencies flow inward | Domain has no dependencies |
337: | Entities are framework-agnostic | No EF Core in Domain |
338: | Use cases in Application | Business logic in handlers |
339: | Controllers are thin | Only HTTP ↔ MediatR |
340: 
341: ### Clean Code
342: 
343: | Principle | Example |
344: |-----------|---------|
345: | **DRY** | Use `GenericRepository<T, TId>` |
346: | **KISS** | Simple handlers, one responsibility |
347: | **YAGNI** | Don't add unused abstractions |
348: | Meaningful names | `GetEventsWithDetails()` not `GetData()` |
349: 
350: ---
351: 
352: ## Related Documentation
353: 
354: - **[GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md)** - Coding conventions (project-agnostic)
355: - **[QUICK_REFERENCE.md](QUICK_REFERENCE.md)** - Critical rules summary
356: - **[ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)** - System architecture patterns
357: 
358: ---
359: 
360: ## Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
361: 
362: This repository (`Explore`) uses the following substitutions:
363: 
364: | Placeholder | ISLAMU Event Value |
365: |-------------|-------------------|
366: | `{Project}` | `Explore` |
367: | `{Project.Domain}` | `Explore.Domain` |
368: | `{Project.Application}` | `Explore.Application` |
369: | `{Project.Persistence}` | `Explore.Persistence` |
370: | `{Project.API}` | `Explore.API` |
371: | `{Project.Blazor}` | `Explore.Blazor` |
372: | `{DbContext}` | `ExploreDbContext` |
373: | `{IdType}` | `Guid` |
374: | `{LookupIdType}` | `int` |
375: 
376: **Sample Entities:**
377: - `{Entity}` = `Event`, `Organization`, `User`, `EventSession`
378: - `{LookupEntity}` = `EventType`, `EventStatus`, `Madhab`, `AudienceAge`
379: - `{LinkEntity}` = `EventCategories`, `EventTags`, `OrganizationMembers`
````

````csharp
195: 
196:

199:     public AuthenticationTestBuilder WithClaim(string type, string value)

201:         _customClaims.Add(new Claim(type, value));
202:         return this;
203:     }
204: 
205: 
206: 
207: 
208:

210:     public AuthenticationTestBuilder WithClaims(params Claim[] claims)
211:     {
212:         _customClaims.AddRange(claims);
213:         return this;
214:     }
215: 
216: 
217: 
218: 
219: 
220: 
221: 
222:     public AuthenticationTestBuilder WithOrganizationClaim(Guid organizationId, string role = "Member")
223:     {
224:         _customClaims.Add(new Claim("org_id", organizationId.ToString()));
225:         _customClaims.Add(new Claim("org_role", role));
226:         return this;
227:     }

230: 
231:     #region Authentication State Configuration
232: 
233: 
234: 
235: 
236: 
237:     public AuthenticationTestBuilder AsAnonymous()
238:     {
239:         _isAuthenticated = false;
240:         _isAuthorizing = false;
241:         _userId = null;
242:         _userName = null;
243:         _roles.Clear();
244:         _policies.Clear();
245:         _customClaims.Clear();
246:         return this;
247:     }
248: 
249: 
250: 
251: 
252: 
253:     public AuthenticationTestBuilder AsAuthorizing()
254:     {
255:         _isAuthorizing = true;
256:         return this;
257:     }
258: 
259: 
260: 
261: 
262: 
263:     public AuthenticationTestBuilder AsAuthenticatedButUnauthorized()
264:     {
265:         _isAuthenticated = true;
266:         _authState = AuthorizationState.Unauthorized;
267:         return this;
268:     }
269: 
270:     #endregion
271: 
272:     #region Build Methods
273: 
274: 
275: 
276: 
277: 
278: 
279:     public TestAuthorizationContext Build(Bunit.TestContext context)
280:     {
281:         var authContext = context.AddTestAuthorization();
282:         ApplyTo(authContext);
283:         return authContext;
284:     }
285: 
286: 
287: 
288: 
289: 
290:     public void ApplyTo(TestAuthorizationContext authContext)
291:     {
292:         if (_isAuthorizing)
293:         {
294:             authContext.SetAuthorizing();
295:             return;
296:         }
297: 
298:         if (!_isAuthenticated)
299:         {
300:             authContext.SetNotAuthorized();
301:             return;
302:         }
303: 
304: 
305:         var claims = BuildClaims();
306: 
307: 
308:         authContext.SetAuthorized(_userName ?? "TestUser", _authState);
309: 
310: 
311:         if (claims.Count > 0)
312:         {
313:             authContext.SetClaims(claims.ToArray());
314:         }
315: 
316: 
317:         if (_roles.Count > 0)
318:         {
319:             authContext.SetRoles(_roles.ToArray());
320:         }
321: 
322: 
323:         if (_policies.Count > 0)
324:         {
325:             authContext.SetPolicies(_policies.ToArray());
326:         }
327:     }
328: 
329: 
330: 
331: 
332:     private List<Claim> BuildClaims()
333:     {
334:         var claims = new List<Claim>();
335: 
336: 
337:         if (_userId.HasValue)
338:         {
339:             var userIdString = _userId.Value.ToString();
340:             claims.Add(new Claim("sub", userIdString));
341:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, userIdString));
342:         }
343: 
344: 
345:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_userName))
346:         {
347:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, _userName));
348:         }
349: 
350: 
351:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_email))
352:         {
353:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Email, _email));
354:         }
355: 
356: 
357:         if (_tenantId.HasValue)
358:         {
359:             claims.Add(new Claim("tenant_id", _tenantId.Value.ToString()));
360:         }
361: 
362: 
363:         foreach (var role in _roles)
364:         {
365:             claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, role));
366:             claims.Add(new Claim("role", role));
367:         }
368: 
369: 
370:         claims.AddRange(_customClaims);
371: 
372:         return claims;
373:     }
374: 
375: 
376: 
377: 
378: 
379: 
380:     public ClaimsPrincipal BuildPrincipal()
381:     {
382:         if (!_isAuthenticated)
383:         {
384:             return new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity());
385:         }
386: 
387:         var claims = BuildClaims();
388:         var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, _authType ?? "TestAuth");
389:         return new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);
390:     }
391: 
392: 
393: 
394: 
395: 
396: 
397:     public AuthenticationState BuildAuthenticationState()
398:     {
399:         return new AuthenticationState(BuildPrincipal());
400:     }
401: 
402:     #endregion
403: }
````

````csharp
245:     private static AdminRouteGuard CreateGuard(

254: 
255:         return new AdminRouteGuard(authStateProvider, instanceOnboardingService);
````

````csharp
223:     private static DefaultHttpContext CreateHttpContext(string userId, string? authToken = null)
224:     {
225:         var claims = new[] { new Claim("sub", userId) };
226:         var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, "TestAuth");
227:         var principal = new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);
228: 
229:         var context = new DefaultHttpContext { User = principal };
230: 
231:         var services = new ServiceCollection();
232: 
233:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(authToken))
234:         {
235:             var authService = Substitute.For<IAuthenticationService>();
236:             var properties = new AuthenticationProperties();
237:             properties.StoreTokens(new[] { new AuthenticationToken { Name = "access_token", Value = authToken } });
238:             var ticket = new AuthenticationTicket(principal, properties, "Cookies");
239: 
240:             authService.AuthenticateAsync(Arg.Any<HttpContext>(), Arg.Any<string>())
241:                 .Returns(Task.FromResult(AuthenticateResult.Success(ticket)));
242: 
243:             services.AddSingleton(authService);
244:             services.AddSingleton<IAuthenticationSchemeProvider>(new AuthenticationSchemeProvider(
245:                 Options.Create(new AuthenticationOptions { DefaultAuthenticateScheme = "Cookies" })));
246:         }
247: 
248:         context.RequestServices = services.BuildServiceProvider();
249:         return context;
250:     }
251: 
252:     private static string CreateJwt(string sub)
253:     {
254:         var jwt = new JwtSecurityToken(claims: new[] { new Claim("sub", sub) });
255:         return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(jwt);
256:     }
257: 
258:     private static void ClearTokenStore()
259:     {
260:         var storeField = typeof(CircuitAccessTokenService).GetField("_tokenStore", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
261:         var store = storeField?.GetValue(null);
262:         var clearMethod = store?.GetType().GetMethod("Clear");
263:         clearMethod?.Invoke(store, null);
264:     }
265: 
266:     private sealed class TestableAccessTokenForwardingHandler : AccessTokenForwardingHandler
267:     {
268:         public TestableAccessTokenForwardingHandler(
269:             IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
270:             ISetupSecretSessionService setupSecretSessionService,
271:             ILogger<AccessTokenForwardingHandler> logger)
272:             : base(httpContextAccessor, setupSecretSessionService, logger)
273:         {
274:         }
275: 
276:         public Task<HttpResponseMessage> InvokeAsync(HttpRequestMessage request)
277:         {
278:             return SendAsync(request, CancellationToken.None);
279:         }
280:     }
281: 
282:     private sealed class CaptureHandler : HttpMessageHandler
283:     {
284:         public HttpRequestMessage? Request { get; private set; }
285: 
286:         protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
287:         {
288:             Request = request;
289:             return Task.FromResult(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK));
290:         }
291:     }
292: }
````

````csharp
258:     private static HttpResponseMessage CreateJsonResponse<T>(T model, HttpStatusCode statusCode = HttpStatusCode.OK)

271:         _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient").Returns(client);
272:     }
273: 
274:     private void SetupBffClient(Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> handler)
275:     {
276:         var httpHandler = new MockHttpMessageHandler(handler);
277:         var client = new HttpClient(httpHandler) { BaseAddress = new Uri("https://test.local") };
278:         _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient").Returns(client);
279:     }
280: 
281:     private class MockHttpMessageHandler : HttpMessageHandler
282:     {
283:         private readonly Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> _handler;
284: 
285:         public MockHttpMessageHandler(HttpResponseMessage response)
286:         {
287:             _handler = _ => Task.FromResult(response);
288:         }
289: 
290:         public MockHttpMessageHandler(Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> handler)
291:         {
292:             _handler = handler;
293:         }
294: 
295:         protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
296:             => _handler(request);
297:     }
298: 
299:     private sealed class NullJsRuntime : IJSRuntime
300:     {
301:         public ValueTask<TValue> InvokeAsync<TValue>(string identifier, object?[]? args)
302:         {
303:             return new ValueTask<TValue>(default(TValue)!);
304:         }
````

````csharp
159:     private static HttpResponseMessage CreateJsonResponse<T>(T model, HttpStatusCode statusCode = HttpStatusCode.OK)
160:     {
161:         var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(model);
162:         return new HttpResponseMessage(statusCode)
163:         {
164:             Content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
165:         };
166:     }
167: 
168:     private sealed class RecordingHttpMessageHandler : HttpMessageHandler
169:     {
170:         private readonly Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> _handler;
171: 
172:         public HttpRequestMessage? LastRequest { get; private set; }
173: 
174:         public RecordingHttpMessageHandler(Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> handler)
175:         {
176:             _handler = handler;
177:         }
178: 
179:         protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
180:         {
181:             LastRequest = request;
182:             return _handler(request);
183:         }
184:     }
185: }
````

````csharp
163:     public async Task UpdateSettingsAsync_ReturnsFailure_WhenApiReturnsError()
164:     {

166:         var response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest)
167:         {
168:             Content = new StringContent("null", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
169:         };
170:         SetupBffClient(response);
171: 
172: 
173:         var result = await _service.UpdateSettingsAsync(new TenantPolicySettingsModel());
174:

177:         await Assert.That(result.Message).IsEqualTo("Operation failed with status 400.");
178:     }

181: 
182:     private static HttpResponseMessage CreateJsonResponse<T>(T model, HttpStatusCode statusCode = HttpStatusCode.OK)
183:     {
184:         var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(model);
185:         return new HttpResponseMessage(statusCode)
186:         {
187:             Content = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
188:         };
189:     }
190: 
191:     private void SetupBffClient(HttpResponseMessage response)
192:     {
193:         var handler = new MockHttpMessageHandler(response);
194:         var client = new HttpClient(handler) { BaseAddress = new Uri("https://test.local") };
195:         _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient").Returns(client);
196:     }
197: 
198:     private void SetupBffClient(Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> handler)
199:     {
200:         var httpHandler = new MockHttpMessageHandler(handler);
201:         var client = new HttpClient(httpHandler) { BaseAddress = new Uri("https://test.local") };
202:         _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient").Returns(client);
203:     }
204: 
205:     private class MockHttpMessageHandler : HttpMessageHandler
206:     {
207:         private readonly Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> _handler;
208: 
209:         public MockHttpMessageHandler(HttpResponseMessage response)
210:         {
211:             _handler = _ => Task.FromResult(response);
212:         }
213: 
214:         public MockHttpMessageHandler(Func<HttpRequestMessage, Task<HttpResponseMessage>> handler)
215:         {
216:             _handler = handler;
217:         }
218: 
219:         protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
220:             => _handler(request);
221:     }
222: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Instance/InstanceAdminSettingsLayout.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Sidebar layout component for Instance Admin Settings with four sections. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Loads instance settings via IInstanceOnboardingService and delegates to section components. *@
  3: 
  4: @using MudBlazor
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  7: 
  8: @inject IInstanceOnboardingService InstanceOnboardingService
  9: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 10: 
 11: <div class="settings-layout">
 12:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="py-8">
 13:         <!-- Header -->
 14:         <div class="settings-header mb-8">
 15:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">Instance Settings</MudText>
 16:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-2">Manage platform governance, domain, branding, modules, and storage settings</MudText>
 17:         </div>
 18: 
 19:         @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))
 20:         {
 21:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-4">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 22:         }
 23: 
 24:         @if (_isLoading)
 25:         {
 26:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Class="py-12">
 27:                 <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 28:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">Loading instance settings...</MudText>
 29:             </MudStack>
 30:         }
 31:         else if (!_canEdit)
 32:         {
 33:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Class="mb-4">
 34:                 You do not have instance administrator permissions to view or modify these settings.
 35:             </MudAlert>
 36:         }
 37:         else
 38:         {
 39:             <!-- Main Layout: Sidebar + Content -->
 40:             <MudGrid Spacing="4">
 41:                 <!-- Sidebar Navigation -->
 42:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="3">
 43:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="settings-sidebar pa-0 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
 44:                         <MudList T="string" Dense="false" DisablePadding="true">
 45:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Gavel"
 46:                                          Text="Governance"
 47:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("governance")"
 48:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("governance"))" />
 49:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Language"
 50:                                          Text="Domain"
 51:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("domain")"
 52:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("domain"))" />
 53:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Palette"
 54:                                          Text="Branding"
 55:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("branding")"
 56:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("branding"))" />
 57:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Extension"
 58:                                          Text="Modules"
 59:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("modules")"
 60:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("modules"))" />
 61:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Cloud"
 62:                                          Text="Object Storage"
 63:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("storage")"
 64:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("storage"))" />
 65:                         </MudList>
 66:                     </MudPaper>
 67:                 </MudItem>
 68: 
 69:                 <!-- Content Area -->
 70:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="9">
 71:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="settings-content pa-6 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
 72:                         @if (_currentSection == "governance")
 73:                         {
 74:                             <InstanceGovernanceSection Model="_model" />
 75:                         }
 76:                         else if (_currentSection == "domain")
 77:                         {
 78:                             <InstanceDomainSection Model="_model" />
 79:                         }
 80:                         else if (_currentSection == "branding")
 81:                         {
 82:                             <InstanceBrandingSection Model="_model" />
 83:                         }
 84:                         else if (_currentSection == "modules")
 85:                         {
 86:                             <InstanceModulesSection Model="_model" />
 87:                         }
 88:                         else if (_currentSection == "storage")
 89:                         {
 90:                             <InstanceStorageSection Model="_storageModel" OnboardingService="InstanceOnboardingService" />
 91:                         }
 92: 
 93:                         <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
 94: 
 95:                         <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd">
 96:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 97:                                        Color="Color.Primary"
 98:                                        OnClick="SaveAsync"
 99:                                        Disabled="_isSaving"
100:                                        StartIcon="@(_isSaving ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassEmpty : Icons.Material.Filled.Save)">
101:                                 @(_isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Instance Settings")
102:                             </MudButton>
103:                         </MudStack>
104:                     </MudPaper>
105:                 </MudItem>
106:             </MudGrid>
107:         }
108:     </MudContainer>
109: </div>
110: 
111: @code {
112:     private InstanceGovernanceSettingsModel _model = new();
113:     private InstanceStorageSettingsModel _storageModel = new();
114:     private bool _isLoading = true;
115:     private bool _isSaving;
116:     private bool _canEdit;
117:     private string? _errorMessage;
118:     private string _currentSection = "governance";
119: 
120:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
121:     {
122:         var status = await InstanceOnboardingService.GetStatusAsync();
123:         _canEdit = status?.IsCurrentUserInstanceAdmin == true;
124: 
125:         if (!_canEdit)
126:         {
127:             _isLoading = false;
128:             return;
129:         }
130: 
131:         _model = await InstanceOnboardingService.GetSettingsAsync();
132:         _storageModel = await InstanceOnboardingService.GetStorageSettingsAsync();
133:         _isLoading = false;
134:     }
135: 
136:     private async Task SaveAsync()
137:     {
138:         _isSaving = true;
139:         _errorMessage = null;
140: 
141:         var response = await InstanceOnboardingService.UpdateSettingsAsync(_model);
142: 
143:         if (response.Success)
144:         {
145:             var storageResponse = await InstanceOnboardingService.UpdateStorageSettingsAsync(_storageModel);
146:             _isSaving = false;
147: 
148:             if (storageResponse.Success)
149:             {
150:                 Snackbar.Add("Instance settings saved.", Severity.Success);
151:                 return;
152:             }
153: 
154:             _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(storageResponse.Message)
155:                 ? "Governance settings saved, but storage settings failed."
156:                 : storageResponse.Message;
157:             return;
158:         }
159: 
160:         _isSaving = false;
161:         _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response.Message)
162:             ? "Failed to save instance settings."
163:             : response.Message;
164:     }
165: 
166:     private void SelectSection(string section)
167:     {
168:         _currentSection = section;
169:     }
170: 
171:     private string GetNavItemClass(string section)
172:     {
173:         return _currentSection == section ? "settings-nav-active" : "";
174:     }
175: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Organization/OrganizationProfileSection.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Editable organization profile section with member-facing branding controls. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Supports name/info updates, picture URL, and banner white-label customization. *@
  3: 
  4: @using MudBlazor

  7: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services

 10: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 11: 
 12: <div class="settings-section">
 13:     <div class="settings-section-header">
 14:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Organization Profile</MudText>
 15:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">
 16:             Update organization information, picture, and white-label banner styling.
 17:         </MudText>
 18:     </div>
 19: 
 20:     @if (_loading)
 21:     {
 22:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />

 25:     {
 26:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true">
 27:             Organization profile could not be loaded.
 28:         </MudAlert>
 29:     }
 30:     else
 31:     {
 32:         @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))
 33:         {
 34:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Dense="true" Class="mb-3">
 35:                 @_errorMessage
 36:             </MudAlert>
 37:         }
 38: 
 39:         <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 40:             <MudItem xs="12">
 41:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.FullName"
 42:                               Label="Organization Name"
 43:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 44:                               Required="true" />
 45:             </MudItem>
 46:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 47:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.Email"
 48:                               Label="Email"
 49:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 50:                               Required="true"
 51:                               InputType="InputType.Email" />
 52:             </MudItem>
 53:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 54:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.WebsiteUrl"
 55:                               Label="Website URL"
 56:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 57:             </MudItem>
 58:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 59:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.Address"
 60:                               Label="Address"
 61:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 62:                               Required="true" />
 63:             </MudItem>
 64:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 65:                 <MudNumericField @bind-Value="_model.Postcode"
 66:                                  Label="Postcode"
 67:                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 68:                                  HideSpinButtons="true"
 69:                                  Min="0" />
 70:             </MudItem>
 71:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 72:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.City"
 73:                               Label="City"
 74:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 75:                               Required="true" />
 76:             </MudItem>
 77:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 78:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.Country"
 79:                               Label="Country"
 80:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 81:                               Required="true" />
 82:             </MudItem>
 83:             <MudItem xs="12">
 84:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.ProfileImageUrl"
 85:                               Label="Profile Image URL"
 86:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 87:                               Placeholder="https://..." />
 88:             </MudItem>
 89:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 90:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundColor"
 91:                               Label="Banner Color"
 92:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 93:                               InputType="InputType.Color" />
 94:             </MudItem>
 95:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="8">
 96:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl"
 97:                               Label="Banner Media URL"
 98:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 99:                               Placeholder="https://... (image or GIF)" />
100:             </MudItem>
101:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
102:                 <MudSelect T="string"
103:                            Label="Banner Effect"
104:                            Variant="Variant.Outlined"
105:                            @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundEffect">
106:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("None")">None</MudSelectItem>
107:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("SoftOverlay")">Soft Overlay</MudSelectItem>
108:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("StrongOverlay")">Strong Overlay</MudSelectItem>
109:                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("Blur")">Blur</MudSelectItem>
110:                 </MudSelect>
111:             </MudItem>
112:         </MudGrid>
113: 
114:         <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
115: 
116:         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Class="mb-2">Preview</MudText>
117:         <MudPaper Elevation="0"
118:                   Class="pa-6 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default"
119:                   Style="@OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper.BuildBannerStyle(_appearance, "#1f6feb")">
120:             <MudStack Row="true" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="2">
121:                 @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(GetProfileImageUri()))
122:                 {
123:                     <MudAvatar Size="Size.Large" Rounded="true">
124:                         <MudImage Src="@GetProfileImageUri()" Alt="@_model.FullName" ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" />
125:                     </MudAvatar>
126:                 }
127:                 else
128:                 {
129:                     <MudAvatar Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" Rounded="true">
130:                         @(_model.FullName.Length > 0 ? _model.FullName[..1].ToUpperInvariant() : "O")
131:                     </MudAvatar>
132:                 }
133:                 <div>
134:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700; color: white;">@_model.FullName</MudText>
135:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);">@_model.City, @_model.Country</MudText>
136:                 </div>
137:             </MudStack>
138:         </MudPaper>
139: 
140:         <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd" Class="mt-4">
141:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
142:                        Color="Color.Primary"
143:                        OnClick="SaveAsync"
144:                        Disabled="@_saving"
145:                        StartIcon="@(_saving ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassEmpty : Icons.Material.Filled.Save)">
146:                 @(_saving ? "Saving..." : "Save Organization Settings")
147:             </MudButton>
148:         </MudStack>
149:     }
150: </div>
151: 
152: @code {
153:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
154:     public Guid OrganizationId { get; set; }
155: 
156:     private OrganizationDto? _organization;
157:     private UpdateOrganizationDto _model = new();
158:     private OrganizationAppearanceSettings _appearance = new();
159:     private bool _loading = true;
160:     private bool _saving;
161:     private string? _errorMessage;
162: 
163:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
164:     {
165:         await LoadOrganizationAsync();
166:     }
167: 
168:     private async Task LoadOrganizationAsync()
169:     {
170:         _loading = true;
171:         _errorMessage = null;
172:         try
173:         {
174:             _organization = await OrganizationService.GetOrganizationByIdAsync(OrganizationId);
175:             if (_organization != null)
176:             {
177:                 _model = new UpdateOrganizationDto
178:                 {
179:                     FullName = _organization.FullName ?? string.Empty,
180:                     Email = _organization.Email ?? string.Empty,
181:                     WebsiteUrl = _organization.WebsiteUrl,
182:                     Address = _organization.Address ?? string.Empty,
183:                     City = _organization.City ?? string.Empty,
184:                     Country = _organization.Country ?? string.Empty,
185:                     Postcode = int.TryParse(_organization.Postcode, out var postcode) ? postcode : null,
186:                     MetadataJson = _organization.MetadataJson
187:                 };
188:                 _appearance = OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper.Parse(_organization.MetadataJson);
189:             }
190:         }
191:         catch (Exception ex)
192:         {
193:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load organization profile: {ex.Message}";
194:         }
195:         finally
196:         {
197:             _loading = false;
198:         }
199:     }
200: 
201:     private async Task SaveAsync()
202:     {
203:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.FullName)
204:             || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Email)
205:             || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Address)
206:             || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.City)
207:             || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Country))
208:         {
209:             _errorMessage = "Please complete all required fields.";
210:             return;
211:         }
212: 
213:         _saving = true;
214:         _errorMessage = null;
215:         try
216:         {
217:             _model.MetadataJson = OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(_model.MetadataJson, _appearance);
218:             var response = await OrganizationService.UpdateOrganizationAsync(OrganizationId, _model);
219: 
220:             if (response?.Success == true)
221:             {
222:                 Snackbar.Add("Organization profile updated.", Severity.Success);
223:                 await LoadOrganizationAsync();
224:                 return;
225:             }
226: 
227:             _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response?.Message)
228:                 ? "Failed to update organization profile."
229:                 : response!.Message;
230:         }
231:         catch (Exception ex)
232:         {
233:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to update organization profile: {ex.Message}";
234:         }
235:         finally
236:         {
237:             _saving = false;
238:         }
239:     }
240: 
241:     private string? GetProfileImageUri()
242:     {
243:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_appearance.ProfileImageUrl))
244:         {
245:             return _appearance.ProfileImageUrl.Trim();
246:         }
247: 
248:         return _organization?.ActorProfilePictureUri;
249:     }
250: }
````

````razor
 91:     [Parameter]
 92:     public EventIslamicAspectDto? Aspect { get; set; }

 97:     [Parameter]

102: 
103:     [Parameter]

106:     private EventIslamicAspectDto? _previousAspect;
107:     private bool _previousShowActions;
108: 
109:     protected override bool ShouldRender()
110:     {
111:         if (ReferenceEquals(Aspect, _previousAspect) && ShowActions == _previousShowActions)
112:             return false;
113: 
114:         _previousAspect = Aspect;
115:         _previousShowActions = ShowActions;

119:     private string GetGenderModeDisplay()

122:         {
123:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Mixed => "Mixed",
124:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.MenOnly => "Men Only",
125:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.WomenOnly => "Women Only",
126:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Segregated => "Segregated",
127:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Family => "Family",
128:             _ => "Mixed"
129:         };
130:     }
131: 
132:     private Color GetGenderModeColor()
133:     {
134:         return Aspect?.GenderMode switch
135:         {
136:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.MenOnly => Color.Info,
137:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.WomenOnly => Color.Secondary,
138:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Segregated => Color.Warning,
139:             (int)GenderSegregationMode.Family => Color.Success,
140:             _ => Color.Default
141:         };
142:     }
143: 
144:     private string GetPrayerTimeDisplay()
145:     {
146:         if (Aspect?.ReferencePrayer == null) return string.Empty;
147: 
148:         var prayerName = Aspect.ReferencePrayer switch
149:         {
150:             (int)PrayerTime.Fajr => "Fajr",
151:             (int)PrayerTime.Sunrise => "Sunrise",
152:             (int)PrayerTime.Dhuhr => "Dhuhr",
153:             (int)PrayerTime.Asr => "Asr",
154:             (int)PrayerTime.Maghrib => "Maghrib",
155:             (int)PrayerTime.Isha => "Isha",
156:             _ => "Unknown"
157:         };
158: 
159:         if (Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.HasValue && Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value != 0)
160:         {
161:             var offsetText = Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value > 0
162:                 ? $"+{Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value} min"
163:                 : $"{Aspect.PrayerTimeOffset.Value} min";
164:             return $"{prayerName} ({offsetText})";
165:         }
166: 
167:         return prayerName;
168:     }
169: }
````

````razor
116:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Prize Pool</MudText>
117:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Success" Style="font-weight: 600;">

127:     [Parameter]
128:     public EventTechAspectDto? Aspect { get; set; }
129: 
130:     [Parameter]
131:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
132: 
133:     [Parameter]
134:     public bool ShowActions { get; set; } = true;
135: 
136:     [Parameter]
137:     public EventCallback OnEdit { get; set; }
138: 
139:     [Parameter]
140:     public EventCallback OnDelete { get; set; }
141: 
142:     private EventTechAspectDto? _previousAspect;
143:     private bool _previousShowActions;
144: 
145:     protected override bool ShouldRender()
146:     {
147:         if (ReferenceEquals(Aspect, _previousAspect) && ShowActions == _previousShowActions)
148:             return false;
149: 
150:         _previousAspect = Aspect;
151:         _previousShowActions = ShowActions;
152:         return true;
153:     }
154: 
155:     private string GetSkillLevelDisplay()
156:     {
157:         return Aspect?.SkillLevel switch
158:         {
159:             (int)SkillLevel.AllLevels => "All Levels",
160:             (int)SkillLevel.Beginner => "Beginner",
161:             (int)SkillLevel.Intermediate => "Intermediate",
162:             (int)SkillLevel.Advanced => "Advanced",
163:             _ => "All Levels"
164:         };
165:     }
166: 
167:     private Color GetSkillLevelColor()
168:     {
169:         return Aspect?.SkillLevel switch
170:         {
171:             (int)SkillLevel.Beginner => Color.Success,
172:             (int)SkillLevel.Intermediate => Color.Warning,
173:             (int)SkillLevel.Advanced => Color.Error,
174:             _ => Color.Default
175:         };
176:     }
177: 
178:     private string GetRepoName()
179:     {
180:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.GithubRepoUrl)) return string.Empty;
181: 
182:         try
183:         {
184:             var uri = new Uri(Aspect.GithubRepoUrl);
185:             var path = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
186:             return path.Length > 30 ? path.Substring(0, 27) + "..." : path;
187:         }
188:         catch
189:         {
190:             return "View Repository";
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:     private IEnumerable<string> GetTechStackTags()
195:     {
196:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Aspect?.TechStackTags))
197:             return Enumerable.Empty<string>();
198: 
199:         return Aspect.TechStackTags
200:             .Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
201:             .Select(t => t.Trim())
202:             .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(t));
203:     }
204: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/SelectSessionDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @inject IEventService EventService
 4: 
 5: <MudDialog>
 6:     <TitleContent>
 7:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Select a Session</MudText>
 8:     </TitleContent>
 9:     <DialogContent>
10:         <MudDataGrid T="EventSessionListDto" Items="@sessions" ReadOnly="true" Bordered="true" Dense="true">
11:             <Columns>
12:                 <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.Title" />
13:                 <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.StartTime" />
14:                 <TemplateColumn StickyRight="true">
15:                     <CellTemplate Context="context">
16:                         <MudButton OnClick="@(() => Select(context.Item))" Variant="Variant.Text">Select</MudButton>
17:                     </CellTemplate>
18:                 </TemplateColumn>
19:             </Columns>
20:         </MudDataGrid>
21:     </DialogContent>
22: </MudDialog>
23: 
24: @code {
25:     [CascadingParameter]
26:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
27: 
28:     private List<EventSessionListDto> sessions = new();
29: 
30:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
31:     {
32:         var result = await EventService.GetAllSessionsAsync();
33:         sessions = result.ToList();
34:     }
35: 
36:     private void Select(EventSessionListDto item)
37:     {
38:         DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Ok(item.Id));
39:     }
40: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/EventReviewDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
  3: 
  4: <MudDialog>
  5:     <DialogContent>
  6: <div class="review-dialog-content">
  7:             <div class="rating-section">
  8:                 <div class="rating-label">How would you rate this event?</div>
  9:                 <div class="star-rating">
 10:                     @for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
 11:                     {
 12:                         var starIndex = i;
 13:                         <span class="star @(starIndex <= rating ? "filled" : "")"
 14:                               @onclick="@(() => SetRating(starIndex))">
 15:                             @if (starIndex <= rating)
 16:                             {
 17:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Star" />
 18:                             }
 19:                             else
 20:                             {
 21:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.StarBorder" />
 22:                             }
 23:                         </span>
 24:                     }
 25:                 </div>
 26:                 @if (rating > 0)
 27:                 {
 28:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Primary" Class="mt-2">
 29:                         @GetRatingText()
 30:                     </MudText>
 31:                 }
 32:             </div>
 33: 
 34:             <div class="comment-section">
 35:                 <div class="comment-label">Share your experience (optional)</div>
 36:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="comment"
 37:                               Label="Your review"
 38:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 39:                               Lines="5"
 40:                               Placeholder="Tell us about your experience at this event..."
 41:                               MaxLength="500"
 42:                               Counter="500" />
 43:             </div>
 44: 
 45:             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorMessage))
 46:             {
 47:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-3">@errorMessage</MudAlert>
 48:             }
 49:         </div>
 50:     </DialogContent>
 51:     <DialogActions>
 52:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel"
 53:                    Variant="Variant.Text"
 54:                    Color="Color.Default">
 55:             Cancel
 56:         </MudButton>
 57:         <MudButton OnClick="Submit"
 58:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
 59:                    Color="Color.Primary"
 60:                    Disabled="@(rating == 0)"
 61:                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Send">
 62:             Submit Review
 63:         </MudButton>
 64:     </DialogActions>
 65: </MudDialog>
 66: 
 67: @code {
 68:     [CascadingParameter]
 69:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
 70: 
 71:     [Parameter]
 72:     public string EventTitle { get; set; } = "";
 73: 
 74:     [Parameter]
 75:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
 76: 
 77:     private int rating = 0;
 78:     private string comment = "";
 79:     private string errorMessage = "";
 80: 
 81:     private void SetRating(int value)
 82:     {
 83:         rating = value;
 84:         errorMessage = "";
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     private string GetRatingText()
 88:     {
 89:         return rating switch
 90:         {
 91:             1 => "Poor",
 92:             2 => "Fair",
 93:             3 => "Good",
 94:             4 => "Very Good",
 95:             5 => "Excellent",
 96:             _ => ""
 97:         };
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     private void Submit()
101:     {
102:         if (rating == 0)
103:         {
104:             errorMessage = "Please select a rating";
105:             return;
106:         }
107: 
108:         // Here you would call the API to submit the review
109:         // For now, just close the dialog with success
110:         DialogReference?.Close(DialogResult.Ok(new { Rating = rating, Comment = comment }));
111:     }
112: 
113:     private void Cancel()
114:     {
115:         DialogReference?.Close(DialogResult.Cancel());
116:     }
117: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Settings/SettingsPersonalInfo.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms
  6: @inject IUserService UserService
  7: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  8: 
  9: <div class="settings-section">
 10:     <!-- Section Header -->
 11:     <div class="settings-section-header mb-6">
 12:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Personal Information</MudText>
 13:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Update your personal details and profile picture</MudText>
 14:     </div>
 15: 
 16:     @if (_loading)
 17:     {
 18:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-8">
 19:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
 20:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mt-4" Color="Color.Secondary">Loading profile...</MudText>
 21:         </div>
 22:     }
 23:     else if (_user == null)
 24:     {
 25:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled">Failed to load user profile.</MudAlert>
 26:     }
 27:     else
 28:     {
 29:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 30:         {
 31:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">
 32:                 @_errorMessage
 33:             </MudAlert>
 34:         }
 35: 
 36:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_successMessage))
 37:         {
 38:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Success" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _successMessage = null)">
 39:                 @_successMessage
 40:             </MudAlert>
 41:         }
 42: 
 43:         <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="_success">
 44:             <!-- Profile Picture Section -->
 45:             <div class="settings-profile-picture mb-8">
 46:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Profile Picture</MudText>
 47:                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-6">
 48:                     <div style="width: 120px;">
 49:                         <ImageUpload @bind-PreviewUrl="_profileImagePreview"
 50:                                    FileDataSelected="OnProfileImageFileDataSelected"
 51:                                    PlaceholderText="Select Profile Picture"
 52:                                    UploadButtonText="Change"
 53:                                    Width="120px"
 54:                                    Height="120px"
 55:                                    HintText="JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP (Max 5MB)" 
 56:                                    Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 57:                     </div>
 58:                     <div>
 59:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
 60:                             Recommended: Square image, at least 400x400px
 61:                         </MudText>
 62:                     </div>
 63:                 </div>
 64:             </div>
 65: 
 66:             <!-- Divider -->
 67:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
 68: 
 69:             <!-- Name Section -->
 70:             <div class="settings-form-section mb-8">
 71:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Name</MudText>
 72:                 <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 73:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 74:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.FirstName" 
 75:                                       Label="First Name" 
 76:                                       Required="true" 
 77:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
 78:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
 79:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 80:                     </MudItem>
 81:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 82:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.LastName" 
 83:                                       Label="Last Name" 
 84:                                       Required="true" 
 85:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 86:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
 87:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" />
 88:                     </MudItem>
 89:                 </MudGrid>
 90:             </div>
 91: 
 92:             <!-- Divider -->
 93:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
 94: 
 95:             <!-- Contact Section -->
 96:             <div class="settings-form-section mb-8">
 97:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 600;" Class="mb-4">Contact Information</MudText>
 98:                 <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 99:                     <MudItem xs="12">
100:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.Email" 
101:                                       Label="Email" 
102:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
103:                                       ReadOnly="true" 
104:                                       HelperText="Email cannot be changed"
105:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
106:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" />
107:                     </MudItem>
108:                     <MudItem xs="12">
109:                         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_user.Username" 
110:                                       Label="Username" 
111:                                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
112:                                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
113:                                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.AlternateEmail" />
114:                     </MudItem>
115:                 </MudGrid>
116:             </div>
117: 
118:             <!-- Divider -->
119:             <MudDivider Class="my-6" />
120: 
121:             <!-- Action Buttons -->
122:             <div class="d-flex justify-end gap-3 mt-8">
123:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
124:                            Color="Color.Default" 
125:                            OnClick="ResetForm"
126:                            Class="rounded-pill px-6">
127:                     Cancel
128:                 </MudButton>
129:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" 
130:                            Color="Color.Primary" 
131:                            OnClick="SaveSettings" 
132:                            Disabled="@(!_success || _isSaving)" 
133:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Save"
134:                            Class="rounded-pill px-6">
135:                     @if (_isSaving)
136:                     {
137:                         <MudProgressCircular Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
138:                         <span>Saving...</span>
139:                     }
140:                     else
141:                     {
142:                         <span>Save Changes</span>
143:                     }
144:                 </MudButton>
145:             </div>
146:         </MudForm>
147:     }
148: </div>
149: 
150: @code {
151:     [Inject]
152:     private IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
153: 
154:     private MudForm? _form;
155:     private bool _loading = true;
156:     private bool _isSaving = false;
157:     private bool _success = true;
158:     private string? _errorMessage;
159:     private string? _successMessage;
160:     private string? _profileImagePreview;
161:     private UserDto? _user;
162:     private UserDto? _originalUser;
163: 
164:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
165:     {
166:         await LoadUserDataAsync();
167:     }
168: 
169:     private async Task LoadUserDataAsync()
170:     {
171:         try
172:         {
173:             _loading = true;
174:             _user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
175:             _originalUser = new UserDto
176:             {
177:                 Id = _user?.Id,
178:                 FirstName = _user?.FirstName,
179:                 LastName = _user?.LastName,
180:                 Email = _user?.Email,
181:                 Username = _user?.Username,
182:                 ProfileImageUri = _user?.ProfileImageUri
183:             };
184:             _profileImagePreview = _user?.ProfileImageUri;
185:         }
186:         catch (Exception ex)
187:         {
188:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load user profile: {ex.Message}";
189:         }
190:         finally
191:         {
192:             _loading = false;
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196:     private async Task SaveSettings()
197:     {
198:         if (_user == null)
199:             return;
200: 
201:         try
202:         {
203:             _isSaving = true;
204:             _errorMessage = null;
205:             _successMessage = null;
206: 
207:             var updateDto = new UpdateUserDto
208:             {
209:                 Id = _user.Id,
210:                 FirstName = _user.FirstName,
211:                 LastName = _user.LastName,
212:                 Email = _user.Email,
213:                 Username = _user.Username
214:             };
215: 
216:             var result = await UserService.UpdateUserAsync(updateDto);
217:             if (result?.Success == true)
218:             {
219:                 _successMessage = "Profile updated successfully!";
220:                 _originalUser = new UserDto
221:                 {
222:                     Id = _user.Id,
223:                     FirstName = _user.FirstName,
224:                     LastName = _user.LastName,
225:                     Email = _user.Email,
226:                     Username = _user.Username,
227:                     ProfileImageUri = _user.ProfileImageUri
228:                 };
229:             }
230:             else
231:             {
232:                 _errorMessage = result?.Message ?? "Failed to save profile";
233:             }
234:         }
235:         catch (Exception ex)
236:         {
237:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to save profile: {ex.Message}";
238:         }
239:         finally
240:         {
241:             _isSaving = false;
242:         }
243:     }
244: 
245:     private void ResetForm()
246:     {
247:         if (_originalUser != null && _user != null)
248:         {
249:             _user.FirstName = _originalUser.FirstName;
250:             _user.LastName = _originalUser.LastName;
251:             _user.Username = _originalUser.Username;
252:             _profileImagePreview = _originalUser.ProfileImageUri;
253:             _errorMessage = null;
254:             _successMessage = null;
255:         }
256:     }
257: 
258:     private Task OnProfileImageFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
259:     {
260:         try
261:         {
262:             if (_user != null && fileData != null)
263:             {
264:                 var base64 = Convert.ToBase64String(fileData.Content);
265:                 _profileImagePreview = $"data:{fileData.ContentType};base64,{base64}";
266:             }
267:         }
268:         catch (Exception ex)
269:         {
270:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to upload image: {ex.Message}";
271:         }
272: 
273:         return Task.CompletedTask;
274:     }
275: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Helpers/OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Text.Json;
  2: using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
  3: 
  4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers;
  5: 
  6: public sealed class OrganizationAppearanceSettings
  7: {
  8:     public string ProfileImageUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;
  9:     public string BackgroundColor { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 10:     public string BackgroundMediaUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 11:     public string BackgroundEffect { get; set; } = "None";
 12: 
 13:     public bool IsEmpty =>
 14:         string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ProfileImageUrl) &&
 15:         string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(BackgroundColor) &&
 16:         string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(BackgroundMediaUrl) &&
 17:         (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(BackgroundEffect) ||
 18:          BackgroundEffect.Equals("None", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 19: }
 20: 
 21: public static class OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper
 22: {
 23:     private const string AppearanceNode = "pageAppearance";
 24: 
 25:     public static OrganizationAppearanceSettings Parse(string? metadataJson)
 26:     {
 27:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadataJson))
 28:         {
 29:             return new OrganizationAppearanceSettings();
 30:         }
 31: 
 32:         try
 33:         {
 34:             var root = JsonNode.Parse(metadataJson) as JsonObject;
 35:             var appearance = root?[AppearanceNode] as JsonObject;
 36:             if (appearance == null)
 37:             {
 38:                 return new OrganizationAppearanceSettings();
 39:             }
 40: 
 41:             return new OrganizationAppearanceSettings
 42:             {
 43:                 ProfileImageUrl = appearance["profileImageUrl"]?.GetValue<string>() ?? string.Empty,
 44:                 BackgroundColor = appearance["backgroundColor"]?.GetValue<string>() ?? string.Empty,
 45:                 BackgroundMediaUrl = appearance["backgroundMediaUrl"]?.GetValue<string>() ?? string.Empty,
 46:                 BackgroundEffect = appearance["backgroundEffect"]?.GetValue<string>() ?? "None"
 47:             };
 48:         }
 49:         catch
 50:         {
 51:             return new OrganizationAppearanceSettings();
 52:         }
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public static string? Upsert(string? metadataJson, OrganizationAppearanceSettings appearance)
 56:     {
 57:         JsonObject root;
 58:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadataJson))
 59:         {
 60:             root = new JsonObject();
 61:         }
 62:         else
 63:         {
 64:             root = JsonNode.Parse(metadataJson) as JsonObject ?? new JsonObject();
 65:         }
 66: 
 67:         if (appearance.IsEmpty)
 68:         {
 69:             root.Remove(AppearanceNode);
 70:         }
 71:         else
 72:         {
 73:             root[AppearanceNode] = new JsonObject
 74:             {
 75:                 ["profileImageUrl"] = NullIfWhiteSpace(appearance.ProfileImageUrl),
 76:                 ["backgroundColor"] = NullIfWhiteSpace(appearance.BackgroundColor),
 77:                 ["backgroundMediaUrl"] = NullIfWhiteSpace(appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl),
 78:                 ["backgroundEffect"] = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.BackgroundEffect) ? "None" : appearance.BackgroundEffect.Trim()
 79:             };
 80:         }
 81: 
 82:         return root.Count == 0 ? null : root.ToJsonString(new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = false });
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     public static string BuildBannerStyle(OrganizationAppearanceSettings appearance, string fallbackColorHex)
 86:     {
 87:         var color = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appearance.BackgroundColor)
 88:             ? fallbackColorHex
 89:             : appearance.BackgroundColor.Trim();
 90: 
 91:         var mediaUrl = appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl?.Trim();
 92:         var overlay = appearance.BackgroundEffect?.Trim() switch
 93:         {
 94:             "SoftOverlay" => "linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.22), rgba(0,0,0,0.22))",
 95:             "StrongOverlay" => "linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.40), rgba(0,0,0,0.40))",
 96:             "Blur" => "linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.18), rgba(0,0,0,0.18))",
 97:             _ => string.Empty
 98:         };
 99: 
100:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mediaUrl))
101:         {
102:             return $"background: {color};";
103:         }
104: 
105:         var mediaBackground = $"url('{mediaUrl}') center / cover no-repeat";
106:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(overlay))
107:         {
108:             return $"background: {mediaBackground};";
109:         }
110: 
111:         return $"background: {overlay}, {mediaBackground};";
112:     }
113: 
114:     private static string? NullIfWhiteSpace(string? value)
115:     {
116:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? null : value.Trim();
117:     }
118: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/LookupTables.razor.cs
````csharp
 1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
 2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
 4: using MudBlazor;
 5: 
 6: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Admin;
 7: 
 8: public partial class LookupTables
 9: {
10:     [Inject] protected IAdminService AdminService { get; set; } = null!;
11:     [Inject] protected ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = null!;
12: 
13:     private bool isLoading = true;
14: 
15:     private ICollection<EventTypeListDto>? eventTypes;
16:     private ICollection<EventFormatListDto>? eventFormats;
17:     private ICollection<EventStatusListDto>? eventStatuses;
18:     private ICollection<VisibilityTypeListDto>? visibilityTypes;
19:     private ICollection<RegistrationModeListDto>? registrationModes;
20:     private ICollection<AudienceGenderListDto>? audienceGenders;
21:     private ICollection<AudienceAgeListDto>? audienceAges;
22:     private ICollection<MadhabListDto>? madhabs;
23:     private ICollection<LanguageListDto>? languages;
24:     private ICollection<OrganizationPositionListDto>? organizationPositions;
25:     private ICollection<StatusTypeListDto>? approvalStatuses;
26:     private ICollection<ActorTypeListDto>? actorTypes;
27:     private ICollection<FileTypeListDto>? fileTypes;
28:     private ICollection<DidCustodyTypeListDto>? didCustodyTypes;
29: 
30:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
31:     {
32:         try
33:         {
34:             isLoading = true;
35: 
36:             var tasks = new List<Task>
37:             {
38:                 LoadEventTypesAsync(),
39:                 LoadEventFormatsAsync(),
40:                 LoadEventStatusesAsync(),
41:                 LoadVisibilityTypesAsync(),
42:                 LoadRegistrationModesAsync(),
43:                 LoadAudienceGendersAsync(),
44:                 LoadAudienceAgesAsync(),
45:                 LoadMadhabsAsync(),
46:                 LoadLanguagesAsync(),
47:                 LoadOrganizationPositionsAsync(),
48:                 LoadApprovalStatusesAsync(),
49:                 LoadActorTypesAsync(),
50:                 LoadFileTypesAsync(),
51:                 LoadDidCustodyTypesAsync()
52:             };
53: 
54:             await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
55:         }
56:         catch (Exception ex)
57:         {
58:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading lookup tables: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
59:         }
60:         finally
61:         {
62:             isLoading = false;
63:         }
64:     }
65: 
66:     private async Task LoadEventTypesAsync() => eventTypes = await AdminService.GetEventTypesAsync();
67:     private async Task LoadEventFormatsAsync() => eventFormats = await AdminService.GetEventFormatsAsync();
68:     private async Task LoadEventStatusesAsync() => eventStatuses = await AdminService.GetEventStatusesAsync();
69:     private async Task LoadVisibilityTypesAsync() => visibilityTypes = await AdminService.GetVisibilityTypesAsync();
70:     private async Task LoadRegistrationModesAsync() => registrationModes = await AdminService.GetRegistrationModesAsync();
71:     private async Task LoadAudienceGendersAsync() => audienceGenders = await AdminService.GetAudienceGendersAsync();
72:     private async Task LoadAudienceAgesAsync() => audienceAges = await AdminService.GetAudienceAgesAsync();
73:     private async Task LoadMadhabsAsync() => madhabs = await AdminService.GetMadhabsAsync();
74:     private async Task LoadLanguagesAsync() => languages = await AdminService.GetLanguagesAsync();
75:     private async Task LoadOrganizationPositionsAsync() => organizationPositions = await AdminService.GetOrganizationPositionsAsync();
76:     private async Task LoadApprovalStatusesAsync() => approvalStatuses = await AdminService.GetApprovalStatusesAsync();
77:     private async Task LoadActorTypesAsync() => actorTypes = await AdminService.GetActorTypesAsync();
78:     private async Task LoadFileTypesAsync() => fileTypes = await AdminService.GetFileTypesAsync();
79:     private async Task LoadDidCustodyTypesAsync() => didCustodyTypes = await AdminService.GetDidCustodyTypesAsync();
````

````csharp
  8: 
  9: public partial class Tags
 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected ITagService TagService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = null!;
 14:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager Nav { get; set; } = null!;
 15: 
 16:     private ICollection<TagListDto> _tags = new List<TagListDto>();
 17:     private string _searchString = string.Empty;
 18:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 19: 
 20:     private IEnumerable<TagListDto> FilteredTags
 21:     {
 22:         get
 23:         {
 24:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
 25:             {
 26:                 return _tags;
 27:             }
 28: 
 29:             return _tags.Where(t =>
 30:                 (t.FullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
 31:                 (t.MasterCode?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
 32:         }
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 36:     {
 37:         await LoadTags();
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     private async Task LoadTags()
 41:     {
 42:         _isLoading = true;
 43:         try
 44:         {
 45:             _tags = await TagService.GetTagsAsync() ?? new List<TagListDto>();
 46:         }
 47:         catch (Exception ex)
 48:         {
 49:             Snackbar.Add($"Failed to load tags: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
 50:         }
 51:         finally
 52:         {
 53:             _isLoading = false;
 54:         }
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
 58:     {
 59:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 60:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateTagDialog>("Create Tag", options);
 61:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 62: 
 63:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: CreateTagDto createDto })
 64:         {
 65:             var response = await TagService.CreateTagAsync(createDto);
 66:             if (response?.Success == true)
 67:             {
 68:                 Snackbar.Add($"Tag '{createDto.FullName}' created successfully", Severity.Success);
 69:                 await LoadTags();
 70:             }
 71:             else
 72:             {
 73:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
 74:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to create tag: {errors}", Severity.Error);
 75:             }
 76:         }
 77:     }

 79:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(TagListDto tag)
 80:     {
 81:         if (!tag.Id.HasValue) return;
 82: 
 83:         var tagDetails = await TagService.GetTagByIdAsync(tag.Id.Value);
 84:         if (tagDetails == null)
 85:         {
 86:             Snackbar.Add("Failed to load tag details", Severity.Error);
 87:             return;
 88:         }
 89: 
 90:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<EditTagDialog>
 91:         {
 92:             { x => x.ExistingTag, tagDetails }
 93:         };
 94: 
 95:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 96:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditTagDialog>("Edit Tag", parameters, options);
 97:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 98: 
 99:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateTagDto updateDto } && updateDto.Id.HasValue)
100:         {
101:             var response = await TagService.UpdateTagAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
102:             if (response?.Success == true)
103:             {
104:                 Snackbar.Add($"Tag '{updateDto.FullName}' updated successfully", Severity.Success);
105:                 await LoadTags();
106:             }
107:             else
108:             {
109:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
110:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to update tag: {errors}", Severity.Error);
111:             }
112:         }
113:     }

118:

120:             "Confirm Delete",

122:             yesText: "Delete",
123:             cancelText: "Cancel");
124: 
125:         if (confirm == true)

131:                 await LoadTags();
132:             }
133:             else
134:             {
135:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to delete tag '{tag.FullName}'", Severity.Error);
````
