## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Organization/OrganizationMembersSection.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Organization member administration section for invite, role changes, and removals. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Enables direct member management inside Organization Admin Settings when user has admin role. *@
  3: 
  4: @using MudBlazor
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers
  7: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Organization
  8: @using System.Security.Claims
  9: @inject IOrganizationMemberService MemberService
 10: @inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
 11: @inject IDialogService DialogService
 12: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 13: @inject NavigationManager Navigation
 14: 
 15: <div class="settings-section">
 16:     <div class="settings-section-header">
 17:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Style="font-weight: 700;">Members</MudText>
 18:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-1">
 19:             People who belong to this organization.
 20:         </MudText>
 21:     </div>
 22: 
 23:     @if (_loading)
 24:     {
 25:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />
 26:     }
 27:     else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))
 28:     {
 29:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Dense="true" Class="mb-3">
 30:             @_errorMessage
 31:         </MudAlert>
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     @if (_canManage)
 35:     {
 36:         <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd" Class="mb-3">
 37:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 38:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 39:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.PersonAdd"
 40:                        OnClick="OpenInviteDialog">
 41:                 Invite Member
 42:             </MudButton>
 43:         </MudStack>
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     @if (!_members.Any())
 47:     {
 48:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true">
 49:             No members found for this organization.
 50:         </MudAlert>
 51:     }
 52:     else
 53:     {
 54:         <MudTable Items="_members" Hover="true" Striped="true" Elevation="0">
 55:             <HeaderContent>
 56:                 <MudTh>Member</MudTh>
 57:                 <MudTh>Role</MudTh>
 58:                 @if (_canManage)
 59:                 {
 60:                     <MudTh Style="text-align:right">Actions</MudTh>
 61:                 }
 62:             </HeaderContent>
 63:             <RowTemplate>
 64:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Member">
 65:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2">
 66:                         <MudAvatar Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined">
 67:                             @GetInitial(context)
 68:                         </MudAvatar>
 69:                         <div>
 70:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">
 71:                                 @(context.UserFullName ?? context.UserEmail ?? "Unknown")
 72:                             </MudText>
 73:                             @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context.OrganizationPositionFullName))
 74:                             {
 75:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">
 76:                                     @context.OrganizationPositionFullName
 77:                                 </MudText>
 78:                             }
 79:                         </div>
 80:                     </div>
 81:                 </MudTd>
 82:                 <MudTd DataLabel="Role">
 83:                     <MudChip T="string"
 84:                              Color="@RoleHelper.GetRoleColor(context.RoleId)"
 85:                              Size="Size.Small"
 86:                              Variant="Variant.Filled">
 87:                         @RoleHelper.GetRoleName(context.RoleId)
 88:                     </MudChip>
 89:                 </MudTd>
 90:                 @if (_canManage)
 91:                 {
 92:                     <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Style="text-align:right">
 93:                         @if (context.RoleId != RoleHelper.OrgCreator)
 94:                         {
 95:                             <MudMenu Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MoreVert"
 96:                                      Size="Size.Small"
 97:                                      Dense="true"
 98:                                      AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomRight"
 99:                                      TransformOrigin="Origin.TopRight">
100:                                 <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => OpenEditRoleDialog(context))" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit">Change Role</MudMenuItem>
101:                                 <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => RemoveMember(context))" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" IconColor="Color.Error">Remove</MudMenuItem>
102:                             </MudMenu>
103:                         }
104:                     </MudTd>
105:                 }
106:             </RowTemplate>
107:         </MudTable>
108: 
109:         <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd" Class="mt-3">
110:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
111:                        Color="Color.Primary"
112:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People"
113:                        OnClick="NavigateToMembers">
114:                 Open Full Members Page
115:             </MudButton>
116:         </MudStack>
117:     }
118: </div>
119: 
120: @code {
121:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
122:     public Guid OrganizationId { get; set; }
123: 
124:     private List<OrganizationMemberDto> _members = new();
125:     private bool _loading = true;
126:     private bool _canManage;
127:     private Guid? _currentUserId;
128:     private string? _errorMessage;
129: 
130:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
131:     {
132:         await LoadMembers();
133:     }
134: 
135:     private static string GetInitial(OrganizationMemberDto member)
136:     {
137:         var name = member.UserFullName ?? member.UserEmail;
138:         return string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) ? "?" : name[..1].ToUpperInvariant();
139:     }
140: 
141:     private async Task LoadMembers()
142:     {
143:         _loading = true;
144:         _errorMessage = null;
145:         try
146:         {
147:             var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
148:             _currentUserId = ExtractUserId(authState.User);
149: 
150:             var result = await MemberService.GetMembersAsync(OrganizationId);
151:             _members = result?.ToList() ?? new List<OrganizationMemberDto>();
152: 
153:             var me = _members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == _currentUserId);
154:             _canManage = RoleHelper.CanManage(me?.RoleId);
155:         }
156:         catch (Exception ex)
157:         {
158:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load members: {ex.Message}";
159:         }
160:         finally
161:         {
162:             _loading = false;
163:         }
164:     }
165: 
166:     private async Task OpenInviteDialog()
167:     {
168:         if (!_canManage)
169:         {
170:             return;
171:         }
172: 
173:         var parameters = new DialogParameters
174:         {
175:             ["OrganizationId"] = OrganizationId
176:         };
177:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<InviteMemberDialog>("Invite Member", parameters);
178:         var result = await dialog.Result;
179: 
180:         if (!result.Canceled)
181:         {
182:             Snackbar.Add("Member invited.", Severity.Success);
183:             await LoadMembers();
184:         }
185:     }
186: 
187:     private async Task OpenEditRoleDialog(OrganizationMemberDto member)
188:     {
189:         if (!_canManage)
190:         {
191:             return;
192:         }
193: 
194:         var parameters = new DialogParameters
195:         {
196:             ["Member"] = member,
197:             ["OrganizationId"] = OrganizationId
198:         };
199:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditMemberRoleDialog>("Change Role", parameters);
200:         var result = await dialog.Result;
201: 
202:         if (!result.Canceled)
203:         {
204:             Snackbar.Add("Member role updated.", Severity.Success);
205:             await LoadMembers();
206:         }
207:     }
208: 
209:     private async Task RemoveMember(OrganizationMemberDto member)
210:     {
211:         if (!_canManage || !member.Id.HasValue)
212:         {
213:             return;
214:         }
215: 
216:         bool? result = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
217:             "Remove Member",
218:             $"Are you sure you want to remove {member.UserEmail ?? member.UserFullName ?? "this member"}?",
219:             yesText: "Remove",
220:             cancelText: "Cancel");
221: 
222:         if (result != true)
223:         {
224:             return;
225:         }
226: 
227:         try
228:         {
229:             await MemberService.DeleteMemberAsync(member.Id.Value);
230:             Snackbar.Add("Member removed.", Severity.Success);
231:             await LoadMembers();
232:         }
233:         catch (Exception ex)
234:         {
235:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to remove member: {ex.Message}";
236:         }
237:     }
238: 
239:     private static Guid? ExtractUserId(ClaimsPrincipal user)
240:     {
241:         var raw = user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
242:             ?? user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
243:             ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
244: 
245:         return Guid.TryParse(raw, out var userId) ? userId : null;
246:     }
247: 
248:     private void NavigateToMembers()
249:     {
250:         Navigation.NavigateTo($"/organization/{OrganizationId}/members");
251:     }
252: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Admin/Tenant/TenantAdminSettingsLayout.razor
````razor
  1: @* ABOUTME: Sidebar layout component for Tenant Admin Settings. *@
  2: @* ABOUTME: Provides Google-style sidebar navigation for tenant-level policy, domain, and branding settings. *@
  3: 
  4: @using MudBlazor
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  7: 
  8: @inject ITenantOnboardingService TenantOnboardingService
  9: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 10: 
 11: <div class="settings-layout">
 12:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="py-8">
 13:         <!-- Header -->
 14:         <div class="settings-header mb-8">
 15:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">Tenant Settings</MudText>
 16:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-2">Manage tenant-level policy, domain, and branding settings</MudText>
 17:         </div>
 18: 
 19:         @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))
 20:         {
 21:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-4">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 22:         }
 23: 
 24:         @if (_isLoading)
 25:         {
 26:             <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Class="py-12">
 27:                 <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 28:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">Loading tenant settings...</MudText>
 29:             </MudStack>
 30:         }
 31:         else if (!_canEdit)
 32:         {
 33:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Class="mb-4">
 34:                 You do not have tenant administrator permissions to view or modify these settings.
 35:             </MudAlert>
 36:         }
 37:         else
 38:         {
 39:             <!-- Main Layout: Sidebar + Content -->
 40:             <MudGrid Spacing="4">
 41:                 <!-- Sidebar Navigation -->
 42:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="3">
 43:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="settings-sidebar pa-0 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
 44:                         <MudList T="string" Dense="false" DisablePadding="true">
 45:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Policy"
 46:                                          Text="Policies"
 47:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("policies")"
 48:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("policies"))" />
 49:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Language"
 50:                                          Text="Domain"
 51:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("domain")"
 52:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("domain"))" />
 53:                             <MudListItem Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Palette"
 54:                                          Text="Branding"
 55:                                          Class="@GetNavItemClass("branding")"
 56:                                          OnClick="@(() => SelectSection("branding"))" />
 57:                         </MudList>
 58:                     </MudPaper>
 59:                 </MudItem>
 60: 
 61:                 <!-- Content Area -->
 62:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="9">
 63:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="settings-content pa-6 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
 64:                         @if (_currentSection == "policies")
 65:                         {
 66:                             <TenantPoliciesSection Model="_model" />
 67:                         }
 68:                         else if (_currentSection == "domain")
 69:                         {
 70:                             <TenantDomainSection Model="_model" />
 71:                         }
 72:                         else if (_currentSection == "branding")
 73:                         {
 74:                             <TenantBrandingSection Model="_model" />
 75:                         }
 76: 
 77:                         <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
 78: 
 79:                         <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd">
 80:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 81:                                        Color="Color.Primary"
 82:                                        OnClick="SaveAsync"
 83:                                        Disabled="_isSaving"
 84:                                        StartIcon="@(_isSaving ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassEmpty : Icons.Material.Filled.Save)">
 85:                                 @(_isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Tenant Settings")
 86:                             </MudButton>
 87:                         </MudStack>
 88:                     </MudPaper>
 89:                 </MudItem>
 90:             </MudGrid>
 91:         }
 92:     </MudContainer>
 93: </div>
 94: 
 95: @code {
 96:     private TenantPolicySettingsModel _model = new();
 97:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 98:     private bool _isSaving;
 99:     private bool _canEdit;
100:     private string? _errorMessage;
101:     private string _currentSection = "policies";
102: 
103:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
104:     {
105:         var status = await TenantOnboardingService.GetStatusAsync();
106:         _canEdit = status?.IsCurrentUserTenantAdministrator == true;
107: 
108:         if (!_canEdit)
109:         {
110:             _isLoading = false;
111:             return;
112:         }
113: 
114:         _model = await TenantOnboardingService.GetSettingsAsync();
115:         _isLoading = false;
116:     }
117: 
118:     private async Task SaveAsync()
119:     {
120:         _isSaving = true;
121:         _errorMessage = null;
122: 
123:         var response = await TenantOnboardingService.UpdateSettingsAsync(_model);
124:         _isSaving = false;
125: 
126:         if (response.Success)
127:         {
128:             Snackbar.Add("Tenant settings saved.", Severity.Success);
129:             return;
130:         }
131: 
132:         _errorMessage = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response.Message)
133:             ? "Failed to save tenant settings."
134:             : response.Message;
135:     }
136: 
137:     private void SelectSection(string section)
138:     {
139:         _currentSection = section;
140:     }
141: 
142:     private string GetNavItemClass(string section)
143:     {
144:         return _currentSection == section ? "settings-nav-active" : "";
145:     }
146: }
````

38:     private MudForm form;
39:     private bool success;
40: 
41:     private CreateEventSessionDto sessionDto = new();
42: 
43:     private DateTime? startDate = DateTime.Now;
44:     private TimeSpan? startTime = DateTime.Now.TimeOfDay;
45:     private DateTime? endDate = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1);
46:     private TimeSpan? endTime = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1).TimeOfDay;

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/DeleteEventDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  4: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  5: 
  6: <MudDialog>
  7:     <TitleContent>
  8:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
  9:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Warning" Color="Color.Error" Class="mr-2" />
 10:             Delete Event
 11:         </MudText>
 12:     </TitleContent>
 13:     <DialogContent>
 14:         @if (_isLoading)
 15:         {
 16:             <div class="d-flex align-center justify-center pa-4">
 17:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />
 18:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="ml-3">Loading event details...</MudText>
 19:             </div>
 20:         }
 21:         else
 22:         {
 23:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">
 24:                 Are you sure you want to delete the event "<strong>@EventTitle</strong>"?
 25:             </MudText>
 26: 
 27:             @if (_sessionCount > 0)
 28:             {
 29:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Dense="true" Class="mb-3">
 30:                     This event has <strong>@_sessionCount</strong> @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions") that will also be deleted.
 31:                 </MudAlert>
 32:             }
 33: 
 34:             <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Dense="true">
 35:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 36:                     <strong>This action cannot be undone.</strong>
 37:                 </MudText>
 38:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mt-2">
 39:                     The following will be permanently deleted:
 40:                 </MudText>
 41:                 <ul class="mt-1 mb-0">
 42:                     <li>Event details and metadata</li>
 43:                     @if (_sessionCount > 0)
 44:                     {
 45:                         <li>@_sessionCount event @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions")</li>
 46:                         <li>All registrations for @(_sessionCount == 1 ? "this session" : "these sessions")</li>
 47:                     }
 48:                 </ul>
 49:             </MudAlert>
 50:         }
 51:     </DialogContent>
 52:     <DialogActions>
 53:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel" Variant="Variant.Text" Disabled="@_isDeleting">Cancel</MudButton>
 54:         <MudButton Color="Color.Error"
 55:                    Variant="Variant.Filled"
 56:                    OnClick="ConfirmDelete"
 57:                    Disabled="@(_isDeleting || _isLoading)"
 58:                    StartIcon="@(_isDeleting ? Icons.Material.Filled.HourglassBottom : Icons.Material.Filled.Delete)">
 59:             @(_isDeleting ? "Deleting..." : "Delete Event")
 60:         </MudButton>
 61:     </DialogActions>
 62: </MudDialog>
 63: 
 64: @code {
 65:     [CascadingParameter]
 66:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
 67: 
 68:     [Parameter]
 69:     public Guid EventId { get; set; }
 70: 
 71:     [Parameter]
 72:     public string EventTitle { get; set; } = "";
 73: 
 74:     [Inject]
 75:     private IEventService EventService { get; set; } = default!;
 76: 
 77:     [Inject]
 78:     private ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = default!;
 79: 
 80:     [Inject]
 81:     private ILogger<DeleteEventDialog> Logger { get; set; } = default!;
 82: 
 83:     private bool _isDeleting = false;
 84:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 85:     private int _sessionCount = 0;
 86: 
 87:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 88:     {
 89:         await LoadSessionCount();
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     private async Task LoadSessionCount()
 93:     {
 94:         _isLoading = true;
 95:         StateHasChanged();
 96: 
 97:         try
 98:         {
 99:             var sessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
100:             _sessionCount = sessions?.Count ?? 0;
101:             Logger.LogDebug("Loaded {SessionCount} sessions for event {EventId}", _sessionCount, EventId);
102:         }
103:         catch (Exception ex)
104:         {
105:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading session count for event {EventId}", EventId);
106:             // Continue anyway - deletion should still work even if we can't load session count
107:             _sessionCount = 0;
108:         }
109:         finally
110:         {
111:             _isLoading = false;
112:             StateHasChanged();
113:         }
114:     }
115: 
116:     private void Cancel()
117:     {
118:         Logger.LogDebug("Delete cancelled for event {EventId}", EventId);
119:         MudDialog.Cancel();
120:     }
121: 
122:     private async Task ConfirmDelete()
123:     {
124:         if (_isDeleting || _isLoading) return;
125: 
126:         _isDeleting = true;
127:         StateHasChanged();
128: 
129:         try
130:         {
131:             Logger.LogInformation("Attempting to delete event {EventId} with {SessionCount} sessions", EventId, _sessionCount);
132: 
133:             var success = await EventService.DeleteEventAsync(EventId);
134: 
135:             if (success)
136:             {
137:                 var message = _sessionCount > 0
138:                     ? $"Event and {_sessionCount} {(_sessionCount == 1 ? "session" : "sessions")} deleted successfully"
139:                     : "Event deleted successfully";
140: 
141:                 Logger.LogInformation("Successfully deleted event {EventId}", EventId);
142:                 Snackbar.Add(message, Severity.Success);
143:                 MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
144:             }
145:             else
146:             {
147:                 Logger.LogWarning("Failed to delete event {EventId} - API returned false", EventId);
148:                 Snackbar.Add("Failed to delete event. You may not have permission or the event may not exist.", Severity.Error);
149:                 _isDeleting = false;
150:                 StateHasChanged();
151:             }
152:         }
153:         catch (Exception ex)
154:         {
155:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting event {EventId}", EventId);
156:             Snackbar.Add($"Error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
157:             _isDeleting = false;
158:             StateHasChanged();
159:         }
160:     }
161: }
````

````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @inject IEventService EventService
 4: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 5: 
 6: <MudDialog>
 7:     <TitleContent>
 8:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
 9:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People" Class="mr-3 mb-n1" />
10:             Registration Manager
11:         </MudText>
12:     </TitleContent>
13:     <DialogContent>
14:     <MudDataGrid T="EventRegistrationListDto" Items="@registrations" ReadOnly="true"
15:                  Bordered="true" Dense="true" Hover="true">
16:         <Columns>
17:             <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.UserFullName" Title="Name" />
18:             <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.UserId" Title="User Id" />
19:             <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.ApprovalStatusFullName" Title="Status" />
20:             <TemplateColumn StickyRight="true">
21:                 <CellTemplate Context="context">
22:                     @if (context.Item.ApprovalStatusMasterCode == "PENDING")
23:                     {
24:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Check" Size="Size.Small" OnClick="@(() => UpdateStatus(context.Item, 2))" />
25:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Close" Size="Size.Small" OnClick="@(() => UpdateStatus(context.Item, 3))" />
26:                     }
27:                 </CellTemplate>
28:             </TemplateColumn>
29:         </Columns>
30:     </MudDataGrid>
31:     </DialogContent>
32:     <DialogActions>
33:         <MudButton OnClick="Close">Close</MudButton>
34:     </DialogActions>
35: </MudDialog>
36: 
37: @code {
38:     [CascadingParameter]
39:     private IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
40: 
41:     [Parameter] public Guid EventSessionId { get; set; }
42: 
43:     private List<EventRegistrationListDto> registrations = new();
44: 
45:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
46:     {
47:         await LoadRegistrations();
48:     }
49: 
50:     private async Task LoadRegistrations()
51:     {
52:         try
53:         {
54:             var result = await EventService.GetRegistrationsForSessionAsync(EventSessionId);
55:             registrations = result.ToList();
56:             StateHasChanged();
57:         }
58:         catch (Exception ex)
59:         {
60:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading registrations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
61:         }
62:     }
63: 
64:     private async Task UpdateStatus(EventRegistrationListDto registration, int newStatusId)
65:     {
66:         var dto = new UpdateEventRegistrationDto
67:         {
68:             Id = registration.Id,
69:             UserId = registration.UserId,
70:             EventSessionId = registration.EventSessionId,
71:             ApprovalStatusId = newStatusId,
72:             TenantId = registration.TenantId,
73:             AtprotoRecordId = null
74:         };
75: 
76:         try
77:         {
78:             var response = await EventService.UpdateRegistrationAsync(dto);
79:             if (response?.Success == true)
80:             {
81:                 Snackbar.Add("Registration status updated.", Severity.Success);
82:                 await LoadRegistrations();
83:             }
84:             else
85:             {
86:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Failed to update registration.", Severity.Error);
87:             }
88:         }
89:         catch (Exception ex)
90:         {
91:             Snackbar.Add($"Error updating status: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
92:         }
93:     }
94: 
95:     private void Close()
96:     {
97:         DialogReference?.Dismiss(DialogResult.Cancel());
98:     }
99: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/SessionSelectionDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: 
  4: <MudDialog>
  5:     <DialogContent>
  6:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4">Select Session</MudText>
  7:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-4">Which session(s) would you like to attend?</MudText>
  8:         
  9:         <MudStack Spacing="3">
 10:             <!-- Register All Option -->
 11:             <MudPaper Class="pa-4 cursor-pointer" 
 12:                       Elevation="@(IsAllSelected ? 4 : 0)"
 13:                       Style="@GetAllSelectionStyle()"
 14:                       OnClick="ToggleSelectAll">
 15:                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
 16:                     <MudCheckBox T="bool" Value="IsAllSelected" 
 17:                                  ValueChanged="@((v) => ToggleSelectAll())" 
 18:                                  Color="Color.Primary" />
 19:                     <div>
 20:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Color="Color.Primary"><b>Register for ALL Sessions</b></MudText>
 21:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">Select all @Sessions.Count available sessions</MudText>
 22:                     </div>
 23:                 </div>
 24:             </MudPaper>
 25: 
 26:             <MudDivider Class="my-2" />
 27: 
 28:             @foreach (var session in Sessions.Where(s => s.Id.HasValue))
 29:             {
 30:                 <MudPaper Class="pa-4 cursor-pointer"
 31:                           Elevation="@(_selectedSessionIds.Contains(session.Id!.Value) ? 4 : 0)"
 32:                           Style="@GetSessionStyle(session.Id!.Value)"
 33:                           OnClick="@(() => ToggleSelection(session.Id!.Value))">
 34:                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-3">
 35:                         <MudCheckBox T="bool" Value="@_selectedSessionIds.Contains(session.Id!.Value)"
 36:                                      ValueChanged="@((v) => ToggleSelection(session.Id!.Value))"
 37:                                      Color="Color.Primary" />
 38:                         <div>
 39:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1">@session.Title</MudText>
 40:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(session.StartTime?.ToString("f") ?? "")</MudText>
 41:                         </div>
 42:                     </div>
 43:                 </MudPaper>
 44:             }
 45:         </MudStack>
 46:     </DialogContent>
 47:     <DialogActions>
 48:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
 49:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="Submit" Disabled="@(!_selectedSessionIds.Any())">
 50:             Register (@_selectedSessionIds.Count)
 51:         </MudButton>
 52:     </DialogActions>
 53: </MudDialog>
 54: 
 55: @code {
 56:     [CascadingParameter] IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
 57:     [Parameter] public List<EventSessionListDto> Sessions { get; set; } = new();
 58: 
 59:     private HashSet<Guid> _selectedSessionIds = new();
 60: 
 61:     private bool IsAllSelected => Sessions.Any(s => s.Id.HasValue) && _selectedSessionIds.Count == Sessions.Count(s => s.Id.HasValue);
 62: 
 63:     private void ToggleSelectAll()
 64:     {
 65:         if (IsAllSelected)
 66:         {
 67:             _selectedSessionIds.Clear();
 68:         }
 69:         else
 70:         {
 71:             _selectedSessionIds = Sessions.Where(s => s.Id.HasValue).Select(s => s.Id!.Value).ToHashSet();
 72:         }
 73:     }
 74: 
 75:     private string GetAllSelectionStyle()
 76:     {
 77:         return IsAllSelected 
 78:             ? "border: 2px solid var(--mud-palette-primary); background-color: var(--mud-palette-primary-hover);" 
 79:             : "border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);";
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     private void ToggleSelection(Guid sessionId)
 83:     {
 84:         if (_selectedSessionIds.Contains(sessionId))
 85:             _selectedSessionIds.Remove(sessionId);
 86:         else
 87:             _selectedSessionIds.Add(sessionId);
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     private string GetSessionStyle(Guid sessionId)
 91:     {
 92:         return _selectedSessionIds.Contains(sessionId) 
 93:             ? "border: 2px solid var(--mud-palette-primary); background-color: var(--mud-palette-primary-hover);" 
 94:             : "border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);";
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
 98: 
 99:     private void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(_selectedSessionIds.ToList()));
100: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/ReviewDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using MudBlazor
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 3: 
 4: <MudDialog>
 5:     <DialogContent>
 6:         <MudStack Spacing="3">
 7:             <MudText>How was your experience with @OrganizationName?</MudText>
 8:             <MudRating @bind-SelectedValue="Rating" MaxValue="5" Size="Size.Large" />
 9:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="Comment" Label="Comment" Lines="4" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
10:         </MudStack>
11:     </DialogContent>
12:     <DialogActions>
13:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
14:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Submit Review</MudButton>
15:     </DialogActions>
16: </MudDialog>
17: 
18: @code {
19:     [CascadingParameter] IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; }
20:     [Parameter] public string OrganizationName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
21: 
22:     public int Rating { get; set; } = 5;
23:     public string Comment { get; set; } = string.Empty;
24: 
25:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
26: 
27:     private void Submit()
28:     {
29:         if (Rating == 0)
30:         {
31:             // Show error or require rating
32:             return;
33:         }
34:         MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(new { Rating, Comment }));
35:     }
36: }

451:     private static ICollection<T> DeserializeItems<T>(ICollection<object> items) where T : class
452:     {
453:         var result = new List<T>(items.Count);
454:         foreach (var item in items)
455:         {
456:             if (item is T typedItem)
457:             {
458: 
459:                 result.Add(typedItem);
460:             }
461:             else if (item is JsonElement jsonElement)
462:             {
463: 
464:                 var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(
465:                     jsonElement.GetRawText(),
466:                     JsonOptions);
467:                 if (deserialized != null)
468:                     result.Add(deserialized);
469:             }
470:             else
471:             {
472: 
473:                 var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(item, JsonOptions);
474:                 var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(json, JsonOptions);
475:                 if (deserialized != null)
476:                     result.Add(deserialized);
477:             }
478:         }
479:         return result;
480:     }
481: }

16:     [Inject] protected ILogger<AdminListDetails> Logger { get; set; } = null!;
17: 
18:     private Guid OrganizationId { get; set; }
19: 
20:     private OrganizationDto? Organization;
21: 
22:     private bool _isLoading = true;
23:     private string? _errorMessage;
24: 
25:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
26:     {
27:         var orgIdStr = RouterState.GetParam("organizationId");
28:         if (Guid.TryParse(orgIdStr, out var id))
29:         {
30:             OrganizationId = id;
31:             await LoadOrganizationDetails();
32:         }
33:         else
34:         {
35:             _errorMessage = "Invalid Organization ID provided.";
36:             _isLoading = false;
37:         }
38:     }
39: 
40:     private async Task LoadOrganizationDetails()
41:     {
42:         _isLoading = true;
43:         _errorMessage = null;
44: 
45:         try
46:         {
47:             Organization = await AdminService.GetOrganizationDetailsAsync(OrganizationId);
48: 
49:             if (Organization == null)
50:             {
51:                 _errorMessage = "Organization not found";
52:                 Snackbar.Add(_errorMessage, Severity.Warning);
53:             }
54:         }
55:         catch (Exception ex)
56:         {
57:             _errorMessage = $"Error loading organization: {ex.Message}";
58:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load organization {OrganizationId}", OrganizationId);
59:             Snackbar.Add(_errorMessage, Severity.Error);
60:         }
61:         finally
62:         {
63:             _isLoading = false;
64:         }
65:     }
66: 
67:     private void NavigateBack()
68:     {
69:         NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/admin");
70:     }
71: 
72:     private static string GetStatusName(int statusTypeId) => statusTypeId switch
73:     {
74:         1 => "Pending",
75:         2 => "Approved",
76:         3 => "Rejected",
77:         _ => "Unknown"
78:     };
79: 
80:     private Color StatusColor(int statusTypeId) => statusTypeId switch
81:     {
82:         1 => Color.Info,
83:         2 => Color.Success,
84:         3 => Color.Error,
85:         _ => Color.Default
86:     };
87: }
````

 48:         }
 49:         catch (Exception ex)

 51:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load categories: {ex.Message}";
 52:         }
 53:         finally

 59:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
 60:     {
 61:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 62:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateCategoryDialog>("Create Category", options);
 63:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 64: 
 65:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: CreateCategoryDto createDto })
 66:         {
 67:             var response = await CategoryService.CreateCategoryAsync(createDto);
 68:             if (response?.Success == true)
 69:             {
 70:                 await LoadCategories();
 71:             }
 72:             else
 73:             {
 74:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to create category: {response?.Message ?? "Unknown error"}";
 75:             }
 76:         }
 77:     }

 79:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(CategoryListDto category)
 80:     {
 81:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<EditCategoryDialog>
 82:         {
 83:             { x => x.ExistingCategory, category }
 84:         };
 85: 
 86:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseButton = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
 87:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditCategoryDialog>("Edit Category", parameters, options);
 88:         var result = await dialog.Result;
 89: 
 90:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateCategoryDto updateDto } && updateDto.Id.HasValue)
 91:         {
 92:             var response = await CategoryService.UpdateCategoryAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
 93:             if (response?.Success == true)
 94:             {
 95:                 await LoadCategories();
 96:             }
 97:             else
 98:             {
 99:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to update category: {response?.Message ?? "Unknown error"}";
100:             }
101:         }
102:     }
103: 
104:     private async Task DeleteCategory(CategoryListDto category)
105:     {
106:         if (!category.Id.HasValue) return;
107: 
108:         bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
109:             "Confirm Delete",
110:             $"Are you sure you want to delete the category '{category.FullName}'? This action cannot be undone.",
111:             yesText: "Delete",
112:             cancelText: "Cancel");
113: 
114:         if (confirm == true)
115:         {
116:             var success = await CategoryService.DeleteCategoryAsync(category.Id.Value);
117:             if (success)
118:             {
119:                 await LoadCategories();
120:             }
121:             else
122:             {
123:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to delete category '{category.FullName}'";
124:             }
125:         }
126:     }

 14: <PageTitle>Tenant Navigation Settings</PageTitle>
 15: 
 16: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="py-8">
 17:     <!-- Header -->
 18:     <div class="settings-header mb-8">
 19:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">Navigation Links</MudText>
 20:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-2">Manage custom navigation links in the navbar</MudText>
 21:     </div>
 22: 
 23:     @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_errorMessage))
 24:     {
 25:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-4">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     @if (_isLoading)
 29:     {
 30:         <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Class="py-12">
 31:             <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 32:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">Loading navigation links...</MudText>
 33:         </MudStack>
 34:     }
 35:     else
 36:     {
 37:         <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-6 rounded-lg border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default">
 38:             <!-- Create Button -->
 39:             <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd" Class="mb-6">
 40:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 41:                            Color="Color.Primary"
 42:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
 43:                            OnClick="OpenCreateDialog">
 44:                     Create Link
 45:                 </MudButton>
 46:             </MudStack>
 47: 
 48:             <!-- Table -->
 49:             @if (_navigationLinks.Count == 0)
 50:             {
 51:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info">
 52:                     No navigation links yet. Create one to get started.
 53:                 </MudAlert>
 54:             }
 55:             else
 56:             {
 57:                 <MudTable Items="@_navigationLinks" Hover="true" Striped="true" Dense="false">
 58:                     <HeaderContent>
 59:                         <MudTh>Order</MudTh>
 60:                         <MudTh>Label</MudTh>
 61:                         <MudTh>URL</MudTh>
 62:                         <MudTh>Icon</MudTh>
 63:                         <MudTh>Open in New Tab</MudTh>
 64:                         <MudTh>Actions</MudTh>
 65:                     </HeaderContent>
 66:                     <RowTemplate>
 67:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Order">
 68:                             <MudStack Row="true" Spacing="1">
 69:                                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowUpward"
 70:                                                Size="Size.Small"
 71:                                                Color="Color.Default"
 72:                                                OnClick="@(() => MoveUp(context))"
 73:                                                Disabled="@IsFirstItem(context)"
 74:                                                Title="Move up" />
 75:                                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowDownward"
 76:                                                Size="Size.Small"
 77:                                                Color="Color.Default"
 78:                                                OnClick="@(() => MoveDown(context))"
 79:                                                Disabled="@IsLastItem(context)"
 80:                                                Title="Move down" />
 81:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@context.Order</MudText>
 82:                             </MudStack>
 83:                         </MudTd>
 84:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Label">@context.Label</MudTd>
 85:                         <MudTd DataLabel="URL">
 86:                             <MudLink Href="@context.Url" Target="_blank">@context.Url</MudLink>
 87:                         </MudTd>
 88:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Icon">
 89:                             @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context.Icon))
 90:                             {
 91:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@context.Icon" Size="Size.Small" />
 92:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Class="ml-2">@context.Icon</MudText>
 93:                             }
 94:                             else
 95:                             {
 96:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">(default)</MudText>
 97:                             }
 98:                         </MudTd>
 99:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Open in New Tab">
100:                             <MudCheckBox T="bool" @bind-Checked="context.OpenInNewTab" Disabled="true" />
101:                         </MudTd>
102:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions">
103:                             <MudStack Row="true" Spacing="1">
104:                                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
105:                                                Size="Size.Small"
106:                                                Color="Color.Primary"
107:                                                OnClick="@(() => OpenEditDialog(context))"
108:                                                Title="Edit" />
109:                                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
110:                                                Size="Size.Small"
111:                                                Color="Color.Error"
112:                                                OnClick="@(() => DeleteLink(context))"
113:                                                Title="Delete" />
114:                             </MudStack>
115:                         </MudTd>
116:                     </RowTemplate>
117:                 </MudTable>
118:             }
119:         </MudPaper>
120:     }
121: </MudContainer>
122: 
123: @code {
124:     private List<TenantNavigationLinkDto> _navigationLinks = new();
125:     private bool _isLoading = true;
126:     private string? _errorMessage;
127: 
128:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
129:     {
130:         await LoadLinksAsync();
131:     }
132: 
133:     private async Task LoadLinksAsync()
134:     {
135:         _isLoading = true;
136:         _errorMessage = null;
137: 
138:         try
139:         {
140:             var links = await NavigationService.GetNavigationLinksAsync();
141:             _navigationLinks = links.OrderBy(l => l.Order).ToList();
142:         }
143:         catch (Exception ex)
144:         {
145:             _errorMessage = "Failed to load navigation links.";
146:         }
147:         finally
148:         {
149:             _isLoading = false;
150:         }
151:     }
152: 
153:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
154:     {
155:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<TenantNavigationDialog>("Create Navigation Link");
156:         var result = await dialog.Result;
157: 
158:         if (!result.Canceled && result.Data is CreateTenantNavigationLinkDto createDto)
159:         {
160:             await CreateLink(createDto);
161:         }
162:     }
163: 
164:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(TenantNavigationLinkDto link)
165:     {
166:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<TenantNavigationDialog>
167:         {
168:             { x => x.ExistingLink, link }
169:         };
170: 
171:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<TenantNavigationDialog>("Edit Navigation Link", parameters);
172:         var result = await dialog.Result;
173: 
174:         if (!result.Canceled && result.Data is UpdateTenantNavigationLinkDto updateDto)
175:         {
176:             await UpdateLink(updateDto);
177:         }
178:     }
179: 
180:     private async Task CreateLink(CreateTenantNavigationLinkDto dto)
181:     {
182:         try
183:         {
184:             var response = await NavigationService.CreateNavigationLinkAsync(dto);
185:             if (response?.Success == true)
186:             {
187:                 Snackbar.Add("Navigation link created successfully.", Severity.Success);
188:                 await LoadLinksAsync();
189:             }
190:             else
191:             {
192:                 _errorMessage = response?.Message ?? "Failed to create navigation link.";
193:             }
194:         }
195:         catch (Exception ex)
196:         {
197:             _errorMessage = "An error occurred while creating the navigation link.";
198:         }
199:     }
200: 
201:      private async Task UpdateLink(UpdateTenantNavigationLinkDto dto)
202:      {
203:          try
204:          {
205:              var response = await NavigationService.UpdateNavigationLinkAsync(dto.Id.Value, dto);
206:             if (response?.Success == true)
207:             {
208:                 Snackbar.Add("Navigation link updated successfully.", Severity.Success);
209:                 await LoadLinksAsync();
210:             }
211:             else
212:             {
213:                 _errorMessage = response?.Message ?? "Failed to update navigation link.";
214:             }
215:         }
216:         catch (Exception ex)
217:         {
218:             _errorMessage = "An error occurred while updating the navigation link.";
219:         }
220:     }
221: 
222:     private async Task DeleteLink(TenantNavigationLinkDto link)
223:     {
224:         var confirmed = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
225:             "Confirm Delete",
226:             $"Are you sure you want to delete '{link.Label}'?",
227:             yesText: "Delete",
228:             cancelText: "Cancel");
229: 
230:          if (confirmed == true)
231:          {
232:              try
233:              {
234:                  var response = await NavigationService.DeleteNavigationLinkAsync(link.Id.Value);
235:                 if (response?.Success == true)
236:                 {
237:                     Snackbar.Add("Navigation link deleted successfully.", Severity.Success);
238:                     await LoadLinksAsync();
239:                 }
240:                 else
241:                 {
242:                     _errorMessage = response?.Message ?? "Failed to delete navigation link.";
243:                 }
244:             }
245:             catch (Exception ex)
246:             {
247:                 _errorMessage = "An error occurred while deleting the navigation link.";
248:             }
249:         }
250:     }
251: 
252:     private async Task MoveUp(TenantNavigationLinkDto link)
253:     {
254:         var index = _navigationLinks.IndexOf(link);
255:         if (index > 0)
256:         {
257:             await SwapOrder(index, index - 1);
258:         }
259:     }
260: 
261:     private async Task MoveDown(TenantNavigationLinkDto link)
262:     {
263:         var index = _navigationLinks.IndexOf(link);
264:         if (index < _navigationLinks.Count - 1)
265:         {
266:             await SwapOrder(index, index + 1);
267:         }
268:     }
269: 
270:     private async Task SwapOrder(int index1, int index2)
271:     {
272:         var link1 = _navigationLinks[index1];
273:         var link2 = _navigationLinks[index2];
274: 
275:         // Swap order values
276:         var tempOrder = link1.Order;
277:         link1.Order = link2.Order;
278:         link2.Order = tempOrder;
279: 
280:         // Swap in list
281:         _navigationLinks[index1] = link2;
282:         _navigationLinks[index2] = link1;
283: 
284:         // Call API to persist
285:         var orders = _navigationLinks.Select(l => new UpdateTenantNavigationLinkOrderDto
286:         {
287:             Id = l.Id,
288:             Order = l.Order
289:         }).ToList();
290: 
291:         try
292:         {
293:             var response = await NavigationService.ReorderNavigationLinksAsync(orders);
294:             if (response?.Success != true)
295:             {
296:                 _errorMessage = response?.Message ?? "Failed to reorder navigation links.";
297:                 await LoadLinksAsync(); // Reload to restore original order
298:             }
299:         }
300:         catch (Exception ex)
301:         {
302:             _errorMessage = "An error occurred while reordering navigation links.";
303:             await LoadLinksAsync(); // Reload to restore original order
304:         }
305:     }
306: 
307:     private bool IsFirstItem(TenantNavigationLinkDto link)
308:     {
309:         return _navigationLinks.IndexOf(link) == 0;
310:     }
311: 
312:     private bool IsLastItem(TenantNavigationLinkDto link)
313:     {
314:         return _navigationLinks.IndexOf(link) == _navigationLinks.Count - 1;
315:     }
316: }
````

 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Event
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Landing
 3: @inject IStartupRoutingService StartupRoutingService
 4: @inject NavigationManager Navigation
 5: @rendermode @(new InteractiveAutoRenderMode(prerender: true))
 6: 
 7: @switch (_state)
 8: {
 9:     case RootState.Loading:
10:         <MudContainer Class="d-flex justify-center align-center" Style="min-height: 60vh;">
11:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
12:         </MudContainer>
13:         break;
14:     case RootState.ShowLanding:
15:         <Home />
16:         break;
17:     case RootState.ShowEvents:
18:         <EventList />
19:         break;
20:     default:
21:         <MudContainer Class="d-flex justify-center align-center" Style="min-height: 60vh;">
22:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
23:         </MudContainer>
24:         break;
25: }
26: 
27: @code {
28:     private RootState _state = RootState.Loading;
29:     private bool _isInitialized;
30: 
31:     [PersistentState]
32:     public RootState? PersistedRootState { get; set; }
33: 
34:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
35:     {
36:         if (_isInitialized)
37:         {
38:             return;
39:         }
40: 
41:         _isInitialized = true;
42: 
43:         if (PersistedRootState.HasValue)
44:         {
45:             _state = PersistedRootState.Value;
46:             return;
47:         }
48: 
49:         await ResolveRootAsync();
50:     }
51: 
52:     private async Task ResolveRootAsync()
53:     {
54:         var decision = await StartupRoutingService.GetRootDecisionAsync();
55:         switch (decision)
56:         {
57:             case StartupRouteDecision.Setup:
58:                 Navigation.NavigateTo("/setup");
59:                 return;
60:             case StartupRouteDecision.InstanceAdmin:
61:                 Navigation.NavigateTo("/admin/instance/settings");
62:                 return;
63:             case StartupRouteDecision.PublicLanding:
64:                 _state = RootState.ShowLanding;
65:                 PersistedRootState = _state;
66:                 return;
67:             default:
68:                 _state = RootState.ShowEvents;
69:                 PersistedRootState = _state;
70:                 return;
71:         }
72:     }
73: 
74:     public enum RootState
75:     {
76:         Loading,
77:         ShowLanding,
78:         ShowEvents
79:     }
80: }
````

 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected IEventService EventService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected IUserService UserService { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected ISnackbar Snackbar { get; set; } = null!;

 17:     private List<MyRegistrationViewModel> _registrations = new();

 20: 
 21:     private IEnumerable<MyRegistrationViewModel> FilteredRegistrations =>
 22:         string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString)
 23:             ? _registrations
 24:             : _registrations.Where(r => r.EventTitle?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true);
 25: 
 26:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()

 28:         await LoadRegistrations();

 31:     private async Task LoadRegistrations()
 32:     {
 33:         _loading = true;
 34:         try
 35:         {
 36:             var user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
 37:             if (user != null && user.Id.HasValue)
 38:             {
 39:                 var registrations = await EventService.GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(user.Id.Value);
 40: 
 41:                 var tasks = registrations.Select(async r =>
 42:                 {
 43:                     var vm = new MyRegistrationViewModel
 44:                     {
 45:                         RegistrationId = r.Id ?? Guid.Empty,
 46:                         EventSessionId = r.EventSessionId ?? Guid.Empty,
 47:                         Status = r.ApprovalStatusFullName,
 48:                         StatusId = r.ApprovalStatusId
 49:                     };
 50: 
 51:                     if (r.EventSessionId.HasValue)
 52:                     {
 53:                         var session = await EventService.GetSessionByIdAsync(r.EventSessionId.Value);
 54:                         if (session != null)
 55:                         {
 56:                             vm.EventId = session.EventId ?? Guid.Empty;
 57:                             vm.EventTitle = session.EventTitle;
 58:                             vm.StartTime = session.StartTime;
 59: 
 60:                             if (session.EventId.HasValue)
 61:                             {
 62:                                 var evt = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(session.EventId.Value);
 63:                                 if (evt != null)
 64:                                 {
 65:                                     vm.FeaturedImageUri = evt.FeaturedImageUri;
 66:                                     vm.EventTitle = evt.Title;
 67:                                 }
 68:                             }
 69:                         }
 70:                     }
 71: 
 72:                     return vm;
 73:                 });
 74: 
 75:                 _registrations = (await Task.WhenAll(tasks)).ToList();
 76:             }
 77:         }
 78:         catch (Exception ex)
 79:         {
 80:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading registrations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
 81:         }
 82:         finally
 83:         {
 84:             _loading = false;
 85:         }
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     private async Task CancelRegistration(Guid registrationId)
 89:     {
 90:         var result = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
 91:             "Cancel Registration",
 92:             "Are you sure you want to cancel your registration for this event?",
 93:             yesText: "Yes, Cancel", cancelText: "No");
 94: 
 95:         if (result == true)
 96:         {
 97:             try
 98:             {
 99:                 var success = await EventService.CancelEventRegistrationAsync(registrationId);
100:                 if (success)
101:                 {
102:                     Snackbar.Add("Registration cancelled successfully.", Severity.Success);
103:                     await LoadRegistrations();
104:                 }
105:                 else
106:                 {
107:                     Snackbar.Add("Failed to cancel registration.", Severity.Error);
108:                 }
109:             }
110:             catch (Exception ex)
111:             {
112:                 Snackbar.Add($"Error cancelling registration: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
113:             }
114:         }
115:     }

24:             return false;
25:         }
26: 
27:         var authState = await authStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
28:         var user = authState.User;
29:         if (user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true)
30:         {
31:             return false;
32:         }
33: 
34: 
35:         var orgId = ExtractOrgIdFromPath(match.MatchedPath);
36:         if (orgId is null)
37:         {
38:             return false;
39:         }
40: 
41:         return user.HasClaim(c => c.Type == OrgAdminClaim
42:                                   && string.Equals(c.Value, orgId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
43:     }
44: 
45:     public async Task<string?> GetRedirectPathAsync(RouteMatch match)
46:     {
47:         if (authStateProvider is not null)
48:         {
49:             var authState = await authStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
50:             if (authState?.User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
51:             {
52:                 return "/";
53:             }
54:         }
55: 
56:         var returnUrl = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(match.MatchedPath)
57:             ? "/"
58:             : match.MatchedPath;
59: 
60:         return $"/login?returnUrl={Uri.EscapeDataString(returnUrl)}";
61:     }
62: 
63:     private static string? ExtractOrgIdFromPath(string? path)
64:     {
65:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
66:             return null;
67: 
68: 
69:         var match = OrgIdPattern().Match(path);
70:         return match.Success ? match.Groups[1].Value : null;
71:     }
72: 
73:     [GeneratedRegex(@"/organization/([0-9a-fA-F\-]{36})", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled)]
74:     private static partial Regex OrgIdPattern();
75: }
````

 10: 
 11: 
 12: public interface IAuthStateService
 13: {
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: 
 18:     Task<string> GetCurrentUserIdAsync();
 19: 
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23: 
 24:     Task<Guid> GetCurrentTenantIdAsync();
 25: 
 26: 
 27: 
 28: 
 29:     Task<bool> IsAuthenticatedAsync();
 30: }
 31: 
 32: public class AuthStateService : IAuthStateService
 33: {
 34:     private readonly AuthenticationStateProvider _authenticationStateProvider;
 35:     private readonly ILogger<AuthStateService> _logger;
 36:     private readonly TenantConfiguration _tenantConfig;
 37: 
 38:     public AuthStateService(
 39:         AuthenticationStateProvider authenticationStateProvider,
 40:         ILogger<AuthStateService> logger,
 41:         IOptions<TenantConfiguration> tenantConfig)
 42:     {
 43:         _authenticationStateProvider = authenticationStateProvider;
 44:         _logger = logger;
 45:         _tenantConfig = tenantConfig?.Value ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tenantConfig));
 46: 
 47: 
 48:         if (!_tenantConfig.IsValid())
 49:         {
 50:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
 51:                 "Invalid tenant configuration. DefaultTenantId and DefaultTenant must be set.");
 52:         }
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public async Task<string> GetCurrentUserIdAsync()
 56:     {
 57:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 58:         var user = authState.User;
 59: 
 60:         if (!user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
 61:         {
 62:             _logger.LogWarning("Attempted to get user ID for unauthenticated user");
 63:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User is not authenticated");
 64:         }
 65: 
 66: 
 67:         var userId = user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
 68:                      ?? user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
 69:                      ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
 70:                      ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
 71: 
 72:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
 73:         {
 74:             _logger.LogError("User ID not found in JWT claims for authenticated user. Available claims: {Claims}",
 75:                 string.Join(", ", user.Claims.Select(c => c.Type)));
 76:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User ID not found in token claims");
 77:         }
 78: 
 79:         return userId;
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     public async Task<Guid> GetCurrentTenantIdAsync()
 83:     {
 84:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
 85:         var user = authState.User;
 86: 
 87:         if (!user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? true)
 88:         {
 89:             _logger.LogWarning("Attempted to get tenant ID for unauthenticated user");
 90:             throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("User is not authenticated");
 91:         }
 92: 
 93: 
 94: 
 95:         if (!_tenantConfig.Enabled)
 96:         {
 97:             _logger.LogDebug("Single-tenant mode: Using default tenant {TenantId}", _tenantConfig.DefaultTenantId);
 98:             return _tenantConfig.DefaultTenantId;
 99:         }
100: 
101: 
102:         _logger.LogDebug("Multi-tenant mode: Extracting tenant from user claims");
103: 
104: 
105:         var tenantIdString = user.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value
106:                             ?? user.FindFirst("tenantId")?.Value
107:                             ?? user.FindFirst("tid")?.Value
108:                             ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/tenantid")?.Value;
109: 
110:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantIdString))
111:         {
112: 
113:             _logger.LogError("Multi-tenant mode enabled but tenant ID not found in claims. Available claims: {Claims}",
114:                 string.Join(", ", user.Claims.Select(c => c.Type)));
115:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
116:                 "Multi-tenant mode is enabled but no tenant ID found in user claims. " +
117:                 "Ensure your identity provider includes tenant_id claim.");
118:         }
119: 
120:         if (!Guid.TryParse(tenantIdString, out var tenantId))
121:         {
122:             _logger.LogError("Invalid tenant ID format in claims: {TenantId}", tenantIdString);
123:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid tenant ID format: {tenantIdString}");
124:         }
125: 
126:         _logger.LogDebug("Multi-tenant mode: Using tenant {TenantId} from claims", tenantId);
127:         return tenantId;
128:     }
129: 
130:     public async Task<bool> IsAuthenticatedAsync()
131:     {
132:         var authState = await _authenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
133:         return authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
134:     }
135: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Http;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 3: 
 4: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: 
10: public class BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler : DelegatingHandler
11: {
12:     private readonly ILogger<BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler>? _logger;
13: 
14:     public BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler()
15:     {
16: 
17:     }
18: 
19:     public BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler(ILogger<BrowserCredentialsMessageHandler> logger)
20:     {
21:         _logger = logger;
22:     }
23: 
24:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
25:         HttpRequestMessage request,
26:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
27:     {
28: 
29:         request.SetBrowserRequestCredentials(BrowserRequestCredentials.Include);
30: 
31: 
32:         request.SetBrowserRequestMode(BrowserRequestMode.SameOrigin);
33: 
34:         _logger?.LogDebug("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Credentials: Include, Mode: SameOrigin",
35:             request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
36: 
37:         try
38:         {
39:             var response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
40: 
41:             _logger?.LogDebug("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Response: {StatusCode}",
42:                 request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery, (int)response.StatusCode);
43: 
44: 
45:             if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
46:             {
47:                 _logger?.LogWarning("[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Unauthorized (401). User may need to re-authenticate.",
48:                     request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
49:             }
50: 
51:             return response;
52:         }
53:         catch (Exception ex)
54:         {
55:             _logger?.LogError(ex, "[WASM HTTP] {Method} {Uri} - Request failed",
56:                 request.Method, request.RequestUri?.PathAndQuery);
57:             throw;
58:         }
59:     }
60: }
````

 86:             if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("items", out var itemsProperty) && itemsProperty.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
 87:             {
 88:                 var rawItems = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GroupPublisherListDto>>(itemsProperty.GetRawText(), JsonOptions);
 89:                 return rawItems ?? new List<GroupPublisherListDto>();
 90:             }

200:         catch (ApiException ex)
201:         {
202:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[GroupService.DeleteGroupMemberAsync] API error deleting group member. MemberId: {MemberId}, StatusCode: {StatusCode}", memberId, ex.StatusCode);
203:             throw;
204:         }
205:     }
206: 
207:     private static bool TryReadHalEmbeddedItems(JsonElement root, out List<GroupPublisherListDto> items)
208:     {
209:         items = new List<GroupPublisherListDto>();
210: 
211:         if (!root.TryGetProperty("_embedded", out var embedded) || embedded.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
212:         {
213:             return false;
214:         }
215: 
216:         foreach (var property in embedded.EnumerateObject())
217:         {
218:             if (property.Value.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
219:             {
220:                 continue;
221:             }
222: 
223:             foreach (var item in property.Value.EnumerateArray())
224:             {
225:                 var parsed = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<GroupPublisherListDto>(item.GetRawText(), JsonOptions);
226:                 if (parsed != null)
227:                 {
228:                     items.Add(parsed);
229:                 }
230:             }
231: 
232:             return true;
233:         }
234: 
235:         return false;
236:     }
237: 
238:     private static string? ReadString(JsonElement root, string propertyName)
239:     {
240:         if (!root.TryGetProperty(propertyName, out var property))
241:         {
242:             return null;
243:         }
244: 
245:         return property.ValueKind switch
246:         {
247:             JsonValueKind.String => property.GetString(),
248:             JsonValueKind.Null => null,
249:             _ => property.ToString()
250:         };
251:     }
252: 
253:     private static Guid? ReadGuid(JsonElement root, string propertyName)
254:     {
255:         var raw = ReadString(root, propertyName);
256:         return Guid.TryParse(raw, out var value) ? value : null;
257:     }
258: }
259: 
260: public class GroupPublisherListDto
261: {
262:     public Guid Id { get; set; }
263:     public string FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
264:     public int? CurrentUserRole { get; set; }
265: }

17: public class MapsService : IMapsService
18: {
19:     private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
20:     private readonly ILogger<MapsService> _logger;
21: 
22:     public MapsService(HttpClient httpClient, ILogger<MapsService> logger)
23:     {
24:         _httpClient = httpClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClient));
25:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
26:     }
27: 
28:     public async Task<string> GetEmbedUrlAsync(string query)
29:     {
30:         try
31:         {
32:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query))
33:             {
34:                 return string.Empty;
35:             }
36: 
37:             var encodedQuery = Uri.EscapeDataString(query);
38:             var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync($"/bff/api/Maps/embed-url?query={encodedQuery}");
39: 
40:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
41:             {
42:                 var embedUrl = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
43: 
44:                 return embedUrl?.Trim('"') ?? string.Empty;
45:             }
46: 
47:             _logger.LogWarning("Error getting map embed URL: {StatusCode}", response.StatusCode);
48:             return string.Empty;
49:         }
50:         catch (Exception ex)
51:         {
52:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error in GetEmbedUrlAsync");
53:             return string.Empty;
54:         }
55:     }
56: }

 18:     public TenantOnboardingService(

 26:     public async Task<TenantOnboardingStatusModel?> GetStatusAsync()

 41:     {
 42:         try
 43:         {
 44:             var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient");
 45:             var result = await client.GetFromJsonAsync<TenantPolicySettingsModel>("api/TenantOnboarding/settings");
 46:             return result ?? new TenantPolicySettingsModel();
 47:         }
 48:         catch (Exception ex)

 51:             return new TenantPolicySettingsModel();

 56:     {

 58:     }

 61:     {

 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     private async Task<InstanceCommandResponseModel> SendAsync(HttpMethod method, string url, TenantPolicySettingsModel settings)
 66:     {
 67:         try
 68:         {
 69:             var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient");
 70:             using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(method, url)
 71:             {
 72:                 Content = JsonContent.Create(settings)
 73:             };
 74: 
 75:             var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
 76:             var payload = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<InstanceCommandResponseModel>();
 77:             if (payload != null)
 78:             {
 79:                 return payload;
 80:             }
 81: 
 82:             return new InstanceCommandResponseModel
 83:             {
 84:                 Success = response.IsSuccessStatusCode,
 85:                 Message = response.IsSuccessStatusCode
 86:                     ? "Operation completed successfully."
 87:                     : $"Operation failed with status {(int)response.StatusCode}."
 88:             };
 89:         }
 90:         catch (Exception ex)
 91:         {
 92:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to call tenant onboarding endpoint {Url}.", url);
 93:             return new InstanceCommandResponseModel
 94:             {
 95:                 Success = false,
 96:                 Message = "Request failed.",
 97:                 Errors = new List<string> { ex.Message }
 98:             };
 99:         }
100:     }
101: }

  7: {
  8:
