 275: 
 276: ---
 277: 
 278: ## 3. Render Modes
 279: 
 280: ### Policy: InteractiveAuto First
 281: 
 282: The application strictly adheres to the **`InteractiveAuto`** render mode policy for all standard UI pages.
 283: 
 284: **Configuration**:
 285: ```csharp
 286: // Program.cs
 287: app.MapRazorComponents<App>()
 288:     .AddInteractiveServerRenderMode()
 289:     .AddInteractiveWebAssemblyRenderMode()
 290:     .AddAdditionalAssemblies(typeof(Explore.Blazor.Client._Imports).Assembly);
 291: ```
 292: 
 293: **Why InteractiveAuto?**
 294: 1.  **Instant Load**: First visit renders HTML immediately on the server (SSR).
 295: 2.  **Seamless Transition**: The browser connects via SignalR (InteractiveServer) while the WASM bundle downloads in the background.
 296: 3.  **Offline Capability**: Subsequent visits (or once loaded) switch to WebAssembly for client-side interactivity, reducing server load.
 297: 
 298: ### Decision Matrix
 299: 
 300: | Scenario | Render Mode | Reason |
 301: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
 302: | **Standard Pages** (Events, Profile) | `InteractiveAuto` | Best balance of speed and interactivity. |
 303: | **Admin Dashboards** | `InteractiveAuto` | Consistent UX; admin users benefit from WASM performance too. |
 304: | **Static Content** (About, Terms) | `SSR` (Static) | No interactivity needed; fastest render. |
 305: | **Real-time / Heavy Compute** | `InteractiveServer` | Only if WASM performance is insufficient (Exception case). |
 306: 
 307: ### Implementation
 308: 
 309: **Page-Level (Preferred)**:
 310: ```razor
 311: @page "/events"
 312: @rendermode InteractiveAuto
 313: ```
 314: 
 315: **Component-Level (Avoid if possible)**:
 316: Inherits the page's render mode automatically. Only specify if a specific component needs a *different* mode than its parent (rare).
 317: 
 318: ---
 319: 
 320: ## 4. Service Layer Architecture
 321: 
 322: ### Interface-Based Design
 323: 
 324: All services implement an interface for testability.
 325: 
 326: **Generic Template:**
 327: 
 328: ```csharp
 329: // Interface definition
 330: public interface I{Entity}Service
 331: {
 332:     Task<ICollection<{Entity}ListDto>> GetAll{Entities}Async();
 333:     Task<{Entity}Dto?> Get{Entity}ByIdAsync({IdType} {entity}Id);
 334:     Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>?> Create{Entity}Async(Create{Entity}Dto dto);
 335:     Task<bool> Delete{Entity}Async({IdType} {entity}Id);
 336: }
 337: 
 338: // Implementation
 339: public class {Entity}Service : I{Entity}Service
 340: {
 341:     private readonly I{Entity}ApiClient _apiClient;
 342:     private readonly ILogger<{Entity}Service> _logger;
 343: 
 344:     public {Entity}Service(I{Entity}ApiClient apiClient, ILogger<{Entity}Service> logger)
 345:     {
 346:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 347:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 348:     }
 349: 
 350:     public async Task<ICollection<{Entity}ListDto>> GetAll{Entities}Async()
 351:     {
 352:         try
 353:         {
 354:             _logger.LogInformation("[{ENTITY} SERVICE] Fetching all {entities}...");
 355:             var response = await _apiClient.{Entity}GETAsync(pageNumber: 1, pageSize: 100);
 356:             return response?.Items ?? new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
 357:         }
 358:         catch (ApiException ex)
 359:         {
 360:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[{ENTITY} SERVICE] API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 361:             return new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
 362:         }
 363:     }
 364: }
 365: ```
 366: 
 367: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 368: 
 369: ```csharp
 370: // Interface definition
 371: public interface IEventService
 372: {
 373:     Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetAllEventsAsync();
 374:     Task<EventDto?> GetEventByIdAsync(Guid eventId);
 375:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> CreateEventAsync(CreateEventDto dto);
 376:     Task<bool> DeleteEventAsync(Guid eventId);
 377: }
 378: 
 379: // Implementation
 380: public class EventService : IEventService
 381: {
 382:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient;
 383:     private readonly ILogger<EventService> _logger;
 384: 
 385:     public EventService(IEventApiClient apiClient, ILogger<EventService> logger)
 386:     {
 387:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 388:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 389:     }
 390: 
 391:     public async Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetAllEventsAsync()
 392:     {
 393:         try
 394:         {
 395:             _logger.LogInformation("[EVENT SERVICE] Fetching all events...");
 396:             var response = await _apiClient.EventGETAsync(pageNumber: 1, pageSize: 100);
 397:             return response?.Items ?? new List<EventListDto>();
 398:         }
 399:         catch (ApiException ex)
 400:         {
 401:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[EVENT SERVICE] API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 402:             return new List<EventListDto>();
 403:         }
 404:     }
 405: }
 406: ```
 407: 
 408: ### Service Registration
 409: 
 410: Services are registered in `Program.cs`.
 411: 
 412: **Generic Template:**
 413: 
 414: ```csharp
 415: // {Project}.Blazor/Program.cs
 416: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{Entity}Service, {Entity}Service>();
 417: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{RelatedEntity}Service, {RelatedEntity}Service>();
 418: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICategoryService, CategoryService>();
 419: builder.Services.AddScoped<IAuthStateService, AuthStateService>();
 420: // ... etc
 421: ```
 422: 
 423: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 424: 
 425: ```csharp
 426: // Explore.Blazor/Program.cs
 427: builder.Services.AddScoped<IEventService, EventService>();
 428: builder.Services.AddScoped<IOrganizationService, OrganizationService>();
 429: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICategoryService, CategoryService>();
 430: builder.Services.AddScoped<IAuthStateService, AuthStateService>();
 431: // ... etc
 432: ```
 433: 
 434: ### NSwag API Client
 435: 
 436: The API client is auto-generated from OpenAPI spec.
 437: 
 438: **Generic Template:**
 439: 
 440: ```csharp
 441: // Configured in Program.cs
 442: builder.Services.AddHttpClient<I{Entity}ApiClient, {Entity}ApiClient>(client =>
 443:     {
 444:         client.BaseAddress = new Uri({project}ApiBaseUrl);
 445:     })
 446:     .AddHttpMessageHandler<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>()
 447:     .ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() => new HttpClientHandler
 448:     {
 449:         // Dev SSL handling if needed
 450:     });
 451: ```
 452: 
 453: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 454: 
 455: ```csharp
 456: // Configured in Program.cs
 457: builder.Services.AddHttpClient<IEventApiClient, EventApiClient>(client =>
 458:     {
 459:         client.BaseAddress = new Uri(exploreApiBaseUrl);
 460:     })
 461:     .AddHttpMessageHandler<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>()
 462:     .ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() => new HttpClientHandler
 463:     {
 464:         // Dev SSL handling if needed
 465:     });
 466: ```

 469: 
 470: ## 5. Component Patterns
 471: 
 472: ### Page Components
 473: 
 474: Page components are routable and typically:
 475: 1. Load data in `OnInitializedAsync`
 476: 2. Manage local state
 477: 3. Delegate to services for API calls
 478: 
 479: **Generic Template:**
 480: 
 481: ```razor
 482: @page "/{entities}"
 483: @inject I{Entity}Service {Entity}Service
 484: @inject ILogger<{Entity}List> Logger
 485: 
 486: <PageTitle>{Entities}</PageTitle>
 487: 
 488: @if (_isLoading)
 489: {
 490:     <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" />
 491: }
 492: else
 493: {
 494:     @foreach (var item in _{entities})
 495:     {
 496:         <{Entity}Card {Entity}="@item" />
 497:     }
 498: }
 499: 
 500: @code {
 501:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 502:     private ICollection<{Entity}ListDto> _{entities} = new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
 503: 
 504:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 505:     {
 506:         try
 507:         {
 508:             _{entities} = await {Entity}Service.GetAll{Entities}Async();
 509:         }
 510:         catch (Exception ex)
 511:         {
 512:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading {entities}");
 513:         }
 514:         finally
 515:         {
 516:             _isLoading = false;
 517:         }
 518:     }
 519: }
 520: ```
 521: 
 522: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 523: 
 524: ```razor
 525: @page "/events"
 526: @inject IEventService EventService
 527: @inject ILogger<EventList> Logger
 528: 
 529: <PageTitle>Explore Events</PageTitle>
 530: 
 531: @if (_isLoading)
 532: {
 533:     <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" />
 534: }
 535: else
 536: {
 537:     @foreach (var evt in _events)
 538:     {
 539:         <EventCard Event="@evt" />
 540:     }
 541: }
 542: 
 543: @code {
 544:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 545:     private ICollection<EventListDto> _events = new List<EventListDto>();
 546: 
 547:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 548:     {
 549:         try
 550:         {
 551:             _events = await EventService.GetAllEventsAsync();
 552:         }
 553:         catch (Exception ex)
 554:         {
 555:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading events");
 556:         }
 557:         finally
 558:         {
 559:             _isLoading = false;
 560:         }
 561:     }
 562: }
 563: ```
 564: 
 565: ### Reusable Components
 566: 
 567: Components receive data via parameters and emit events.
 568: 
 569: **Generic Template:**
 570: 
 571: ```razor
 572: @* {Entity}Card.razor *@
 573: <MudCard Class="{entity}-card">
 574:     <MudCardContent>
 575:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@{Entity}.Title</MudText>
 576:     </MudCardContent>
 577:     <MudCardActions>
 578:         <MudButton OnClick="@(() => OnViewDetails.InvokeAsync({Entity}.Id))">
 579:             View Details
 580:         </MudButton>
 581:     </MudCardActions>
 582: </MudCard>
 583: 
 584: @code {
 585:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
 586:     public {Entity}ListDto {Entity} { get; set; } = null!;
 587: 
 588:     [Parameter]
 589:     public EventCallback<{IdType}> OnViewDetails { get; set; }
 590: }
 591: ```
 592: 
 593: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 594: 
 595: ```razor
 596: @* EventCard.razor *@
 597: <MudCard Class="event-card">
 598:     <MudCardContent>
 599:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@Event.Title</MudText>
 600:     </MudCardContent>
 601:     <MudCardActions>
 602:         <MudButton OnClick="@(() => OnViewDetails.InvokeAsync(Event.Id))">
 603:             View Details
 604:         </MudButton>
 605:     </MudCardActions>
 606: </MudCard>
 607: 
 608: @code {
 609:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
 610:     public EventListDto Event { get; set; } = null!;
 611: 
 612:     [Parameter]
 613:     public EventCallback<Guid> OnViewDetails { get; set; }
 614: }
 615: ```
 616: 
 617: ### Parameter Conventions
 618: 
 619: | Convention | Example |
 620: |------------|---------|
 621: | Required parameters | `[Parameter, EditorRequired]` |
 622: | Nullable parameters | `[Parameter] public Guid? ParentId { get; set; }` |
 623: | Event callbacks | `[Parameter] public EventCallback<T> OnChanged { get; set; }` |
 624: | Cascading values | `[CascadingParameter] public Task<AuthenticationState> AuthState { get; set; }` |
 625: 
 626: ---
 627: 
 628: ## 6. MudBlazor Usage
 629: 
 630: ### Required Providers
 631: 
 632: In `MainLayout.razor`:
 633: 
 634: ```razor
 635: <MudThemeProvider Theme="@_theme" IsDarkMode="@_isDarkMode" />
 636: <MudPopoverProvider />
 637: <MudDialogProvider />
 638: <MudSnackbarProvider />
 639: ```
 640: 
 641: ### Common Components
 642: 
 643: **Data Display**:
 644: ```razor
 645: @* DataGrid with CRUD *@
 646: <MudDataGrid T="EventSessionListDto" Items="@sessions"
 647:              ReadOnly="false" EditMode="DataGridEditMode.Cell"
 648:              Bordered="true" Dense="true" Hover="true">
 649:     <Columns>
 650:         <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.Title" />
 651:         <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.StartTime" Format="s" />
 652:         <TemplateColumn StickyRight="true">
 653:             <CellTemplate>
 654:                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
 655:                                OnClick="@(() => Edit(context.Item))" />
 656:             </CellTemplate>
 657:         </TemplateColumn>
 658:     </Columns>
 659: </MudDataGrid>
 660: ```
 661: 
 662: **Forms**:
 663: ```razor
 664: <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="@_isValid">
 665:     <MudTextField @bind-Value="model.Title"
 666:                   Label="Title"
 667:                   Required="true"
 668:                   RequiredError="Title is required" />
 669: 
 670:     <MudSelect @bind-Value="model.CategoryId"
 671:                Label="Category"
 672:                AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter">
 673:         @foreach (var cat in categories)
 674:         {
 675:             <MudSelectItem Value="@cat.Id">@cat.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 676:         }
 677:     </MudSelect>
 678: 
 679:     <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="model.StartDate"
 680:                    Label="Start Date" />
 681: </MudForm>
 682: ```
 683: 
 684: **Feedback**:
 685: ```razor
 686: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 687: 
 688: @code {
 689:     private async Task SaveAsync()
 690:     {
 691:         var result = await Service.CreateAsync(model);
 692:         if (result?.Success == true)
 693:         {
 694:             Snackbar.Add("Created successfully!", Severity.Success);
 695:         }
 696:         else
 697:         {
 698:             Snackbar.Add(result?.Message ?? "Error", Severity.Error);
 699:         }
 700:     }
 701: }
 702: ```
 703: 
 704: ---
 705: 
 706: ## 7. State Management
 707: 
 708: ### 7.1. URL-Based State (The Source of Truth)
 709: 
 710: For list views, filters, and pagination, the **URL is the single source of truth**. This ensures deep-linking works and state survives refreshes.
 711: 
 712: **Pattern**: Use `[SupplyParameterFromQuery]`.
 713: 
 714: ```csharp
 715: @page "/events"
 716: 
 717: @code {
 718:     [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "q")]
 719:     public string? SearchTerm { get; set; }
 720: 
 721:     [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
 722:     public int Page { get; set; } = 1;
 723: 
 724:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 725:     {
 726:         // Load data based on URL parameters
 727:         await LoadDataAsync();
 728:     }
 729: 
 730:     private void OnSearch(string term)
 731:     {
 732:         // Update URL, triggering navigation and re-initialization
 733:         Navigation.NavigateTo(
 734:             Navigation.GetUriWithQueryParameters(new Dictionary<string, object?>
 735:             {
 736:                 ["q"] = term,
 737:                 ["Page"] = 1 // Reset page on filter change
 738:             }));
 739:     }
 740: }
 741: ```
 742: 
 743: ### 7.2. Cascading Values (Global Context)
 744: 
 745: Use `CascadingValue` for read-only global context like Tenant, Theme, or User Identity.
 746: 
 747: ```razor
 748: @* MainLayout.razor *@
 749: <CascadingValue Value="@_tenantContext" Name="TenantContext" IsFixed="true">
 750:     @Body
 751: </CascadingValue>
 752: ```
 753: 
 754: ### 7.3. Service State (Caching)
 755: 
 756: Use Scoped Services to cache data that doesn't change often but is needed across components (e.g., User Profile, Lookup Data).
 757: 
 758: **Do NOT** use static fields for state (creates bugs in Server mode).
 759: 
 760: ### 7.4. AuthStateService
 761: 
 762: Centralized authentication state:
 763: 
 764: ```csharp
 765: public interface IAuthStateService
 766: {
 767:     Task<string> GetCurrentUserIdAsync();
 768:     Task<Guid> GetCurrentTenantIdAsync();
 769:     Task<bool> IsAuthenticatedAsync();
 770: }
 771: ```
 772: 
 773: ---
 774: 
 775: ## 8. Pagination Patterns
 776: 
 777: ### Client-Side Pagination
 778: 
 779: For smaller datasets (< 1000 items), load all and paginate client-side.
 780: 
 781: **Generic Template:**
 782: 
 783: ```razor
 784: <MudPagination Count="@TotalPages"
 785:                Selected="@_currentPage"
 786:                SelectedChanged="@OnPageChanged"
 787:                Color="Color.Primary"
 788:                ShowFirstButton="true"
 789:                ShowLastButton="true" />
 790: 
 791: <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 792:     Showing @((_currentPage - 1) * _pageSize + 1) -
 793:     @(Math.Min(_currentPage * _pageSize, _allItems.Count))
 794:     of @_allItems.Count items
 795: </MudText>
 796: 
 797: @code {
 798:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 799:     private int _pageSize = 10;
 800:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _allItems = new();
 801: 
 802:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> PagedItems => _allItems
 803:         .Skip((_currentPage - 1) * _pageSize)
 804:         .Take(_pageSize)
 805:         .ToList();
 806: 
 807:     private int TotalPages => _allItems.Count > 0
 808:         ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_allItems.Count / _pageSize)
 809:         : 1;
 810: 
 811:     private void OnPageChanged(int page)
 812:     {
 813:         _currentPage = page;
 814:     }
 815: }
 816: ```
 817: 
 818: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 819: 
 820: ```razor
 821: @code {
 822:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 823:     private int _pageSize = 10;
 824:     private List<EventListDto> _allItems = new();
 825: 
 826:     private List<EventListDto> PagedItems => _allItems
 827:         .Skip((_currentPage - 1) * _pageSize)
 828:         .Take(_pageSize)
 829:         .ToList();
 830: 
 831:     private int TotalPages => _allItems.Count > 0
 832:         ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_allItems.Count / _pageSize)
 833:         : 1;
 834: 
 835:     private void OnPageChanged(int page)
 836:     {
 837:         _currentPage = page;
 838:     }
 839: }
 840: ```
 841: 
 842: ### Server-Side Pagination
 843: 
 844: For large datasets, use API pagination.
 845: 
 846: **Generic Template:**
 847: 
 848: ```csharp
 849: // Service method
 850: public async Task<PagedResult<{Entity}ListDto>> Get{Entities}PagedAsync(int page, int pageSize)
 851: {
 852:     var response = await _apiClient.{Entity}GETAsync(pageNumber: page, pageSize: pageSize);
 853:     return new PagedResult<{Entity}ListDto>
 854:     {
 855:         Items = response?.Items?.ToList() ?? new List<{Entity}ListDto>(),
 856:         TotalCount = response?.TotalCount ?? 0,
 857:         PageNumber = page,
 858:         PageSize = pageSize
 859:     };
 860: }
 861: ```
 862: 
 863: ```razor
 864: @code {
 865:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 866:     private int _pageSize = 10;
 867:     private int _totalCount = 0;
 868:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _items = new();
 869: 
 870:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 871:     {
 872:         await LoadPageAsync(_currentPage);
 873:     }
 874: 
 875:     private async Task LoadPageAsync(int page)
 876:     {
 877:         var result = await {Entity}Service.Get{Entities}PagedAsync(page, _pageSize);
 878:         _items = result.Items;
 879:         _totalCount = result.TotalCount;
 880:         _currentPage = page;
 881:     }
 882: 
 883:     private int TotalPages => _totalCount > 0
 884:         ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_totalCount / _pageSize)
 885:         : 1;
 886: 
 887:     private async Task OnPageChanged(int page)
 888:     {
 889:         await LoadPageAsync(page);
 890:     }
 891: }
 892: ```
 893: 
 894: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 895: 
 896: ```csharp
 897: // Service method
 898: public async Task<PagedResult<EventListDto>> GetEventsPagedAsync(int page, int pageSize)
 899: {
 900:     var response = await _apiClient.EventGETAsync(pageNumber: page, pageSize: pageSize);
 901:     return new PagedResult<EventListDto>
 902:     {
 903:         Items = response?.Items?.ToList() ?? new List<EventListDto>(),
 904:         TotalCount = response?.TotalCount ?? 0,
 905:         PageNumber = page,
 906:         PageSize = pageSize
 907:     };
 908: }
 909: ```
 910: 
 911: ```razor
 912: @code {
 913:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 914:     private int _pageSize = 10;
 915:     private int _totalCount = 0;
 916:     private List<EventListDto> _items = new();
 917: 
 918:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 919:     {
 920:         await LoadPageAsync(_currentPage);
 921:     }
 922: 
 923:     private async Task LoadPageAsync(int page)
 924:     {
 925:         var result = await EventService.GetEventsPagedAsync(page, _pageSize);
 926:         _items = result.Items;
 927:         _totalCount = result.TotalCount;
 928:         _currentPage = page;
 929:     }
 930: 
 931:     private int TotalPages => _totalCount > 0
 932:         ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_totalCount / _pageSize)
 933:         : 1;
 934: 
 935:     private async Task OnPageChanged(int page)
 936:     {
 937:         await LoadPageAsync(page);
 938:     }
 939: }
 940: ```
 941: 
 942: ### Filtering with Pagination
 943: 
 944: When filters change, reset to page 1.
 945: 
 946: **Generic Template:**
 947: 
 948: ```razor
 949: @code {
 950:     private {IdType}? _selectedCategoryId;
 951:     private string _searchText = "";
 952: 
 953:     private async Task OnCategoryChanged({IdType}? categoryId)
 954:     {
 955:         _selectedCategoryId = categoryId;
 956:         _currentPage = 1;  // Reset to first page
 957:         await ApplyFiltersAsync();
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     private void OnSearch(string value)
 961:     {
 962:         _searchText = value;
 963:         _currentPage = 1;  // Reset to first page
 964:     }
 965: 
 966:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> FilteredItems => _allItems
 967:         .Where(e => string.IsNullOrEmpty(_searchText) ||
 968:                     e.Title.Contains(_searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 969:         .Where(e => !_selectedCategoryId.HasValue ||
 970:                     e.CategoryId == _selectedCategoryId.Value)
 971:         .ToList();
 972: }
 973: ```
 974: 
 975: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 976: 
 977: ```razor
 978: @code {
 979:     private Guid? _selectedCategoryId;
 980:     private string _searchText = "";
 981: 
 982:     private async Task OnCategoryChanged(Guid? categoryId)
 983:     {
 984:         _selectedCategoryId = categoryId;
 985:         _currentPage = 1;  // Reset to first page
 986:         await ApplyFiltersAsync();
 987:     }
 988: 
 989:     private void OnSearch(string value)
 990:     {
 991:         _searchText = value;
 992:         _currentPage = 1;  // Reset to first page
 993:     }
 994: 
 995:     private List<EventListDto> FilteredItems => _allItems
 996:         .Where(e => string.IsNullOrEmpty(_searchText) ||
 997:                     e.Title.Contains(_searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 998:         .Where(e => !_selectedCategoryId.HasValue ||
 999:                     e.CategoryId == _selectedCategoryId.Value)
1000:         .ToList();
1001: }
1002: ```

1006: ## 9. Dialog Patterns
1007: 
1008: ### Creating Dialogs
1009: 
1010: ```razor
1011: @* CreateCategoryDialog.razor *@
1012: <MudDialog>
1013:     <DialogContent>
1014:         <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="@_isValid">
1015:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.FullName"
1016:                           Label="Name" Required="true" />
1017:         </MudForm>
1018:     </DialogContent>
1019:     <DialogActions>
1020:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
1021:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary"
1022:                    Disabled="@(!_isValid)"
1023:                    OnClick="Submit">Create</MudButton>
1024:     </DialogActions>
1025: </MudDialog>
1026: 
1027: @code {
1028:     [CascadingParameter]
1029:     private MudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
1030: 
1031:     private MudForm _form = null!;
1032:     private bool _isValid;
1033:     private CreateCategoryDto _model = new();
1034: 
1035:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
1036: 
1037:     private void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(_model));
1038: }
1039: ```
1040: 
1041: ### Opening Dialogs
1042: 
1043: ```csharp
1044: @inject IDialogService DialogService
1045: 
1046: @code {
1047:     private async Task OpenCreateDialogAsync()
1048:     {
1049:         var options = new DialogOptions
1050:         {
1051:             CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
1052:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
1053:             FullWidth = true
1054:         };
1055: 
1056:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateCategoryDialog>(
1057:             "Create Category",
1058:             options);
1059: 
1060:         var result = await dialog.Result;
1061: 
1062:         if (!result.Canceled)
1063:         {
1064:             var newCategory = (CreateCategoryDto)result.Data;
1065:             await SaveCategoryAsync(newCategory);
1066:         }
1067:     }
1068: }
1069: ```
1070: 
1071: ### Dialogs with Parameters
1072: 
1073: ```csharp
1074: var parameters = new DialogParameters
1075: {
1076:     { "EventId", eventId },
1077:     { "Title", "Edit Event" }
1078: };
1079: 
1080: var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditEventDialog>(
1081:     "Edit Event",
1082:     parameters,
1083:     options);
1084: ```
1085: 
1086: ### Confirmation Dialogs
1087: 
1088: ```csharp
1089: var confirmed = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
1090:     "Delete Item",
1091:     "Are you sure you want to delete this item?",
1092:     yesText: "Delete",
1093:     cancelText: "Cancel",
1094:     options: new DialogOptions
1095:     {
1096:         FullWidth = false,
1097:         MaxWidth = MaxWidth.ExtraSmall
1098:     }
1099: );
1100: 
1101: if (confirmed == true)
1102: {
1103:     await DeleteItemAsync(itemId);
1104: }
1105: ```
1106: 
1107: ---
1108: 
1109: ## 10. Authentication & Authorization
1110: 
1111: ### Checking Authentication State
1112: 
1113: ```razor
1114: @inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthStateProvider
1115: 
1116: <AuthorizeView>
1117:     <Authorized>
1118:         <MudText>Welcome, @context.User.Identity?.Name!</MudText>
1119:         <MudButton Href="/logout">Logout</MudButton>
1120:     </Authorized>
1121:     <NotAuthorized>
1122:         <MudButton Href="/login">Login</MudButton>
1123:     </NotAuthorized>
1124: </AuthorizeView>
1125: ```
1126: 
1127: ### Protected Pages
1128: 
1129: ```razor
1130: @page "/my-events"
1131: @attribute [Authorize]
1132: 
1133: @* Page content only visible to authenticated users *@
1134: ```
1135: 
1136: ### Using AuthStateService
1137: 
1138: ```csharp
1139: @inject IAuthStateService AuthState
1140: 
1141: @code {
1142:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
1143:     {
1144:         if (!await AuthState.IsAuthenticatedAsync())
1145:         {
1146:             Navigation.NavigateTo("/login?returnUrl=/my-events");
1147:             return;
1148:         }
1149: 
1150:         var userId = await AuthState.GetCurrentUserIdAsync();
1151:         var tenantId = await AuthState.GetCurrentTenantIdAsync();
1152: 
1153:         // Load user-specific data
1154:     }
1155: }
1156: ```
1157: 
1158: ### User ID Claim Extraction
1159: 
1160: The `AuthStateService` uses a fallback chain:
1161: 
1162: ```csharp
1163: var userId = user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
1164:              ?? user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
1165:              ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
1166:              ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
1167: ```
1168:

1171: ## 11. Theming
1172: 
1173: ### Theme Configuration
1174: 
1175: In `MainLayout.razor`:
1176: 
1177: ```csharp
1178: @code {
1179:     private bool _isDarkMode = false;
1180:     private MudTheme? _theme;
1181: 
1182:     protected override void OnInitialized()
1183:     {
1184:         _theme = new()
1185:         {
1186:             PaletteLight = _lightPalette,
1187:             PaletteDark = _darkPalette,
1188:             LayoutProperties = new LayoutProperties()
1189:         };
1190:     }
1191: 
1192:     private readonly PaletteLight _lightPalette = new()
1193:     {
1194:         Black = "#110e2d",
1195:         AppbarText = "#424242",
1196:         AppbarBackground = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)",
1197:         DrawerBackground = "#ffffff",
1198:         GrayLight = "#e8e8e8",
1199:         GrayLighter = "#f9f9f9",
1200:     };
1201: 
1202:     private readonly PaletteDark _darkPalette = new()
1203:     {
1204:         Primary = "#7e6fff",
1205:         Surface = "#1e1e2d",
1206:         Background = "#1a1a27",
1207:         // ... etc
1208:     };
1209: }
1210: ```
1211: 
1212: ### Theme Persistence
1213: 
1214: Theme preference is stored in localStorage and cookie:
1215: 
1216: ```javascript
1217: // wwwroot/js/theme.js
1218: window.ExploreTheme = {
1219:     getStoredTheme: () => localStorage.getItem('theme'),
1220:     setStoredTheme: (theme) => localStorage.setItem('theme', theme),
1221:     setThemeCookie: (theme) => {
1222:         document.cookie = `theme=${theme};path=/;max-age=31536000`;
1223:     }
1224: };
1225: ```
1226: 
1227: ### Dark Mode Toggle
1228: 
1229: ```csharp
1230: private async Task DarkModeToggle()
1231: {
1232:     _isDarkMode = !_isDarkMode;
1233:     var themeValue = _isDarkMode ? "dark" : "light";
1234: 
1235:     await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("ExploreTheme.setStoredTheme", themeValue);
1236:     await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("ExploreTheme.setThemeCookie", themeValue);
1237: }
1238: ```
1239: 
1240: ---
1241: 
1242: ## 12. CSS & Styling Conventions
1243: 
1244: ### Strategy: BEM within Isolation
1245: 
1246: We use a hybrid approach combining **Blazor CSS Isolation** (for scoping) with **BEM Naming** (for structure).
1247: 
1248: **Goal**: 100% of components should have a corresponding `.razor.css` file.
1249: 
1250: ### 12.1. File Structure (Co-location)
1251: 
1252: Always place the CSS file next to the component.
1253: 
1254: ```
1255: Components/
1256: ├── EventCard.razor
1257: └── EventCard.razor.css       ✅ Correct
1258: ```
1259: 
1260: ### 12.2. BEM Naming Convention
1261: 
1262: Even inside isolated CSS, we use BEM. This reduces specificity wars and makes the code self-documenting.
1263: 
1264: **Pattern**:
1265: - **Block**: `.component-name` (e.g., `.event-card`)
1266: - **Element**: `.component-name__element` (e.g., `.event-card__title`)
1267: - **Modifier**: `.component-name--modifier` (e.g., `.event-card--featured`)
1268: 
1269: **Why BEM in Isolation?**
1270: - Isolation adds a random attribute `[b-xyz]`.
1271: - If you just use `h1` or `.title`, it's hard to debug which component owns it.
1272: - `.event-card__title[b-xyz]` is unambiguous in DevTools.
1273: 
1274: ### 12.3. Styling Child Components
1275: 
1276: **Rule**: A parent component should NOT style its children's internals.
1277: 
1278: **✅ Good (Props)**:
1279: Pass a Class parameter.
1280: ```razor
1281: <ChildComponent Class="my-context-class" />
1282: ```
1283: 
1284: **⚠️ Caution (::deep)**:
1285: Use `::deep` only when styling 3rd party components (MudBlazor) where you can't change the source.
1286: ```css
1287: /* Styling MudBlazor internals */
1288: .my-component ::deep .mud-input {
1289:     border: 1px solid red;
1290: }
1291: ```
1292: 
1293: ### 12.4. Global Styles
1294: 
1295: Global styles (`wwwroot/css/app.css`) are restricted to:
1296: 1.  CSS Variables (Theming colors, spacing).
1297: 2.  Utility classes (`.isl-flex-center`).
1298: 3.  Reset/Normalize rules.
1299: 
1300: Everything else belongs in `.razor.css`.
1301: 
1302: ---
1303: 
1304: ### CSS Isolation Architecture
1305: 
1306: Blazor provides **CSS isolation** via `.razor.css` files that scope styles to individual components, preventing global collisions.
1307: 
1308: #### How CSS Isolation Works
1309: 
1310: **Build-Time Process**:
1311: 1. Blazor generates unique scope attribute: `b-<10-char-string>` (e.g., `b-3xxtam6d07`)
1312: 2. Appends scope attribute to all selectors in `.razor.css`
1313: 3. Applies scope attribute to rendered DOM elements
1314: 4. Bundles scoped CSS into `{Project}.styles.css`
1315: 
1316: **Example Transformation**:
1317: ```css
1318: /* Author in Counter.razor.css */
1319: h1 { color: brown; }
1320: 
1321: /* Compiled in Explore.styles.css */
1322: h1[b-3xxtam6d07] { color: brown; }
1323: ```
1324: 
1325: **Rendered HTML**:
1326: ```html
1327: <h1 b-3xxtam6d07>Counter</h1>
1328: ```
1329: 
1330: **Result**: Styles apply ONLY to component's elements, never globally.
1331: 
1332: ---
1333: 
1334: ### BEM Methodology with CSS Isolation
1335: 
1336: Use BEM (Block Element Modifier) naming **even with isolation** for explicit, maintainable styling hooks.
1337: 
1338: #### BEM Pattern Structure
1339: 
1340: ```
1341: .block
1342: .block__element
1343: .block--modifier
1344: .block__element--modifier
1345: ```
1346: 
1347: #### Component Example (EventCard)
1348: 
1349: **File Structure**:
1350: ```
1351: Components/
1352: ├── EventCard.razor
1353: └── EventCard.razor.css
1354: ```
1355: 
1356: **EventCard.razor**:
1357: ```razor
1358: <MudCard Class="event-card event-card--featured">
1359:     <MudCardHeader Class="event-card__header">
1360:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="event-card__title">@Title</MudText>
1361:         <span class="event-card__badge event-card__badge--new">New</span>
1362:     </MudCardHeader>
1363:     <MudCardContent Class="event-card__body">
1364:         <MudText Class="event-card__description">@Description</MudText>
1365:     </MudCardContent>
1366:     <MudCardActions Class="event-card__footer">
1367:         <MudButton Class="event-card__action">Register</MudButton>
1368:     </MudCardActions>
1369: </MudCard>
1370: ```
1371: 
1372: **EventCard.razor.css** (scoped automatically):
1373: ```css
1374: /* Block */
1375: .event-card {
1376:     border-radius: 12px;
1377:     transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease;
1378: }
1379: 
1380: .event-card:hover {
1381:     box-shadow: var(--mud-elevation-4);
1382: }
1383: 
1384: /* Block modifier */
1385: .event-card--featured {
1386:     border-left: 4px solid var(--mud-palette-success);
1387: }
1388: 
1389: /* Elements */
1390: .event-card__header {
1391:     background: var(--mud-palette-surface-variant);
1392: }
1393: 
1394: .event-card__title {
1395:     font-weight: 600;
1396:     color: var(--mud-palette-primary);
1397: }
1398: 
1399: .event-card__badge {
1400:     display: inline-block;
1401:     padding: 4px 8px;
1402:     border-radius: 4px;
1403:     font-size: 0.75rem;
1404: }
1405: 
1406: /* Element modifier */
1407: .event-card__badge--new {
1408:     background: var(--mud-palette-success);
1409:     color: var(--mud-palette-success-text);
1410: }
1411: 
1412: .event-card__body {
1413:     padding: 16px;
1414: }
1415: 
1416: .event-card__description {
1417:     line-height: 1.6;
1418: }
1419: 
1420: .event-card__footer {
1421:     justify-content: flex-end;
1422: }
1423: ```
1424: 
1425: **Compiled Output** (automatic):
1426: ```css
1427: /* All selectors receive scope attribute */
1428: .event-card[b-xyz123] { ... }
1429: .event-card--featured[b-xyz123] { ... }
1430: .event-card__header[b-xyz123] { ... }
1431: /* Prevents collision with other components' .event-card */
1432: ```
1433: 
1434: ---
1435: 
1436: ### Styling Child Components
1437: 
1438: #### Pattern A: Child's Own CSS (Preferred)
1439: 
1440: Each component styles itself in its own `.razor.css`.
1441: 
1442: ```css
1443: /* Parent.razor.css */
1444: .parent {
1445:     display: grid;
1446:     gap: 16px;
1447: }
1448: 
1449: /* EventCard.razor.css (child owns its styles) */
1450: .event-card {
1451:     padding: 12px;
1452:     background: var(--mud-palette-surface);
1453: }
1454: ```
1455: 
1456: **Why**: Separation of concerns; child owns its presentation.
1457: 
1458: ---
1459: 
1460: #### Pattern B: Wrapper Container (Safe Descendant Styling)
1461: 
1462: Wrap child in HTML element to enable parent's descendant selectors.
1463: 
1464: ```razor
1465: <div class="parent">
1466:     <div class="parent__child-wrapper">
1467:         <ChildComponent />
1468:     </div>
1469: </div>
1470: ```
1471: 
1472: ```css
1473: /* Parent.razor.css */
1474: .parent__child-wrapper {
1475:     padding: 8px;
1476:     border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-divider);
1477: }
1478: ```
1479: 
1480: **Why**: Wrapper gets scope attribute; you can style without penetrating child.
1481: 
1482: ---
1483: 
1484: #### Pattern C: The ::deep Selector (Last Resort)
1485: 
1486: **Purpose**: Penetrate child component encapsulation.
1487: 
1488: **Transformation**:
1489: ```css
1490: /* Author */
1491: .parent ::deep .child-element { color: red; }
1492: 
1493: /* Compiled */
1494: .parent[b-xyz123] .child-element { color: red; }
1495: ```
1496: 
1497: **Example** - Styling MudBlazor Component:
1498: ```css
1499: /* Host.razor.css */
1500: .host ::deep .mud-table-cell {
1501:     padding: 12px 16px;
1502: }
1503: ```
1504: 
1505: **When to Use ::deep**:
1506: - ✅ Styling third-party components with no exposed API
1507: - ✅ Overriding MudBlazor internals when necessary
1508: 
1509: **When NOT to Use ::deep**:
1510: - ❌ Styling your own child components (use child's `.razor.css`)
1511: - ❌ First resort (prefer wrapper or component parameters)
1512: 
1513: **Tradeoffs**:
1514: - ⚠️ **Fragile**: Coupled to child's internal markup
1515: - ⚠️ **Upgrade Risk**: Library updates may break selectors
1516: 
1517: ---
1518: 
1519: ### CSS Isolation File Structure
1520: 
1521: **Required Pattern**:
1522: - Place `ComponentName.razor.css` next to `ComponentName.razor`
1523: - File names must match (case-insensitive)
1524: - Reference `{Project}.styles.css` bundle in `App.razor` or `index.html`
1525: 
1526: **Example Structure**:
1527: ```
1528: Components/
1529: ├── EventList.razor
1530: ├── EventList.razor.css       ✅ Scoped to EventList
1531: ├── EventCard.razor
1532: └── EventCard.razor.css       ✅ Scoped to EventCard
1533: ```
1534: 
1535: **Bundle Reference** (`App.razor`):
1536: ```html
1537: <link href="Explore.styles.css" rel="stylesheet" />
1538: ```
1539: 
1540: ---
1541: 
1542: ### Debugging Scoped CSS
1543: 
1544: **Step 1: Inspect Element Scope Attribute**
1545: ```html
1546: <h1 b-3xxtam6d07>Counter</h1>
1547: ```
1548: 
1549: **Step 2: Find Matching Selector in DevTools**
1550: ```css
1551: h1[b-3xxtam6d07] { color: brown; }
1552: ```
1553: 
1554: **Step 3: Verify Bundle Reference**
1555: 
1556: Check `App.razor` includes:
1557: ```html
1558: <link href="Explore.styles.css" rel="stylesheet" />
1559: ```
1560: 
1561: #### Common Issues & Solutions
1562: 
1563: | Symptom | Cause | Fix |
1564: |---------|-------|-----|
1565: | Styles not applying | Missing bundle reference | Add `<link>` to `{Project}.styles.css` |
1566: | Child not styled | Using parent CSS | Add `.razor.css` to child OR use ::deep |
1567: | ::deep not working | Child renders to body | Use component's `Target` parameter |
1568: 
1569: ---
1570: 
1571: ### Global Styles
1572: 
1573: Global styles go in `wwwroot/css/app.css`:
1574: 
1575: ```css
1576: /* Custom utility classes */
1577: .isl-typo-h5 {
1578:     font-size: 1.5rem;
1579:     font-weight: 600;
1580:     line-height: 1.3;
1581: }
1582: 
1583: .isl-button-pill {
1584:     border-radius: 20px;
1585:     padding: 8px 16px;
1586:     cursor: pointer;
1587: }
1588: 
1589: .isl-popover-menu {
1590:     border-radius: 8px;
1591:     box-shadow: var(--mud-elevation-4);
1592: }
1593: 
1594: .isl-popover-menu__option {
1595:     padding: 8px 12px;
1596:     cursor: pointer;
1597:     border-radius: 4px;
1598: }
1599: 
1600: .isl-popover-menu__option:hover {
1601:     background-color: var(--mud-palette-action-default-hover);
1602: }
1603: ```
1604: 
1605: ---
1606: 
1607: ## 13. Error Handling
1608: 
1609: ### Service-Level Error Handling
1610: 
1611: ```csharp
1612: public async Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetAllEventsAsync()
1613: {
1614:     try
1615:     {
1616:         var response = await _apiClient.EventGETAsync(pageNumber: 1, pageSize: 100);
1617:         return response?.Items ?? new List<EventListDto>();
1618:     }
1619:     catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 401)
1620:     {
1621:         _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized access attempt");
1622:         return new List<EventListDto>();
1623:     }
1624:     catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 404)
1625:     {
1626:         _logger.LogInformation("Resource not found");
1627:         return new List<EventListDto>();
1628:     }
1629:     catch (ApiException ex)
1630:     {
1631:         _logger.LogError(ex, "API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
1632:         return new List<EventListDto>();
1633:     }
1634:     catch (Exception ex)
1635:     {
1636:         _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error");
1637:         return new List<EventListDto>();
1638:     }
1639: }
1640: ```
1641: 
1642: ### Component-Level Error Handling
1643: 
1644: ```razor
1645: @code {
1646:     private bool _hasError = false;
1647:     private string? _errorMessage;
1648: 
1649:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
1650:     {
1651:         try
1652:         {
1653:             await LoadDataAsync();
1654:         }
1655:         catch (Exception ex)
1656:         {
1657:             _hasError = true;
1658:             _errorMessage = "Failed to load data. Please try again.";
1659:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error in OnInitializedAsync");
1660:         }
1661:     }
1662: }
1663: 
1664: @if (_hasError)
1665: {
1666:     <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
1667:     <MudButton OnClick="RetryAsync">Retry</MudButton>
1668: }
1669: ```
1670: 
1671: ### Global Error Boundary
1672: 
1673: ```razor
1674: @* In App.razor *@
1675: <ErrorBoundary>
1676:     <ChildContent>
1677:         <Router AppAssembly="@typeof(App).Assembly">
1678:             <!-- ... -->
1679:         </Router>
1680:     </ChildContent>
1681:     <ErrorContent Context="ex">
1682:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">
1683:             An unexpected error occurred. Please refresh the page.
1684:         </MudAlert>
1685:     </ErrorContent>
1686: </ErrorBoundary>
1687: ```
1688: 
1689: ---
1690: 
1691: ## 14. Best Practices
1692: 
1693: ### DO ✅
1694: 
1695: 1. **Use service layer** - Never call `IEventApiClient` directly from components
1696: 2. **Handle loading states** - Show skeletons or spinners during data fetching
1697: 3. **Reset pagination on filter change** - Always reset to page 1
1698: 4. **Use `[EditorRequired]`** - For mandatory parameters
1699: 5. **Log appropriately** - Use structured logging with context
1700: 6. **Dispose resources** - Implement `IDisposable` when needed
1701: 7. **Use `StateHasChanged()`** - Only when necessary (after async callbacks)
1702: 
1703: ### DON'T ❌
1704: 
1705: 1. **Don't store tokens in WASM** - BFF handles token management
1706: 2. **Don't call API directly** - Use the generated NSwag client via services
1707: 3. **Don't use `Console.WriteLine`** - Use `ILogger<T>` instead
1708: 4. **Don't block with `.Result`** - Always use `await`
1709: 5. **Don't ignore errors** - Handle and log all exceptions
1710: 6. **Don't hardcode URLs** - Use configuration
1711: 
1712: ### Performance Tips
1713: 
1714: ```csharp
1715: // Use parallel loading for independent data
1716: protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
1717: {
1718:     var eventsTask = EventService.GetAllEventsAsync();
1719:     var categoriesTask = CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
1720:     var tagsTask = TagService.GetAllTagsAsync();
1721: 
1722:     await Task.WhenAll(eventsTask, categoriesTask, tagsTask);
1723: 
1724:     _events = await eventsTask;
1725:     _categories = await categoriesTask;
1726:     _tags = await tagsTask;
1727: }
1728: 
1729: // Use virtualization for large lists
1730: <MudVirtualize Items="@_largeList" Context="item" OverscanCount="5">
1731:     <ItemContent>
1732:         <EventCard Event="@item" />
1733:     </ItemContent>
1734: </MudVirtualize>
1735: ```
1736:

## File: docs/CODEBASE_STRUCTURE.md
````markdown
  1: # Codebase Structure Reference
  2: 
  3: > Complete directory map for AI agents and developers.
  4: > Lists all folders with max 2 key files per folder for quick lookup.
  5: > Last Updated: February 2026
  6: 
  7: ---
  8: 
  9: ## Solution Overview
 10: 
 11: The solution uses **Clean Architecture** with CQRS (MediatR). There are **two naming prefixes**:
 12: 
 13: - **Explore.\*** - Main application projects (API, Domain, Application, Persistence, Blazor, Infrastructure) (historical naming from when the project was "Explore", were not renamed to "Event" yet)
 14: - **Event.\*** - Test projects (for now, later all projects will be renamed to "Event" prefix)
 15: 
 16: ---
 17: 
 18: ## Project Dependency Graph
 19: 
 20: ```
 21: Explore.Domain          (no dependencies - pure entities & interfaces)
 22:     ↑
 23: Explore.Application     (depends on Domain - CQRS handlers, DTOs, contracts)
 24:     ↑
 25: Explore.Persistence     (depends on Application - EF Core, repositories)
 26: Explore.Infrastructure  (depends on Application - email, storage, identity)
 27: Explore.Secrets         (standalone - secrets management)
 28:     ↑
 29: Explore.API             (depends on all above - controllers, middleware, DI)
 30: Explore.Blazor          (Blazor Server host - depends on API indirectly)
 31: Explore.Blazor.Client   (Blazor WASM - standalone client, calls API via BFF)
 32:     ↑
 33: Explore.AppHost         (.NET Aspire orchestrator)
 34: Explore.ServiceDefaults (shared Aspire defaults)
 35: Explore.Diagnostic      (diagnostic/observability extensions)
 36: Event.MigrationService  (EF Core migration runner)
 37: ```
 38: 
 39: ---
 40: 
 41: ## Directory Tree
 42: 
 43: ### Explore.Domain/ — Domain Entities & Interfaces
 44: 
 45: Pure domain model. No external dependencies. All entities live at root level.
 46: 
 47: ```
 48: Explore.Domain/
 49: ├── *.cs                          — Entity classes (one per file)
 50: │   ├── Event.cs                  — Core event entity (ITenantEntity, IAuditableEntity, ISoftDeletable)
 51: │   └── Organization.cs           — Organization entity with appearance metadata
 52: ├── Interfaces/                   — Marker interfaces for cross-cutting concerns
 53: │   ├── IAuditableEntity.cs       — CreatedAt/By, UpdatedAt/By audit fields
 54: │   ├── ISoftDeletable.cs         — IsDeleted, DeletedAt/By soft delete fields
 55: │   └── ITenantEntity.cs          — TenantId for multi-tenant isolation
 56: ├── Enums/                        — Enums mirroring lookup table IDs
 57: │   ├── EventTypeEnum.cs          — Maps to EventType lookup table int IDs
 58: │   └── EventStatusEnum.cs        — Maps to EventStatus lookup table int IDs
 59: ├── Constants/                    — Platform-wide constants
 60: │   ├── GovernanceSettingKeys.cs  — SystemSetting key strings (deployment mode, branding, domains)
 61: │   └── PlatformDefaults.cs       — Default values for platform settings
 62: ├── Federation/                   — ATProto federation entities
 63: │   └── PdsSyncOutbox.cs          — Outbox pattern for PDS synchronization
 64: └── Modules/                      — Module governance entities
 65:     ├── ModuleDefinition.cs       — Module definitions (Core, Islamic, Tech)
 66:     └── TenantCapability.cs       — Per-tenant module enablement
 67: ```
 68: 
 69: **Entity categories:**
 70: - **Main entities** (Guid PK): Event, Organization, Actor, User, Tenant, Location, StorageObject, Category, Tag
 71: - **Lookup tables** (int PK): EventType, EventStatus, EventFormat, AudienceAge, AudienceGender, Madhab, Language, VisibilityType, RegistrationMode, Role, OrganizationPosition
 72: - **Link/junction tables** (composite PK): EventCategories, EventTags, EventSessionLanguage, EventSessionSpeaker, TagTypeTags, OrganizationMember, TenantUser, RolePermission
 73: - **Aspect tables** (1:1 optional): EventIslamicAspect, EventTechAspect
 74: - **Admin/onboarding**: InstanceAdministrator, InstanceBootstrapState, TenantMember, TenantOnboardingState
 75:

 77: 
 78: ### Explore.Application/ — CQRS Handlers, DTOs, Contracts
 79: 
 80: Application layer. Depends only on Domain. Contains all business logic orchestration.
 81: 
 82: ```
 83: Explore.Application/
 84: ├── Features/                     — CQRS feature slices (one folder per aggregate)
 85: │   ├── Events/                   — Event aggregate (largest feature)
 86: │   │   ├── Handlers/
 87: │   │   │   ├── Commands/         — CreateEventCommandHandler.cs, UpdateEventCommandHandler.cs, etc.
 88: │   │   │   └── Queries/          — GetEventListRequestHandler.cs, GetEventDetailsRequestHandler.cs, etc.
 89: │   │   └── Requests/
 90: │   │       ├── Commands/         — CreateEventCommand.cs, UpdateEventCommand.cs, etc.
 91: │   │       └── Queries/          — GetEventListRequest.cs, GetEventDetailsRequest.cs, etc.
 92: │   ├── Organizations/            — Organization aggregate (same Handlers/Requests structure)
 93: │   ├── InstanceOnboarding/       — Instance-level admin onboarding
 94: │   │   └── Common/               — Shared helpers for onboarding features
 95: │   ├── TenantOnboarding/         — Tenant-level onboarding flow
 96: │   ├── PublicExperience/         — Public-facing discovery (landing pages)
 97: │   └── [30+ more feature folders] — Each follows Handlers/{Commands,Queries} + Requests/{Commands,Queries}
 98: ├── DTOs/                         — Data Transfer Objects (one folder per entity)
 99: │   ├── Event/                    — CreateEventDto.cs, UpdateEventDto.cs, EventDto.cs, EventListDto.cs
100: │   ├── Organization/             — CreateOrganizationDto.cs, OrganizationDto.cs, OrganizationListDto.cs
101: │   ├── Onboarding/               — DTOs for instance/tenant onboarding flows
102: │   └── [40+ more DTO folders]    — Each entity has Create/Update/Detail/List DTOs
103: ├── Contracts/                    — Interface definitions (dependency inversion)
104: │   ├── Persistence/              — Repository interfaces (one per entity)
105: │   │   ├── IGenericRepository.cs — Base generic repository interface
106: │   │   ├── IEventRepository.cs   — Event-specific repository methods
107: │   │   └── [50+ more interfaces] — One interface per entity/aggregate
108: │   ├── Infrastructure/           — Infrastructure service interfaces
109: │   │   ├── ITenantContext.cs     — Multi-tenant context resolution
110: │   │   ├── ICurrentUserService.cs— Current authenticated user info
111: │   │   ├── IObjectStorageService.cs — S3-compatible storage operations
112: │   │   ├── IS3ConfigResolver.cs  — S3 config from cascading settings (per-tenant)
113: │   │   ├── ISmtpConfigResolver.cs— SMTP config from cascading settings (per-tenant)
114: │   │   └── ISettingsResolver.cs  — Governance settings resolution
115: │   ├── Identity/                 — User identity interfaces
116: │   │   └── IUserContext.cs       — User context abstraction
117: │   ├── Strategies/               — Strategy pattern interfaces
118: │   │   ├── IEventStrategy.cs     — Module-specific event behavior
119: │   │   └── IStrategyResolver.cs  — Strategy factory interface
120: │   └── Hateoas/                  — HATEOAS link assembly interfaces
121: ├── Responses/                    — Shared response types
122: │   ├── BaseCommandResponse.cs    — Generic command response with Id, Success, Message, Errors
123: │   └── PaginatedResult.cs        — Pagination wrapper
124: ├── Exceptions/                   — Custom exception types
125: │   ├── NotFoundException.cs      — 404 mapping
126: │   ├── BadRequestException.cs    — 400 mapping
127: │   └── ValidationException.cs    — Validation failure mapping
128: ├── Profiles/                     — AutoMapper profiles
129: │   └── MappingProfile.cs         — Single file with ALL entity↔DTO mappings
130: ├── Hateoas/                      — HAL resource models
131: │   ├── HalResource.cs            — Base HAL envelope
132: │   └── HalLink.cs                — Link representation
133: ├── Models/                       — Infrastructure models
134: │   ├── EmailMessage.cs           — Rich email message DTO (To, CC, BCC, HTML, attachments)
135: │   ├── EmailAttachment.cs        — Email attachment with inline image support
136: │   ├── EmailResult.cs            — Email send result with success/failure and duration
137: │   └── SmtpConfiguration.cs      — SMTP config POCO resolved from cascading settings
138: └── Requests/                     — Shared request types
139:     └── PaginationParams.cs       — Page number/size parameters
140: ```
141: 
142: **CQRS pattern note:** Most features follow `Handlers/{Commands,Queries}` + `Requests/{Commands,Queries}`. One exception: `OrganizationReviews` uses `Commands/` and `Queries/` directly (flattened structure).

451: ## Quick File Lookup by Concern
452: 
453: | Need to work on... | Look in... |
454: |---|---|
455: | Add/modify a domain entity | `Explore.Domain/EntityName.cs` |
456: | Add a lookup table enum | `Explore.Domain/Enums/EntityNameEnum.cs` |
457: | Create/update DTO | `Explore.Application/DTOs/EntityName/` |
458: | Create CQRS command/query | `Explore.Application/Features/EntityNames/Requests/` |
459: | Create command/query handler | `Explore.Application/Features/EntityNames/Handlers/` |
460: | Add repository interface | `Explore.Application/Contracts/Persistence/IEntityNameRepository.cs` |
461: | Implement repository | `Explore.Persistence/Repositories/EntityNameRepository.cs` |
462: | Add EF configuration | `Explore.Persistence/Configurations/Entities/EntityNameConfiguration.cs` |
463: | Add API controller | `Explore.API/Controllers/EntityNameController.cs` |
464: | Add Blazor page | `Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/AreaName/PageName.razor` |
465: | Add client service | `Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/EntityNameService.cs` |
466: | Register DI services | `Explore.Persistence/PersistenceServicesRegistration.cs` (repos) or `Explore.Blazor.Client/Program.cs` (client) |
467: | Add seed data | `Explore.Persistence/Seed/SeedData.cs` (runtime) or entity configuration `HasData()` (lookup) |
468: | Multi-tenancy logic | `Explore.API/Services/TenantContext.cs` + `Explore.Persistence/ExploreDbContext.cs` |
469: | Authentication | `Explore.Blazor/Program.cs` (OIDC) + `Explore.Infrastructure/Services/CurrentUserService.cs` |
470: | Secret management | `Explore.Secrets/` (standalone library) |
471: | Database migrations | `dotnet ef` via `Event.MigrationService/` |
472: | Architecture tests | `Event.Architecture.Tests/` |
````

## File: docs/FEDERATION.md
````markdown
  1: # Federation
  2: 
  3: ## Status
  4: 
  5: Federation (ATProto / ActivityPub) is a **roadmap feature** - currently in **Phase 1: Data Model Only**.
  6: 
  7: ### ✅ Implemented (Phase 1: Foundation)
  8: - **Domain Entities**: Federation data models exist in `Explore.Domain`:
  9:   - `Actor` - Federated identity representation
 10:   - `AtprotoRecord` - ATProto record storage
 11:   - `PdsSyncOutbox` - Sync queue for outbound records
 12:   - `IndexedDid` - DID resolution cache
 13:   - `ActorKeyStore` - Cryptographic key storage
 14:   - Supporting entities: `ActorType`, `DidCustodyType` enums
 15: 
 16: ### ⏳ Not Yet Implemented (Roadmap)
 17: - **HTTP Endpoints**: No federation endpoints exposed in `Explore.API`:
 18:   - ❌ WebFinger (`/.well-known/webfinger`)
 19:   - ❌ Actor endpoints (`/actors/{handle}`)
 20:   - ❌ Inbox/Outbox (ActivityPub)
 21:   - ❌ ATProto PDS server
 22:   - ❌ ATProto AppView indexing
 23: - **Protocol Implementation**: No active federation protocol logic
 24: - **Bridge/Gateway**: ActivityPub ↔ ATProto translation not implemented
 25: - **DID Resolution**: No PLC/DNS-based DID resolution
 26: - **HTTP Signatures**: Cryptographic message verification not implemented
 27: - **Collections**: Followers/Following/Liked collections not exposed
 28: 
 29: **Timeline**: Federation implementation planned for future release. Foundation (entities) is complete.
 30: 
 31: ## Protocol Overview (Planned)
 32: 
 33: > **Note**: This section describes the **intended** federation model for ISLAMU Event.
 34: > **Current Status**: Protocol implementation not yet started. Only domain entities exist.
 35: 
 36: - **Server-to-Server (S2S)** (planned): Instances exchange activities via inbox/outbox
 37: - **HTTP Signatures** (planned): Cryptographic verification of federated messages
 38: - **WebFinger** (planned): Actor discovery via `/.well-known/webfinger`
 39: - **Collections** (planned): Followers, Following, Liked as ordered collections
 40: 
 41: ## Planned Architecture Philosophy
 42: 
 43: > **⚠️ Planned Feature**: The architecture diagrams below represent the **intended design**.
 44: > **Current Implementation**: Only domain entities (Actor, AtprotoRecord, etc.) exist. No HTTP endpoints or federation logic implemented.
 45: 
 46: ```
 47: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 48: │                           ISLAMU Event Architecture                          │
 49: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 50: │                                                                             │
 51: │   ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────────────────────┐   │
 52: │   │   Users     │────▶│    PDS      │────▶│    ATProto Network          │   │
 53: │   │  (DIDs)     │     │  (Hosting)  │     │  (Relay/Firehose/AppView)   │   │
 54: │   └─────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └─────────────────────────────┘   │
 55: │         │                                              │                    │
 56: │         │                                              │                    │
 57: │         ▼                                              ▼                    │
 58: │   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 59: │   │                    ISLAMU Event AppView                              │   │
 60: │   │  • Indexes ngo.islamu.event.* records                               │   │
 61: │   │  • Provides search/discovery APIs                                    │   │
 62: │   │  • Manages cultural/audience filtering                               │   │
 63: │   │  • Hosts ActivityPub Gateway                                         │   │
 64: │   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 65: │                                        │                                    │
 66: │                                        ▼                                    │
 67: │   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 68: │   │               ActivityPub Gateway (Bridge)                           │   │
 69: │   │  • Exposes ATProto events as ActivityPub Event objects              │   │
 70: │   │  • Translates ActivityPub Follow → ATProto follow records           │   │
 71: │   │  • Translates ActivityPub RSVP → ATProto participation records      │   │
 72: │   │  • Would provide WebFinger, Actor endpoints, Inbox/Outbox (planned) │   │
 73: │   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 74: │                                        │                                    │
 75: │                                        ▼                                    │
 76: │   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 77: │   │                      Fediverse                                       │   │
 78: │   │              (Mastodon, Mobilizon, Pleroma, etc.)                   │   │
 79: │   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 80: │                                                                             │
 81: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 82: ```
 83: 
 84: ## Event Data Flow (Planned Implementation)
 85: 
 86: ```
 87: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 88: │                        Event Data Flow                                       │
 89: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 90: │                                                                             │
 91: │  ATProto/ActivityPub Federation                    ISLAMU Event WebApp      │
 92: │  ─────────────────────────────────                 ───────────────────      │
 93: │                                                                             │
 94: │  ┌─────────────────────────────┐                  ┌─────────────────────┐   │
 95: │  │  Federated Event Record     │                  │  Full Event Detail  │   │
 96: │  │  ─────────────────────────  │                  │  ─────────────────  │   │
 97: │  │  • Title                    │                  │  • All event info   │   │
 98: │  │  • Summary/Description      │    Link to       │  • Session 1        │   │
 99: │  │  • Start Date (first)       │ ──────────────▶  │    - Time, Location │   │
100: │  │  • Location (primary)       │                  │    - Agenda         │   │
101: │  │  • Cover Image              │                  │    - Speakers       │   │
102: │  │  • URL → webapp             │                  │  • Session 2        │   │
103: │  │  • Basic audience info      │                  │    - Time, Location │   │
104: │  └─────────────────────────────┘                  │    - Agenda         │   │
105: │                                                    │  • Session N...     │   │
106: │  What Mastodon/Bluesky users see:                 │  • Registration     │   │
107: │  "🗓️ Community Iftar 2025                         │  • Comments         │   │
108: │   March 15-17, Amsterdam                          │  • Participants     │   │
109: │   Join us for 3 days of..."                       └─────────────────────┘   │
110: │   [View Event →]                                                            │
111: │                                                                             │
112: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
113: ```
114: 
115: ## CID
116: ```
117: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
118: │                          How CID Works                                       │
119: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
120: │                                                                             │
121: │  1. User creates event record                                               │
122: │     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐                                     │
123: │     │ {                               │                                     │
124: │     │   "$type": "ngo.islamu.event...",│                                    │
125: │     │   "title": "Community Iftar",   │                                     │
126: │     │   "startsAt": "2025-03-15...",  │                                     │
127: │     │   ...                           │                                     │
128: │     │ }                               │                                     │
129: │     └─────────────────────────────────┘                                     │
130: │                    │                                                        │
131: │                    ▼                                                        │
132: │  2. PDS serializes to DAG-CBOR (deterministic binary format)               │
133: │                    │                                                        │
134: │                    ▼                                                        │
135: │  3. PDS computes SHA-256 hash → CID                                        │
136: │     ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐        │
137: │     │ bafyreigxyz123... (base32 encoded multihash)                │        │
138: │     └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘        │
139: │                    │                                                        │
140: │  4. CID is included in the repo commit (signed by user's key)              │
141: │                                                                             │
142: │  WHY THIS MATTERS:                                                          │
143: │  ─────────────────                                                          │
144: │  • Anyone can verify the record hasn't been tampered with                  │
145: │  • If content changes → CID changes → old references become invalid        │
146: │  • Enables "strong references" (URI + CID = exact version)                 │
147: │                                                                             │
148: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
149: ```
150: 
151: ## Identity System Hybrid Approach (Planned)
152: 
153: > **⚠️ Planned Feature**: The hybrid authentication system is not yet implemented.
154: > **Current State**: Only Keycloak/OIDC authentication is active. ATProto OAuth integration is planned.
155: 
156: **Planned Approach**: Support BOTH Keycloak (traditional) AND ATProto OAuth, with custodial DIDs for Keycloak users:
157: 
158: ```
159: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
160: │                    Hybrid Auth Architecture                                  │
161: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
162: │                                                                             │
163: │                      ┌─────────────────┐                                    │
164: │                      │   Login Page    │                                    │
165: │                      └────────┬────────┘                                    │
166: │                               │                                             │
167: │              ┌────────────────┼────────────────┐                            │
168: │              ▼                                 ▼                            │
169: │    ┌──────────────────┐              ┌──────────────────┐                  │
170: │    │ Login with Email │              │ Login with ATProto│                  │
171: │    │   (Keycloak)     │              │ (Bring your DID)  │                  │
172: │    └────────┬─────────┘              └────────┬─────────┘                  │
173: │             │                                  │                            │
174: │             ▼                                  ▼                            │
175: │    ┌──────────────────┐              ┌──────────────────┐                  │
176: │    │ Keycloak returns │              │ ATProto OAuth    │                  │
177: │    │ UUID + email     │              │ returns DID      │                  │
178: │    └────────┬─────────┘              └────────┬─────────┘                  │
179: │             │                                  │                            │
180: │             ▼                                  ▼                            │
181: │    ┌──────────────────┐              ┌──────────────────┐                  │
182: │    │ Create custodial │              │ Link existing    │                  │
183: │    │ DID for user     │              │ DID to account   │                  │
184: │    └────────┬─────────┘              └────────┬─────────┘                  │
185: │             │                                  │                            │
186: │             └────────────────┬─────────────────┘                            │
187: │                              ▼                                              │
188: │                    ┌──────────────────┐                                     │
189: │                    │  user + actor    │                                     │
190: │                    │  records created │                                     │
191: │                    └──────────────────┘                                     │
192: │                                                                             │
193: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
194: ```
195: 
196: ## Handling Nullable DID (did_status)
197: 
198: The key insight is that DID creation is **async**. Here's how to handle it:
199: ```
200: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
201: │                    DID Status State Machine                                  │
202: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
203: │                                                                             │
204: │  ┌─────────┐     Background job      ┌─────────┐                           │
205: │  │ pending │ ──────────────────────▶ │ active  │                           │
206: │  └─────────┘     creates DID         └─────────┘                           │
207: │       │                                                                     │
208: │       │ DID creation fails                                                  │
209: │       ▼                                                                     │
210: │  ┌─────────┐     Retry succeeds      ┌─────────┐                           │
211: │  │ failed  │ ──────────────────────▶ │ active  │                           │
212: │  └─────────┘                         └─────────┘                           │
213: │                                                                             │
214: │  WHAT USERS CAN DO:                                                         │
215: │  ──────────────────                                                         │
216: │  pending → Browse, edit profile (read-heavy)                                │
217: │  failed  → Same as pending, show "retry" button                            │
218: │  active  → Full access: post events, comment, etc. (write access)          │
219: │                                                                             │
220: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
221: ```
````
