## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/EditSessionDialog.razor
````razor
 1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Validators
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers
 4: @using FluentValidation
 5: @using MudBlazor
 6: 
 7: <MudDialog>
 8:     <TitleContent>
 9:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">
10:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" Class="mr-3 mb-n1" />
11:             Edit Session
12:         </MudText>
13:     </TitleContent>
14:     <DialogContent>
15:         <MudForm @ref="form" @bind-IsValid="success" Model="sessionDto">
16:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="sessionDto.Title" Label="Title" For="@(() => sessionDto.Title)" Required="true" RequiredError="Title is required." />
17:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="sessionDto.Description" Label="Description" For="@(() => sessionDto.Description)" Lines="3" />
18:             <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="startDate" Label="Start Date" Required="true" />
19:             <MudTimePicker @bind-Time="startTime" Label="Start Time" Required="true" />
20:             <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="endDate" Label="End Date" Required="true" />
21:             <MudTimePicker @bind-Time="endTime" Label="End Time" Required="true" />
22:             <MudNumericField @bind-Value="sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees" Label="Max Audience" For="@(() => sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees)" Min="0" />
23:         </MudForm>
24:     </DialogContent>
25:     <DialogActions>
26:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
27:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Update</MudButton>
28:     </DialogActions>
29: </MudDialog>
30: 
31: @code {
32:     [CascadingParameter]
33:     private IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
34: 
35:     [Parameter] public EventSessionDto ExistingSession { get; set; }
36: 
37:     private UpdateEventSessionDtoValidator validator = new();
38:     private MudForm form;
39:     private bool success;
40: 
41:     private UpdateEventSessionDto sessionDto = new();
42: 
43:     private DateTime? startDate = DateTime.Now;
44:     private TimeSpan? startTime = DateTime.Now.TimeOfDay;
45:     private DateTime? endDate = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1);
46:     private TimeSpan? endTime = DateTime.Now.AddHours(1).TimeOfDay;
47: 
48:     protected override void OnInitialized()
49:     {
50:         sessionDto.EventId = ExistingSession.EventId;
51:         sessionDto.Id = ExistingSession.Id;
52:         sessionDto.Title = ExistingSession.Title;
53:         sessionDto.Description = ExistingSession.Description;
54:         sessionDto.StartTime = ExistingSession.StartTime;
55:         sessionDto.EndTime = ExistingSession.EndTime;
56:         sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees = ExistingSession.MaxAudienceAttendees;
57: 
58:         // Set date/time pickers from existing session
59:         if (ExistingSession.StartTime.HasValue)
60:         {
61:             startDate = ExistingSession.StartTime.Value.Date.ToLocalTime();
62:             startTime = ExistingSession.StartTime.Value.TimeOfDay;
63:         }
64:         if (ExistingSession.EndTime.HasValue)
65:         {
66:             endDate = ExistingSession.EndTime.Value.Date.ToLocalTime();
67:             endTime = ExistingSession.EndTime.Value.TimeOfDay;
68:         }
69:     }
70: 
71:     private async Task Submit()
72:     {
73:         await form.Validate();
74:         if (form.IsValid)
75:         {
76:             // Use DateTimeHelper for consistent UTC conversion
77:             var startDateTime = startDate.Value.Date + startTime.Value;
78:             var endDateTime = endDate.Value.Date + endTime.Value;
79: 
80:             sessionDto.StartTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(startDateTime);
81:             sessionDto.EndTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(endDateTime);
82: 
83:             MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(sessionDto));
84:         }
85:     }
86: 
87:     void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
88: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/EventSessionEditor.razor
````razor
  1: @using MudBlazor
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers
  5: 
  6: <MudPaper Class="event-session-editor" Elevation="1">
  7:     <div class="event-session-editor__header">
  8:         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Class="event-session-editor__title">
  9:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Schedule" Size="Size.Small" Class="mr-2" />
 10:             Session @(Index + 1)
 11:         </MudText>
 12:         @if (ShowRemoveButton)
 13:         {
 14:             <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
 15:                            Color="Color.Error"
 16:                            Size="Size.Small"
 17:                            OnClick="@OnRemoveClicked"
 18:                            aria-label="Remove session" />
 19:         }
 20:     </div>
 21: 
 22:     <MudDivider Class="event-session-editor__divider" />
 23: 
 24:     <MudGrid Spacing="2">
 25:         <MudItem xs="12">
 26:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="Session.Title"
 27:                           Label="Session Title"
 28:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 29:                           FullWidth
 30:                           Placeholder="e.g., Opening Ceremony, Workshop Part 1" />
 31:         </MudItem>
 32: 
 33:         <MudItem xs="12">
 34:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="Session.Description"
 35:                           Label="Session Description"
 36:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 37:                           Lines="2"
 38:                           FullWidth
 39:                           Placeholder="Brief description of this session" />
 40:         </MudItem>
 41: 
 42:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 43:             <MudDatePicker Date="StartDate"
 44:                            DateChanged="OnStartDateChanged"
 45:                            Label="Start Date"
 46:                            Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 47:         </MudItem>
 48: 
 49:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 50:             <MudTimePicker Time="StartTime"
 51:                            TimeChanged="OnStartTimeChanged"
 52:                            Label="Start Time"
 53:                            Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 54:         </MudItem>
 55: 
 56:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 57:             <MudDatePicker Date="EndDate"
 58:                            DateChanged="OnEndDateChanged"
 59:                            Label="End Date"
 60:                            Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 61:         </MudItem>
 62: 
 63:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 64:             <MudTimePicker Time="EndTime"
 65:                            TimeChanged="OnEndTimeChanged"
 66:                            Label="End Time"
 67:                            Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
 68:         </MudItem>
 69: 
 70:         @if (ShowLocationSelector && Locations != null && Locations.Any())
 71:         {
 72:             <MudItem xs="12">
 73:                 <MudSelect T="Guid?"
 74:                            @bind-Value="Session.LocationId"
 75:                            Label="Location"
 76:                            Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 77:                            FullWidth
 78:                            Clearable>
 79:                     @foreach (var location in Locations)
 80:                     {
 81:                         <MudSelectItem Value="@((Guid?)location.Id)">
 82:                             @location.FullName @(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(location.City) ? $" - {location.City}" : "")
 83:                         </MudSelectItem>
 84:                     }
 85:                 </MudSelect>
 86:             </MudItem>
 87:         }
 88: 
 89:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 90:             <MudNumericField @bind-Value="Session.MaxAudienceAttendees"
 91:                              Label="Max Attendees (optional)"
 92:                              Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 93:                              FullWidth
 94:                              Min="0"
 95:                              Placeholder="Leave empty for unlimited" />
 96:         </MudItem>
 97: 
 98:         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 99:             <MudSelect T="int?"
100:                        @bind-Value="Session.RegistrationModeId"
101:                        Label="Registration Mode"
102:                        Variant="Variant.Outlined"
103:                        FullWidth>
104:                 @if (RegistrationModes != null && RegistrationModes.Any())
105:                 {
106:                     @foreach (var mode in RegistrationModes)
107:                     {
108:                         <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@((int?)mode.Id)">@mode.FullName</MudSelectItem>
109:                     }
110:                 }
111:                 else
112:                 {
113:                     <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@((int?)1)">Open (Auto-approve)</MudSelectItem>
114:                     <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@((int?)2)">Approval Required</MudSelectItem>
115:                     <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@((int?)3)">Invite Only</MudSelectItem>
116:                 }
117:             </MudSelect>
118:         </MudItem>
119: 
120:         @if (ShowLanguageSelector && Languages != null && Languages.Any())
121:         {
122:             <MudItem xs="12">
123:                 <MudSelect T="int"
124:                            MultiSelection="true"
125:                            SelectedValues="Session.LanguageIds"
126:                            SelectedValuesChanged="OnLanguageValuesChanged"
127:                            Label="Languages"
128:                            Variant="Variant.Outlined"
129:                            FullWidth>
130:                     @foreach (var language in Languages)
131:                     {
132:                         <MudSelectItem Value="@language.Id">@language.FullName</MudSelectItem>
133:                     }
134:                 </MudSelect>
135:             </MudItem>
136:         }
137:     </MudGrid>
138: </MudPaper>
139: 
140: @code {
141:     [Parameter]
142:     public SessionEditorModel Session { get; set; } = new();
143: 
144:     [Parameter]
145:     public EventCallback<SessionEditorModel> SessionChanged { get; set; }
146: 
147:     [Parameter]
148:     public int Index { get; set; }
149: 
150:     [Parameter]
151:     public bool ShowRemoveButton { get; set; } = true;
152: 
153:     [Parameter]
154:     public EventCallback OnRemove { get; set; }
155: 
156:     [Parameter]
157:     public bool ShowLocationSelector { get; set; } = false;
158: 
159:     [Parameter]
160:     public ICollection<LocationListDto>? Locations { get; set; }
161: 
162:     [Parameter]
163:     public ICollection<RegistrationModeListDto>? RegistrationModes { get; set; }
164: 
165:     [Parameter]
166:     public bool ShowLanguageSelector { get; set; } = false;
167: 
168:     [Parameter]
169:     public ICollection<LanguageListDto>? Languages { get; set; }
170: 
171:     private DateTime? StartDate
172:     {
173:         get => Session.StartTime.Date;
174:         set
175:         {
176:             if (value.HasValue)
177:             {
178:                 var time = Session.StartTime.TimeOfDay;
179:                 Session.StartTime = value.Value.Date + time;
180:             }
181:         }
182:     }
183: 
184:     private TimeSpan? StartTime
185:     {
186:         get => Session.StartTime.TimeOfDay;
187:         set
188:         {
189:             if (value.HasValue)
190:             {
191:                 Session.StartTime = Session.StartTime.Date + value.Value;
192:             }
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196:     private DateTime? EndDate
197:     {
198:         get => Session.EndTime.Date;
199:         set
200:         {
201:             if (value.HasValue)
202:             {
203:                 var time = Session.EndTime.TimeOfDay;
204:                 Session.EndTime = value.Value.Date + time;
205:             }
206:         }
207:     }
208: 
209:     private TimeSpan? EndTime
210:     {
211:         get => Session.EndTime.TimeOfDay;
212:         set
213:         {
214:             if (value.HasValue)
215:             {
216:                 Session.EndTime = Session.EndTime.Date + value.Value;
217:             }
218:         }
219:     }
220: 
221:     private async Task OnStartDateChanged(DateTime? value)
222:     {
223:         StartDate = value;
224:         await SessionChanged.InvokeAsync(Session);
225:     }
226: 
227:     private async Task OnStartTimeChanged(TimeSpan? value)
228:     {
229:         StartTime = value;
230:         await SessionChanged.InvokeAsync(Session);
231:     }
232: 
233:     private async Task OnEndDateChanged(DateTime? value)
234:     {
235:         EndDate = value;
236:         await SessionChanged.InvokeAsync(Session);
237:     }
238: 
239:     private async Task OnEndTimeChanged(TimeSpan? value)
240:     {
241:         EndTime = value;
242:         await SessionChanged.InvokeAsync(Session);
243:     }
244: 
245:     private async Task OnLanguageValuesChanged(object? values)
246:     {
247:         if (values is IEnumerable<int> languageIds)
248:         {
249:             Session.LanguageIds = languageIds.ToHashSet();
250:         }
251:         else if (values is IEnumerable<object> rawValues)
252:         {
253:             Session.LanguageIds = rawValues.OfType<int>().ToHashSet();
254:         }
255:         else
256:         {
257:             Session.LanguageIds = new HashSet<int>();
258:         }
259: 
260:         await SessionChanged.InvokeAsync(Session);
261:     }
262: 
263:     private async Task OnRemoveClicked()
264:     {
265:         await OnRemove.InvokeAsync();
266:     }
267: 
268:     public class SessionEditorModel
269:     {
270:         public Guid? Id { get; set; }
271:         public string? Title { get; set; }
272:         public string? Description { get; set; }
273:         public DateTime StartTime { get; set; } = DateTime.Today.AddHours(9);
274:         public DateTime EndTime { get; set; } = DateTime.Today.AddHours(17);
275:         public Guid? LocationId { get; set; }
276:         public int? MaxAudienceAttendees { get; set; }
277:         public int? RegistrationModeId { get; set; } = 1;
278:         public IEnumerable<int> LanguageIds { get; set; } = new HashSet<int>();
279: 
280:         public CreateEventSessionDto ToCreateDto(Guid eventId, Guid tenantId)
281:         {
282:             return new CreateEventSessionDto
283:             {
284:                 EventId = eventId,
285:                 Title = Title ?? "Session",
286:                 Description = Description,
287:                 StartTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(StartTime),
288:                 EndTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(EndTime),
289:                 LocationId = LocationId,
290:                 MaxAudienceAttendees = MaxAudienceAttendees,
291:                 RegistrationModeId = RegistrationModeId,
292:                 TenantId = tenantId
293:             };
294:         }
295: 
296:         public UpdateEventSessionDto ToUpdateDto(Guid eventId)
297:         {
298:             return new UpdateEventSessionDto
299:             {
300:                 Id = Id ?? Guid.Empty,
301:                 EventId = eventId,
302:                 Title = Title ?? "Session",
303:                 Description = Description,
304:                 StartTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(StartTime),
305:                 EndTime = DateTimeHelper.ConvertLocalToUtc(EndTime),
306:                 LocationId = LocationId,
307:                 MaxAudienceAttendees = MaxAudienceAttendees,
308:                 RegistrationModeId = RegistrationModeId
309:             };
310:         }
311: 
312:         public static SessionEditorModel FromDto(EventSessionListDto dto)
313:         {
314:             return new SessionEditorModel
315:             {
316:                 Id = dto.Id,
317:                 Title = dto.Title ?? dto.EventTitle,
318:                 Description = null,
319:                 StartTime = dto.StartTime?.LocalDateTime ?? DateTime.Now,
320:                 EndTime = dto.EndTime?.LocalDateTime ?? DateTime.Now.AddHours(1),
321:                 LocationId = dto.LocationId,
322:                 MaxAudienceAttendees = dto.MaxAudienceAttendees,
323:                 RegistrationModeId = dto.RegistrationModeId
324:             };
325:         }
326:     }
327: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/Event/ManageSpeakersDialog.razor
````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  3: @using MudBlazor
  4: @using MudBlazor.Services
  5: @inject IEventSessionSpeakerService EventSessionSpeakerService
  6: @inject IActorService ActorService
  7: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  8: 
  9: <MudDialog>
 10:     <TitleContent>
 11:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Manage Speakers</MudText>
 12:     </TitleContent>
 13:     <DialogContent>
 14:         <MudStack Spacing="4">
 15:             <MudAutocomplete T="ActorListDto" Label="Add Speaker" @bind-Value="selectedActor"
 16:                              SearchFunc="@SearchActors" ToStringFunc="@(e => e?.DisplayName)"
 17:                              Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true" />
 18: 
 19:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="AddSpeaker" Disabled="@(selectedActor == null)">Add Speaker</MudButton>
 20: 
 21:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Current Speakers</MudText>
 22:             <MudList T="EventSessionSpeakerListDto" Clickable="true">
 23:                 @foreach (var speaker in speakers)
 24:                 {
 25:                     <MudListItem T="EventSessionSpeakerListDto">
 26:                         @speaker.ActorDisplayName
 27:                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" Size="Size.Small" OnClick="@(() => RemoveSpeaker(speaker.Id))" />
 28:                     </MudListItem>
 29:                 }
 30:             </MudList>
 31:         </MudStack>
 32:     </DialogContent>
 33:     <DialogActions>
 34:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
 35:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit">Ok</MudButton>
 36:     </DialogActions>
 37: </MudDialog>
 38: 
 39: @code {
 40:     [CascadingParameter] IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = default!;
 41:     [Parameter] public Guid SessionId { get; set; }
 42: 
 43:     private List<EventSessionSpeakerListDto> speakers = new();
 44:     private ActorListDto? selectedActor;
 45:     private List<ActorListDto> allActors = new();
 46: 
 47:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 48:     {
 49:         await LoadSpeakers();
 50:         var actorsCollection = await ActorService.GetActorsAsync();
 51:         allActors = actorsCollection.ToList();
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     private async Task LoadSpeakers()
 55:     {
 56:         // Note: Service returns ICollection<object> due to neutralized methods
 57:         var rawSpeakers = await EventSessionSpeakerService.GetSpeakersBySessionAsync(SessionId);
 58:         speakers = new List<EventSessionSpeakerListDto>(); // Will be empty until API is updated
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     private async Task<IEnumerable<ActorListDto>> SearchActors(string value, CancellationToken token)
 62:     {
 63:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
 64:         {
 65:             return allActors;
 66:         }
 67:         return allActors.Where(x => x.DisplayName.Contains(value, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     private async Task AddSpeaker()
 71:     {
 72:         if (selectedActor != null && selectedActor.Id.HasValue)
 73:         {
 74:             // Note: Using anonymous object since CreateEventSessionSpeakerDto is not available
 75:             var newSpeaker = new { ActorId = selectedActor.Id.Value, EventSessionId = SessionId };
 76:             var response = await EventSessionSpeakerService.AddSpeakerToSessionAsync(newSpeaker);
 77:             if (response?.Success == true)
 78:             {
 79:                 Snackbar.Add("Speaker added.", Severity.Success);
 80:                 await LoadSpeakers();
 81:                 selectedActor = null;
 82:                 StateHasChanged();
 83:             }
 84:             else
 85:             {
 86:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Failed to add speaker", Severity.Error);
 87:             }
 88:         }
 89:     }
 90: 
 91:     private async Task RemoveSpeaker(Guid? speakerId)
 92:     {
 93:         if (!speakerId.HasValue) return;
 94:         await EventSessionSpeakerService.RemoveSpeakerFromSessionAsync(speakerId.Value);
 95:         Snackbar.Add("Speaker removed.", Severity.Success);
 96:         await LoadSpeakers();
 97:         StateHasChanged();
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(true));
101:     void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
102: }
````

````razor
  1: @inject IEventService EventService
  2: @inject IUserService UserService
  3: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
  4: <MudDialog Class="registration-dialog">
  5:     <DialogContent>
  6:         @if (isLoading)
  7:         {
  8:             <div class="registration-shell" style="text-align: center; padding: 48px;">
  9:                 <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 10:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" style="margin-top: 16px;">
 11:                     Checking registration status...
 12:                 </MudText>
 13:             </div>
 14:         }
 15:         else if (isAlreadyRegistered)
 16:         {
 17:             <div class="registration-shell">
 18:                 <div class="success-content">
 19:                     <div class="success-icon">
 20:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.EventAvailable" Style="color: var(--mud-palette-success);" />
 21:                     </div>
 22:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="success-title">
 23:                         You're Already Registered! ✅
 24:                     </MudText>
 25:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="success-message">
 26:                         You have already registered for this event.<br />
 27:                         We look forward to seeing you there!
 28:                     </MudText>
 29:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 30:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 31:                                Size="Size.Large"
 32:                                OnClick="Close"
 33:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Close">
 34:                         Close
 35:                     </MudButton>
 36:                 </div>
 37:             </div>
 38:         }
 39:         else if (!isRegistered)
 40:         {
 41:             <div class="registration-shell">
 42:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mb-2">@Title</MudText>
 43:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-6 mud-text-secondary">
 44:                     Click confirm to register for this event
 45:                 </MudText>
 46: 
 47:                 @if (currentUser != null)
 48:                 {
 49:                     <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Class="mb-4">
 50:                         You will be registered as: <strong>@currentUser.FirstName @currentUser.LastName</strong> (@currentUser.Email)
 51:                     </MudAlert>
 52:                 }
 53: 
 54:                 <div class="action-buttons">
 55:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
 56:                                Color="Color.Default"
 57:                                OnClick="Cancel"
 58:                                Disabled="isSubmitting">
 59:                         Cancel
 60:                     </MudButton>
 61:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 62:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 63:                                OnClick="HandleSubmit"
 64:                                Disabled="isSubmitting || currentUser == null"
 65:                                StartIcon="@(isSubmitting ? null : Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle)">
 66:                         @if (isSubmitting)
 67:                         {
 68:                             <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" />
 69:                             <span>Registering...</span>
 70:                         }
 71:                         else
 72:                         {
 73:                             <span>Confirm Registration</span>
 74:                         }
 75:                     </MudButton>
 76:                 </div>
 77:             </div>
 78:         }
 79:         else
 80:         {
 81:             <div class="registration-shell">
 82:                 <div class="success-content">
 83:                     <div class="success-icon">
 84:                         <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle" />
 85:                     </div>
 86:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Class="success-title">
 87:                         Registration Successful! 🎉
 88:                     </MudText>
 89:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="success-message">
 90:                         Thank you for registering@(currentUser != null ? $", {currentUser.FirstName}" : "")! <br />
 91:                         You will receive a confirmation email shortly.
 92:                     </MudText>
 93:                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 94:                                Color="Color.Primary"
 95:                                Size="Size.Large"
 96:                                OnClick="Close"
 97:                                StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Close">
 98:                         Close
 99:                     </MudButton>
100:                 </div>
101:             </div>
102:         }
103:     </DialogContent>
104: </MudDialog>
105: 
106: @code {
107:     [CascadingParameter]
108:     private MudBlazor.IDialogReference? DialogReference { get; set; }
109: 
110:     [Parameter]
111:     public Guid EventSessionId { get; set; }
112: 
113:     [Parameter]
114:     public string Title { get; set; } = "Register for Event";
115: 
116:     private CreateEventRegistrationDto registrationModel = new();
117:     private UserDto? currentUser;
118:     private bool isSubmitting = false;
119:     private bool isRegistered = false;
120:     private bool isAlreadyRegistered = false;
121:     private bool isLoading = true;
122: 
123:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
124:     {
125:         try
126:         {
127:             // Get current user
128:             currentUser = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
129: 
130:             if (currentUser != null)
131:             {
132:                 registrationModel.EventSessionId = EventSessionId;
133:                 registrationModel.UserId = currentUser.Id;
134:             }
135:         }
136:         catch (Exception ex)
137:         {
138:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading user data: {ex.Message}", Severity.Warning);
139:         }
140:         finally
141:         {
142:             isLoading = false;
143:         }
144:     }
145: 
146:     private async Task HandleSubmit()
147:     {
148:         if (currentUser == null)
149:         {
150:             Snackbar.Add("You must be logged in to register.", Severity.Error);
151:             return;
152:         }
153: 
154:         if (EventSessionId == Guid.Empty)
155:         {
156:             Snackbar.Add("Registration is unavailable for this session.", Severity.Error);
157:             return;
158:         }
159: 
160:         isSubmitting = true;
161: 
162:         try
163:         {
164:             var response = await EventService.RegisterForEventSessionAsync(registrationModel);
165: 
166:             if (response?.Success == true)
167:             {
168:                 isRegistered = true;
169:                 Snackbar.Add("You have been successfully registered!", Severity.Success);
170:             }
171:             else
172:             {
173:                 Snackbar.Add(response?.Message ?? "Something went wrong. Please try again later.", Severity.Error);
174:             }
175:         }
176:         catch (Exception ex)
177:         {
178:             Snackbar.Add($"Registration error: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
179:         }
180:         finally
181:         {
182:             isSubmitting = false;
183:         }
184:     }
185: 
186:     private void Cancel()
187:     {
188:         DialogReference?.Close();
189:     }
190: 
191:     private void Close()
192:     {
193:         DialogReference?.Close();
194:     }
195: }
````

````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  2: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  3: @inject IImageStorageService ImageStorageService
  4: @inject ILogger<S3Image> Logger
  5: <div class="s3-image-container" style="@ContainerStyle">
  6:     @if (isLoading && !hasError)
  7:     {
  8:         <div class="s3-image-placeholder">
  9:             <div class="loading-spinner">
 10:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
 11:             </div>
 12:         </div>
 13:     }
 14:     else if (hasError)
 15:     {
 16:         <div class="s3-image-error">
 17:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.BrokenImage" Color="Color.Secondary" Size="Size.Large" />
 18:             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption">@(ErrorText ?? "Failed to load image")</MudText>
 19:         </div>
 20:     }
 21:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(imageUrl))
 22:     {
 23:         <img src="@imageUrl"
 24:              alt="@Alt"
 25:              class="s3-image @(isLoading ? "loading" : "")"
 26:              @onload="OnImageLoaded"
 27:              @onerror="OnImageError" />
 28:     }
 29:     else
 30:     {
 31:         <div class="s3-image-placeholder">
 32:             <MudIcon Icon="@(PlaceholderIcon ?? Icons.Material.Filled.Image)"
 33:                     Color="Color.Secondary"
 34:                     Size="Size.Large" />
 35:         </div>
 36:     }
 37: </div>
 38: 
 39: @code {
 40:     /// <summary>
 41:     /// The S3 image key to load
 42:     /// </summary>
 43:     [Parameter] public string? ImageKey { get; set; }
 44: 
 45:     /// <summary>
 46:     /// Direct image URL (if already fetched)
 47:     /// </summary>
 48:     [Parameter] public string? ImageUrl { get; set; }
 49: 
 50:     /// <summary>
 51:     /// Alt text for the image
 52:     /// </summary>
 53:     [Parameter] public string Alt { get; set; } = "Image";
 54: 
 55:     /// <summary>
 56:     /// CSS object-fit property
 57:     /// </summary>
 58:     [Parameter] public string ObjectFit { get; set; } = "cover";
 59: 
 60:     /// <summary>
 61:     /// Border radius for the image
 62:     /// </summary>
 63:     [Parameter] public string? BorderRadius { get; set; }
 64: 
 65:     /// <summary>
 66:     /// Additional styles for the container
 67:     /// </summary>
 68:     [Parameter] public string? ContainerStyle { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     /// <summary>
 71:     /// Icon to show when no image is available
 72:     /// </summary>
 73:     [Parameter] public string? PlaceholderIcon { get; set; }
 74: 
 75:     /// <summary>
 76:     /// Text to show on error
 77:     /// </summary>
 78:     [Parameter] public string? ErrorText { get; set; }
 79: 
 80:     /// <summary>
 81:     /// Whether to use a fallback image on error
 82:     /// </summary>
 83:     [Parameter] public string? FallbackUrl { get; set; }
 84: 
 85:     private string? imageUrl;
 86:     private bool isLoading = true;
 87:     private bool hasError = false;
 88: 
 89:     protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
 90:     {
 91:         await LoadImageAsync();
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     private async Task LoadImageAsync()
 95:     {
 96:         isLoading = true;
 97:         hasError = false;
 98:         imageUrl = null;
 99: 
100:         try
101:         {
102:             // If ImageUrl is provided directly, use it
103:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ImageUrl))
104:             {
105:                 imageUrl = ImageUrl;
106:                 isLoading = false;
107:                 return;
108:             }
109: 
110:             // If ImageKey is provided, fetch the pre-signed URL
111:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ImageKey))
112:             {
113:                 var url = await ImageStorageService.GetImageUrlAsync(ImageKey);
114: 
115:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
116:                 {
117:                     imageUrl = url;
118:                 }
119:                 else
120:                 {
121:                     hasError = true;
122:                 }
123: 
124:                 isLoading = false;
125:             }
126:             else
127:             {
128:                 // No image key or URL provided
129:                 isLoading = false;
130:             }
131:         }
132:         catch (Exception ex)
133:         {
134:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading S3 image for key {ImageKey}", ImageKey);
135:             hasError = true;
136:             isLoading = false;
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:     private void OnImageLoaded()
141:     {
142:         isLoading = false;
143:         StateHasChanged();
144:     }
145: 
146:     private void OnImageError()
147:     {
148:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FallbackUrl))
149:         {
150:             imageUrl = FallbackUrl;
151:         }
152:         else
153:         {
154:             hasError = true;
155:         }
156: 
157:         isLoading = false;
158:         StateHasChanged();
159:     }
160: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Admin/AdminList.razor.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  5: using MudBlazor;
  6: 
  7: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Admin;
  8: 
  9: public partial class AdminList
 10: {
 11:     [Inject] protected IDialogService DialogService { get; set; } = null!;
 12:     [Inject] protected NavigationManager Nav { get; set; } = null!;
 13:     [Inject] protected IAdminService AdminService { get; set; } = null!;
 14:     [Inject] protected IUserService UserService { get; set; } = null!;
 15:     [Inject] protected ILogger<AdminList> Logger { get; set; } = null!;
 16: 
 17: 
 18:     private enum RequestStatus { Pending = 1, Approved = 2, Rejected = 3 }
 19: 
 20:     private ICollection<OrganizationListDto> _organizationRequests = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 21:     private string _search = string.Empty;
 22:     private int _activeTab = 0;
 23:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 24:     private string? _errorMessage;
 25:     private HashSet<RequestStatus> _selectedStatuses = new();
 26:     private enum SortOption { OldestFirst, NewestFirst, Name, Status }
 27:     private SortOption _sort = SortOption.OldestFirst;
 28: 
 29:     private int PendingCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Pending);
 30:     private int ApprovedCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Approved);
 31:     private int RejectedCount => _organizationRequests.Count(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)RequestStatus.Rejected);
 32: 
 33:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 34:     {
 35:         await LoadOrganizationRequests();
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     private async Task LoadOrganizationRequests()
 39:     {
 40:         _isLoading = true;
 41:         _errorMessage = null;
 42: 
 43:         try
 44:         {
 45:             Logger.LogDebug("Loading organizations from API");
 46:             var tempOrgs = await AdminService.GetOrganizationRequestsAsync();
 47: 
 48:             if (tempOrgs != null)
 49:             {
 50:                 _organizationRequests = tempOrgs;
 51:                 Logger.LogDebug("Loaded {OrganizationCount} organizations", _organizationRequests.Count);
 52:             }
 53:             else
 54:             {
 55:                 _organizationRequests = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 56:             }
 57:         }
 58:         catch (Exception ex)
 59:         {
 60:             _errorMessage = $"Failed to load organizations: {ex.Message}";
 61:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load organizations");
 62:             _organizationRequests = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
 63:         }
 64:         finally
 65:         {
 66:             _isLoading = false;
 67:         }
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     private bool IsStatusSelected(RequestStatus s) => _selectedStatuses.Contains(s);
 71: 
 72:     private void ToggleStatus(RequestStatus s)
 73:     {
 74:         if (_selectedStatuses.Contains(s)) _selectedStatuses.Remove(s); else _selectedStatuses.Add(s);
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     private void ClearFilters()
 78:     {
 79:         _selectedStatuses.Clear();
 80:         _search = string.Empty;
 81:         _sort = SortOption.OldestFirst;
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     private IEnumerable<OrganizationListDto> GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus? status)
 85:     {
 86:         IEnumerable<OrganizationListDto> q = _organizationRequests;
 87: 
 88:         if (status.HasValue)
 89:             q = q.Where(r => r.ApprovalStatusId == (int)status.Value);
 90: 
 91: 
 92:         if (_selectedStatuses.Count > 0)
 93:         {
 94:             var allowed = _selectedStatuses.Select(s => (int)s).ToHashSet();
 95:             q = q.Where(r => r.ApprovalStatusId.HasValue && allowed.Contains(r.ApprovalStatusId.Value));
 96:         }
 97: 
 98:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search))
 99:         {
100:             var s = _search.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
101:             q = q.Where(r =>
102:                 (r.FullName?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
103:                 (r.Id.ToString().ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s)) ||
104:                 (r.Email?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
105:                 (r.City?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false) ||
106:                 (r.Country?.ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ?? false));
107:         }
108: 
109: 
110:         q = _sort switch
111:         {
112:             SortOption.NewestFirst => q.OrderByDescending(r => r.CreatedAt),
113:             SortOption.Name => q.OrderBy(r => r.FullName),
114:             SortOption.Status => q.OrderBy(r => r.ApprovalStatusId),
115:             _ => q.OrderBy(r => r.CreatedAt)
116:         };
117: 
118:         return q;
119:     }
120: 
121:     private async Task Approve(OrganizationListDto req)
122:     {
123:         if (!req.Id.HasValue) return;
124: 
125:         bool? ok = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
126:             "Confirm approval",
127:             $"Approve {req.FullName}?",
128:             yesText: "Approve", cancelText: "Cancel");
129: 
130:         if (ok == true)
131:         {
132:             var success = await AdminService.ApproveOrganizationAsync(req.Id.Value);
133:             if (success)
134:             {
135:                 await LoadOrganizationRequests();
136:             }
137:             else
138:             {
139:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to approve {req.FullName}";
140:             }
141:         }
142:     }
143:

147:

151:             yesText: "Reject", cancelText: "Cancel");
152: 
153:         if (ok == true)
154:         {
155:             var success = await AdminService.RejectOrganizationAsync(req.Id.Value);
156:             if (success)

158:                 await LoadOrganizationRequests();
159:             }
160:             else
161:             {
162:                 _errorMessage = $"Failed to reject {req.FullName}";
163:             }
164:         }
165:     }

174:         }
````

````csharp
 18:
````

````csharp
 20:     private bool acceptTerms = false;
 21:     private bool confirmInformation = false;
 22:     private bool isSubmitting = false;
 23:     private string logoPreview = string.Empty;
 24: 
 25:     private ImageUpload? _imageUpload;
 26:     private FileUploadData? _selectedLogoData;
 27:     private bool _isUploadingLogo = false;
 28:     private Guid? _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = null;
 29:     private string? _logoUploadError;
 30:     private OrganizationAppearanceSettings _appearance = new();
 31: 
 32:     private bool submitSuccess = false;
 33:     private string errorMessage = string.Empty;
 34: 
 35:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 36:     {
 37:         organization = new CreateOrganizationDto();
 38:         await base.OnInitializedAsync();
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     private async Task HandleSubmit()
 42:     {
 43:         if (!CanSubmit()) return;
 44: 
 45:         isSubmitting = true;
 46:         errorMessage = string.Empty;
 47: 
 48:         try
 49:         {
 50:             organization.MetadataJson = OrganizationAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(organization.MetadataJson, _appearance);
 51:             var createdOrganization = await OrganizationService.CreateOrganizationAsync(organization);
 52: 
 53:             if (createdOrganization != null)
 54:             {
 55:                 submitSuccess = true;
 56:                 Logger.LogInformation("Organization successfully created with ID: {OrganizationId}", createdOrganization.Id);
 57:                 await Task.Delay(1000);
 58:                 NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/organization/success");
 59:             }
 60:             else
 61:             {
 62:                 errorMessage = "An error occurred while creating the organization. Please try again.";
 63:             }
 64:         }
 65:         catch (Exception ex)
 66:         {
 67:             errorMessage = $"Error creating organization: {ex.Message}";
 68:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during organization creation");
 69:         }
 70:         finally
 71:         {
 72:             isSubmitting = false;
 73:         }
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     private async Task OnLogoFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
 77:     {
 78:         _selectedLogoData = fileData;
 79:         _logoUploadError = null;
 80: 
 81:         if (fileData == null)
 82:         {
 83:             _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = null;
 84:             organization.ProfilePictureId = null;
 85:             return;
 86:         }
 87: 
 88:         _isUploadingLogo = true;
 89: 
 90:         await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
 91: 
 92:         try
 93:         {
 94:             var uploadResult = await ImageStorageService.UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync(fileData);
 95: 
 96:             if (uploadResult?.Success == true)
 97:             {
 98:                 _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
 99:                 organization.ProfilePictureId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
100:                 _logoUploadError = null;
101:             }
102:             else
103:             {
104:                 _logoUploadError = uploadResult?.ErrorMessage ?? "Failed to upload logo.";
105:                 await ClearLogoUploadState();
106:             }
107:         }
108:         catch (Exception ex)
109:         {
110:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Exception during logo upload");
111:             _logoUploadError = $"Upload error: {ex.Message}";
112:             await ClearLogoUploadState();
113:         }
114:         finally
115:         {
116:             _isUploadingLogo = false;
117: 
118:             await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
119:         }
120:     }
121: 
122:     private async Task ClearLogoUploadState()
123:     {
124:         try
125:         {
126:             if (_imageUpload != null)
127:             {
128:                 await _imageUpload.RemoveImage();
129:             }
130:         }
131:         catch { }
132: 
133:         _selectedLogoData = null;
134:         _uploadedLogoStorageObjectId = null;
135:         organization.ProfilePictureId = null;
136:     }
137:

139:     {
140:         logoPreview = value ?? string.Empty;
141:     }
142: 
143:     private bool CanSubmit()
144:     {
145:         return acceptTerms &&
146:                confirmInformation &&
147:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.FullName) &&
148:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Email) &&
149:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Address) &&
150:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.City) &&
151:                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.Country) &&
152:                organization.Postcode > 0 &&
153:                !_isUploadingLogo;
154:     }
155: }
````

````razor
32:     {
````

````csharp
 67:                     orgs = await OrganizationService.GetMyOrganizationsAsync();

 69:             }
 70:

 72:             Logger.LogInformation("[MyOrganizations] Loaded {Count} organizations", _organizations.Count);
````

````csharp
164:     {
165:         try
166:         {
167:             var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient");
168:             using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(method, url)
169:             {
170:                 Content = JsonContent.Create(settings)
171:             };
172:

174: 
175:             var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
176:             var payload = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<InstanceCommandResponseModel>();
177: 
178:             if (payload != null)
179:             {
180:                 return payload;
181:             }
182: 
183:             return new InstanceCommandResponseModel
184:             {
185:                 Success = response.IsSuccessStatusCode,
186:                 Message = response.IsSuccessStatusCode
187:                     ? "Operation completed successfully."
188:                     : $"Operation failed with status {(int)response.StatusCode}."
189:             };
190:         }
191:         catch (Exception ex)
192:         {
193:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to call instance onboarding endpoint {Url}.", url);
194:             return new InstanceCommandResponseModel
195:             {
196:                 Success = false,
197:                 Message = "Request failed.",
198:                 Errors = new List<string> { ex.Message }
199:             };
200:         }
201:     }
202: 
203:     private async Task AddSetupSecretHeaderAsync(HttpRequestMessage request)
204:     {
205:         if (request.Headers.Contains("X-Setup-Secret"))
206:         {
207:             return;
208:         }
209: 
210:         var requestPath = GetRequestPath(request.RequestUri);
211:         if (!RequiresSetupSecret(requestPath))
212:         {
213:             return;
214:         }
215: 
216:         try
217:         {
218:             var secret = await _jsRuntime.InvokeAsync<string?>("sessionStorage.getItem", "setup-secret");
219:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secret))
220:             {
221:                 request.Headers.Add("X-Setup-Secret", secret.Trim());
222:             }
223:         }
224:         catch (Exception ex)
225:         {
226:             _logger.LogDebug(ex, "Could not read setup-secret from sessionStorage for {Path}", requestPath);
227:         }
228:     }
229: 
230:     private static string GetRequestPath(Uri? requestUri)
231:     {
232:         if (requestUri is null)
233:         {
234:             return string.Empty;
235:         }
236: 
237:         var path = requestUri.IsAbsoluteUri ? requestUri.PathAndQuery : requestUri.OriginalString;
238:         if (!path.StartsWith('/'))
239:         {
240:             path = "/" + path;
241:         }
242: 
243:         return path;
244:     }
245: 
246:     private static bool RequiresSetupSecret(string pathAndQuery)
247:     {
248:         return pathAndQuery.Contains("/api/InstanceOnboarding/complete", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
249:             || pathAndQuery.Contains("/api/InstanceOnboarding/settings", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
250:             || pathAndQuery.Contains("/api/InstanceOnboarding/storage-settings", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
251:             || pathAndQuery.Contains("/api/InstanceOnboarding/test-storage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
252:     }
253: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor/wwwroot/js/layout.js
````javascript
 1: window.ExploreLayout = {
 2:     setAnnouncementBarHeight: function (element) {
 3:         var height = element && element.offsetHeight ? element.offsetHeight : 0;
 4:         document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--announcement-bar-height", height + "px");
 5:     },
 6:     clearAnnouncementBarHeight: function () {
 7:         document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--announcement-bar-height", "0px");
 8:     }
 9: };
10: 
11: window.ExploreTheme = {
12:     getStoredTheme: function () {
13:         try {
14:             return localStorage.getItem("explore-theme") || "";
15:         } catch (e) {
16:             return "";
17:         }
18:     },
19:     setStoredTheme: function (theme) {
20:         try {
21:             localStorage.setItem("explore-theme", theme);
22:         } catch (e) {
23: 
24:         }
25:     },
26:     setThemeCookie: function (theme) {
27:         var maxAge = 365 * 24 * 60 * 60;
28:         document.cookie = "theme=" + theme + ";path=/;max-age=" + maxAge + ";SameSite=Lax";
29:     }
30: };
31: 
32: (function () {
33:     var path = (window.location.pathname || "").toLowerCase();
34: 
35:     // Normalize optional trailing slash while keeping root intact.
36:     if (path.length > 1 && path.endsWith("/")) {
37:         path = path.slice(0, -1);
38:     }
39: 
40:     if (path === "/login") {
41:         window.location.replace("/auth/challenge" + (window.location.search || ""));
42:         return;
43:     }
44: 
45:     if (path === "/logout") {
46:         window.location.replace("/auth/signout" + (window.location.search || ""));
47:     }
48: })();
````

## File: Explore.ServiceDefaults/Extensions.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Text.Json;
  2: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;
  4: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
  5: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
  6: using Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;
  7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  8: using Microsoft.Extensions.ServiceDiscovery;
  9: using OpenTelemetry;
 10: using OpenTelemetry.Logs;
 11: using OpenTelemetry.Metrics;
 12: using OpenTelemetry.Trace;
 13: 
 14: namespace Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
 15: 
 16: 
 17: 
 18: 
 19: public static class Extensions
 20: {
 21:     private const string HealthEndpointPath = "/health";
 22:     private const string AlivenessEndpointPath = "/alive";
 23: 
 24:     public static TBuilder AddServiceDefaults<TBuilder>(this TBuilder builder) where TBuilder : IHostApplicationBuilder
 25:     {
 26:         builder.ConfigureOpenTelemetry();
 27: 
 28:         builder.AddDefaultHealthChecks();
 29: 
 30:         builder.Services.AddServiceDiscovery();
 31: 
 32:         builder.Services.ConfigureHttpClientDefaults(http =>
 33:         {
 34: 
 35:             http.AddStandardResilienceHandler();
 36: 
 37: 
 38:             http.AddServiceDiscovery();
 39:         });
 40: 
 41: 
 42: 
 43: 
 44: 
 45: 
 46: 
 47:         return builder;
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     public static TBuilder ConfigureOpenTelemetry<TBuilder>(this TBuilder builder) where TBuilder : IHostApplicationBuilder
 51:     {
 52:         builder.Logging.AddOpenTelemetry(logging =>
 53:         {
 54:             logging.IncludeFormattedMessage = true;
 55:             logging.IncludeScopes = true;
 56:         });
 57: 
 58:         builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry()
 59:             .WithMetrics(metrics =>
 60:             {
 61:                 metrics.AddAspNetCoreInstrumentation()
 62:                     .AddHttpClientInstrumentation()
 63:                     .AddRuntimeInstrumentation()
 64:                     .AddMeter("Explore.Business")
 65:                     .AddPrometheusExporter();
 66:             })
 67:             .WithTracing(tracing =>
 68:             {
 69:                 tracing.AddSource(builder.Environment.ApplicationName)
 70:                     .AddAspNetCoreInstrumentation(tracing =>
 71: 
 72:                         tracing.Filter = context =>
 73:                             !context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments(HealthEndpointPath)
 74:                             && !context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments(AlivenessEndpointPath)
 75:                     )
 76: 
 77: 
 78:                     .AddHttpClientInstrumentation();
 79:             });
 80: 
 81:         builder.AddOpenTelemetryExporters();
 82: 
 83:         return builder;
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     private static TBuilder AddOpenTelemetryExporters<TBuilder>(this TBuilder builder) where TBuilder : IHostApplicationBuilder
 87:     {
 88:         var useOtlpExporter = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(builder.Configuration["OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT"]);
 89: 
 90:         if (useOtlpExporter)
 91:         {
 92:             builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry().UseOtlpExporter();
 93:         }
 94: 
 95: 
 96: 
 97: 
 98: 
 99: 
100: 
101: 
102:         return builder;
103:     }
104: 
105:     public static TBuilder AddDefaultHealthChecks<TBuilder>(this TBuilder builder) where TBuilder : IHostApplicationBuilder
106:     {
107:         builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
108: 
109:             .AddCheck("self", () => HealthCheckResult.Healthy(), ["live"]);
110: 
111:         return builder;
112:     }
113: 
114:     public static WebApplication MapDefaultEndpoints(this WebApplication app)
115:     {
116: 
117: 
118: 
119: 
120:         var healthCheckOptions = new HealthCheckOptions
121:         {
122:             ResponseWriter = WriteHealthCheckResponse,
123:             ResultStatusCodes =
124:             {
125:                 [HealthStatus.Healthy] = StatusCodes.Status200OK,
126:                 [HealthStatus.Degraded] = StatusCodes.Status200OK,
127:                 [HealthStatus.Unhealthy] = StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable
128:             }
129:         };
130: 
131: 
132:         app.MapHealthChecks(HealthEndpointPath, healthCheckOptions);
133: 
134: 
135:         app.MapHealthChecks(AlivenessEndpointPath, new HealthCheckOptions
136:         {
137:             Predicate = r => r.Tags.Contains("live"),
138:             ResponseWriter = WriteHealthCheckResponse,
139:             ResultStatusCodes =
140:             {
141:                 [HealthStatus.Healthy] = StatusCodes.Status200OK,
142:                 [HealthStatus.Degraded] = StatusCodes.Status200OK,
143:                 [HealthStatus.Unhealthy] = StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable
144:             }
145:         });
146: 
147:         app.MapPrometheusScrapingEndpoint("/metrics");
148: 
149:         return app;
150:     }
151: 
152:     private static async Task WriteHealthCheckResponse(HttpContext context, HealthReport report)
153:     {
154: 
155:         context.Response.ContentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8";
156:         context.Response.Headers["Connection"] = "close";
157:         context.Response.Headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*";
158:         context.Response.Headers["X-Health-Status"] = report.Status.ToString();
159:         context.Response.Headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
160:         context.Response.Headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache";
161: 
162:         var response = new
163:         {
164:             status = report.Status.ToString(),
165:             message = report.Status switch
166:             {
167:                 HealthStatus.Healthy => "Ok",
168:                 HealthStatus.Degraded => "Degraded",
169:                 HealthStatus.Unhealthy => "Service Unavailable",
170:                 _ => "Unknown"
171:             },
172:             totalDuration = report.TotalDuration.TotalMilliseconds,
173:             checks = report.Entries.Select(e => new
174:             {
175:                 name = e.Key,
176:                 status = e.Value.Status.ToString(),
177:                 description = e.Value.Description,
178:                 duration = e.Value.Duration.TotalMilliseconds,
179:                 error = e.Value.Exception?.Message,
180:                 data = e.Value.Data.Count > 0 ? e.Value.Data : null
181:             })
182:         };
183: 
184:         var jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions
185:         {
186:             WriteIndented = true,
187:             PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
188:             DefaultIgnoreCondition = System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
189:         };
190: 
191:         await context.Response.WriteAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(response, jsonOptions));
192:     }
193: }
````

````markdown
  1: ---
  2: name: blazor-component-architect

  8: 
  9: > **Project-Agnostic Blazor Component Architecture Agent**

 12: 
 13: # Blazor Component Architect Agent
 14: 
 15: ## Purpose
 16: 
 17: Designs, reviews, and refactors Blazor components for the {Project} platform. Ensures components follow Blazor best practices, MudBlazor patterns, BFF architecture, and Clean Architecture principles.
 18: 
 19: ## When This Agent Activates
 20: 
 21: **Triggered by**:
 22: - Keywords: "blazor", "component", "razor", "mudblazor", "page", "dialog", "layout", "wasm", "server", "bff", "render mode", "component design", "refactoring", "architecture review"
 23: - File patterns: `**/*.razor`, `**/*.razor.cs`, `**/*Blazor/**/*.cs`, `**/*Blazor.Client/**/*.cs`
 24: 
 25: ## {Project} Blazor Architecture
 26: 
 27: For an overview of the {Project} Blazor Hybrid Architecture and its integration with the BFF pattern, refer to [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and the `blazor-bff-patterns` skill.
 28: 
 29: ## Review Checklist
 30: 
 31: This checklist helps ensure components adhere to established patterns and best practices. For detailed guidance on each point, refer to the `blazor-ui-conventions` and `blazor-bff-patterns` skills.
 32: 
 33: ### Component Structure & Lifecycle
 34: 
 35: - [ ] Component has clear single responsibility.
 36: - [ ] Uses the project's routing strategy consistently (`@page` routing or centralized Blazouter `RouteConfig`).
 37: - [ ] Uses `@rendermode` appropriately (InteractiveAuto/Server/WebAssembly). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (render modes).
 38: - [ ] Proper `@using` statements are present.
 39: - [ ] `@code` block is organized (fields → properties → lifecycle → methods).
 40: - [ ] Parameter handling matches the local pattern: standard `[Parameter]` + `EventCallback` for most app components; use `ParameterState<T>` when building custom MudBlazor base/stateful components.
 41: - [ ] EventCallbacks are used for child → parent communication. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 42: - [ ] Implements `IDisposable` for event cleanup. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design, state management).
 43: - [ ] Data loading in `OnInitializedAsync` (not `OnAfterRender`). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 44: - [ ] JS interop in `OnAfterRenderAsync(firstRender: true)`. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 45: - [ ] No `StateHasChanged()` in `OnAfterRender` (to prevent infinite loops). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 46: - [ ] Null checks before accessing data.
 47: 
 48: ### MudBlazor Usage & Styling
 49: 
 50: - [ ] Uses MudBlazor components over raw HTML. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage).
 51: - [ ] Grid system used correctly (`MudGrid` + `MudItem` with breakpoints). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage).
 52: - [ ] Proper component properties (e.g., `Variant`, `Color`, `Size`) are applied. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage).
 53: - [ ] **BEM class names applied via `Class` parameter** (e.g., `Class="event-card event-card--featured"`). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 54: - [ ] **CSS isolation via `Component.razor.css` file** (placed next to `.razor` file). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 55: - [ ] **BEM naming in CSS** (`.block`, `.block__element`, `.block--modifier`). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 56: - [ ] **Child components styled via own `.razor.css` or wrapper pattern** (not ::deep unless necessary). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 57: - [ ] **::deep selector used only for third-party internals** (sparingly, documented why). See `blazor-css-isolation`.
 58: - [ ] **MudBlazor theme variables used** (not hardcoded colors). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (theming).
 59: - [ ] Dialogs use `[CascadingParameter] MudDialogInstance` for programmatic control. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage, common patterns).
 60: - [ ] Forms use MudBlazor input components. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage, common patterns).
 61: - [ ] Notifications use `ISnackbar`. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage).
 62: - [ ] Icons use `@Icons.Material.*` constants.
 63: 
 64: ### State Management & BFF Pattern Compliance
 65: 
 66: - [ ] State management patterns (component state, parameters, cascading values, services) are applied appropriately. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (state management).
 67: - [ ] Services wrap NSwag API client (not direct API calls). See `blazor-bff-patterns` (service layer patterns).
 68: - [ ] Services handle errors and return safe defaults. See `blazor-bff-patterns` (service layer patterns) and `error-tracking` (Blazor error boundary).
 69: - [ ] Services log operations for debugging. See `error-tracking` (logging).
 70: - [ ] Authentication state via `CascadingAuthenticationState`. See `blazor-bff-patterns` (auth state management) and `auth-patterns`.
 71: - [ ] No direct HttpContext access in WASM components. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (render modes) and `blazor-bff-patterns`.
 72: - [ ] Cookie-based authentication and token forwarding handled by BFF. See `blazor-bff-patterns`.
 73: - [ ] Theme state management (if applicable) follows `blazor-ui-conventions` (theming).
 74: - [ ] Route guards and route params follow the configured routing library conventions (for example Blazouter guards and `RouterStateService.GetParam`).
 75: 
 76: ### Performance & Accessibility
 77: 
 78: - [ ] Virtualization for large lists (`<Virtualize>`).
 79: - [ ] Lazy loading for expensive operations.
 80: - [ ] Skeleton loaders or progress indicators for loading states. See `blazor-ui-conventions` (common patterns).
 81: - [ ] Minimal re-renders (avoid unnecessary `StateHasChanged()`). See `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
 82: - [ ] Proper disposal of resources.
 83: - [ ] Semantic HTML structure.
 84: - [ ] ARIA labels where needed.
 85: - [ ] Keyboard navigation support.
 86: - [ ] Color contrast compliance.
 87: - [ ] Screen reader friendly.
 88: 
 89: ## Component Patterns
 90: 
 91: For detailed examples and templates of Page Components, Reusable Components, Dialog Components, and Service Layer implementations, refer to the `blazor-ui-conventions` skill and `blazor-bff-patterns` skill.
 92: 
 93: ## Common Anti-Patterns to Avoid
 94: 
 95: For a comprehensive list of common Blazor anti-patterns, including direct API client usage, data loading in `OnAfterRender`, modifying parameters directly, `async void` event handlers, and `HttpContext` access in WASM, refer to the `blazor-ui-conventions` skill. Also, refer to `blazor-bff-patterns` for BFF-specific anti-patterns.
 96: 
 97: ## Review Process
 98: 
 99: To conduct a thorough review, follow these steps, utilizing the referenced skills for detailed guidance:
100: 
101: 1.  **Analyze Component Structure & Design**: Assess component responsibility, parameter usage, and lifecycle. Refer to `blazor-ui-conventions` (component design).
102: 2.  **Evaluate UI/UX Implementation**: Check MudBlazor usage, layout, and adherence to BEM. Refer to `blazor-ui-conventions` (MudBlazor usage, BEM methodology).
103: 3.  **Verify State & Data Flow**: Review state management patterns, data loading, and authentication state. Refer to `blazor-ui-conventions` (state management) and `blazor-bff-patterns` (auth state management).
104: 4.  **Assess Interactivity & Performance**: Examine render modes, resource usage, and responsiveness. Refer to `blazor-ui-conventions` (render modes).
105: 5.  **Check Error Handling & Robustness**: Review `try-catch` blocks, user feedback, and API service error handling. Refer to `error-tracking` (Blazor error boundary) and `blazor-bff-patterns` (service layer patterns).
106: 6.  **Ensure BFF Compliance**: Verify that API communication adheres to the BFF pattern. Refer to `blazor-bff-patterns`.
107: 7.  **Generate Report**: Provide specific recommendations, code examples (before/after), and a step-by-step implementation plan.
108: 
109: ## Related Skills
110: 
111: - [`blazor-ui-conventions`](../skills/blazor-ui-conventions/SKILL.md) - Comprehensive Blazor UI patterns, MudBlazor usage, theming, component design, state management, render modes.
112: - [`blazor-css-isolation`](../skills/blazor-css-isolation/SKILL.md) - **CSS isolation with BEM methodology, ::deep selector, component styling patterns**.
113: - [`blazor-bff-patterns`](../skills/blazor-bff-patterns/SKILL.md) - BFF architecture, YARP, token forwarding, cookie management, service layer patterns.
114: - [`clean-architecture-rules`](../skills/clean-architecture-rules/SKILL.md) - Layer separation and dependencies relevant to Blazor.
115: - [`cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`](../skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/SKILL.md) - MediatR usage from Blazor (if applicable for commands/queries).
116: - [`auth-patterns`](../skills/auth-patterns/SKILL.md) - Authentication and authorization patterns in Blazor.
117: - [`error-tracking`](../skills/error-tracking/SKILL.md) - Error handling and logging specific to Blazor components.
118: 
119: ## Related Documentation
120: 
121: - [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - Overall system architecture.
122: - [`docs/SECURITY.md`](../../docs/SECURITY.md) - General authentication and authorization context.
123: 
124: ## Output Format
125: 
126: When reviewing or designing components, provide:
127: 
128: 1. **Component Analysis**
129:    - Purpose and responsibility
130:    - Current structure assessment
131:    - Compliance with patterns
132: 
133: 2. **Recommendations**
134:    - Specific improvements with code examples
135:    - Performance optimizations
136:    - Accessibility enhancements
137: 
138: 3. **Implementation Plan**
139:    - Step-by-step refactoring approach
140:    - File changes required
141:    - Testing strategy
142: 
143: 4. **Code Examples**
144:    - Before/after comparisons
145:    - Complete working examples
146:    - Integration with existing codebase
147: 
148: **Enforcement Level**: SUGGEST (Provides guidance and recommendations)
````
