116: ## ⚡ Quick Reference
117: 
118: ### 1. YARP Reverse Proxy Configuration
119: 
120: **Purpose**: Forward API requests from BFF to backend API with token attachment.
121: 
122: **Generic Template**:
123: 
124: ```csharp
125: // File: {Project}.Blazor/Program.cs
126: var {project}ApiBaseUrl = builder.Configuration["{Project}Api:BaseUrl"] ?? "https://localhost:7039/";
127: 
128: var proxyRoutes = new[]
129: {
130:     new RouteConfig
131:     {
132:         RouteId = "{project}-api",
133:         ClusterId = "{project}-api",
134:         Match = new RouteMatch
135:         {
136:             Path = "/api/{**catchall}"  // Catch all API routes
137:         }
138:     }
139: };
140: 
141: var proxyClusters = new[]
142: {
143:     new ClusterConfig
144:     {
145:         ClusterId = "{project}-api",
146:         Destinations = new Dictionary<string, DestinationConfig>
147:         {
148:             ["primary"] = new() { Address = {project}ApiBaseUrl }
149:         }
150:     }
151: };
152: 
153: builder.Services.AddReverseProxy()
154:     .LoadFromMemory(proxyRoutes, proxyClusters)
155:     .AddTransforms(context =>
156:     {
157:         context.AddRequestTransform(async transformContext =>
158:         {
159:             var httpContext = transformContext.HttpContext;
160:             var token = await httpContext.GetTokenAsync("access_token"); // Get token from cookie
161:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
162:             {
163:                 transformContext.ProxyRequest.Headers.Authorization =
164:                     new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token); // Attach as Bearer token
165:             }
166:         });
167:     });
168: ```
169: 
170: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**:
171: 
172: ```csharp
173: // File: Explore.Blazor/Program.cs
174: var exploreApiBaseUrl = builder.Configuration["ExploreApi:BaseUrl"] ?? "https://localhost:7039/";
175: 
176: var proxyRoutes = new[]
177: {
178:     new RouteConfig
179:     {
180:         RouteId = "event-api",
181:         ClusterId = "event-api",
182:         Match = new RouteMatch
183:         {
184:             Path = "/api/{**catchall}"  // Catch all API routes
185:         }
186:     }
187: };
188: 
189: var proxyClusters = new[]
190: {
191:     new ClusterConfig
192:     {
193:         ClusterId = "explore-api",
194:         Destinations = new Dictionary<string, DestinationConfig>
195:         {
196:             ["primary"] = new() { Address = exploreApiBaseUrl }
197:         }
198:     }
199: };
200: 
201: builder.Services.AddReverseProxy()
202:     .LoadFromMemory(proxyRoutes, proxyClusters)
203:     .AddTransforms(context =>
204:     {
205:         context.AddRequestTransform(async transformContext =>
206:         {
207:             var httpContext = transformContext.HttpContext;
208:             var token = await httpContext.GetTokenAsync("access_token"); // Get token from cookie
209:             if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
210:             {
211:                 transformContext.ProxyRequest.Headers.Authorization =
212:                     new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token); // Attach as Bearer token
213:             }
214:         });
215:     });
216: ```
217: 
218: *For more details, see [bff-configuration.md](resources/bff-configuration.md).*
219: 
220: ### 2. Authentication Configuration (OIDC + Cookies)
221: 
222: **Purpose**: Configure OIDC authentication and cookie-based session management for the Blazor Server BFF.
223: 
224: **Generic Template** (works with any OIDC provider):
225: 
226: ```csharp
227: // File: {Project}.Blazor/Program.cs
228: builder.Services.AddAuthentication(options =>
229: {
230:     options.DefaultScheme = CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
231:     options.DefaultChallengeScheme = OpenIdConnectDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
232: })
233: .AddCookie(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme, options =>
234: {
235:     options.LoginPath = "/login";
236:     options.LogoutPath = "/logout";
237:     options.ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromDays(7);
238:     options.SlidingExpiration = true;
239:     options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;
240:     options.Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest;
241:     options.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax;
242: })
243: .AddOpenIdConnect(options =>
244: {
245:     options.Authority = builder.Configuration["OIDC:Authority"];
246:     options.ClientId = builder.Configuration["OIDC:ClientId"];
247:     options.ClientSecret = builder.Configuration["OIDC:ClientSecret"];
248:     options.ResponseType = "code";
249:     options.UsePkce = true;
250:     options.SaveTokens = true;  // Store tokens in cookie
251:     options.GetClaimsFromUserInfoEndpoint = true;
252: 
253:     options.Scope.Clear();
254:     options.Scope.Add("openid");
255:     options.Scope.Add("profile");
256:     options.Scope.Add("email");
257:     options.Scope.Add("offline_access");  // Request refresh token
258: });
259: ```
260: 
261: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event** (uses Keycloak):
262: 
263: ```csharp
264: // File: Explore.Blazor/Program.cs
265: builder.Services.AddAuthentication(options =>
266: {
267:     options.DefaultScheme = CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
268:     options.DefaultChallengeScheme = OpenIdConnectDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
269: })
270: .AddCookie(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme, options =>
271: {
272:     options.LoginPath = "/login";
273:     options.LogoutPath = "/logout";
274:     options.ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromDays(7);
275:     options.SlidingExpiration = true;
276:     options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;
277:     options.Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest;
278:     options.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax;
279: })
280: .AddOpenIdConnect(options =>
281: {
282:     options.Authority = builder.Configuration["Keycloak:Authority"];
283:     options.ClientId = builder.Configuration["Keycloak:ClientId"];
284:     options.ClientSecret = builder.Configuration["Keycloak:ClientSecret"];
285:     options.ResponseType = "code";
286:     options.UsePkce = true;
287:     options.SaveTokens = true;  // Store tokens in cookie
288:     options.GetClaimsFromUserInfoEndpoint = true;
289: 
290:     options.Scope.Clear();
291:     options.Scope.Add("openid");
292:     options.Scope.Add("profile");
293:     options.Scope.Add("email");
294:     options.Scope.Add("offline_access");  // Request refresh token
295: });
296: ```
297: 
298: *For more details, see [auth-state-management.md](resources/auth-state-management.md).*
299: 
300: ### 3. Token Forwarding for InteractiveServer Components
301: 
302: **Purpose**: In Blazor Hybrid apps, `HttpContext` is not always available in interactive components. Access tokens need to be explicitly forwarded to HTTP clients.
303: 
304: **Generic Template**:
305: 
306: ```csharp
307: // File: {Project}.Blazor/Services/CircuitAccessTokenService.cs (Scoped service)
308: public interface ICircuitAccessTokenService
309: {
310:     void SetAccessToken(string? token);
311:     string? GetAccessToken();
312: }
313: 
314: // File: {Project}.Blazor/Services/AccessTokenForwardingHandler.cs (DelegatingHandler)
315: public class AccessTokenForwardingHandler : DelegatingHandler
316: {
317:     private readonly ICircuitAccessTokenService _tokenService;
318:     public AccessTokenForwardingHandler(ICircuitAccessTokenService tokenService) => _tokenService = tokenService;
319:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
320:     {
321:         var token = _tokenService.GetAccessToken();
322:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
323:         {
324:             request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
325:         }
326:         return await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
327:     }
328: }
329: 
330: // Registration in Program.cs
331: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICircuitAccessTokenService, CircuitAccessTokenService>();
332: builder.Services.AddTransient<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>();
333: builder.Services.AddHttpClient<I{Entity}ApiClient, {Entity}ApiClient>(client =>
334: {
335:     client.BaseAddress = new Uri({project}ApiBaseUrl);
336: })
337: .AddHttpMessageHandler<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>();  // Attach token
338: ```
339: 
340: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**:
341: 
342: ```csharp
343: // File: Explore.Blazor/Services/CircuitAccessTokenService.cs (Scoped service)
344: public interface ICircuitAccessTokenService
345: {
346:     void SetAccessToken(string? token);
347:     string? GetAccessToken();
348: }
349: 
350: // File: Explore.Blazor/Services/AccessTokenForwardingHandler.cs (DelegatingHandler)
351: public class AccessTokenForwardingHandler : DelegatingHandler
352: {
353:     private readonly ICircuitAccessTokenService _tokenService;
354:     public AccessTokenForwardingHandler(ICircuitAccessTokenService tokenService) => _tokenService = tokenService;
355:     protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
356:     {
357:         var token = _tokenService.GetAccessToken();
358:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
359:         {
360:             request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
361:         }
362:         return await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
363:     }
364: }
365: 
366: // Registration in Program.cs
367: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICircuitAccessTokenService, CircuitAccessTokenService>();
368: builder.Services.AddTransient<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>();
369: builder.Services.AddHttpClient<IEventApiClient, EventApiClient>(client =>
370: {
371:     client.BaseAddress = new Uri(exploreApiBaseUrl);
372: })
373: .AddHttpMessageHandler<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>();  // Attach token
374: ```
375: 
376: *For more details, see [token-forwarding.md](resources/token-forwarding.md).*
377: 
378: ### 4. Service Layer Pattern
379: 
380: **Purpose**: Wrap NSwag-generated API clients with a service layer for error handling, logging, and providing safe defaults.
381: 
382: **Generic Template**:
383: 
384: ```csharp
385: // File: {Project}.Blazor.Client/Services/{Entity}Service.cs
386: public interface I{Entity}Service { /* ... */ }
387: 
388: public class {Entity}Service : I{Entity}Service
389: {
390:     private readonly I{Entity}ApiClient _apiClient; // NSwag-generated
391:     private readonly ILogger<{Entity}Service> _logger;
392: 
393:     public {Entity}Service(I{Entity}ApiClient apiClient, ILogger<{Entity}Service> logger) { /* ... */ }
394: 
395:     public async Task<ICollection<{Entity}ListDto>> GetAll{Entities}Async()
396:     {
397:         try
398:         {
399:             return await _apiClient.{Entity}AllAsync() ?? new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
400:         }
401:         catch (ApiException ex)
402:         {
403:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
404:             return new List<{Entity}ListDto>();  // Safe default
405:         }
406:     }
407: }
408: ```
409: 
410: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**:
411: 
412: ```csharp
413: // File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/EventService.cs
414: public interface IEventService { /* ... */ }
415: 
416: public class EventService : IEventService
417: {
418:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient; // NSwag-generated
419:     private readonly ILogger<EventService> _logger;
420: 
421:     public EventService(IEventApiClient apiClient, ILogger<EventService> logger) { /* ... */ }
422: 
423:     public async Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetAllEventsAsync()
424:     {
425:         try
426:         {
427:             return await _apiClient.EventAllAsync() ?? new List<EventListDto>();
428:         }
429:         catch (ApiException ex)
430:         {
431:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
432:             return new List<EventListDto>();  // Safe default
433:         }
434:     }
435: }
436: ```
437: 
438: *For more details, see [service-layer-patterns.md](resources/service-layer-patterns.md).*
439: 
440: ## ✅ Do's
441: 
442: -   ✅ **DO** use YARP for API proxying (not custom middleware).
443: -   ✅ **DO** store tokens in server-side cookies (not `localStorage`).
444: -   ✅ **DO** forward Bearer token to API in YARP transform.
445: -   ✅ **DO** use a service layer to wrap API clients.
446: -   ✅ **DO** handle errors and return safe defaults in the service layer.
447: -   ✅ **DO** log API operations for debugging.
448: -   ✅ **DO** use `BrowserRequestCredentials.Include` for WASM requests.
449: -   ✅ **DO** redirect to login on `401 Unauthorized` responses.
450: -   ✅ **DO** serialize authentication state for WASM components.
451: -   ✅ **DO** enforce anti-forgery validation for state-changing requests.
452: -   ✅ **DO** configure forwarded headers correctly when running behind reverse proxies.
453: 
454: ## ❌ Don'ts
455: 
456: -   ❌ **DON'T** expose tokens to the browser.
457: -   ❌ **DON'T** call API directly from WASM; always go through the BFF.
458: -   ❌ **DON'T** store sensitive data in `localStorage`.
459: -   ❌ **DON'T** bypass the service layer; use services, not API client directly.
460: -   ❌ **DON'T** forget CSRF protection (use antiforgery tokens).
461: -   ❌ **DON'T** hardcode API URLs; use configuration.
462: 
463: ---
464: 
465: **Related Documentation**:
466: - [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - Overall system architecture.
467: - [`auth-patterns`](../auth-patterns/SKILL.md) - Authentication and authorization patterns.
````

````markdown
  1: ---
  2: name: blazor-ui-conventions

  4: type: ui
  5: enforcement: suggest

  7: ---
  8: 
  9: # Blazor UI Conventions & MudBlazor Guidelines
 10: 
 11: > **Project-Agnostic Blazor UI Patterns**
 12: >
 13: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
 14: 
 15: ## Purpose
 16: 
 17: This skill provides comprehensive guidelines and best practices for developing UI components in Blazor applications. It covers MudBlazor usage, BEM methodology for CSS, theming, component structure, lifecycle, state management, and render modes to ensure consistency, maintainability, and optimal user experience.
 18: 
 19: ## When This Skill Activates
 20: 
 21: **Triggered by**:
 22: - Keywords: "blazor", "component", "razor", "mudblazor", "ui", "page", "dialog", "render", "parameter", "css", "theme", "state", "lifecycle"
 23: - File patterns: `**/*.razor`, `**/*.razor.cs`, `**/*.Client/**/*.cs`, `**/*.css`, `**/*.scss`
 24: - Content patterns: `@page`, `@inject`, `<Mud`, `Parameter`, `EventCallback`, `::deep`, `::part`, `BEM` class names.
 25: 
 26: ## Blazor Hybrid Architecture
 27: 
 28: ```mermaid
 29: graph TD
 30:     subgraph Blazor Hybrid App
 31:         BFF[{Project}.Blazor (Server-side BFF)]
 32:         WASM[{Project}.Blazor.Client (WebAssembly)]
 33:         Router[Router / InteractiveAuto]
 34:     end
 35: 
 36:     subgraph UI Layer
 37:         Components[UI Components (.razor)]
 38:         MudBlazor[MudBlazor Library]
 39:         CSS[BEM-structured CSS]
 40:     end
 41: 
 42:     Router -- Renders on --> BFF
 43:     Router -- Interactivity via --> WASM
 44:     Components -- Built with --> MudBlazor
 45:     Components -- Styled with --> CSS
 46:     WASM -- Communicates with --> BFF
 47: ```
 48: 
 49: ## Resources
 50: 
 51: | Resource | Description |
 52: |----------|-------------|
 53: | [mudblazor-usage.md](resources/mudblazor-usage.md) | Detailed usage of common MudBlazor components (Grid, Buttons, Forms, Dialogs, Tables, Snackbar, Cards). |
 54: | [component-design.md](resources/component-design.md) | Blazor component structure, lifecycle, parameters, `EventCallback`, and best practices for parent-child communication. |
 55: | [state-management.md](resources/state-management.md) | Comprehensive guide to Blazor state management techniques (component state, parameters, cascading values, scoped/singleton services). |
 56: | [render-modes.md](resources/render-modes.md) | Explanation of Blazor render modes (InteractiveAuto, Server, WebAssembly, Static SSR) and their appropriate use cases. |
 57: | [blazouter-routing.md](resources/blazouter-routing.md) | Centralized route configuration with Blazouter, guards, and route parameter patterns. |

 61: 
 62: ## Quick Reference
 63: 
 64: ### 1. BEM Methodology
 65: 
 66: **Rule**: All custom CSS should follow the BEM (Block, Element, Modifier) naming convention.
 67: 
 68: ```css
 69: /* Block: .{entity}-card */
 70: .{entity}-card {
 71:     border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-lines-default);
 72:     border-radius: var(--mud-default-border-radius);
 73:     box-shadow: var(--mud-shadow-1);
 74: }
 75: 
 76: /* Element: .{entity}-card__title */
 77: .{entity}-card__title {
 78:     font-size: var(--mud-typography-h6-size);
 79:     color: var(--mud-palette-primary);
 80: }
 81: 
 82: /* Modifier: .{entity}-card--featured */
 83: .{entity}-card--featured {
 84:     border-color: var(--mud-palette-success);
 85:     box-shadow: var(--mud-shadow-2);
 86: }
 87: ```
 88: *For more details, see [bem-methodology.md](resources/bem-methodology.md).*
 89: 
 90: ### 2. MudBlazor Usage
 91: 
 92: **Rule**: Prefer MudBlazor components over custom HTML for consistent UI and functionality.
 93: 
 94: ```razor
 95: @* Grid Layout *@
 96: <MudGrid Spacing="3">
 97:     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4" lg="3">
 98:         <MudCard>
 99:             <MudCardMedia Image="@item.CoverImageUrl" Height="200" />
100:             <MudCardContent>
101:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@item.Title</MudText>
102:             </MudCardContent>
103:         </MudCard>
104:     </MudItem>
105: </MudGrid>
106: 
107: @* Buttons *@
108: <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add">
109:     Create {Entity}
110: </MudButton>
111: 
112: @* Forms *@
113: <MudTextField @bind-Value="title" Label="{Entity} Title" Required="true" />
114: <MudSelect @bind-Value="selectedId" Label="{LookupEntity}">
115:     <MudSelectItem Value="1">Option 1</MudSelectItem>
116: </MudSelect>
117: ```
118: *For more details, see [mudblazor-usage.md](resources/mudblazor-usage.md).*
119: 
120: ### 3. Theming
121: 
122: **Rule**: Global styles and theme overrides are managed in your app-level stylesheet(s) (for example `wwwroot/css/site.css` and `wwwroot/css/variables.css`). Dark/Light mode switching is handled via a `CascadingValue`.
123: 
124: ```csharp
125: // App.razor logic for cascading theme
126: @inject IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessor
127: 
128: @code {
129:     var theme = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.Request.Cookies["theme"];
130:     var isDark = theme == "dark";
131: }
132: 
133: <CascadingValue Value="isDark" Name="InitialTheme">
134:     <Routes @rendermode="InteractiveAuto" />
135: </CascadingValue>
136: 
137: // MainLayout.razor consuming the theme
138: @code {
139:     [CascadingParameter(Name = "InitialTheme")]
140:     public bool IsDarkMode { get; set; }
141: 
142:     private MudTheme _theme = new();
143:     private bool _isDarkMode;
144: 
145:     protected override void OnInitialized()
146:     {
147:         _isDarkMode = IsDarkMode;
148:     }
149: }
150: 
151: <MudThemeProvider @bind-IsDarkMode="_isDarkMode" Theme="_theme" />
152: ```
153: *For more details, see [theming.md](resources/theming.md).*
154: 
155: ### 4. Component Structure & Lifecycle
156: 
157: **Rule**: Use standard `[Parameter]` + `EventCallback` as the default pattern. Use `ParameterState` when building custom MudBlazor stateful/base components. Use `OnInitializedAsync` for initial data fetching.
158: 
159: #### MudBlazor ParameterState Framework (When Needed)
160: 
161: **Use This Pattern**: For custom MudBlazor stateful/base components where parameter orchestration needs explicit state tracking.
162: 
163: ```razor
164: @* Child Component: {Entity}Card.razor (MudBlazor) *@
165: @using MudBlazor.State
166: 
167: <MudCard>
168:     <MudCardContent>
169:         <MudText>@_entityState.Value.Title</MudText>
170:     </MudCardContent>
171:     <MudCardActions>
172:         <MudButton OnClick="DeleteClicked">Delete</MudButton>
173:     </MudCardActions>
174: </MudCard>
175: 
176: @code {
177:     // ✅ CORRECT: Use ParameterState for MudBlazor components
178:     private readonly ParameterState<{Entity}Dto> _entityState;
179: 
180:     [Parameter]
181:     public {Entity}Dto {Entity}
182:     {
183:         get => _entityState.Value;
184:         set => _entityState.SetValue(value);
185:     }
186: 
187:     [Parameter]
188:     public EventCallback<{IdType}> OnDelete { get; set; }
189: 
190:     public {Entity}Card()
191:     {
192:         // Initialize state, optionally with a change handler
193:         _entityState = RegisterParameter(nameof({Entity}), () => {Entity}, () =>
194:         {
195:             // Optional: Logic when parameter changes
196:         });
197:     }
198: 
199:     private async Task DeleteClicked()
200:     {
201:         await OnDelete.InvokeAsync({Entity}.Id);
202:     }
203: }
204: ```
205: 
206: **Why ParameterState?** It can prevent parameter update feedback loops and centralize parameter change handling in advanced/custom MudBlazor components.
207: 
208: *For more details, see [component-design.md](resources/component-design.md).*
209: 
210: ### 5. State Management
211: 
212: **Rule**: Choose the appropriate state management pattern based on the component relationship and data scope.
213: 
214: -   **Component State**: For isolated component data.
215: -   **Parameters/EventCallback**: For direct parent-child communication.
216: -   **CascadingValue**: For sharing state deep in the component hierarchy (e.g., `AuthenticationState`, theme).
217: -   **Scoped Services**: For sharing state across multiple, unrelated components within the same user session.
218: -   **Singleton Services**: For global, read-only application data.
219: 
220: *For more details, see [state-management.md](resources/state-management.md).*
221: 
222: ### 6. Render Modes
223: 
224: **Rule**: Use `InteractiveAuto` as the default render mode for interactive components. Use `InteractiveServer` for server-only features (e.g., `HttpContext` access) and `InteractiveWebAssembly` for offline-first or highly client-side interactive components.
225: 
226: ```razor
227: @page "/{entities}"
228: @rendermode InteractiveAuto // Default for interactive pages
229: ```
230: *For more details, see [render-modes.md](resources/render-modes.md).*
231: 
232: ### 6.1 Routing with Blazouter (if used)
233: 
234: **Rule**: When using Blazouter, keep route definitions centralized in a route config file and apply guards there, instead of relying only on scattered `@page` directives.
235: 
236: *For more details, see [blazouter-routing.md](resources/blazouter-routing.md).*
237: 
238: ### 7. Common Patterns
239: 
240: **Rule**: Implement common UI patterns like forms, dialogs, tables, and loading states consistently across the application.
241: 
242: ```razor
243: @* Confirmation Dialog *@
244: @inject IDialogService DialogService
245: 
246: <MudButton OnClick="Delete{Entity}">Delete</MudButton>
247: 
248: @code {
249:     private async Task Delete{Entity}()
250:     {
251:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<ConfirmDialog>("Confirm Delete");
252:         var result = await dialog.Result;
253:         if (!result.Canceled) { /* Perform delete */ }
254:     }
255: }
256: ```
257: *For more details, see [common-patterns.md](resources/common-patterns.md).*
258: 
259: ## Do's
260: 
261: -   **DO** use `@rendermode="InteractiveAuto"` as the default for interactive pages.
262: -   **DO** prefer MudBlazor components over custom HTML for consistency.
263: -   **DO** follow the BEM methodology for all custom CSS classes.
264: -   **DO** use `[Parameter]` for inputs and `EventCallback<T>` for child-to-parent events.
265: -   **DO** load data in `OnInitializedAsync` for initial setup.
266: -   **DO** use `IDialogService` for modals and `ISnackbar` for notifications.
267: -   **DO** implement `IDisposable` for event clean-up in services and components.
268: -   **DO** use scoped services for state management across components within a user session.
269: -   **DO** centralize theme customization in `wwwroot/css/site.css` and `wwwroot/css/variables.css`.
270: 
271: ## Don'ts
272: 
273: -   **DON'T** use raw HTML when a suitable MudBlazor component exists.
274: -   **DON'T** modify `[Parameter]` properties directly from within a child component.
275: -   **DON'T** access `HttpContext` in components rendered with `InteractiveAuto` or `InteractiveWebAssembly` (use `InteractiveServer` or BFF pattern).
276: -   **DON'T** use JavaScript interop for tasks that MudBlazor or Blazor itself can handle.
277: -   **DON'T** call `StateHasChanged()` unnecessarily (can lead to performance issues).
278: -   **DON'T** use static state in Blazor Server apps (can cause data leakage between users).
279: 
280: ---
281: 
282: **Related Documentation**:
283: - [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - Overall system architecture, especially Blazor Hybrid.
284: - [`blazor-bff-patterns`](../blazor-bff-patterns/SKILL.md) - Details on YARP, token forwarding, and cookie-based auth.
285: - [`auth-patterns`](../auth-patterns/SKILL.md) - Authentication and authorization patterns in Blazor.
````

## File: .claude/skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/resources/handler-patterns.md
````markdown
  1: # Handler Patterns - Complete Reference
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Handler Patterns**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Repository Usage in Handlers
  8: 
  9: **CRITICAL RULE**: Handlers use repositories (not DbContext directly).
 10: 
 11: ```csharp
 12: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
 13: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
 14: 
 15: using System;
 16: using System.Collections.Generic;
 17: using System.Linq;
 18: using System.Threading;
 19: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 20: using AutoMapper;
 21: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;  // ✅ Repository interfaces
 22: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
 23: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
 24: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
 25: using {Project}.Domain;
 26: using MediatR;
 27: 
 28: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
 29: {
 30:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;  // ✅ Repository interface
 31:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
 32:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
 33:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
 34:     private readonly IUserContext _userContext;
 35:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
 36:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
 37: 
 38:     // ✅ Inject repositories, not DbContext
 39:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
 40:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
 41:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
 42:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
 43:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
 44:         IUserContext userContext,
 45:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
 46:         IMapper mapper)
 47:     {
 48:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
 49:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
 50:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
 51:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
 52:         _userContext = userContext;
 53:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
 54:         _mapper = mapper;
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 58:     {
 59:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
 60: 
 61:         // Validation...
 62:         var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
 63:         {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
 64: 
 65:         // ✅ Use repository methods
 66:         {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
 67: 
 68:         response.Success = true;
 69:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
 70:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
 71: 
 72:         return response;
 73:     }
 74: }
 75: ```
 76: 
 77: **Why Repositories?**
 78: - ✅ Application layer doesn't depend on EF Core
 79: - ✅ Can mock repositories for unit tests
 80: - ✅ Encapsulates complex queries
 81: - ✅ Consistent data access patterns
 82: 
 83: ---
 84: 
 85: ## AutoMapper Usage
 86: 
 87: **Query Handler Example**:
 88: ```csharp
 89: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
 90: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
 91: 
 92: using System.Collections.Generic;
 93: using System.Threading;
 94: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 95: using AutoMapper;
 96: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 97: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 98: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
 99: using MediatR;
100: 
101: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
102: {
103:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
104:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
105: 
106:     public Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
107:     {
108:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
109:         _mapper = mapper;
110:     }
111: 
112:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
113:     {
114:         // ✅ Repository returns List<{Entity}> (entities)
115:         var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();
116: 
117:         // ✅ AutoMapper maps entities → DTOs
118:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
119:     }
120: }
121: ```
122: 
123: **Common AutoMapper Patterns**:
124: ```csharp
125: // Map DTO → Entity (Create)
126: var entity = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
127: 
128: // Map DTO → Existing Entity (Update)
129: _mapper.Map(request.{Entity}Dto, existingEntity);
130: 
131: // Map Entity → DTO (Read)
132: var dto = _mapper.Map<{Entity}Dto>(entity);
133: 
134: // Map Entity Collection → DTO Collection (List)
135: var dtos = _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>(entities);
136: ```
137: 
138: ---
139: 
140: ## CancellationToken Pattern
141: 
142: **Always include `CancellationToken` parameter in Handle method**:
143: 
144: ```csharp
145: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(
146:     Create{Entity}Command request,
147:     CancellationToken cancellationToken)  // ✅ Always include
148: {
149:     // Pass cancellationToken to all async operations that accept it
150:     await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
151: }
152: ```
153: 
154: **Why?**
155: - ✅ Enables request cancellation
156: - ✅ Prevents wasted work when client disconnects
157: - ✅ Required by MediatR `IRequestHandler<TRequest, TResponse>`
158: 
159: ---
160: 
161: ## Manual Validator Instantiation Pattern
162: 
163: **CRITICAL PATTERN**: Validators are instantiated manually with dependencies, NOT injected via DI.
164: 
165: ```csharp
166: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
167: {
168:     var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
169: 
170:     // ✅ CRITICAL: Manual validator instantiation with all required repositories
171:     var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
172:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
173:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
174:         _{lookupEntity}Repository,
175:         _{storageObject}Repository);
176: 
177:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
178: 
179:     if (!validationResult.IsValid)
180:     {
181:         response.Success = false;
182:         response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
183:         response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
184:         return response;
185:     }
186: 
187:     // Continue with business logic...
188: }
189: ```
190: 
191: **Why Manual Instantiation?**
192: - ✅ Fine-grained control over dependencies
193: - ✅ Validators can have different repository dependencies per use case
194: - ✅ No need to register validators in DI container
195: - ✅ Clear and explicit
196: 
197: ---
198: 
199: ## Command Handler Pattern (Create)
200: 
201: **Full Pattern**:
202: ```csharp
203: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
204: {
205:     var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
206: 
207:     // 1. Manual validation
208:     var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(/* repositories */);
209:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
210: 
211:     if (!validationResult.IsValid)
212:     {
213:         response.Success = false;
214:         response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
215:         response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
216:         return response;
217:     }
218: 
219:     // 2. Map DTO → Entity
220:     var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
221: 
222:     // 3. Set default values (not in DTO)
223:     {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
224:     {entity}.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
225: 
226:     // 4. Save through repository
227:     {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
228: 
229:     // 5. Return success response
230:     response.Success = true;
231:     response.Id = {entity}.Id;
232:     response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
233: 
234:     return response;
235: }
236: ```
237: 
238: ---
239: 
240: ## Command Handler Pattern (Update)
241: 
242: **Full Pattern**:
243: ```csharp
244: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Update{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
245: {
246:     var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
247: 
248:     // 1. Validate
249:     var validator = new Update{Entity}DtoValidator(/* repositories */);
250:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
251: 
252:     if (!validationResult.IsValid)
253:     {
254:         response.Success = false;
255:         response.Message = "{Entity} update failed.";
256:         response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
257:         return response;
258:     }
259: 
260:     // 2. Get existing entity
261:     var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.GetById(request.{Entity}Dto.Id);
262: 
263:     if ({entity} == null)
264:     {
265:         response.Success = false;
266:         response.Message = "{Entity} not found.";
267:         return response;
268:     }
269: 
270:     // 3. Map DTO → Existing Entity
271:     _mapper.Map(request.{Entity}Dto, {entity});
272: 
273:     // 4. Update through repository
274:     await _{entity}Repository.Update({entity});
275: 
276:     // 5. Return success response
277:     response.Success = true;
278:     response.Id = {entity}.Id;
279:     response.Message = "{Entity} updated successfully.";
280: 
281:     return response;
282: }
283: ```
284: 
285: ---
286: 
287: ## Command Handler Pattern (Delete)
288: 
289: **Full Pattern**:
290: ```csharp
291: public async Task<bool> Handle(Delete{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
292: {
293:     // 1. Get entity
294:     var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.GetById(request.Id);
295: 
296:     // 2. Check if exists
297:     if ({entity} == null)
298:         return false;
299: 
300:     // 3. Delete through repository
301:     await _{entity}Repository.Delete({entity});
302: 
303:     // 4. Return success
304:     return true;
305: }
306: ```
307: 
308: **Note**: Delete returns `bool`, not `BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>`.
309: 
310: ---
311: 
312: ## Query Handler Pattern (List)
313: 
314: **Full Pattern**:
315: ```csharp
316: public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
317: {
318:     // 1. Get entities from repository
319:     var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();
320: 
321:     // 2. Map entities → DTOs
322:     return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
323: }
324: ```
325: 
326: **Key Points**:
327: - ❌ No validation needed for queries
328: - ❌ No BaseCommandResponse wrapper
329: - ✅ Return DTOs directly
330: - ✅ Repository returns entities, handler maps to DTOs
331: 
332: ---
333: 
334: ## Query Handler Pattern (Details)
335: 
336: **Full Pattern**:
337: ```csharp
338: public async Task<{Entity}Dto> Handle(Get{Entity}DetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
339: {
340:     // 1. Get entity from repository
341:     var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entity}WithDetails(request.Id);
342: 
343:     // 2. Return null if not found (controller handles NotFound)
344:     if ({entity} == null)
345:         return null;
346: 
347:     // 3. Map entity → DTO
348:     return _mapper.Map<{Entity}Dto>({entity});
349: }
350: ```
351: 
352: **Key Points**:
353: - ✅ Return `null` for not found (not exception)
354: - ✅ Controller checks for null and returns `NotFound()`
355: - ✅ Simple and straightforward
356: 
357: ---
358: 
359: ## Error Handling Pattern
360: 
361: **Commands**:
362: ```csharp
363: // Validation errors
364: if (!validationResult.IsValid)
365: {
366:     response.Success = false;
367:     response.Message = "Operation failed.";
368:     response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
369:     return response;
370: }
371: 
372: // Not found errors
373: if (entity == null)
374: {
375:     response.Success = false;
376:     response.Message = "Entity not found.";
377:     return response;
378: }
379: 
380: // Success
381: response.Success = true;
382: response.Id = entity.Id;
383: response.Message = "Operation successful.";
384: return response;
385: ```
386: 
387: **Queries**:
388: ```csharp
389: // Not found
390: if (entity == null)
391:     return null;  // Let controller handle NotFound()
392: 
393: // Success
394: return _mapper.Map<{Entity}Dto>(entity);
395: ```
396: 
397: ---
398: 
399: ## Dependency Injection Registration
400: 
401: **Handlers are auto-registered by MediatR**:
402: ```csharp
403: // File: {Project}.API/Program.cs
404: using {Project}.Application.Profiles;
405: 
406: // Register MediatR (scans assembly for handlers)
407: builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
408:     cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(MappingProfile).Assembly));
409: 
410: // Register AutoMapper
411: builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(typeof(MappingProfile));
412: ```
413: 
414: **No need to manually register each handler!**
415: 
416: ---
417: 
418: ## Common Patterns Summary
419: 
420: | Pattern | Command | Query |
421: |---------|---------|-------|
422: | **Response Type** | `BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>` (or `bool` for Delete) | DTO type directly |
423: | **Validation** | Manual with validator | Not needed |
424: | **Repository** | CRUD operations | Read with `.Include()` |
425: | **Mapping** | DTO → Entity | Entity → DTO |
426: | **Error Handling** | Success flag + errors | Return null |
427: | **Controller** | Check `Success` flag | Check for null |
428: 
429: ---
430: 
431: **See Also**:
432: - [command-patterns.md](command-patterns.md) - Command request/handler structure
433: - [query-patterns.md](query-patterns.md) - Query request/handler structure
434: - [validation-integration.md](validation-integration.md) - FluentValidation patterns
````

## File: .claude/skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/resources/validation-integration.md
````markdown
  1: # Validation Integration - Complete Reference
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Validation Patterns**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Validation Pattern Overview
  8: 
  9: **CRITICAL**: Validation is **manual in handlers** (not automated pipeline behavior).
 10: 
 11: ---
 12: 
 13: ## Validator Structure
 14: 
 15: ```csharp
 16: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
 17: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
 18: 
 19: using FluentValidation;
 20: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 21: 
 22: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
 23: {
 24:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
 25:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
 26:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
 27:     private readonly I{ParentEntity}Repository _{parentEntity}Repository;
 28:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
 29: 
 30:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
 31:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
 32:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
 33:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
 34:         I{ParentEntity}Repository {parentEntity}Repository,
 35:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository)
 36:     {
 37:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
 38:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
 39:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
 40:         _{parentEntity}Repository = {parentEntity}Repository;
 41:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
 42: 
 43:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
 44:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
 45:             .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("Title must not exceed 200 characters");
 46: 
 47:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
 48:             .MaximumLength(5000).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description))
 49:             .WithMessage("Description must not exceed 5000 characters");
 50: 
 51:         RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
 52:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
 53:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 54:             {
 55:                 var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
 56:                 return exists;
 57:             })
 58:             .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
 59: 
 60:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity1}Id)
 61:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} is required")
 62:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 63:             {
 64:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity1}Repository.Exists(id);
 65:                 return exists;
 66:             })
 67:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} not found");
 68: 
 69:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id)
 70:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} is required")
 71:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 72:             {
 73:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity2}Repository.Exists(id);
 74:                 return exists;
 75:             })
 76:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} not found");
 77: 
 78:         RuleFor(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id)
 79:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 80:             {
 81:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
 82:                 return await _{parentEntity}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
 83:             })
 84:             .When(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id.HasValue)
 85:             .WithMessage("{ParentEntity} does not exist.");
 86: 
 87:         RuleFor(x => x.FeaturedImageId)
 88:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 89:             {
 90:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
 91:                 return await _storageObjectRepository.Exists(id.Value);
 92:             })
 93:             .When(x => x.FeaturedImageId.HasValue)
 94:             .WithMessage("FeaturedImageId does not exist.");
 95:     }
 96: }
 97: ```
 98: 
 99: **Key Patterns**:
100: - ✅ Validators take repositories in constructor
101: - ✅ Use `MustAsync` for async database validation
102: - ✅ Check foreign key existence with repository
103: - ✅ Custom error messages with `.WithMessage()`
104: 
105: ---
106: 
107: ## Handler Validation Pattern
108: 
109: ```csharp
110: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
111: public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
112: {
113:     var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
114: 
115:     // 1. Create validator instance (manual instantiation)
116:     var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
117:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
118:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
119:         _{lookupEntity}Repository,
120:         _{parentEntity}Repository,
121:         _storageObjectRepository);
122: 
123:     // 2. Validate DTO
124:     var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
125: 
126:     // 3. Check result
127:     if (!validationResult.IsValid)
128:     {
129:         response.Success = false;
130:         response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
131:         response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
132:         return response;
133:     }
134: 
135:     // 4. Proceed with business logic
136:     var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
137:     {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
138:     {entity}.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
139:     {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
140: 
141:     response.Success = true;
142:     response.Id = {entity}.Id;
143:     response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
144: 
145:     return response;
146: }
147: ```
148: 
149: **Critical Steps**:
150: 1. **Instantiate validator manually** with repository dependencies
151: 2. **Validate DTO** using `ValidateAsync`
152: 3. **Check `IsValid`** property
153: 4. **Return errors** in `BaseCommandResponse.Errors` list
154: 5. **Early return** if validation fails
155: 
156: ---
157: 
158: ## Common Validation Rules
159: 
160: ### Required Field
161: ```csharp
162: RuleFor(x => x.Title)
163:     .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required");
164: ```
165: 
166: ### String Length
167: ```csharp
168: RuleFor(x => x.Title)
169:     .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("Title must not exceed 200 characters");
170: 
171: RuleFor(x => x.Description)
172:     .MinimumLength(10).WithMessage("Description must be at least 10 characters")
173:     .MaximumLength(5000);
174: ```
175: 
176: ### Numeric Range
177: ```csharp
178: RuleFor(x => x.Price)
179:     .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).WithMessage("Price must be non-negative");
180: 
181: RuleFor(x => x.MaxAttendees)
182:     .InclusiveBetween(1, 10000).WithMessage("Max attendees must be between 1 and 10000");
183: ```
184: 
185: ### Email Validation
186: ```csharp
187: RuleFor(x => x.Email)
188:     .EmailAddress().WithMessage("Invalid email address");
189: ```
190: 
191: ### Async Database Validation (Foreign Keys)
192: ```csharp
193: RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
194:     .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
195:     .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
196:     {
197:         var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
198:         return exists;
199:     })
200:     .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
201: ```
202: 
203: ### Conditional Validation
204: ```csharp
205: RuleFor(x => x.ExternalUrl)
206:     .NotEmpty()
207:     .When(x => x.IsExternalEnabled)
208:     .WithMessage("External URL is required when external option is enabled");
209: 
210: RuleFor(x => x.Price)
211:     .GreaterThan(0)
212:     .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.CurrencyCode))
213:     .WithMessage("Price must be greater than 0 when currency is specified");
214: ```
215: 
216: ### Custom Validation Logic
217: ```csharp
218: RuleFor(x => x.Slug)
219:     .MustAsync(async (dto, slug, cancellation) =>
220:     {
221:         // Custom logic: slug must be unique
222:         var existing = await _{entity}Repository.GetBySlug(slug);
223:         return existing == null;
224:     })
225:     .WithMessage("Slug must be unique");
226: ```
227: 
228: ### Complex Validation (Multiple Properties)
229: ```csharp
230: RuleFor(x => x)
231:     .Must(x => x.StartDate <= x.EndDate)
232:     .WithMessage("Start date must be before or equal to end date")
233:     .When(x => x.StartDate.HasValue && x.EndDate.HasValue);
234: ```
235: 
236: ---
237: 
238: ## Update DTO Validation
239: 
240: **Different from Create**:
241: ```csharp
242: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Update{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
243: public class Update{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Update{Entity}Dto>
244: {
245:     public Update{Entity}DtoValidator()
246:     {
247:         // ID is required for updates
248:         RuleFor(x => x.Id)
249:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{Entity} ID is required");
250: 
251:         // Title might be optional for partial updates
252:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
253:             .MaximumLength(200).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Title))
254:             .WithMessage("Title must not exceed 200 characters");
255: 
256:         // Description optional
257:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
258:             .MaximumLength(5000).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description))
259:             .WithMessage("Description must not exceed 5000 characters");
260:     }
261: }
262: ```
263: 
264: **Key Differences**:
265: - ✅ `Id` property is required
266: - ⚠️ Some fields might be optional (partial updates)
267: - ✅ Validation rules can be less strict than create
268: 
269: ---
270: 
271: ## Error Response Format
272: 
273: **Validation Failure Response**:
274: ```json
275: {
276:   "id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
277:   "success": false,
278:   "message": "{Entity} creation failed.",
279:   "errors": [
280:     "Title is required",
281:     "{LookupEntity} not found",
282:     "{RelatedEntity1} is required"
283:   ]
284: }
285: ```
286: 
287: **Success Response**:
288: ```json
289: {
290:   "id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
291:   "success": true,
292:   "message": "{Entity} created successfully.",
293:   "errors": []
294: }
295: ```
296: 
297: ---
298: 
299: ## Why Manual Validation?
300: 
301: | Approach | Manual Pattern | Pipeline Behavior |
302: |----------|---------------|-------------------|
303: | **When runs** | Manually in handler | Automatically before handler |
304: | **Validator creation** | Manual instantiation | DI injection |
305: | **Dependencies** | Passed to constructor | Must be registered in DI |
306: | **Flexibility** | High - can skip validation | Fixed - always runs |
307: | **Error handling** | BaseCommandResponse | Exceptions or custom |
308: | **Control** | Explicit in handler | Hidden in pipeline |
309: 
310: **Benefits of Manual Validation**:
311: - ✅ Fine-grained control over when validation runs
312: - ✅ Validators can have different repository dependencies per use case
313: - ✅ No need to register validators in DI container
314: - ✅ Clear and explicit validation flow
315: - ✅ Easy to understand for new developers
316: 
317: ---
318: 
319: ## Self-Referencing Entity Validation
320: 
321: For entities with parent relationships (e.g., hierarchical categories):
322: 
323: ```csharp
324: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
325: {
326:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
327: 
328:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository)
329:     {
330:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
331: 
332:         // Prevent self-reference (relevant for Update scenarios where Id exists)
333:         RuleFor(x => x.ParentId)
334:             .NotEqual(x => x.Id)
335:             .When(x => x.ParentId.HasValue && x.Id != default)
336:             .WithMessage("{Entity} cannot be its own parent");
337: 
338:         // Validate parent exists
339:         RuleFor(x => x.ParentId)
340:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
341:             {
342:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
343:                 return await _{entity}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
344:             })
345:             .When(x => x.ParentId.HasValue)
346:             .WithMessage("Parent {Entity} not found");
347: 
348:         // Prevent circular reference (for update)
349:         RuleFor(x => x.ParentId)
350:             .MustAsync(NotCreateCircularReference)
351:             .When(x => x.ParentId.HasValue && x.Id != default)
352:             .WithMessage("Would create circular reference");
353:     }
354: 
355:     private async Task<bool> NotCreateCircularReference(
356:         Create{Entity}Dto dto,
357:         {IdType}? parentId,
358:         CancellationToken cancellation)
359:     {
360:         // Implementation depends on business logic
361:         return true;
362:     }
363: }
364: ```
365: 
366: ---
367: 
368: ## FluentValidation NuGet Package
369: 
370: ```xml
371: <PackageReference Include="FluentValidation" Version="11.9.0" />
372: ```
373: 
374: **No need for** `FluentValidation.AspNetCore` or `FluentValidation.DependencyInjectionExtensions` - we don't use pipeline behaviors or DI registration.
375: 
376: ---
377: 
378: **See Also**:
379: - [command-patterns.md](command-patterns.md) - Complete command handler examples
380: - [handler-patterns.md](handler-patterns.md) - Handler structure and patterns
````
