  8: 
  9: # Clean Architecture Dependency Rules
 10: 
 11: > **Project-Agnostic Clean Architecture Guidelines**
 12: >
 13: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
 14: 
 15: ## Purpose
 16: 
 17: This is a **CRITICAL GUARDRAIL** that enforces Clean Architecture's fundamental dependency rule: **dependencies flow inward only**. Violations are **BLOCKED** to prevent architectural degradation.
 18: 
 19: ## When This Skill Activates
 20: 
 21: **Automatically BLOCKS when**:
 22: - Attempting to add wrong project references
 23: - Importing namespaces that violate dependency rules
 24: - Detecting prohibited `using` statements in Domain or Application layers
 25: 
 26: **Triggered by**:
 27: - Keywords: "dependency", "reference", "architecture", "layer", "add project"
 28: - File patterns: Domain/**/*.cs, Application/**/*.cs
 29: - Content patterns: `using {Project}.Infrastructure`, `using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore` in Domain
 30: 
 31: ## The Dependency Rule
 32: 
 33: ```
 34: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 35: │              CLEAN ARCHITECTURE LAYERS                       │
 36: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 37: │                                                             │
 38: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 39: │  │              1. DOMAIN (Core)                       │   │
 40: │  │              {Project}.Domain                       │   │
 41: │  │              ↑ NO DEPENDENCIES                      │   │
 42: │  │  • Entities, Enums, Value Objects, Domain Events    │   │
 43: │  │  • Pure C# - No framework dependencies             │   │
 44: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 45: │                         ▲                                   │
 46: │                         │ References                        │
 47: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 48: │  │         2. APPLICATION (Use Cases)                  │   │
 49: │  │         {Project}.Application                       │   │
 50: │  │         ↑ References: Domain ONLY                   │   │
 51: │  │  • CQRS Commands/Queries, DTOs, Interfaces          │   │
 52: │  │  • MediatR, FluentValidation, AutoMapper            │   │
 53: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 54: │                         ▲                                   │
 55: │                         │ References                        │
 56: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 57: │  │    3. INFRASTRUCTURE (Implementation)               │   │
 58: │  │    {Project}.Persistence + {Project}.Infrastructure │   │
 59: │  │    ↑ References: Application, Domain                │   │
 60: │  │  • DbContext, Repositories, External APIs           │   │
 61: │  │  • EF Core, Database Provider, Email, File Storage  │   │
 62: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 63: │                         ▲                                   │
 64: │                         │ References                        │
 65: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
 66: │  │       4. PRESENTATION (Entry Points)                │   │
 67: │  │       {Project}.API + {Project}.Blazor              │   │
 68: │  │       ↑ References: ALL (Composition Root)          │   │
 69: │  │  • Controllers, Pages, Dependency Registration      │   │
 70: │  │  • ASP.NET Core, Blazor, SignalR                    │   │
 71: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
 72: │                                                             │
 73: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 74: ```
 75: 
 76: ## Resources
 77: 
 78: | Resource | Description |
 79: |----------|-------------|
 80: | [dependency-rules.md](resources/dependency-rules.md) | Complete dependency matrix and flow diagram |
 81: | [layer-responsibilities.md](resources/layer-responsibilities.md) | What code belongs in each layer |
 82: | [violation-examples.md](resources/violation-examples.md) | Common violations and error messages |
 83: | [fix-patterns.md](resources/fix-patterns.md) | How to fix violations using interfaces and DI |
 84: 
 85: ## Valid Dependency Examples
 86: 
 87: ```csharp
 88: // ✅ VALID: Application references Domain
 89: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Commands;
 90: 
 91: using {Project}.Domain.Entities;  // ✅ OK - App can reference Domain
 92: using {Project}.Domain.Enums;     // ✅ OK
 93: using MediatR;                    // ✅ OK - Framework dependency
 94: 
 95: // ✅ VALID: Infrastructure references Application and Domain
 96: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
 97: 
 98: using {Project}.Application.Interfaces;  // ✅ OK - Implements interfaces
 99: using {Project}.Domain.Entities;         // ✅ OK - Works with entities
100: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;     // ✅ OK - Infrastructure can use EF Core
101: 
102: // ✅ VALID: API references all layers
103: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
104: 
105: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Commands;  // ✅ OK
106: using {Project}.Infrastructure.Services;                   // ✅ OK
107: using MediatR;                                             // ✅ OK
108: ```
109: 
110: ## BLOCKED Violations
111: 
112: ```csharp
113: // ❌ BLOCKED: Domain referencing ANYTHING
114: namespace {Project}.Domain.Entities;
115: 
116: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;    // ❌ BLOCKED! Domain must be pure
117: using {Project}.Application.DTOs;       // ❌ BLOCKED! Dependency flows wrong way
118: 
119: // ❌ BLOCKED: Application referencing Infrastructure
120: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Queries;
121: 
122: using {Project}.Infrastructure.Persistence;  // ❌ BLOCKED! Use interfaces instead
123: using {Project}.API.Controllers;             // ❌ BLOCKED! Wrong direction
124: 
125: // ❌ BLOCKED: Application referencing Presentation
126: namespace {Project}.Application.Commands;
127: 
128: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;  // ❌ BLOCKED! Application must be framework-agnostic
129: ```
130: 
131: ## Quick Fix: Use Dependency Inversion
132: 
133: **Problem**: Application needs database access (Infrastructure)
134: 
135: **❌ Wrong - Direct dependency**:
136: ```csharp
137: // In {Project}.Application
138: using {Project}.Infrastructure.Persistence;  // ❌ BLOCKED
139: 
140: public class Get{Entities}Handler
141: {
142:     private readonly {DbContext} _context;  // ❌ Concrete class
143: }
144: ```
145: 
146: **✅ Correct - Interface in Application, Implementation in Infrastructure**:
147: ```csharp
148: // Step 1: Define interface in Application layer
149: // File: {Project}.Application/Contracts/Persistence/I{Entity}Repository.cs
150: namespace {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
151: 
152: public interface I{Entity}Repository
153: {
154:     Task<List<{Entity}>> GetAllAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
155: }
156: 
157: // Step 2: Use interface in Application
158: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
159: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
160: 
161: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;  // ✅ OK - Same layer
162: 
163: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
164: {
165:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _repository;  // ✅ Abstraction
166: 
167:     public Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository repository)
168:     {
169:         _repository = repository;
170:     }
171: 
172:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
173:     {
174:         var {entities} = await _repository.GetAllAsync(cancellationToken);
175:         return {entities}.Select(e => e.ToDto()).ToList();
176:     }
177: }
178: 
179: // Step 3: Implement in Infrastructure layer
180: // File: {Project}.Persistence/Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs
181: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
182: 
183: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;  // ✅ OK - Implements interface
184: using {Project}.Domain.Entities;                    // ✅ OK - Works with entities
185: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;                // ✅ OK - Infrastructure can use EF Core
186: 
187: public class {Entity}Repository : I{Entity}Repository
188: {
189:     private readonly {DbContext} _context;
190: 
191:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> GetAllAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
192:     {
193:         return await _context.{Entities}.ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
194:     }
195: }
196: 
197: // Step 4: Register in API/Blazor (Composition Root)
198: // File: {Project}.API/Program.cs
199: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{Entity}Repository, {Entity}Repository>();  // ✅ DI binding
200: ```
201: 
202: ## Why This Matters
203: 
204: **Benefits of Clean Architecture**:
205: 1. **Testability**: Domain and Application can be tested without database
206: 2. **Flexibility**: Swap database providers without changing business logic
207: 3. **Maintainability**: Business logic isolated from framework changes
208: 4. **Team Scalability**: Clear boundaries for parallel development
209: 5. **Deployment Options**: Domain can be reused across API, Blazor, CLI, etc.
210: 
211: **Cost of Violations**:
212: - Tight coupling makes testing difficult
213: - Framework upgrades break business logic
214: - Cannot reuse domain logic across projects
215: - Circular dependencies cause build failures
216: 
217: ## CRITICAL: Validator Manual Instantiation Pattern
218: 
219: ### Rule: Validators Must Be Instantiated Manually, NOT DI Injected
220: 
221: **BLOCKED Violation**: Validators injected via DI in handler constructor
222: 
223: ```csharp
224: // ❌ BLOCKED: DI injection of validators
225: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
226: {
227:     private readonly IValidator<Create{Entity}Dto> _validator;  // ❌ BLOCKED!
228: 
229:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
230:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
231:         IMapper mapper,
232:         IValidator<Create{Entity}Dto> validator)  // ❌ BLOCKED - DI injection
233:     {
234:         _validator = validator;  // ❌ BLOCKED
235:     }
236: 
237:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(...)
238:     {
239:         var validationResult = await _validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);  // ❌ BLOCKED
240:         ...
241:     }
242: }
243: ```
244: 
245: **✅ Correct Pattern**: Validator instantiated with dependencies passed to constructor
246: 
247: **C# 12+ Primary Constructor (Preferred)**:
248: 
249: ```csharp
250: // ✅ CORRECT: Manual instantiation with primary constructor (C# 12+)
251: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
252: 
253: using System.Linq;
254: using System.Threading;
255: using System.Threading.Tasks;
256: using AutoMapper;
257: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
258: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
259: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
260: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
261: using {Project}.Domain;
262: using MediatR;
263: 
264: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
265:     I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
266:     I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
267:     I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
268:     IMapper mapper) : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
269: {
270:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
271:     {
272:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
273: 
274:         // ✅ CORRECT: Validator instantiated manually with all dependencies
275:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
276:             {relatedEntity1}Repository,
277:             {relatedEntity2}Repository);
278: 
279:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
280: 
281:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
282:         {
283:             response.Success = false;
284:             response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
285:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
286:             return response;
287:         }
288: 
289:         // Map DTO to Entity
290:         var {entity} = mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
291: 
292:         // Save through repository
293:         {entity} = await {entity}Repository.Create({entity});
294: 
295:         response.Success = true;
296:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
297:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
298: 
299:         return response;
300:     }
301: }
302: ```
303: 
304: **Traditional Constructor (Still Valid)**:
305: 
306: ```csharp
307: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
308: {
309:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
310:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
311:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
312:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
313: 
314:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
315:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
316:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
317:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
318:         IMapper mapper)
319:     {
320:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
321:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
322:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
323:         _mapper = mapper;
324:     }
325:     // ... Handle method same as above
326: }
327: ```
328: 
329: ### Why Manual Instantiation?
330: 
331: 1. **Fine-grained dependency control**: Each validator receives specific repositories it needs
332: 2. **Prevents DI configuration issues**: No need to register validators in DI container
333: 3. **Simplifies testing**: Easy to create test validators with mocked repositories
334: 4. **Follows established pattern**: Consistent across all entity implementations
335: 
336: ### Validator Constructor Pattern
337: 
338: Validators MUST accept repositories in constructor for FK validation.
339: 
340: ```csharp
341: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
342: 
343: using FluentValidation;
344: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
345: 
346: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
347: {
348:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
349:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
350: 
351:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
352:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
353:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository)
354:     {
355:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
356:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
357: 
358:         // Standard validation rules
359:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
360:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
361:             .MaximumLength(200);
362: 
363:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
364:             .MaximumLength(5000)
365:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description));
366: 
367:         // Foreign key validation with repository
368:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity1}Id)
369:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} is required")
370:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
371:             {
372:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity1}Repository.Exists(id);
373:                 return exists;
374:             })
375:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} not found");
376: 
377:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id)
378:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
379:             {
380:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
381:                 return await _{relatedEntity2}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
382:             })
383:             .When(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id.HasValue)
384:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} not found");
385:     }
386: }
387: ```
388: 
389: ---
390: 
391: ## Deep Dive
392: 
393: For comprehensive guidance:
394: - **Dependency Matrix**: [dependency-rules.md](resources/dependency-rules.md)
395: - **Layer Responsibilities**: [layer-responsibilities.md](resources/layer-responsibilities.md)
396: - **Common Violations**: [violation-examples.md](resources/violation-examples.md)
397: - **Fix Patterns**: [fix-patterns.md](resources/fix-patterns.md)
398: 
399: ---
400: 
401: **Enforcement Level**: BLOCK (Violations are prevented)
402: **Override**: Add `@skip-architecture-check` comment in file (use sparingly)
````

## File: .claude/skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/resources/command-patterns.md
````markdown
  1: # Command Patterns - Project Conventions
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Command Patterns**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Key Pattern: BaseCommandResponse + DTO + Manual Validation
  8: 
  9: Commands in Clean Architecture projects use a specific pattern different from standard MediatR CQRS.
 10: 
 11: ## Structure
 12: 
 13: ```
 14: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/
 15: ├── Requests/Commands/
 16: │   ├── Create{Entity}Command.cs        # Contains DTO property
 17: │   ├── Update{Entity}Command.cs
 18: │   └── Delete{Entity}Command.cs
 19: └── Handlers/Commands/
 20:     ├── Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs  # Manual validation inside
 21:     ├── Update{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
 22:     └── Delete{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
 23: 
 24: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/
 25: ├── Create{Entity}Dto.cs
 26: ├── Update{Entity}Dto.cs
 27: └── Validators/
 28:     ├── Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs   # FluentValidation validators
 29:     └── Update{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
 30: ```
 31: 
 32: ## Create Command Pattern
 33: 
 34: ### 1. Command (Request)
 35: 
 36: **Example**:
 37: ```csharp
 38: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/Create{Entity}Command.cs
 39: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
 40: 
 41: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 42: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
 43: using MediatR;
 44: 
 45: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
 46: {
 47:     public Create{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; } = null!;
 48: }
 49: ```
 50: 
 51: **Key Points**:
 52: - ✅ Command wraps a DTO, not individual properties
 53: - ✅ Returns `BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>`, not plain `{IdType}`
 54: - ✅ Uses MediatR's `IRequest<TResponse>`
 55: 
 56: ### 2. DTO (Create Payload)
 57: 
 58: **Example**:
 59: ```csharp
 60: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Create{Entity}Dto.cs
 61: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 62: 
 63: using System;
 64: 
 65: public class Create{Entity}Dto
 66: {
 67:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
 68:     public string? Description { get; set; }
 69:     public string? Slug { get; set; }
 70: 
 71:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
 72:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
 73:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity2}Id { get; set; }
 74: 
 75:     /// <summary>
 76:     /// Optional: the parent entity that owns this entity.
 77:     /// If provided, the handler enforces admin membership.
 78:     /// </summary>
 79:     public {IdType}? {ParentEntity}Id { get; set; }
 80: 
 81:     public decimal? Price { get; set; }
 82:     public string? CurrencyCode { get; set; }
 83: 
 84:     // Featured Image (optional)
 85:     public {IdType}? FeaturedImageId { get; set; }
 86: 
 87:     public bool IsActive { get; set; }
 88:     public string? ExternalUrl { get; set; }
 89: 
 90:     // Defaults (DTO-level defaults are OK; do NOT add defaults in Domain entities)
 91:     public {LookupIdType} StatusId { get; set; } = 1;
 92:     public {LookupIdType} VisibilityTypeId { get; set; } = 1;
 93:     public {LookupIdType} FormatId { get; set; } = 1;
 94: 
 95:     public {LookupIdType}? OptionalLookupId { get; set; }
 96:     public DateTimeOffset? StartDate { get; set; }
 97:     public DateTimeOffset? EndDate { get; set; }
 98:     public string? Timezone { get; set; }
 99: }
100: ```
101: 
102: **Conventions**:
103: - ❌ No `Id` property (generated by system)
104: - ✅ Foreign keys as IDs (e.g., `{LookupEntity}Id`, not `{LookupEntity}`)
105: - ✅ All properties settable (no readonly)
106: 
107: ### 3. Validator (Manual Instantiation)
108: 
109: **Example**:
110: ```csharp
111: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs
112: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
113: 
114: using FluentValidation;
115: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
116: 
117: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
118: {
119:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
120:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
121:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
122:     private readonly I{ParentEntity}Repository _{parentEntity}Repository;
123:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity3}Repository _{relatedEntity3}Repository;
124: 
125:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
126:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
127:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
128:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
129:         I{ParentEntity}Repository {parentEntity}Repository,
130:         I{RelatedEntity3}Repository {relatedEntity3}Repository)
131:     {
132:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
133:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
134:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
135:         _{parentEntity}Repository = {parentEntity}Repository;
136:         _{relatedEntity3}Repository = {relatedEntity3}Repository;
137: 
138:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
139:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
140:             .MaximumLength(200);
141: 
142:         RuleFor(x => x.Description)
143:             .MaximumLength(5000).When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Description));
144: 
145:         RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
146:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
147:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
148:             {
149:                 var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
150:                 return exists;
151:             })
152:             .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
153: 
154:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id)
155:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} is required")
156:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
157:             {
158:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity2}Repository.Exists(id);
159:                 return exists;
160:             })
161:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} not found");
162: 
163:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity1}Id)
164:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} is required")
165:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
166:             {
167:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity1}Repository.Exists(id);
168:                 return exists;
169:             })
170:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} not found");
171: 
172:         // {ParentEntity}Id is optional: validate only if provided
173:         RuleFor(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id)
174:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
175:             {
176:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
177:                 return await _{parentEntity}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
178:             })
179:             .When(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id.HasValue)
180:             .WithMessage("{ParentEntity} does not exist.");
181: 
182:         // FeaturedImageId is optional: validate only if provided
183:         RuleFor(x => x.FeaturedImageId)
184:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
185:             {
186:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
187:                 return await _{relatedEntity3}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
188:             })
189:             .When(x => x.FeaturedImageId.HasValue)
190:             .WithMessage("Featured image does not exist.");
191:     }
192: }
193: ```
194: 
195: **Critical Pattern**:
196: - ✅ Validators take repositories in constructor (NOT injected via DI)
197: - ✅ Use `MustAsync` for async validation rules
198: - ✅ Check foreign key existence in database
199: 
200: ### 4. Handler (Manual Validation + Mapping)
201: 
202: **Example**:
203: ```csharp
204: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
205: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
206: 
207: using System;
208: using System.Collections.Generic;
209: using System.Linq;
210: using System.Threading;
211: using System.Threading.Tasks;
212: using AutoMapper;
213: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
214: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
215: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
216: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
217: using {Project}.Domain;
218: using MediatR;
219: 
220: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
221: {
222:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
223:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
224:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
225:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
226:     private readonly I{ParentEntity}Repository _{parentEntity}Repository;
227:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity3}Repository _{relatedEntity3}Repository;
228:     private readonly IUserContext _userContext;
229:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
230:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
231: 
232:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
233:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
234:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
235:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
236:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
237:         I{ParentEntity}Repository {parentEntity}Repository,
238:         I{RelatedEntity3}Repository {relatedEntity3}Repository,
239:         IUserContext userContext,
240:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
241:         IMapper mapper)
242:     {
243:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
244:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
245:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
246:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
247:         _{parentEntity}Repository = {parentEntity}Repository;
248:         _{relatedEntity3}Repository = {relatedEntity3}Repository;
249:         _userContext = userContext;
250:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
251:         _mapper = mapper;
252:     }
253: 
254:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
255:     {
256:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
257: 
258:         // ✅ CRITICAL: Manual validator instantiation with dependencies
259:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
260:             _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
261:             _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
262:             _{lookupEntity}Repository,
263:             _{parentEntity}Repository,
264:             _{relatedEntity3}Repository);
265: 
266:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
267: 
268:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
269:         {
270:             response.Success = false;
271:             response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
272:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
273:             return response;
274:         }
275: 
276:         // ✅ Map DTO to entity using AutoMapper
277:         var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
278: 
279:         // ✅ Set server-side values (never from client)
280:         {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
281:         {entity}.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
282: 
283:         // NOTE: Ownership is enforced by resolving ActorId based on the current user
284:         // (organization context requires admin membership).
285: 
286:         // ✅ Save through repository
287:         {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
288: 
289:         // ✅ Success response
290:         response.Success = true;
291:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
292:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
293: 
294:         return response;
295:     }
296: }
297: ```
298: 
299: **Critical Patterns**:
300: - ✅ Validator instantiated manually: `new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(...)`
301: - ✅ All repositories passed to validator constructor
302: - ✅ Map DTO → Entity with AutoMapper
303: - ✅ Set default values (like `ViewCount = 0`) in handler
304: - ✅ Return `BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>` with Success/Message/Errors
305: 
306: ## BaseCommandResponse Structure
307: 
308: **Example**:
309: ```csharp
310: // File: {Project}.Application/Responses/BaseCommandResponse.cs
311: namespace {Project}.Application.Responses;
312: 
313: using System.Collections.Generic;
314: 
315: public class BaseCommandResponse<T>
316: {
317:     public T? Id { get; set; }
318:     public bool Success { get; set; } = true;
319:     public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
320:     public List<string> Errors { get; set; } = new List<string>();
321: }
322: ```
323: 
324: **Usage**:
325: ```json
326: // Success response
327: {
328:   "id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
329:   "success": true,
330:   "message": "{Entity} created successfully.",
331:   "errors": []
332: }
333: 
334: // Failure response
335: {
336:   "id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
337:   "success": false,
338:   "message": "{Entity} creation failed.",
339:   "errors": [
340:     "Title is required",
341:     "{LookupEntity} not found"
342:   ]
343: }
344: ```
345: 
346: ## Update Command Pattern
347: 
348: **Example**:
349: ```csharp
350: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/Update{Entity}Command.cs
351: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
352: 
353: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
354: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
355: using MediatR;
356: 
357: public class Update{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
358: {
359:     public Update{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; } = null!;
360: }
361: 
362: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Update{Entity}Dto.cs
363: public class Update{Entity}Dto
364: {
365:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }  // ✅ Required for updates
366:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
367:     public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
368:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
369:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
370:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity2}Id { get; set; }
371:     // ... other updatable properties
372: }
373: 
374: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Update{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
375: public class Update{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Update{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
376: {
377:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
378:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
379:     // ... other repositories
380: 
381:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Update{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
382:     {
383:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
384: 
385:         // Validate
386:         var validator = new Update{Entity}DtoValidator(/* repositories */);
387:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto);
388: 
389:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
390:         {
391:             response.Success = false;
392:             response.Message = "{Entity} update failed.";
393:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
394:             return response;
395:         }
396: 
397:         // Get existing entity
398:         var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.GetById(request.{Entity}Dto.Id);
399: 
400:         if ({entity} == null)
401:         {
402:             response.Success = false;
403:             response.Message = "{Entity} not found.";
404:             return response;
405:         }
406: 
407:         // Update entity
408:         _mapper.Map(request.{Entity}Dto, {entity});
409:         await _{entity}Repository.Update({entity});
410: 
411:         response.Success = true;
412:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
413:         response.Message = "{Entity} updated successfully.";
414: 
415:         return response;
416:     }
417: }
418: ```
419: 
420: ## Delete Command Pattern
421: 
422: **Example**:
423: ```csharp
424: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/Delete{Entity}Command.cs
425: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
426: 
427: using MediatR;
428: 
429: public class Delete{Entity}Command : IRequest<bool>  // ✅ Returns bool, not BaseCommandResponse
430: {
431:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
432: }
433: 
434: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Delete{Entity}CommandHandler.cs
435: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
436: 
437: using System;
438: using System.Threading;
439: using System.Threading.Tasks;
440: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
441: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
442: using MediatR;
443: 
444: public class Delete{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Delete{Entity}Command, bool>
445: {
446:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
447: 
448:     public Delete{Entity}CommandHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository)
449:     {
450:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
451:     }
452: 
453:     public async Task<bool> Handle(Delete{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
454:     {
455:         var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.GetById(request.Id);
456: 
457:         if ({entity} == null)
458:             return false;
459: 
460:         await _{entity}Repository.Delete({entity});
461:         return true;
462:     }
463: }
464: ```
465: 
466: **Note**: Delete commands return `bool` instead of `BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>`.
467: 
468: ## Controller Usage
469: 
470: **Example**:
471: ```csharp
472: // File: {Project}.API/Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs
473: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
474: 
475: using System;
476: using System.Collections.Generic;
477: using System.Threading.Tasks;
478: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
479: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
480: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
481: using MediatR;
482: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
483: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
484: 
485: [Route("api/[controller]")]
486: [ApiController]
487: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
488: {
489:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
490: 
491:     public {Entity}Controller(IMediator mediator) => _mediator = mediator;
492: 
493:     [HttpPost]
494:     [Authorize]
495:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create([FromBody] Create{Entity}Dto dto)
496:     {
497:         var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto };
498:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command);
499:         return Ok(response);
500:     }
501: 
502:     [HttpPut("{id}")]
503:     [Authorize]
504:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Update({IdType} id, [FromBody] Update{Entity}Dto dto)
505:     {
506:         if (id != dto.Id)
507:         {
508:             return BadRequest(new { error = "{Entity} ID mismatch" });
509:         }
510: 
511:         var command = new Update{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto };
512:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command);
513: 
514:         if (!response.Success)
515:         {
516:             return BadRequest(response);
517:         }
518: 
519:         return Ok(response);
520:     }
521: 
522:     [HttpDelete("{id}")]
523:     [Authorize]
524:     public async Task<ActionResult> Delete({IdType} id)
525:     {
526:         var command = new Delete{Entity}Command { Id = id };
527:         var result = await _mediator.Send(command);
528: 
529:         if (!result)
530:         {
531:             return NotFound(new { error = "{Entity} not found or you don't have permission to delete it" });
532:         }
533: 
534:         return NoContent();
535:     }
536: }
537: ```
538: 
539: ## Key Differences from Standard CQRS
540: 
541: | Aspect | Standard MediatR CQRS | This Pattern |
542: |--------|----------------------|---------------------|
543: | **Command properties** | Direct on command | Wrapped in DTO |
544: | **Response** | Direct type ({IdType}) | BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}> (except Delete) |
545: | **Validation** | Pipeline behavior | Manual in handler |
546: | **Success/Failure** | Exceptions | Success flag + errors list |
547: | **Validator location** | Behaviors folder | DTOs/Validators |
548: | **Validator creation** | DI injection | Manual instantiation with repositories |
549: 
550: ## Benefits of This Pattern
551: 
552: ✅ **Explicit success/failure**: No exceptions for business validation failures
553: ✅ **Reusable DTOs**: Same DTO for API requests and commands
554: ✅ **Consistent responses**: All commands return same structure
555: ✅ **Flexible validation**: Validators can have repository dependencies
556: ✅ **Clear error messages**: List of validation errors returned to client
557: 
558: ---
559: 
560: **Next**: See [query-patterns.md](query-patterns.md) for query conventions and [handler-patterns.md](handler-patterns.md) for common handler patterns.
````

## File: .claude/skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/resources/query-patterns.md
````markdown
  1: # Query Patterns - Project Conventions
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Query Patterns**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Query Conventions
  8: 
  9: Queries in this project follow a specific pattern with `Request` suffix (not `Query`) and return DTOs directly.
 10: 
 11: ## File Organization
 12: 
 13: ```
 14: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/
 15: ├── Requests/Queries/
 16: │   ├── Get{Entity}ListRequest.cs
 17: │   ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequest.cs
 18: │   └── GetMy{Entities}Request.cs
 19: └── Handlers/Queries/
 20:     ├── Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
 21:     ├── Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler.cs
 22:     └── GetMy{Entities}RequestHandler.cs
 23: 
 24: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/
 25: ├── {Entity}ListDto.cs          # For list views
 26: ├── {Entity}Dto.cs              # For detail views
 27: └── (other DTOs)
 28: ```
 29: 
 30: ## List Query Pattern
 31: 
 32: ### 1. Query Request
 33: 
 34: **Example**:
 35: ```csharp
 36: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequest.cs
 37: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
 38: 
 39: using System.Collections.Generic;
 40: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 41: using MediatR;
 42: 
 43: public class Get{Entity}ListRequest : IRequest<List<{Entity}ListDto>>
 44: {
 45: }
 46: ```
 47: 
 48: **Key Conventions**:
 49: - ✅ Class name ends with `Request` (not `Query`)
 50: - ✅ Implements `IRequest<List<TDto>>`
 51: - ✅ Returns `List<{Entity}ListDto>` directly (no wrapper)
 52: - ✅ Can include filter properties if needed
 53: 
 54: ### 2. Query Handler
 55: 
 56: **Example**:
 57: ```csharp
 58: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler.cs
 59: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
 60: 
 61: using System.Collections.Generic;
 62: using System.Threading;
 63: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 64: using AutoMapper;
 65: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 66: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 67: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
 68: using MediatR;
 69: 
 70: public class Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}ListRequest, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
 71: {
 72:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
 73:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
 74: 
 75:     public Get{Entity}ListRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
 76:     {
 77:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
 78:         _mapper = mapper;
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(Get{Entity}ListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 82:     {
 83:         // ✅ Repository returns List<{Entity}> (entities)
 84:         var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entities}WithDetails();
 85: 
 86:         // ✅ AutoMapper maps entities → DTOs
 87:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
 88:     }
 89: }
 90: ```
 91: 
 92: **Key Patterns**:
 93: - ✅ Uses `I{Entity}Repository`, not DbContext
 94: - ✅ Repository method returns `List<{Entity}>` (entities)
 95: - ✅ AutoMapper maps entities to DTOs
 96: - ✅ Returns DTOs directly, no `BaseCommandResponse` wrapper
 97: 
 98: ### 3. List DTO
 99: 
100: **Example**:
101: ```csharp
102: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/{Entity}ListDto.cs
103: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
104: 
105: using System;
106: 
107: public class {Entity}ListDto
108: {
109:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
110:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
111:     public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
112:     public string {LookupEntity}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
113:     public string {RelatedEntity1}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
114:     public string {RelatedEntity2}Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
115: }
116: ```
117: 
118: **Conventions**:
119: - ✅ Minimal properties for list views
120: - ✅ Include navigation property names (e.g., `{LookupEntity}Name`, not just `{LookupEntity}Id`)
121: - ✅ Suffix with `ListDto`
122: 
123: ## Details Query Pattern
124: 
125: ### 1. Query Request
126: 
127: **Example**:
128: ```csharp
129: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/Get{Entity}DetailsRequest.cs
130: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
131: 
132: using System;
133: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
134: using MediatR;
135: 
136: public class Get{Entity}DetailsRequest : IRequest<{Entity}Dto?>
137: {
138:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
139: }
140: ```
141: 
142: ### 2. Query Handler
143: 
144: **Example**:
145: ```csharp
146: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler.cs
147: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
148: 
149: using System.Threading;
150: using System.Threading.Tasks;
151: using AutoMapper;
152: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
153: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
154: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
155: using MediatR;
156: 
157: public class Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<Get{Entity}DetailsRequest, {Entity}Dto?>
158: {
159:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
160:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
161: 
162:     public Get{Entity}DetailsRequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
163:     {
164:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
165:         _mapper = mapper;
166:     }
167: 
168:     public async Task<{Entity}Dto?> Handle(Get{Entity}DetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
169:     {
170:         // ✅ Repository returns {Entity}? (nullable entity)
171:         var {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Get{Entity}WithDetails(request.Id);
172: 
173:         // ✅ Return null if not found (controller handles NotFound)
174:         if ({entity} == null)
175:         {
176:             return null;
177:         }
178: 
179:         // ✅ Map entity → DTO
180:         return _mapper.Map<{Entity}Dto>({entity});
181:     }
182: }
183: ```
184: 
185: ### 3. Details DTO
186: 
187: **Example**:
188: ```csharp
189: // File: {Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/{Entity}Dto.cs
190: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
191: 
192: using System;
193: 
194: public class {Entity}Dto
195: {
196:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
197:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
198:     public string? Description { get; set; }
199:     public string? Slug { get; set; }
200: 
201:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
202:     public string {LookupEntity}FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
203:     public string {LookupEntity}MasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
204: 
205:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
206:     public string {RelatedEntity1}FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
207:     public string {RelatedEntity1}MasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
208: 
209:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity2}Id { get; set; }
210:     public string {RelatedEntity2}FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
211:     public string {RelatedEntity2}MasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
212:     public int? {RelatedEntity2}MinValue { get; set; }
213:     public int? {RelatedEntity2}MaxValue { get; set; }
214: 
215:     public {IdType} OwnerId { get; set; }
216:     public string OwnerDisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
217:     public string? OwnerHandle { get; set; }
218:     public int OwnerTypeId { get; set; }
219:     public string OwnerTypeFullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
220:     public {IdType}? OwnerProfilePictureId { get; set; }
221:     public string? OwnerProfilePictureUri { get; set; }
222: 
223:     public decimal? Price { get; set; }
224:     public string? CurrencyCode { get; set; }
225: 
226:     public {IdType}? FeaturedImageId { get; set; }
227:     public string? FeaturedImageUri { get; set; }
228: 
229:     public bool IsActive { get; set; }
230:     public string? ExternalUrl { get; set; }
231: 
232:     public {LookupIdType} StatusId { get; set; }
233:     public string StatusFullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
234:     public string StatusMasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
235: 
236:     public {LookupIdType} VisibilityTypeId { get; set; }
237:     public string VisibilityTypeFullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
238:     public string VisibilityTypeMasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
239: 
240:     public {LookupIdType} FormatId { get; set; }
241:     public string FormatFullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
242:     public string FormatMasterCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
243: 
244:     public {LookupIdType}? OptionalLookupId { get; set; }
245:     public string? OptionalLookupFullName { get; set; }
246:     public string? OptionalLookupMasterCode { get; set; }
247: 
248:     public int? ChildCount { get; set; }
249:     public DateOnly? StartDate { get; set; }
250:     public DateOnly? EndDate { get; set; }
251:     public string? Timezone { get; set; }
252: 
253:     public int ViewCount { get; set; }
254: 
255:     public {IdType} TenantId { get; set; }
256: 
257:     public {IdType}? ExternalRecordId { get; set; }
258:     public string? ExternalRecordUri { get; set; }
259:     public string? ExternalRecordCid { get; set; }
260: }
261: ```
262: 
263: **Conventions**:
264: - ✅ All entity properties
265: - ✅ Include both IDs and Names for foreign keys
266: - ✅ Suffix with `Dto` (not `DetailsDto`)
267: 
268: ## User-Specific Query Pattern
269: 
270: **Example**:
271: ```csharp
272: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Queries/GetMy{Entities}Request.cs
273: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
274: 
275: using System.Collections.Generic;
276: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
277: using MediatR;
278: 
279: public class GetMy{Entities}Request : IRequest<List<{Entity}ListDto>>
280: {
281:     public string UserId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
282: }
283: 
284: // File: {Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Queries/GetMy{Entities}RequestHandler.cs
285: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Queries;
286: 
287: using System.Collections.Generic;
288: using System.Threading;
289: using System.Threading.Tasks;
290: using AutoMapper;
291: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
292: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
293: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
294: using MediatR;
295: 
296: public class GetMy{Entities}RequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetMy{Entities}Request, List<{Entity}ListDto>>
297: {
298:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
299:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
300: 
301:     public GetMy{Entities}RequestHandler(I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository, IMapper mapper)
302:     {
303:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
304:         _mapper = mapper;
305:     }
306: 
307:     public async Task<List<{Entity}ListDto>> Handle(GetMy{Entities}Request request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
308:     {
309:         // ✅ Repository handles complex filtering
310:         var {entities} = await _{entity}Repository.GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(request.UserId);
311: 
312:         // ✅ Map to DTOs
313:         return _mapper.Map<List<{Entity}ListDto>>({entities});
314:     }
315: }
316: ```
317: 
318: ## Repository Pattern for Queries
319: 
320: **Example**:
321: ```csharp
322: // File: {Project}.Application/Contracts/Persistence/I{Entity}Repository.cs
323: namespace {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
324: 
325: using System;
326: using System.Collections.Generic;
327: using System.Threading.Tasks;
328: using {Project}.Domain;
329: 
330: public interface I{Entity}Repository : IGenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>
331: {
332:     Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id);
333:     Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails();
334:     Task<List<{Entity}>> GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(string userId);
335: }
336: 
337: // File: {Project}.Persistence/Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs
338: namespace {Project}.Persistence.Repositories;
339: 
340: using System;
341: using System.Collections.Generic;
342: using System.Linq;
343: using System.Threading.Tasks;
344: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
345: using {Project}.Domain;
346: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
347: 
348: public class {Entity}Repository : GenericRepository<{Entity}, {IdType}>, I{Entity}Repository
349: {
350:     private readonly {DbContext} _dbContext;
351: 
352:     public {Entity}Repository({DbContext} dbContext) : base(dbContext)
353:     {
354:         _dbContext = dbContext;
355:     }
356: 
357:     public async Task<{Entity}?> Get{Entity}WithDetails({IdType} id)
358:     {
359:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
360:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
361:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
362:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
363:             .Include(e => e.Owner)
364:                 .ThenInclude(o => o.OwnerType)
365:             .Include(e => e.Status)
366:             .Include(e => e.VisibilityType)
367:             .Include(e => e.Format)
368:             .Include(e => e.OptionalLookup)
369:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
370:             .Include(e => e.ExternalRecord)
371:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.Id == id);
372:     }
373: 
374:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> Get{Entities}WithDetails()
375:     {
376:         return await _dbContext.{Entities}
377:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
378:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
379:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
380:             .Include(e => e.Owner)
381:                 .ThenInclude(o => o.OwnerType)
382:             .Include(e => e.Status)
383:             .Include(e => e.VisibilityType)
384:             .Include(e => e.Format)
385:             .Include(e => e.OptionalLookup)
386:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
387:             .ToListAsync();
388:     }
389: 
390:     public async Task<List<{Entity}>> GetMy{Entities}WithDetails(string userId)
391:     {
392:         // Current implementation supports GUID user ids and checks both:
393:         // - direct user owner ownership
394:         // - organization membership ownership
395:         {IdType} userGuid;
396:         var isGuid = {IdType}.TryParse(userId, out userGuid);
397: 
398:         var query = _dbContext.{Entities}
399:             .Include(e => e.{LookupEntity})
400:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity1})
401:             .Include(e => e.{RelatedEntity2})
402:             .Include(e => e.Owner)
403:                 .ThenInclude(o => o.OwnerType)
404:             .Include(e => e.FeaturedImage)
405:             .Include(e => e.Status)
406:             .Include(e => e.VisibilityType)
407:             .Include(e => e.Format)
408:             .Include(e => e.OptionalLookup)
409:             .AsQueryable();
410: 
411:         if (isGuid)
412:         {
413:             query = query.Where(e =>
414:                 _dbContext.Users.Any(u => u.Id == userGuid && u.OwnerId == e.OwnerId) ||
415:                 _dbContext.{ParentEntity}Members.Any(pm =>
416:                     pm.UserId == userGuid &&
417:                     _dbContext.{ParentEntities}.Any(p => p.Id == pm.{ParentEntity}Id && p.OwnerId == e.OwnerId)));
418:         }
419: 
420:         return await query.ToListAsync();
421:     }
422: }
423: ```
424: 
425: **Critical Patterns**:
426: - ✅ Repository returns `List<{Entity}>` (entities), not DTOs
427: - ✅ Use `.Include()` and `.ThenInclude()` for eager loading
428: - ✅ Complex filtering happens in repository
429: - ✅ Handler maps entities → DTOs
430: 
431: ## AutoMapper Configuration
432: 
433: **Example**:
434: ```csharp
435: // File: {Project}.Application/Profiles/MappingProfile.cs
436: namespace {Project}.Application.Profiles;
437: 
438: using AutoMapper;
439: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
440: using {Project}.Domain;
441: 
442: public class MappingProfile : Profile
443: {
444:     public MappingProfile()
445:     {
446:         // {Entity} → {Entity}ListDto (AutoMapper infers navigation properties)
447:         CreateMap<{Entity}, {Entity}ListDto>();
448: 
449:         // {Entity} → {Entity}Dto (AutoMapper infers navigation properties)
450:         CreateMap<{Entity}, {Entity}Dto>();
451: 
452:         // Create{Entity}Dto → {Entity}
453:         CreateMap<Create{Entity}Dto, {Entity}>();
454: 
455:         // Update{Entity}Dto → {Entity}
456:         CreateMap<Update{Entity}Dto, {Entity}>();
457:     }
458: }
459: ```
460: 
461: **AutoMapper Note**:
462: 
463: This codebase uses explicit `.ForMember(...)` mappings for many "*FullName" / "*MasterCode" / owner fields.
464: 
465: ## Naming Conventions
466: 
467: | Pattern | Example | Returns |
468: |---------|---------|---------|
469: | Get{Entity}ListRequest | Get{Entity}ListRequest | `List<{Entity}ListDto>` |
470: | Get{Entity}DetailsRequest | Get{Entity}DetailsRequest | `{Entity}Dto?` |
471: | GetMy{Entities}Request | GetMy{Entities}Request | `List<{Entity}ListDto>` |
472: | Check{Condition}Query | CheckUserExistsQuery | `bool` |
473: 
474: **Note**: Most queries use `Request` suffix. Some newer ones use `Query` suffix (both patterns exist).
475: 
476: ## Controller Usage
477: 
478: **Example**:
479: ```csharp
480: // File: {Project}.API/Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs
481: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
482: 
483: using System;
484: using System.Collections.Generic;
485: using System.Linq;
486: using System.Security.Claims;
487: using System.Threading.Tasks;
488: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
489: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
490: using MediatR;
491: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
492: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
493: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
494: 
495: [Route("api/[controller]")]
496: [ApiController]
497: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
498: {
499:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
500:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
501: 
502:     public {Entity}Controller(IMediator mediator, IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor)
503:     {
504:         _mediator = mediator;
505:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
506:     }
507: 
508:     // ✅ Public read access
509:     [HttpGet]
510:     [AllowAnonymous]
511:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll()
512:     {
513:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
514:         return Ok({entities});
515:     }
516: 
517:     // ✅ Public read access for single item
518:     [HttpGet("{id}")]
519:     [AllowAnonymous]
520:     public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id)
521:     {
522:         var {entity} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}DetailsRequest { Id = id });
523: 
524:         if ({entity} == null)
525:             return NotFound();
526: 
527:         return Ok({entity});
528:     }
529: 
530:     // ✅ User-specific query (authenticated)
531:     [HttpGet("my")]
532:     [Authorize]
533:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetMy{Entities}()
534:     {
535:         var userId = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
536:             ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
537:             ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
538: 
539:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
540:         {
541:             return Unauthorized(new { error = "User ID not found in token" });
542:         }
543: 
544:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new GetMy{Entities}Request { UserId = userId });
545:         return Ok({entities});
546:     }
547: }
548: ```
549: 
550: **Key Points**:
551: - ✅ GET endpoints use `[AllowAnonymous]` for public read
552: - ✅ Return `null` for not found, handle in controller with `NotFound()`
553: - ✅ Simple `return Ok(result)` - no wrapper needed
554: - ✅ Extract userId from JWT claims for user-specific queries
555: 
556: ---
557: 
558: **Next**: See [command-patterns.md](command-patterns.md) for write operations and [handler-patterns.md](handler-patterns.md) for common handler patterns.
````

591:     private static HalResourceOfEventDto CreateHalResourceResponse(EventDto dto)
592:     {
593:         var json = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(dto);
594:         return System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<HalResourceOfEventDto>(json)
595:                ?? new HalResourceOfEventDto();
596:     }
597: 
598:     private static ApiException CreateApiException(string message, int statusCode, string response = "")
599:     {
600:         return new ApiException(
601:             message,
602:             statusCode,
603:             response,
604:             new Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<string>>(),
605:             new InvalidOperationException(message));
606:     }
607: 
608:     #endregion
609: }

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Components/ImageUpload.razor
````razor
  1: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  3: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
  4: @inject IImageStorageService ImageStorageService
  5: @inject ILogger<ImageUpload> Logger
  6: 
  7: <div class="d-flex flex-column gap-2" style="@($"width: {Width};")">
  8:     <div class="relative d-flex justify-center align-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed mud-border-primary" 
  9:          style="@($"height: {Height}; background-color: var(--mud-palette-background-grey);")">
 10:         
 11:         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PreviewUrl))
 12:         {
 13:             <img src="@PreviewUrl" alt="@(Alt ?? "Image preview")" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;" />
 14:         }
 15:         else
 16:         {
 17:             <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center gap-2 pa-4 text-center">
 18:                 <MudIcon Icon="@(Icon ?? Icons.Material.Filled.Image)" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" />
 19:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">@(PlaceholderText ?? "No image selected")</MudText>
 20:             </div>
 21:         }
 22:     </div>
 23: 
 24:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 25:     {
 26:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Dense="true" Class="my-1" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     <div class="d-flex justify-center gap-2">
 30:         <MudFileUpload T="IBrowserFile"
 31:                        @ref="_fileUpload"
 32:                        FilesChanged="OnFileSelected"
 33:                        Accept="@AcceptedFormats"
 34:                        MaximumFileCount="1">
 35:             <ActivatorContent>
 36:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 37:                            StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CloudUpload"
 38:                            Color="Color.Primary"
 39:                            Size="Size.Small">
 40:                     @(UploadButtonText ?? "Select Image")
 41:                 </MudButton>
 42:             </ActivatorContent>
 43:         </MudFileUpload>
 44: 
 45:         @if (HasImage)
 46:         {
 47:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
 48:                        Color="Color.Error"
 49:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
 50:                        Size="Size.Small"
 51:                        OnClick="RemoveImage">
 52:                 Remove
 53:             </MudButton>
 54:         }
 55:     </div>
 56: 
 57:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(HintText))
 58:     {
 59:         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary" Align="Align.Center">@HintText</MudText>
 60:     }
 61: </div>
 62: 
 63: @code {
 64:     [Parameter] public string? PreviewUrl { get; set; }
 65:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<string?> PreviewUrlChanged { get; set; }
 66: 
 67:     /// <summary>
 68:     /// Legacy callback that passes IBrowserFile. Prefer using FileDataSelected for reliable WASM uploads.
 69:     /// </summary>
 70:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<IBrowserFile?> FileSelected { get; set; }
 71: 
 72:     /// <summary>
 73:     /// Preferred callback that passes FileUploadData (bytes read into memory).
 74:     /// This prevents stream exhaustion issues in Blazor WASM.
 75:     /// </summary>
 76:     [Parameter] public EventCallback<FileUploadData?> FileDataSelected { get; set; }
 77: 
 78:     // Customization parameters
 79:     [Parameter] public string Width { get; set; } = "100%";
 80:     [Parameter] public string Height { get; set; } = "250px";
 81:     [Parameter] public string? PlaceholderText { get; set; }
 82:     [Parameter] public string? UploadButtonText { get; set; }
 83:     [Parameter] public string? HintText { get; set; } = "Supported formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP (Max 5MB)";
 84:     [Parameter] public string? Icon { get; set; }
 85:     [Parameter] public string? Alt { get; set; }
 86:     [Parameter] public string AcceptedFormats { get; set; } = ".jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.webp";
 87:     [Parameter] public long MaxFileSize { get; set; } = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5MB default
 88: 
 89:     /// <summary>
 90:     /// Set to true to show a loading indicator while processing the file.
 91:     /// </summary>
 92:     [Parameter] public bool IsProcessing { get; set; }
 93: 
 94:     private MudFileUpload<IBrowserFile>? _fileUpload;
 95:     private bool _isReadingFile;
 96:     private bool HasImage => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PreviewUrl);
 97:     private string? _errorMessage;
 98: 
 99:     private async Task OnFileSelected(IBrowserFile? file)
100:     {
101:         _errorMessage = null;
102:         if (file == null) return;
103: 
104:         // Validate file type
105:         var allowedTypes = new[] { "image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/gif", "image/webp" };
106:         if (!allowedTypes.Contains(file.ContentType.ToLower()))
107:         {
108:             _errorMessage = "Please select a valid image file (JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP)";
109:             return;
110:         }
111: 
112:         // Validate file size
113:         if (file.Size > MaxFileSize)
114:         {
115:             var maxSizeMB = MaxFileSize / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
116:             _errorMessage = $"File size must be less than {maxSizeMB:F1}MB";
117:             return;
118:         }
119: 
120:         _isReadingFile = true;
121:         StateHasChanged();
122: 
123:         try
124:         {
125:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Starting file processing for {FileName} ({Size} bytes)", file.Name, file.Size);
126: 
127:             // STEP 1: Read the file bytes FIRST - this is reliable
128:             // We'll generate the preview from these bytes (skip browser-side resizing which can hang)
129:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 1: Reading file {FileName} ({Size} bytes) into memory...", file.Name, file.Size);
130:             var fileData = await ImageStorageService.ReadFileAsync(file, MaxFileSize);
131: 
132:             if (fileData == null)
133:             {
134:                 Logger.LogError("[ImageUpload] ReadFileAsync returned null for {FileName}", file.Name);
135:                 _errorMessage = "Failed to read the selected file. Please try again.";
136:                 await RemoveImage();
137:                 return;
138:             }
139: 
140:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 1a: Successfully read {ByteCount} bytes from {FileName}", fileData.Size, fileData.FileName);
141: 
142:             // STEP 2: Generate preview from the bytes we just read
143:             // Use full-size bytes directly - browser-side resizing (RequestImageFileAsync) can hang in WASM
144:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 2: Generating preview from bytes...");
145:             string localPreview = ImageStorageService.GenerateLocalPreviewFromBytes(fileData);
146: 
147:             if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(localPreview))
148:             {
149:                 Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] Failed to generate preview for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
150:                 _errorMessage = "Failed to generate image preview";
151:                 // Continue anyway - the upload might still work
152:             }
153:             else
154:             {
155:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 2a: Preview generated successfully");
156:             }
157: 
158:             // STEP 3: Update preview URL and notify parent
159:             // Yield to allow UI thread to process before heavy operations
160:             await Task.Yield();
161:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3: Setting preview URL (length={Length} chars)...", localPreview?.Length ?? 0);
162:             try
163:             {
164:                 PreviewUrl = localPreview;
165:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3a: PreviewUrl property set");
166: 
167:                 // Use InvokeAsync to ensure we're on the correct sync context
168:                 await InvokeAsync(() =>
169:                 {
170:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3b: Inside InvokeAsync, calling StateHasChanged...");
171:                     StateHasChanged();
172:                 });
173:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3c: StateHasChanged completed");
174: 
175:                 // Yield again after render to let browser process
176:                 await Task.Yield();
177: 
178:                 if (PreviewUrlChanged.HasDelegate)
179:                 {
180:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3d: Invoking PreviewUrlChanged callback...");
181:                     await PreviewUrlChanged.InvokeAsync(localPreview);
182:                     Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 3e: PreviewUrlChanged callback completed");
183:                 }
184:                 else
185:                 {
186:                     Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] Step 3d: PreviewUrlChanged has no delegate");
187:                 }
188:             }
189:             catch (Exception previewEx)
190:             {
191:                 Logger.LogError(previewEx, "[ImageUpload] Error during preview URL update: {Message}", previewEx.Message);
192:                 // Continue - don't fail the entire upload just because preview failed
193:             }
194: 
195:             // STEP 4: Pass the file data to the parent component for upload
196:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4: Checking FileDataSelected delegate (HasDelegate={HasDelegate})...", FileDataSelected.HasDelegate);
197:             if (FileDataSelected.HasDelegate)
198:             {
199:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4a: Invoking FileDataSelected callback with {Size} bytes...", fileData.Size);
200:                 await FileDataSelected.InvokeAsync(fileData);
201:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 4b: FileDataSelected callback completed successfully");
202:             }
203:             else
204:             {
205:                 Logger.LogWarning("[ImageUpload] FileDataSelected has no delegate - parent callback not configured!");
206:             }
207: 
208:             // STEP 5: Also invoke legacy callback for backward compatibility
209:             if (FileSelected.HasDelegate)
210:             {
211:                 Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] Step 5: Invoking legacy FileSelected callback...");
212:                 await FileSelected.InvokeAsync(file);
213:             }
214: 
215:             Logger.LogInformation("[ImageUpload] ✓ File processing completed successfully for {FileName}", file.Name);
216:         }
217:         catch (Exception ex)
218:         {
219:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing selected file {FileName}", file.Name);
220:             _errorMessage = $"An error occurred while processing the image: {ex.Message}";
221:             await RemoveImage();
222:         }
223:         finally
224:         {
225:             _isReadingFile = false;
226:             StateHasChanged();
227:         }
228:     }
229: 
230:     public async Task RemoveImage()
231:     {
232:         PreviewUrl = null;
233:         _errorMessage = null;
234:         await PreviewUrlChanged.InvokeAsync(null);
235: 
236:         // Notify parent that file was removed
237:         if (FileDataSelected.HasDelegate)
238:         {
239:             await FileDataSelected.InvokeAsync(null);
240:         }
241:         if (FileSelected.HasDelegate)
242:         {
243:             await FileSelected.InvokeAsync(null);
244:         }
245: 
246:         // Clear the file upload component
247:         if (_fileUpload != null)
248:         {
249:             await _fileUpload.ClearAsync();
250:         }
251: 
252:         StateHasChanged();
253:     }
254: }
