## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/EventCreated.razor
````razor
  1: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  3: @using Blazouter.Services
  4: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  5: @attribute [Authorize]
  6: @rendermode @(new InteractiveAutoRenderMode(prerender: false))
  7: @inject IEventService EventService
  8: @inject NavigationManager Navigation
  9: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 10: @inject RouterStateService RouterState
 11: 
 12: <PageTitle>Event Created - Explore</PageTitle>
 13: 
 14: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Medium" Class="mt-8">
 15:     @if (isLoading)
 16:     {
 17:         <MudPaper Class="pa-8 text-center">
 18:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 19:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-4">Loading event details...</MudText>
 20:         </MudPaper>
 21:     }
 22:     else if (eventDetails != null)
 23:     {
 24:         <MudPaper Class="pa-8">
 25:             <div class="text-center mb-6">
 26:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.CheckCircle"
 27:                         Color="Color.Success"
 28:                         Size="Size.Large"
 29:                         Style="font-size: 5rem;" />
 30:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Color="Color.Success" Class="mt-4">
 31:                     Event Created Successfully!
 32:                 </MudText>
 33:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mt-2 text-muted">
 34:                     Your event has been created and is now visible in your events.
 35:                 </MudText>
 36:             </div>
 37: 
 38:             <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
 39: 
 40:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mb-4">Event Details</MudText>
 41: 
 42:             <MudGrid>
 43:                 <MudItem xs="12">
 44:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Title</MudText>
 45:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.Title</MudText>
 46:                 </MudItem>
 47: 
 48:                 <MudItem xs="12">
 49:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Description</MudText>
 50:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.Description</MudText>
 51:                 </MudItem>
 52: 
 53:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 54:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Event Format</MudText>
 55:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.EventFormatFullName</MudText>
 56:                 </MudItem>
 57: 
 58:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 59:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Event Type</MudText>
 60:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.EventTypeFullName</MudText>
 61:                 </MudItem>
 62: 
 63:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 64:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Target Audience</MudText>
 65:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.AudienceGenderFullName, @eventDetails.AudienceAgeFullName</MudText>
 66:                 </MudItem>
 67: 
 68:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 69:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Price</MudText>
 70:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">
 71:                         @(eventDetails.Price > 0 ? $"{eventDetails.CurrencyCode} {eventDetails.Price:N2}" : "Free")
 72:                     </MudText>
 73:                 </MudItem>
 74: 
 75:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 76:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Registration Required</MudText>
 77:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">
 78:                         @(eventDetails.IsRegistrationRequired == true ? "Yes" : "No")
 79:                     </MudText>
 80:                 </MudItem>
 81: 
 82:                 @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventDetails.EventUrl))
 83:                 {
 84:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 85:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Event URL</MudText>
 86:                         <MudLink Href="@eventDetails.EventUrl" Target="_blank" Typo="Typo.body1">
 87:                             View Event Page
 88:                         </MudLink>
 89:                     </MudItem>
 90:                 }
 91: 
 92:                 @if (eventDetails.FirstSessionDate.HasValue)
 93:                 {
 94:                     <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
 95:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">First Session</MudText>
 96:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-3">@eventDetails.FirstSessionDate.Value.ToString("g")</MudText>
 97:                     </MudItem>
 98:                 }
 99:             </MudGrid>
100: 
101:             <MudDivider Class="my-4" />
102: 
103:             <div class="d-flex justify-content-between mt-6">
104:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
105:                           Color="Color.Primary"
106:                           OnClick="@(() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/createevent"))">
107:                     Create Another Event
108:                 </MudButton>
109:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
110:                           Color="Color.Primary"
111:                           OnClick="@(() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents"))">
112:                     View My Events
113:                 </MudButton>
114:             </div>
115:         </MudPaper>
116:     }
117:     else
118:     {
119:         <MudPaper Class="pa-8 text-center">
120:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Error" Color="Color.Error" Size="Size.Large" />
121:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-4">Event not found</MudText>
122:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
123:                       Color="Color.Primary"
124:                       Class="mt-4"
125:                       OnClick="@(() => Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents"))">
126:                 Go to My Events
127:             </MudButton>
128:         </MudPaper>
129:     }
130: </MudContainer>
131: 
132: @code {
133:     private Guid EventId { get; set; }
134: 
135:     private EventDto? eventDetails;
136:     private bool isLoading = true;
137: 
138:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
139:     {
140:         // Get route parameter from Blazouter
141:         var eventIdStr = RouterState.GetParam("eventId");
142:         if (Guid.TryParse(eventIdStr, out var id))
143:         {
144:             EventId = id;
145:         }
146: 
147:         try
148:         {
149:             isLoading = true;
150:             eventDetails = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(EventId);
151:         }
152:         catch (Exception ex)
153:         {
154:             Snackbar.Add($"Error loading event details: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
155:         }
156:         finally
157:         {
158:             isLoading = false;
159:         }
160:     }
161: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Home.razor
````razor
 1: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
 2: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Pages.Landing
 3: @using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
 4: @inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
 5: @inject ILogger<Home> Logger
 6: 
 7: <PageTitle>ISLAMU Explore</PageTitle>
 8: 
 9: @if (isLoading)
10: {
11:     <div class="home-page__loading">
12:         <div class="home-page__loading-content">
13:             <div class="home-page__loading-title">Loading...</div>
14:             <div class="home-page__loading-text">Please wait while we check your authentication status</div>
15:         </div>
16:     </div>
17: }
18: else if (isAuthenticated)
19: {
20:     <LandingPageForUsers />
21: }
22: else
23: {
24:     <LandingPageForNonUsers />
25: }
26: 
27: @code {
28:     private bool isLoading = true;
29:     private bool isAuthenticated = false;
30: 
31:     [PersistentState]
32:     public HomeState? PersistedState { get; set; }
33: 
34:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
35:     {
36:         if (PersistedState != null)
37:         {
38:             isAuthenticated = PersistedState.IsAuthenticated;
39:             isLoading = false;
40:             return;
41:         }
42: 
43:         try
44:         {
45:             var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
46:             isAuthenticated = authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
47:         }
48:         catch (Exception ex)
49:         {
50:             Logger.LogWarning(ex, "Auth check failed");
51:             isAuthenticated = false;
52:         }
53:         finally
54:         {
55:             isLoading = false;
56:             PersistedState = new HomeState { IsAuthenticated = isAuthenticated };
57:         }
58:     }
59: 
60:     public sealed class HomeState
61:     {
62:         public bool IsAuthenticated { get; init; }
63:     }
64: }
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Services/LandingPageService.cs
````csharp
  1: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients;
  2: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Constants;
  3: using Explore.Blazor.Client.Helpers;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  5: 
  6: namespace Explore.Blazor.Client.Services;
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: public interface ILandingPageService
 12: {
 13: 
 14: 
 15: 
 16: 
 17: 
 18:     Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetFeaturedEventsAsync(int count = 6);
 19: 
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23: 
 24:     Task<int> GetTotalMembersCountAsync();
 25: 
 26: 
 27: 
 28: 
 29: 
 30:     Task<int> GetUpcomingEventsCountAsync();
 31: }
 32: 
 33: 
 34: 
 35: 
 36: public class LandingPageService : ILandingPageService
 37: {
 38:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient;
 39:     private readonly ILogger<LandingPageService> _logger;
 40: 
 41: 
 42: 
 43: 
 44: 
 45: 
 46:     public LandingPageService(IEventApiClient apiClient, ILogger<LandingPageService> logger)
 47:     {
 48:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 49:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 50:     }
 51: 
 52: 
 53:     public async Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetFeaturedEventsAsync(int count = 6)
 54:     {
 55:         try
 56:         {
 57:             _logger.LogDebug("Fetching featured events with count {Count}", count);
 58:             var response = await _apiClient.GetEventsAsync(pageNumber: ApiConstants.FirstPage, pageSize: ApiConstants.DefaultPageSize);
 59:             var events = response?.GetItems() ?? new List<EventListDto>();
 60: 
 61: 
 62:             var featuredEvents = events
 63:                 .Where(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Title) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.Description))
 64:                 .OrderByDescending(p => p.TotalViews)
 65:                 .Take(count)
 66:                 .ToList();
 67: 
 68:             _logger.LogDebug("Retrieved {FeaturedCount} featured events from {TotalCount} total", featuredEvents.Count, events.Count);
 69:             return featuredEvents;
 70:         }
 71:         catch (ApiException ex)
 72:         {
 73:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[LandingPageService.GetFeaturedEventsAsync] API error fetching featured events. StatusCode: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 74:             return new List<EventListDto>();
 75:         }
 76:         catch (Exception ex)
 77:         {

 79:             return new List<EventListDto>();

 88: 
 89:             _logger.LogDebug("Returning placeholder member count");

## File: .claude/agents/documentation-architect.md
````markdown
 1: ---
 2: name: documentation-architect
 3: description: Generates C# XML documentation, Swagger/Scalar annotations, and architecture documentation for {Project}.
 4: tools: All tools
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: > **Project-Agnostic Documentation Agent**
 8: >
 9: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
10: 
11: You are the **Documentation Architect** for the {Project} platform. You ensure the codebase is self-documenting via XML comments and that high-level documentation reflects the actual Clean Architecture implementation.
12: 
13: ## Technology Stack
14: 
15: - **.NET**: 10.0
16: - **Language**: C# 13
17: - **API Documentation**: Scalar (primary), Swagger/OpenAPI
18: - **Architecture**: Clean Architecture with CQRS
19: - **Diagrams**: Mermaid.js for architecture flows
20: 
21: ## Core Responsibilities
22: 
23: ### 1. C# XML Documentation
24: 
25: The agent ensures that all public APIs (classes, methods, properties) in the C# codebase are well-documented using XML comments. This includes Controllers, MediatR Commands/Queries/Handlers, and Domain Entities.
26: 
27: - For **Controllers**: Document HTTP endpoints, parameters, return types, and response codes. See `auth-patterns` and `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` for typical controller structures.
28: - For **MediatR Handlers**: Document the handler's purpose, the command/query it handles, and its side effects. **CRITICAL**: Ensure the manual validator instantiation pattern and repository return types are explicitly mentioned in `remarks` if relevant. See `cqrs-mediatr-guidelines` (handler patterns).
29: - For **Domain Entities**: Document the entity's purpose, its key properties, and any domain invariants. **CRITICAL**: Explicitly state if properties do NOT have default values in the entity. See `dotnet-efcore-guidelines` (key principles & conventions).
30: 
31: ### 2. Scalar/Swagger Configuration
32: 
33: The agent configures API documentation using Scalar (primary) and Swagger/OpenAPI. This involves adding `[ProducesResponseType]` attributes to controller actions and ensuring `Program.cs` correctly sets up Scalar/Swagger UI.
34: 
35: ```csharp
36: // Example: {Project}.API/Program.cs - Scalar/OpenAPI setup
37: builder.Services.AddOpenApi("api"); // .NET 10 built-in OpenAPI support
38: var app = builder.Build();
39: app.MapScalarApiReference(options => { /* ... */ });
40: app.MapOpenApi();
41: ```
42: 
43: ### 3. Architecture Documentation
44: 
45: The agent maintains and generates architectural documentation, including Mermaid.js diagrams for visualizing complex flows (e.g., CQRS flow, Clean Architecture layers) in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
46: 
47: - **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and the `clean-architecture-rules` skill for detailed architectural diagrams and layer dependency rules.
48: 
49: ## Key Principles
50: 
51: - ✅ Document **WHY**, not just WHAT (capture business intent, decisions).
52: - ✅ Add XML comments to all public APIs (classes, methods, properties).
53: - ✅ Use `/// <summary>`, `/// <param>`, `/// <returns>`, `/// <remarks>` comprehensively.
54: - ✅ Add `[ProducesResponseType]` for all HTTP endpoints for accurate API documentation.
55: - ✅ Explicitly document **CRITICAL PATTERNS** (e.g., manual validator instantiation, repository return types) in MediatR handler `remarks`.
56: - ✅ Create Mermaid diagrams for complex flows and architectural overviews.
57: - ✅ Keep documentation close to code (same repository, e.g., in `.claude/skills` resources).
58: - ❌ Don't write documentation that duplicates obvious code logic.
59: - ❌ Don't forget to document edge cases and business rules.
60: - ❌ Don't use generic descriptions ("This method does X").
61: 
62: ## Related Skills
63: 
64: - [`clean-architecture-rules`](../skills/clean-architecture-rules/SKILL.md) - Architectural patterns and dependency rules to document.
65: - [`cqrs-mediatr-guidelines`](../skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/SKILL.md) - CQRS flow, handler patterns, and validation integration to document.
66: - [`dotnet-efcore-guidelines`](../skills/dotnet-efcore-guidelines/SKILL.md) - EF Core patterns, entity documentation concerns.
67: - [`auth-patterns`](../skills/auth-patterns/SKILL.md) - Authentication/Authorization flows and security aspects to document.
68: - [`blazor-ui-conventions`](../skills/blazor-ui-conventions/SKILL.md) - Blazor component documentation, theming, state management.
69: - [`blazor-bff-patterns`](../skills/blazor-bff-patterns/SKILL.md) - BFF pattern and its documentation needs.
70: - [`error-tracking`](../skills/error-tracking/SKILL.md) - Error handling and observability patterns to document.
71: 
72: ## Output Format
73: 
74: When assisting with documentation, provide:
75: 
76: 1.  **Documentation Plan**: Outline which code elements need documentation and which patterns to follow.
77: 2.  **Proposed XML Comments/Annotations**: Provide generated XML comments or `[ProducesResponseType]` attributes for specific code blocks.
78: 3.  **Mermaid Diagram (if requested)**: Provide Mermaid code for architectural visualizations.
79: 4.  **Review Feedback**: Identify missing or unclear documentation, suggest improvements, and ensure compliance with project standards.
80: 5.  **Code Examples**: Before/after examples for clarity where appropriate.
81: 
82: Always ensure documentation is accurate and reflects the actual implementation. Update documentation when code changes.
83: 
84: **Enforcement Level**: SUGGEST (Provides guidance and recommendations)
````

## File: .claude/skills/cqrs-mediatr-guidelines/resources/complete-examples.md
````markdown
  1: # Complete Feature Example - Full CQRS Cycle
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Complete Example**
  4: >
  5: > This document shows the **complete CQRS cycle** for a generic entity, demonstrating all patterns and conventions.
  6: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](../../../../docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  7: 
  8: ---
  9: 
 10: ## Complete CQRS Cycle Overview
 11: 
 12: ```
 13: User Request → Controller → MediatR → Handler → Repository → Entity → Database
 14:                                ↓
 15:                           Validation (manual instantiation)
 16:                                ↓
 17:                           AutoMapper (Entity ↔ DTO)
 18:                                ↓
 19:                           Response (BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>)
 20: ```
 21: 
 22: ---
 23: 
 24: ## 1. Create Entity - Full Command Flow
 25: 
 26: ### Domain Entity
 27: 
 28: **File**: `{Project}.Domain/{Entity}.cs`
 29: 
 30: ```csharp
 31: using System;
 32: using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
 33: 
 34: namespace {Project}.Domain;
 35: 
 36: public class {Entity}
 37: {
 38:     public {IdType} Id { get; set; }
 39: 
 40:     [ForeignKey("{LookupEntity}")]
 41:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
 42:     public {LookupEntity} {LookupEntity} { get; set; }
 43: 
 44:     public string Title { get; set; }
 45:     public string? Description { get; set; }
 46: 
 47:     [ForeignKey("{RelatedEntity1}")]
 48:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
 49:     public {RelatedEntity1} {RelatedEntity1} { get; set; }
 50: 
 51:     [ForeignKey("{RelatedEntity2}")]
 52:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity2}Id { get; set; }
 53:     public {RelatedEntity2} {RelatedEntity2} { get; set; }
 54: 
 55:     [ForeignKey("{ParentEntity}")]
 56:     public {IdType} {ParentEntity}Id { get; set; }
 57:     public {ParentEntity} {ParentEntity} { get; set; }
 58: 
 59:     public decimal? Price { get; set; }
 60:     public string? CurrencyCode { get; set; }
 61: 
 62:     [ForeignKey("FeaturedImage")]
 63:     public {IdType}? FeaturedImageId { get; set; }
 64:     public StorageObject? FeaturedImage { get; set; }
 65: 
 66:     public int ViewCount { get; set; }
 67:     public bool IsActive { get; set; }
 68:     public string? ExternalUrl { get; set; }
 69: 
 70:     [ForeignKey("Status")]
 71:     public {LookupIdType} StatusId { get; set; }
 72:     public Status Status { get; set; }
 73: 
 74:     [ForeignKey("Visibility")]
 75:     public {LookupIdType} VisibilityId { get; set; }
 76:     public Visibility Visibility { get; set; }
 77: 
 78:     [ForeignKey("Tenant")]
 79:     public {IdType} TenantId { get; set; }
 80:     public Tenant Tenant { get; set; }
 81: 
 82:     public string? Slug { get; set; }
 83:     public DateOnly? StartDate { get; set; }
 84:     public DateOnly? EndDate { get; set; }
 85:     public string? Timezone { get; set; }
 86: }
 87: ```
 88: 
 89: ### Create DTO
 90: 
 91: **File**: `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Create{Entity}Dto.cs`
 92: 
 93: ```csharp
 94: using System;
 95: 
 96: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
 97: 
 98: public class Create{Entity}Dto
 99: {
100:     public string Title { get; set; }
101:     public string? Description { get; set; }
102:     public string? Slug { get; set; }
103: 
104:     // Lookup references
105:     public {LookupIdType} {LookupEntity}Id { get; set; }
106:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity1}Id { get; set; }
107:     public {LookupIdType} {RelatedEntity2}Id { get; set; }
108: 
109:     // Optional parent reference
110:     public {IdType}? {ParentEntity}Id { get; set; }
111: 
112:     // Pricing
113:     public decimal? Price { get; set; }
114:     public string? CurrencyCode { get; set; }
115: 
116:     // Featured Image (optional)
117:     public {IdType}? FeaturedImageId { get; set; }
118: 
119:     // Configuration
120:     public bool IsActive { get; set; }
121:     public string? ExternalUrl { get; set; }
122: 
123:     // Status & Visibility (DTO defaults are OK; do not add defaults in Domain entities)
124:     public {LookupIdType} StatusId { get; set; } = 1;
125:     public {LookupIdType} VisibilityId { get; set; } = 1;
126: 
127:     // Date range
128:     public DateTimeOffset? StartDate { get; set; }
129:     public DateTimeOffset? EndDate { get; set; }
130:     public string? Timezone { get; set; }
131: 
132:     // TenantId is set by the handler from the authenticated context.
133: }
134: ```
135: 
136: ### Validator (CRITICAL: Manual Instantiation)
137: 
138: **File**: `{Project}.Application/DTOs/{Entity}/Validators/Create{Entity}DtoValidator.cs`
139: 
140: ```csharp
141: using FluentValidation;
142: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
143: 
144: namespace {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
145: 
146: public class Create{Entity}DtoValidator : AbstractValidator<Create{Entity}Dto>
147: {
148:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
149:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
150:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
151:     private readonly I{ParentEntity}Repository _{parentEntity}Repository;
152:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
153: 
154:     public Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
155:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
156:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
157:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
158:         I{ParentEntity}Repository {parentEntity}Repository,
159:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository)
160:     {
161:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
162:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
163:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
164:         _{parentEntity}Repository = {parentEntity}Repository;
165:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
166: 
167:         // Title validation
168:         RuleFor(x => x.Title)
169:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Title is required")
170:             .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("Title cannot exceed 200 characters");
171: 
172:         // Lookup entity validation with async database check
173:         RuleFor(x => x.{LookupEntity}Id)
174:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{LookupEntity} is required")
175:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
176:             {
177:                 var exists = await _{lookupEntity}Repository.Exists(id);
178:                 return exists;
179:             })
180:             .WithMessage("{LookupEntity} not found");
181: 
182:         // Related entity 1 validation
183:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity1}Id)
184:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} is required")
185:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
186:             {
187:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity1}Repository.Exists(id);
188:                 return exists;
189:             })
190:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity1} not found");
191: 
192:         // Related entity 2 validation
193:         RuleFor(x => x.{RelatedEntity2}Id)
194:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} is required")
195:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
196:             {
197:                 var exists = await _{relatedEntity2}Repository.Exists(id);
198:                 return exists;
199:             })
200:             .WithMessage("{RelatedEntity2} not found");
201: 
202:         // Parent entity validation (optional)
203:         RuleFor(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id)
204:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
205:             {
206:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
207:                 return await _{parentEntity}Repository.Exists(id.Value);
208:             })
209:             .When(x => x.{ParentEntity}Id.HasValue)
210:             .WithMessage("{ParentEntity} does not exist.");
211: 
212:         RuleFor(x => x.FeaturedImageId)
213:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
214:             {
215:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
216:                 return await _storageObjectRepository.Exists(id.Value);
217:             })
218:             .When(x => x.FeaturedImageId.HasValue)
219:             .WithMessage("FeaturedImageId does not exist.");
220: 
221:         // Price validation
222:         RuleFor(x => x.Price)
223:             .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).When(x => x.Price.HasValue)
224:             .WithMessage("Price cannot be negative");
225: 
226:         // Currency validation
227:         RuleFor(x => x.CurrencyCode)
228:             .MaximumLength(3)
229:             .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.CurrencyCode))
230:             .WithMessage("Currency code must be 3 characters (ISO 4217)");
231:     }
232: }
233: ```
234: 
235: ### Command Request
236: 
237: **File**: `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Requests/Commands/Create{Entity}Command.cs`
238: 
239: ```csharp
240: using MediatR;
241: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
242: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
243: 
244: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
245: 
246: public class Create{Entity}Command : IRequest<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
247: {
248:     public Create{Entity}Dto {Entity}Dto { get; set; }
249: }
250: ```
251: 
252: ### Command Handler (CRITICAL: Shows All Patterns)
253: 
254: **File**: `{Project}.Application/Features/{Entities}/Handlers/Commands/Create{Entity}CommandHandler.cs`
255: 
256: ```csharp
257: using System;
258: using System.Linq;
259: using System.Threading;
260: using System.Threading.Tasks;
261: using AutoMapper;
262: using {Project}.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
263: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity}.Validators;
264: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
265: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
266: using {Project}.Domain;
267: using MediatR;
268: 
269: namespace {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Handlers.Commands;
270: 
271: public class Create{Entity}CommandHandler : IRequestHandler<Create{Entity}Command, BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>
272: {
273:     private readonly I{Entity}Repository _{entity}Repository;
274:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity1}Repository _{relatedEntity1}Repository;
275:     private readonly I{RelatedEntity2}Repository _{relatedEntity2}Repository;
276:     private readonly I{LookupEntity}Repository _{lookupEntity}Repository;
277:     private readonly I{ParentEntity}Repository _{parentEntity}Repository;
278:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
279:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
280:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
281: 
282:     public Create{Entity}CommandHandler(
283:         I{Entity}Repository {entity}Repository,
284:         I{RelatedEntity1}Repository {relatedEntity1}Repository,
285:         I{RelatedEntity2}Repository {relatedEntity2}Repository,
286:         I{LookupEntity}Repository {lookupEntity}Repository,
287:         I{ParentEntity}Repository {parentEntity}Repository,
288:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
289:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
290:         IMapper mapper)
291:     {
292:         _{entity}Repository = {entity}Repository;
293:         _{relatedEntity1}Repository = {relatedEntity1}Repository;
294:         _{relatedEntity2}Repository = {relatedEntity2}Repository;
295:         _{lookupEntity}Repository = {lookupEntity}Repository;
296:         _{parentEntity}Repository = {parentEntity}Repository;
297:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
298:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
299:         _mapper = mapper;
300:     }
301: 
302:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>> Handle(Create{Entity}Command request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
303:     {
304:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>();
305: 
306:         // CRITICAL: Manual validator instantiation with all dependencies
307:         var validator = new Create{Entity}DtoValidator(
308:             _{relatedEntity1}Repository,
309:             _{relatedEntity2}Repository,
310:             _{lookupEntity}Repository,
311:             _{parentEntity}Repository,
312:             _storageObjectRepository);
313: 
314:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.{Entity}Dto, cancellationToken);
315: 
316:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
317:         {
318:             response.Success = false;
319:             response.Message = "{Entity} creation failed.";
320:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
321:             return response;
322:         }
323: 
324:         // Map DTO to Entity using AutoMapper
325:         var {entity} = _mapper.Map<{Entity}>(request.{Entity}Dto);
326: 
327:         // Set properties not in DTO (system-generated values)
328:         {entity}.ViewCount = 0;
329:         {entity}.TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId;
330: 
331:         // Save through repository
332:         {entity} = await _{entity}Repository.Create({entity});
333: 
334:         response.Success = true;
335:         response.Id = {entity}.Id;
336:         response.Message = "{Entity} created successfully.";
337: 
338:         return response;
339:     }
340: }
341: ```
342: 
343: ### Controller (Complete with Authorization)
344: 
345: **File**: `{Project}.API/Controllers/{Entity}Controller.cs`
346: 
347: ```csharp
348: using System;
349: using System.Collections.Generic;
350: using System.Threading.Tasks;
351: using {Project}.Application.DTOs.{Entity};
352: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Commands;
353: using {Project}.Application.Features.{Entities}.Requests.Queries;
354: using {Project}.Application.Responses;
355: using MediatR;
356: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
357: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
358: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
359: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
360: using static Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.StatusCodes;
361: 
362: namespace {Project}.API.Controllers;
363: 
364: [Route("api/[controller]")]
365: [ApiController]
366: public class {Entity}Controller : ControllerBase
367: {
368:     private readonly IMediator _mediator;
369:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
370:     private readonly ILogger<{Entity}Controller> _logger;
371: 
372:     public {Entity}Controller(
373:         IMediator mediator,
374:         IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
375:         ILogger<{Entity}Controller> logger)
376:     {
377:         _mediator = mediator;
378:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
379:         _logger = logger;
380:     }
381: 
382:     // POST: api/{entity}
383:     [HttpPost]
384:     [EndpointSummary("Create {Entity}")]
385:     [EndpointDescription("Creates a new {entity}. Requires authentication.")]
386:     [Authorize]  // CRITICAL: Write operations require authentication
387:     [Consumes("application/json")]
388:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), Status200OK)]
389:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>), Status400BadRequest)]
390:     [ProducesResponseType(Status401Unauthorized)]
391:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>>> Create([FromBody] Create{Entity}Dto dto)
392:     {
393:         var command = new Create{Entity}Command { {Entity}Dto = dto };
394:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command);
395: 
396:         if (!response.Success)
397:         {
398:             return BadRequest(response);
399:         }
400: 
401:         return Ok(response);
402:     }
403: 
404:     // GET: api/{entity}
405:     [HttpGet]
406:     [EndpointSummary("List {Entities}")]
407:     [EndpointDescription("Returns a list of {entities}.")]
408:     [AllowAnonymous]  // CRITICAL: Read operations are public
409:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(List<{Entity}ListDto>), Status200OK)]
410:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetAll()
411:     {
412:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}ListRequest());
413:         return Ok({entities});
414:     }
415: 
416:     // GET: api/{entity}/{id}
417:     [HttpGet("{id}")]
418:     [EndpointSummary("Get {Entity} Details")]
419:     [EndpointDescription("Returns {entity} details.")]
420:     [AllowAnonymous]
421:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof({Entity}Dto), Status200OK)]
422:     [ProducesResponseType(Status404NotFound)]
423:     public async Task<ActionResult<{Entity}Dto>> GetById({IdType} id)
424:     {
425:         var {entity} = await _mediator.Send(new Get{Entity}DetailsRequest { Id = id });
426: 
427:         if ({entity} == null)
428:         {
429:             return NotFound(new { error = "{Entity} not found" });
430:         }
431: 
432:         return Ok({entity});
433:     }
434: 
435:     // GET: api/{entity}/my
436:     [HttpGet("my")]
437:     [EndpointSummary("List My {Entities}")]
438:     [EndpointDescription("Returns {entities} owned by the current user.")]
439:     [Authorize]
440:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(List<{Entity}ListDto>), Status200OK)]
441:     [ProducesResponseType(Status401Unauthorized)]
442:     public async Task<ActionResult<List<{Entity}ListDto>>> GetMy{Entities}()
443:     {
444:         // CRITICAL: UserId extraction with fallback pattern
445:         var userId = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
446:             ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
447:             ?? _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
448: 
449:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
450:         {
451:             return Unauthorized(new { error = "User ID not found in token" });
452:         }
453: 
454:         var {entities} = await _mediator.Send(new GetMy{Entities}Request { UserId = userId });
455:         return Ok({entities});
456:     }
457: }
458: ```
