````razor
146:                             <div class="admin-locations__name-cell">
147:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Success" />
148:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-locations__name-text">@context.FullName</MudText>
149:                             </div>
150:                         </MudTd>
151:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Address">
152:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">@(context.Address ?? "—")</MudText>
153:                         </MudTd>
154:                         <MudTd DataLabel="City">
155:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Info">
156:                                 @(context.City ?? "—")
157:                             </MudChip>
158:                         </MudTd>
159:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Country">
160:                             <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Default">
161:                                 @(context.Country ?? "—")
162:                             </MudChip>
163:                         </MudTd>
164:                         <MudTd DataLabel="Actions" Class="admin-locations__cell-actions">
165:                             <div class="admin-locations__actions">
166:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Edit">
167:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
168:                                                    Color="Color.Primary"
169:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
170:                                                    OnClick="@(() => OpenEditDialog(context))" />
171:                                 </MudTooltip>
172:                                 <MudTooltip Text="Delete">
173:                                     <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete"
174:                                                    Color="Color.Error"
175:                                                    Size="Size.Small"
176:                                                    OnClick="@(() => DeleteLocation(context))" />
177:                                 </MudTooltip>
178:                             </div>
179:                         </MudTd>
180:                     </RowTemplate>
181:                     <NoRecordsContent>
182:                         <div class="admin-locations__empty">
183:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Large" />
184:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="admin-locations__empty-title">No locations found</MudText>
185:                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="admin-locations__muted">
186:                                 @if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString))
187:                                 {
188:                                     <span>Create your first location to get started.</span>
189:                                 }
190:                                 else
191:                                 {
192:                                     <span>No locations match your search criteria.</span>
193:                                 }
194:                             </MudText>
195:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
196:                                        Color="Color.Success"
197:                                        OnClick="OpenCreateDialog"
198:                                        Class="admin-locations__empty-btn">
199:                                 Create Location
200:                             </MudButton>
201:                         </div>
202:                     </NoRecordsContent>
203: 
204:                 </MudTable>
205:             </MudPaper>
206:         </div>
207:     }
208: </div>
209: 
210: @code {
211:     private ICollection<LocationListDto> _locations = new List<LocationListDto>();
212:     private string _searchString = string.Empty;
213:     private bool _isLoading = true;
214: 
215:     private IEnumerable<LocationListDto> FilteredLocations => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchString)
216:         ? _locations
217:         : _locations.Where(l =>
218:             (l.FullName?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
219:             (l.Address?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
220:             (l.City?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
221:             (l.Country?.Contains(_searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
222: 
223:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
224:     {
225:         await LoadLocations();
226:     }
227: 
228:     private async Task LoadLocations()
229:     {
230:         _isLoading = true;
231:         try
232:         {
233:             _locations = await LocationService.GetLocations();
234:         }
235:         catch (Exception ex)
236:         {
237:             Snackbar.Add($"Failed to load locations: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
238:             _locations = new List<LocationListDto>();
239:         }
240:         finally
241:         {
242:             _isLoading = false;
243:         }
244:     }
245: 
246:     private async Task OpenCreateDialog()
247:     {
248:         var options = new DialogOptions
249:         {
250:             CloseButton = true,
251:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
252:             FullWidth = true
253:         };
254: 
255:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateLocationDialog>("Create Location", options);
256:         var result = await dialog.Result;
257: 
258:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: CreateLocationDto createDto })
259:         {
260:             var response = await LocationService.CreateLocationAsync(createDto);
261:             if (response?.Success == true)
262:             {
263:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{createDto.FullName}' created successfully", Severity.Success);
264:                 await LoadLocations();
265:             }
266:             else
267:             {
268:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
269:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to create location: {errors}", Severity.Error);
270:             }
271:         }
272:     }
273: 
274:     private async Task OpenEditDialog(LocationListDto location)
275:     {
276:         if (location.Id == null)
277:         {
278:             Snackbar.Add("Location ID is missing.", Severity.Error);
279:             return;
280:         }
281: 
282:         // First, get the full location details
283:         var locationDetails = await LocationService.GetLocationByIdAsync(location.Id.Value);
284:         if (locationDetails == null)
285:         {
286:             Snackbar.Add("Failed to load location details", Severity.Error);
287:             return;
288:         }
289: 
290:         var parameters = new DialogParameters<EditLocationDialog>
291:         {
292:             { x => x.ExistingLocation, locationDetails }
293:         };
294: 
295:         var options = new DialogOptions
296:         {
297:             CloseButton = true,
298:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
299:             FullWidth = true
300:         };
301: 
302:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditLocationDialog>("Edit Location", parameters, options);
303:         var result = await dialog.Result;
304: 
305:         if (result is { Canceled: false, Data: UpdateLocationDto updateDto })
306:         {
307:             if (updateDto.Id == null)
308:             {
309:                 Snackbar.Add("Location ID is missing for update.", Severity.Error);
310:                 return;
311:             }
312:             var response = await LocationService.UpdateLocationAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
313:             if (response?.Success == true)
314:             {
315:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{updateDto.FullName}' updated successfully", Severity.Success);
316:                 await LoadLocations();
317:             }
318:             else
319:             {
320:                 var errors = response?.Errors != null ? string.Join(", ", response.Errors) : "Unknown error";
321:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to update location: {errors}", Severity.Error);
322:             }
323:         }
324:     }
325: 
326:     private async Task DeleteLocation(LocationListDto location)
327:     {
328:         bool? confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
329:             "Confirm Delete",
330:             $"Are you sure you want to delete the location '{location.FullName}'? This action cannot be undone.",
331:             yesText: "Delete",
332:             cancelText: "Cancel");
333: 
334:         if (confirm == true)
335:         {
336:             if (location.Id == null)
337:             {
338:                 Snackbar.Add("Location ID is missing for delete.", Severity.Error);
339:                 return;
340:             }
341:             var success = await LocationService.DeleteLocationAsync(location.Id.Value);
342:             if (success)
343:             {
344:                 Snackbar.Add($"Location '{location.FullName}' deleted successfully", Severity.Success);
345:                 await LoadLocations();
346:             }
347:             else
348:             {
349:                 Snackbar.Add($"Failed to delete location '{location.FullName}'", Severity.Error);
350:             }
351:         }
352:     }
353: }
````

````csharp
145:                     if (registrations != null)
146:                     {
147:                         var eventIds = new HashSet<Guid>();
148:                         var regMap = new Dictionary<Guid, Guid>();
149:                         foreach (var reg in registrations)
150:                         {
151:                             if (reg.EventId.HasValue && reg.Id.HasValue)
152:                             {
153:                                 eventIds.Add(reg.EventId.Value);
154:                                 regMap[reg.EventId.Value] = reg.Id.Value;
155:                             }
156:                         }
157:                         _registeredEventIds = eventIds;
158:                         _registrationIdByEventId = regMap;

160:                 }
161:             }
162:         }

232:         var pageSize = Math.Max(request.Count, 20);

235:

253:

255:         var includesQuran = _filterBar?.IncludesQuranRecitation;
256:         var prayerId = _filterBar?.SelectedReferencePrayer != null ? (int?)_filterBar.SelectedReferencePrayer : null;

267: 
268:         DateTimeOffset? dateFrom = null;
269:         DateTimeOffset? dateTo = null;
270:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dateFilter))
271:         {
272:             var today = DateTimeOffset.Now.Date;
273:             (dateFrom, dateTo) = dateFilter switch
274:             {
275:                 "today" => ((DateTimeOffset?)today, (DateTimeOffset?)today.AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1)),
276:                 "tomorrow" => ((DateTimeOffset?)today.AddDays(1), (DateTimeOffset?)today.AddDays(2).AddTicks(-1)),
277:                 "thisweek" => ((DateTimeOffset?)today, (DateTimeOffset?)today.AddDays(7)),
278:                 "thismonth" => ((DateTimeOffset?)today, (DateTimeOffset?)today.AddDays(30)),
279:                 _ => (null, null)

283:         var result = await EventService.GetEventsPagedAsync(
284:             pageNumber,
285:             pageSize,
286:             searchTerm: searchTerm,
287:             categoryId: categoryId,
288:             tagId: tagId,
289:             formatId: formatId,
290:             madhabId: madhabId,
291:             locationId: locationId,
292:             registrationModeId: registrationModeId,
293:             languageId: languageId,
294:             dateFrom: dateFrom,
295:             dateTo: dateTo,
296:             sortBy: sortBy,
297:             sortDescending: sortDescending,
298:             eventTypeId: eventTypeId,
299:             audienceGenderId: audienceGenderId,
300:             audienceAgeId: audienceAgeId,
301:             eventStatusId: eventStatusId,
302:             genderModeId: genderModeId,
303:             includesQuranRecitation: includesQuran,
304:             referencePrayerId: prayerId,

306:             hasIslamicAspect: hasIslamic,
307:             skillLevelId: skillLevelId,
308:             isCodingCompetition: codingComp,
309:             isHackathon: hackathon,
310:             requiresLaptop: laptop,
311:             techStackTag: techStack,
312:             hasTechAspect: hasTech,
313:             cancellationToken: request.CancellationToken);
314: 
315:         _totalCount = result.TotalCount;
316:         _eventsLoaded = true;
317: 
318: 
319: 
320: 
321:         if (isLoading) isLoading = false;
322:         StateHasChanged();
323: 
324:         if (PersistedState == null && request.StartIndex == 0)

326:             PersistedState = new EventListState
327:             {
328:                 InitialItems = result.Items.ToList(),
329:                 TotalCount = result.TotalCount,

360:     private async Task OpenDeleteDialog(EventListDto evt)
361:     {
362:         var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["EventId"] = evt.Id, ["EventTitle"] = evt.Title };
363:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseOnEscapeKey = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small, FullWidth = true };
364:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event.DeleteEventDialog>("Delete Event", parameters, options);
365:         var result = await dialog.Result;
366:         if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
367:         {
368:             await _virtualize?.RefreshDataAsync()!;
369:         }
370:     }

372:     private async Task OpenQuickRegisterDialog(EventListDto evt)
373:     {
374:         if (!evt.Id.HasValue) return;
375:         var sessions = await EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(evt.Id.Value);
376:         if (sessions == null || !sessions.Any())
377:         {
378:             _errorMessage = "No sessions available for this event yet.";
379:             return;
380:         }
381:         var primarySession = sessions.First();
382:         var parameters = new DialogParameters { ["EventSessionId"] = primarySession.Id, ["Title"] = $"Register for {evt.Title}" };
383:         var options = new DialogOptions { CloseOnEscapeKey = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true };
384:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.EventRegistration>("Register", parameters, options);
385:         var result = await dialog.Result;
386:         if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
387:         {
388:             _successMessage = "Successfully registered for event!";
389:             await LoadUserRegistrationsAsync();
390:         }
391:     }
392: 
393:     private async Task CancelRegistrationAsync(EventListDto evt)
394:     {
395:         if (!evt.Id.HasValue) return;
396:         var eventId = evt.Id.Value;
397: 
398:         if (!_registrationIdByEventId.TryGetValue(eventId, out var registrationId))
399:         {
400:             _errorMessage = "Registration not found.";
401:             return;
402:         }
403: 
404:         var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
405:             "Cancel Registration",
406:             $"Are you sure you want to cancel your registration for \"{evt.Title}\"?",
407:             yesText: "Cancel Registration",
408:             cancelText: "Keep Registration");
409: 
410:         if (confirm != true) return;
411: 
412:         _isCancellingRegistration = true;
413: 
414:         try
415:         {
416:             var success = await EventService.CancelEventRegistrationAsync(registrationId);
417:             if (success)
418:             {
419:                 _registeredEventIds.Remove(eventId);
420:                 _registrationIdByEventId.Remove(eventId);
421:                 _successMessage = "Registration cancelled.";
422:             }
423:             else
424:             {
425:                 _errorMessage = "Failed to cancel registration. Please try again.";
426:             }
427:         }
428:         catch (Exception ex)
429:         {
430:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error cancelling registration for event {EventId}", eventId);
431:             _errorMessage = "An error occurred while cancelling registration.";
432:         }
433:         finally
434:         {
435:             _isCancellingRegistration = false;
436:         }
437:     }

443:             return eventTypeName;

451:         if (eventItem.EventFormatId.HasValue && eventFormatMap.TryGetValue(eventItem.EventFormatId.Value, out var formatName))
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/User/MyReviews.razor
````razor
 1: @page "/user/reviews"
 2: @using MudBlazor
 3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
 4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
 5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
 6: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
 7: @rendermode @(new InteractiveAutoRenderMode(prerender: false))
 8: @attribute [Authorize]
 9: 
10: <PageTitle>My Reviews</PageTitle>
11: 
12: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="py-8">
13:     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center mb-6 flex-wrap gap-4">
14:         <div>
15:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">My Reviews</MudText>
16:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Manage your reviews and feedback</MudText>
17:         </div>
18:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Secondary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack" Href="/user/profile" Class="rounded-pill">
19:             Back to Profile
20:         </MudButton>
21:     </div>
22: 
23:     @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
24:     {
25:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => _errorMessage = null)">
26:             @_errorMessage
27:         </MudAlert>
28:     }
29: 
30:     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
31:         <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString" 
32:                       Placeholder="Search reviews..." 
33:                       Adornment="Adornment.Start" 
34:                       AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search" 
35:                       Variant="Variant.Outlined" 
36:                       Margin="Margin.Dense" 
37:                       Class="mb-6 rounded-pill"
38:                       Style="max-width: 400px;" />
39: 
40:         @if (_loading)
41:         {
42:             <div class="d-flex justify-center py-12">
43:                 <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" />
44:             </div>
45:         }
46:         else if (!FilteredReviews.Any())
47:         {
48:             <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center pa-12">
49:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.RateReview" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" />
50:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-4" Style="font-weight: 700;">No reviews found</MudText>
51:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">You haven't written any reviews yet.</MudText>
52:             </div>
53:         }
54:         else
55:         {
56:             <MudGrid Spacing="3">
57:                 @foreach (var review in FilteredReviews)
58:                 {
59:                     <MudItem @key="review.Id" xs="12">
60:                         <MudCard Elevation="0" Class="border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
61:                             <MudCardHeader>
62:                                 <CardHeaderContent>
63:                                     <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-start w-100">
64:                                         <div>
65:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700;">@review.OrganizationFullName</MudText>
66:                                             <MudRating ReadOnly="true" SelectedValue="@(review.Rating ?? 0)" Size="Size.Small" />
67:                                         </div>
68:                                         <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" Color="Color.Error" OnClick="@(() => DeleteReview(review))" Size="Size.Small" />
69:                                     </div>
70:                                 </CardHeaderContent>
71:                             </MudCardHeader>
72:                             <MudCardContent>
73:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-2">@review.Comment</MudText>
74:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(review.CreatedAt?.ToString("MMMM dd, yyyy") ?? "")</MudText>
75:                             </MudCardContent>
76:                         </MudCard>
77:                     </MudItem>
78:                 }
79:             </MudGrid>
80:         }
81:     </MudPaper>
82: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Organization/MyOrganizations.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/organizations/my"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  6: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  7: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.Virtualization
  8: @rendermode @(new InteractiveAutoRenderMode(prerender: false))
  9: @attribute [Authorize]
 10: 
 11: <PageTitle>My Organizations</PageTitle>
 12: 
 13: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge" Class="py-4 py-sm-8 py-md-12">
 14:     <!-- Header -->
 15:     <div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-end justify-space-between gap-4 mb-8">
 16:         <div>
 17:             <MudText Typo="Typo.overline" Class="mud-text-secondary" Style="letter-spacing: 0.18em;">MANAGEMENT</MudText>
 18:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4">My Organizations</MudText>
 19:         </div>
 20:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 21:                    Color="Color.Primary"
 22:                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
 23:                    Href="/organization/create">
 24:             Create Organization
 25:         </MudButton>
 26:     </div>
 27: 
 28:     @if (_isLoading)
 29:     {
 30:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 31:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 32:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">
 33:                 Loading your organizations...
 34:             </MudText>
 35:         </div>
 36:     }
 37:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 38:     {
 39:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="my-4">
 40:             @_errorMessage
 41:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Inherit" OnClick="RetryLoadAsync" Class="ml-4">
 42:                 Retry
 43:             </MudButton>
 44:         </MudAlert>
 45:     }
 46:     else if (_organizations == null || !_organizations.Any())
 47:     {
 48:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 49:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Business" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" Style="width: 80px; height: 80px; opacity: 0.2;" />
 50:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mt-4">No organizations yet</MudText>
 51:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-6">
 52:                 Create an organization to start hosting events
 53:             </MudText>
 54:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 55:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 56:                        Href="/organization/create"
 57:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add">
 58:                 Create your first organization
 59:             </MudButton>
 60:         </div>
 61:     }
 62:     else
 63:     {
 64:         <!-- Search -->
 65:         <MudGrid Class="mb-8">
 66:             <MudItem xs="12">
 67:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 68:                               Placeholder="Search by name or email..."
 69:                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 70:                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 71:                               Immediate="true"
 72:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 73:                               Margin="Margin.Dense" />
 74:             </MudItem>
 75:         </MudGrid>
 76: 
 77:         @if (!FilteredOrganizations.Any())
 78:         {
 79:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-8">
 80:                 No organizations match your search.
 81:             </MudText>
 82:         }
 83:         else
 84:         {
 85:             <MudGrid>
 86:                 <Virtualize Items="@FilteredOrganizations.ToList()" Context="org" OverscanCount="4">
 87:                     <ItemContent>
 88:                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
 89:                             <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column">
 90:                                 <div class="d-flex align-center justify-center py-8" style="background-color: @GetOrganizationColor(org.FullName); min-height: 120px;">
 91:                                     <MudAvatar Size="Size.Large"
 92:                                                Color="Color.Surface"
 93:                                                Variant="Variant.Filled">
 94:                                         <MudText Color="Color.Primary" Typo="Typo.h5">@GetInitials(org.FullName)</MudText>
 95:                                     </MudAvatar>
 96:                                 </div>
 97: 
 98:                                 <MudCardContent Class="flex-grow-1">
 99:                                     <div class="mb-2">
100:                                         @if (org.CurrentUserRole.HasValue)
101:                                         {
102:                                             <MudChip T="string"
103:                                                      Size="Size.Small"
104:                                                      Color="@GetRoleColor(org.CurrentUserRole.Value)"
105:                                                      Variant="Variant.Outlined">
106:                                                 @GetRoleName(org.CurrentUserRole.Value)
107:                                             </MudChip>
108:                                         }
109:                                     </div>
110: 
111:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4">@org.FullName</MudText>
112: 
113:                                     <div class="mt-auto">
114:                                         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1 mb-1">
115:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
116:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary" Style="white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">
117:                                                 @org.City, @org.Country
118:                                             </MudText>
119:                                         </div>
120:                                         
121:                                         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
122:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
123:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary" Style="white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">@org.Email</MudText>
124:                                         </div>
125:                                     </div>
126:                                 </MudCardContent>
127: 
128:                                 <MudCardActions>
129:                                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
130:                                                Color="Color.Primary"
131:                                                Href="@($"/organization/{org.Id}")"
132:                                                EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward">
133:                                         Details
134:                                     </MudButton>
135:                                     <MudSpacer />
136:                                     @if (CanCreateEvents(org))
137:                                     {
138:                                         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
139:                                                    Color="Color.Primary"
140:                                                    StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
141:                                                    Href="@($"/organization/{org.Id}/create-event")">
142:                                             Event
143:                                         </MudButton>
144:                                     }
145:                                 </MudCardActions>
146:                             </MudCard>
147:                         </MudItem>
148:                     </ItemContent>
149:                     <Placeholder>
150:                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
151:                             <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column">
152:                                 <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="120px" />
153:                                 <MudCardContent>
154:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="30%" Class="mb-2" />
155:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="70%" Class="mb-4" />
156:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="50%" />
157:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="60%" />
158:                                 </MudCardContent>
159:                             </MudCard>
160:                         </MudItem>
161:                     </Placeholder>
162:                 </Virtualize>
163:             </MudGrid>
164: 
165:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-8 mb-8">
166:                 @FilteredOrganizations.Count() organization(s)
167:             </MudText>
168:         }
169:     }
170: </MudContainer>
````

````csharp
114: public class ImageStorageService : IImageStorageService
115: {
116:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient;
117:     private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
118:     private readonly ILogger<ImageStorageService> _logger;
119:     private const long DefaultMaxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
120: 
121:     public ImageStorageService(IEventApiClient apiClient, IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILogger<ImageStorageService> logger)
122:     {
123:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
124:         _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClientFactory));
125:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
126:     }

128: 
129:     public async Task<FileUploadData?> ReadFileAsync(IBrowserFile file, long maxFileSize = DefaultMaxFileSize)
130:     {
131:         if (file == null)
132:         {
133:             _logger.LogWarning("ReadFileAsync called with null file");
134:             return null;
135:         }
136: 
137:         try
138:         {
139:             _logger.LogInformation("Reading file into memory: {FileName}, Size: {Size} bytes, ContentType: {ContentType}",
140:                 file.Name, file.Size, file.ContentType);
141: 
142:             if (file.Size > maxFileSize)
143:             {
144:                 _logger.LogWarning("File {FileName} exceeds max size ({Size} > {MaxSize})",
145:                     file.Name, file.Size, maxFileSize);
146:                 return null;
147:             }
148: 
149: 
150:             await using var stream = file.OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize: maxFileSize);
151:             using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
152:             await stream.CopyToAsync(memoryStream);
153:             var bytes = memoryStream.ToArray();
154: 
155:             _logger.LogDebug("Successfully read {ByteCount} bytes from {FileName}", bytes.Length, file.Name);
156: 
157:             return new FileUploadData
158:             {
159:                 Content = bytes,
160:                 FileName = file.Name,
161:                 ContentType = file.ContentType
162:             };
163:         }
164:         catch (Exception ex)
165:         {
166:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error reading file {FileName} into memory", file.Name);
167:             return null;
168:         }
169:     }
170: 
171: 
172:     public async Task<ImageUploadResponse?> GetUploadUrlAsync(string fileName, string contentType)
173:     {
174:         try
175:         {
176:             _logger.LogInformation("Getting upload URL for: {FileName}, type: {ContentType}", fileName, contentType);
177: 
178:             var request = new UploadRequestDto
179:             {
180:                 FileName = fileName,
181:                 ContentType = contentType
182:             };
183: 
184:             var response = await _apiClient.GenerateUploadUrlAsync(request);
185: 
186: 
187:             if (response == null)
188:             {
189:                 _logger.LogWarning("GenerateUploadUrlAsync returned null response");
190:                 return null;
191:             }
192: 
193:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response.UploadUrl))
194:             {
195:                 _logger.LogWarning("UploadUrl is null or empty. Check server S3 configuration (bucket/endpoint/credentials)");
196:                 return null;
197:             }
198: 
199:             _logger.LogDebug("Got upload URL: {UploadUrlPreview}...", response.UploadUrl?.Substring(0, Math.Min(50, response.UploadUrl?.Length ?? 0)));
200:             return new ImageUploadResponse
201:             {
202:                 UploadUrl = response.UploadUrl ?? string.Empty,
203:                 ObjectKey = response.ObjectKey ?? string.Empty,
204:                 ViewUrl = response.ViewUrl ?? string.Empty,
205:                 ExpiresInMinutes = response.ExpiresInMinutes ?? 60
206:             };
207:         }
208:         catch (ApiException ex)
209:         {
210:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error getting upload URL: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
211:             return null;
212:         }
213:         catch (Exception ex)
214:         {
215:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting upload URL");
216:             return null;
217:         }
218:     }

220: 
221:     public async Task<bool> UploadImageAsync(string uploadUrl, IBrowserFile file)
222:     {
223:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uploadUrl))
224:         {
225:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL (empty/null) - aborting upload");
226:             return false;
227:         }
228: 
229:         if (!Uri.TryCreate(uploadUrl, UriKind.Absolute, out var validatedUri))
230:         {
231:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL format: {UploadUrl} - aborting upload", uploadUrl);
232:             return false;
233:         }
234: 
235:         try
236:         {
237:             _logger.LogInformation("Uploading to S3: {FileName}, Size: {Size} bytes, ContentType: {ContentType}, Host: {Host}",
238:                 file.Name, file.Size, file.ContentType, validatedUri.Host);
239: 
240: 
241:             using var s3Client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("S3Upload");
242: 
243: 
244:             const long maxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
245:             await using var stream = file.OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize: maxFileSize);
246:             using var content = new StreamContent(stream);
247: 
248: 
249:             content.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(file.ContentType);
250: 
251:             _logger.LogDebug("Sending PUT request to S3...");
252: 
253: 
254:             var response = await s3Client.PutAsync(validatedUri, content);
255: 
256:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
257:             {
258:                 var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
259:                 _logger.LogError("S3 upload failed: {StatusCode} - {ReasonPhrase} - {ErrorContent}",
260:                     (int)response.StatusCode, response.ReasonPhrase, errorContent);
261: 
262: 
263:                 if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
264:                 {
265:                     _logger.LogError("S3 403 Forbidden - Check: 1) CORS config on bucket 2) Pre-signed URL expired 3) Content-Type mismatch");
266:                 }
267:                 else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.BadRequest)
268:                 {
269:                     _logger.LogError("S3 400 Bad Request - Check: 1) Content-Type header matches pre-signed URL 2) Request headers are correct");
270:                 }
271:             }
272:             else
273:             {
274:                 var etag = response.Headers.ETag?.Tag ?? "no-etag";
275:                 _logger.LogInformation("S3 upload successful! ETag: {ETag}", etag);
276:             }
277: 
278:             return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
279:         }
280:         catch (HttpRequestException ex)
281:         {
282:             _logger.LogError(ex, "HTTP request error uploading to S3. This may be a CORS issue - check bucket CORS configuration.");
283:             return false;
284:         }
285:         catch (Exception ex)
286:         {
287:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error uploading image to S3");
288:             return false;
289:         }
290:     }

292: 
293:     public async Task<bool> UploadImageFromBytesAsync(string uploadUrl, FileUploadData fileData)
294:     {
295:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uploadUrl))
296:         {
297:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL (empty/null) - aborting upload");
298:             return false;
299:         }
300: 
301:         if (fileData == null || fileData.Content.Length == 0)
302:         {
303:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid file data (null or empty) - aborting upload");
304:             return false;
305:         }
306: 
307:         if (!Uri.TryCreate(uploadUrl, UriKind.Absolute, out var validatedUri))
308:         {
309:             _logger.LogWarning("Invalid upload URL format: {UploadUrl} - aborting upload", uploadUrl);
310:             return false;
311:         }
312: 
313:         try
314:         {
315:             _logger.LogInformation("Uploading to S3: {FileName}, Size: {Size} bytes, ContentType: {ContentType}, Host: {Host}",
316:                 fileData.FileName, fileData.Size, fileData.ContentType, validatedUri.Host);
317: 
318: 
319:             using var s3Client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("S3Upload");
320: 
321: 
322: 
323:             using var content = new ByteArrayContent(fileData.Content);
324: 
325: 
326:             content.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(fileData.ContentType);
327: 
328:             _logger.LogDebug("Sending PUT request to S3 with ByteArrayContent ({Size} bytes)...", fileData.Size);
329: 
330: 
331:             using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(3));
332:             var response = await s3Client.PutAsync(validatedUri, content, cts.Token);
333: 
334:             if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
335:             {
336:                 var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
337:                 _logger.LogError("S3 upload failed: {StatusCode} - {ReasonPhrase} - {ErrorContent}",
338:                     (int)response.StatusCode, response.ReasonPhrase, errorContent);
339: 
340: 
341:                 if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
342:                 {
343:                     _logger.LogError("S3 403 Forbidden - Check: 1) CORS config on bucket 2) Pre-signed URL expired 3) Content-Type mismatch");
344:                 }
345:                 else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.BadRequest)
346:                 {
347:                     _logger.LogError("S3 400 Bad Request - Check: 1) Content-Type header matches pre-signed URL 2) Request headers are correct");
348:                 }
349: 
350:                 return false;
351:             }
352: 
353:             var etag = response.Headers.ETag?.Tag ?? "no-etag";
354:             _logger.LogInformation("S3 upload successful! ETag: {ETag}, Size: {Size} bytes", etag, fileData.Size);
355:             return true;
356:         }
357:         catch (OperationCanceledException)
358:         {
359:             _logger.LogError("S3 upload timed out after 3 minutes for file {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
360:             return false;
361:         }
362:         catch (HttpRequestException ex)
363:         {
364:             _logger.LogError(ex, "HTTP request error uploading to S3. This may be a CORS issue - check bucket CORS configuration. File: {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
365:             return false;
366:         }
367:         catch (Exception ex)
368:         {
369:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error uploading image to S3. File: {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
370:             return false;
371:         }
372:     }

374: 
375:     public async Task<ImageUploadResult?> UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync(FileUploadData fileData)
376:     {
377:         if (fileData == null || fileData.Content.Length == 0)
378:         {
379:             _logger.LogWarning("UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync called with null or empty file data");
380:             return new ImageUploadResult
381:             {
382:                 Success = false,
383:                 ErrorMessage = "No file data provided"
384:             };
385:         }
386: 
387:         try
388:         {
389:             _logger.LogInformation("Starting byte-based upload process for: {FileName} ({Size} bytes)",
390:                 fileData.FileName, fileData.Size);
391: 
392: 
393:             var uploadResponse = await GetUploadUrlAsync(fileData.FileName, fileData.ContentType);
394:             if (uploadResponse == null)
395:             {
396:                 _logger.LogError("Failed to get pre-signed URL for file {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
397:                 return new ImageUploadResult
398:                 {
399:                     Success = false,
400:                     ErrorMessage = "Failed to get pre-signed URL. Please check your authentication and try again."
401:                 };
402:             }
403: 
404:             _logger.LogDebug("Got pre-signed URL. ObjectKey: {ObjectKey}", uploadResponse.ObjectKey);
405: 
406: 
407:             var uploadSuccess = await UploadImageFromBytesAsync(uploadResponse.UploadUrl, fileData);
408:             if (!uploadSuccess)
409:             {
410:                 _logger.LogError("S3 upload failed for file {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
411:                 return new ImageUploadResult
412:                 {
413:                     Success = false,
414:                     ErrorMessage = "Failed to upload image to storage. Please check your connection and try again."
415:                 };
416:             }
417: 
418:             _logger.LogDebug("S3 upload completed successfully for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
419: 
420: 
421:             var createDto = new CreateStorageObjectDto
422:             {
423:                 FileTypeId = GetFileTypeId(fileData.ContentType),
424:                 Uri = uploadResponse.ViewUrl,
425:                 FullName = fileData.FileName,
426:                 Extension = Path.GetExtension(fileData.FileName),
427:                 Size = fileData.Size
428:             };
429: 
430:             _logger.LogInformation("Creating StorageObject record for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
431: 
432:             BaseCommandResponseOfGuid? createResponse = null;
433:             try
434:             {
435:                 createResponse = await _apiClient.StorageobjectPOSTAsync(createDto);
436:                 _logger.LogInformation("StorageObject API response received: Success={Success}, Id={Id}, Message={Message}",
437:                     createResponse?.Success, createResponse?.Id, createResponse?.Message);
438:             }
439:             catch (Exception apiEx)
440:             {
441:                 _logger.LogError(apiEx, "Exception calling StorageobjectPOSTAsync for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
442:                 return new ImageUploadResult
443:                 {
444:                     Success = false,
445:                     ErrorMessage = $"API call failed: {apiEx.Message}"
446:                 };
447:             }
448: 
449:             if (createResponse?.Success == true)
450:             {
451:                 _logger.LogInformation("StorageObject created successfully! ID: {StorageObjectId}", createResponse.Id);
452:                 var result = new ImageUploadResult
453:                 {
454:                     Success = true,
455:                     StorageObjectId = createResponse.Id ?? Guid.Empty,
456:                     ViewUrl = uploadResponse.ViewUrl,
457:                     ObjectKey = uploadResponse.ObjectKey
458:                 };
459:                 _logger.LogInformation("Returning successful ImageUploadResult for {FileName}", fileData.FileName);
460:                 return result;
461:             }
462:             else
463:             {
464:                 var errorMsg = createResponse?.Message ?? "Failed to create storage object record";
465:                 _logger.LogWarning("StorageObject creation failed: {Message}", errorMsg);
466:                 return new ImageUploadResult

475:             _logger.LogError(ex, "API error during upload process: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
476:             return new ImageUploadResult

495:     {
496:         try
497:         {
498:             _logger.LogInformation("Starting upload process for: {FileName}", file.Name);
499: 
500: 
501:             var uploadResponse = await GetUploadUrlAsync(file.Name, file.ContentType);
502:             if (uploadResponse == null)
503:             {
504:                 return new ImageUploadResult
505:                 {
506:                     Success = false,
507:                     ErrorMessage = "Failed to get pre-signed URL"
508:                 };
509:             }
510: 
511: 
512:             var uploadSuccess = await UploadImageAsync(uploadResponse.UploadUrl, file);
513:             if (!uploadSuccess)
514:             {
515:                 return new ImageUploadResult
516:                 {
517:                     Success = false,
518:                     ErrorMessage = "Failed to upload image to storage"
519:                 };
520:             }

522: 
523:             var createDto = new CreateStorageObjectDto
524:             {
525:                 FileTypeId = GetFileTypeId(file.ContentType),
526:                 Uri = uploadResponse.ViewUrl,
527:                 FullName = file.Name,
528:                 Extension = Path.GetExtension(file.Name),
529:                 Size = file.Size
530:             };
531: 
532:             _logger.LogInformation("Creating StorageObject record");
533:             var createResponse = await _apiClient.StorageobjectPOSTAsync(createDto);

535:             if (createResponse?.Success == true)

537:                 _logger.LogInformation("StorageObject created with ID: {StorageObjectId}", createResponse.Id);
538:                 return new ImageUploadResult
539:                 {
540:                     Success = true,
541:                     StorageObjectId = createResponse.Id ?? Guid.Empty,
542:                     ViewUrl = uploadResponse.ViewUrl,
543:                     ObjectKey = uploadResponse.ObjectKey
544:                 };
545:             }
546:             else
547:             {
548:                 _logger.LogWarning("StorageObject creation failed: {Message}", createResponse?.Message);
549:                 return new ImageUploadResult

551:                     Success = false,
552:                     ErrorMessage = createResponse?.Message ?? "Failed to create storage object record"
553:                 };

578:     {

580:         {
581:             return null;
582:         }
583: 
584:         try
585:         {
586:             string objectKey;
587: 
588:             if (Uri.TryCreate(imageKey, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
589:             {
590: 
591:                 objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
592:             }
593:             else
594:             {
595: 
596:                 objectKey = imageKey;
597:             }
598: 
599: 
600:             using var httpClient = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("BffClient");
601:             var response = await httpClient.GetAsync($"/api/StorageObject/presigned-url-by-key/{objectKey}?expirationMinutes=60");
602: 
603:             if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
604:             {
605:                 var presignedResponse = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<PresignedDownloadUrlResponse>();
606:                 if (presignedResponse != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(presignedResponse.PresignedUrl))
607:                 {
608:                     return presignedResponse.PresignedUrl;
609:                 }
610:             }
611: 
612:             _logger.LogWarning("Failed to get presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}, Status: {StatusCode}", objectKey, response.StatusCode);
613:             return null;
614:         }
615:         catch (Exception ex)

617:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error getting presigned URL");

668:     public async Task<string> GenerateLocalPreviewAsync(IBrowserFile file, long maxFileSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024)
669:     {
670:         try
671:         {
672:             var resizedImage = await file.RequestImageFileAsync(file.ContentType, 400, 400);
673:             using var stream = resizedImage.OpenReadStream(maxFileSize);
674:             using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
675:             await stream.CopyToAsync(memoryStream);
676:             var bytes = memoryStream.ToArray();
677:             return $"data:{file.ContentType};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(bytes)}";
678:         }
679:         catch (Exception ex)

682:             return string.Empty;

691:             _logger.LogWarning("GenerateLocalPreviewFromBytes called with null or empty file data");
692:             return string.Empty;
693:         }
694: 
695:         try
696:         {
697:             return $"data:{fileData.ContentType};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(fileData.Content)}";
698:         }
699:         catch (Exception ex)

701:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error generating preview from bytes");
702:             return string.Empty;
703:         }

706:     private int GetFileTypeId(string contentType)
707:     {
708:         return contentType.ToLower() switch
709:         {
710:             "image/jpeg" or "image/jpg" => 1,
711:             "image/png" => 2,
712:             "image/gif" => 3,
713:             "image/webp" => 4,
714:             "image/svg+xml" => 5,
715:             _ => 1
716:         };
717:     }
718: }
````

````csharp
203:     private async Task CheckRegistrationStatusAsync()
204:     {
205:         try
206:         {
207:             var authState = await AuthStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
208:             if (authState.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
209:             {
210:                 var user = await UserService.GetCurrentUserAsync();
211:                 if (user?.Id != null)
212:                 {
213:                     var registrations = await EventService.GetRegistrationsByUserAsync(user.Id.Value);
214:                     if (_eventSessions != null && registrations != null)
215:                     {
216:                         var sessionIds = _eventSessions.Select(s => s.Id).ToHashSet();
217:                         var matchingRegistrations = registrations
218:                             .Where(r => sessionIds.Contains(r.EventSessionId) && r.Id.HasValue)
219:                             .ToList();
220:                         _isUserRegistered = matchingRegistrations.Any();
221:                         _userRegistrationIds = matchingRegistrations.Select(r => r.Id!.Value).ToList();
222:                     }
223:                 }
224:             }
225:         }
226:         catch (Exception ex)
227:         {
228:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error checking registration status");
229:         }
230:     }

235:     private async Task CancelRegistrationAsync()
236:     {
237:         if (!_userRegistrationIds.Any()) return;
238: 
239:         var confirm = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
240:             "Cancel Registration",
241:             $"Are you sure you want to cancel your registration for \"{_eventDetails?.Title}\"?",
242:             yesText: "Cancel Registration",
243:             cancelText: "Keep Registration");
244: 
245:         if (confirm != true) return;
246: 
247:         _isCancellingRegistration = true;
248: 
249:         try
250:         {
251:             var allCancelled = true;
252:             foreach (var registrationId in _userRegistrationIds)
253:             {
254:                 var success = await EventService.CancelEventRegistrationAsync(registrationId);
255:                 if (!success) allCancelled = false;
256:             }
257: 
258:             if (allCancelled)
259:             {
260:                 _isUserRegistered = false;
261:                 _userRegistrationIds.Clear();
262:                 Logger.LogInformation("Registration cancelled for event {EventId}", EventId);
263:             }
264:             else
265:             {
266:                 _errorMessage = "Some registrations could not be cancelled. Please try again.";
267: 
268:                 await CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
269:             }
270:         }
271:         catch (Exception ex)
272:         {
273:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error cancelling registration for event {EventId}", EventId);
274:             _errorMessage = "An error occurred while cancelling registration.";
275:         }
276:         finally
277:         {
278:             _isCancellingRegistration = false;
279:         }
280:     }

435:     private async Task OpenRegistrationDialog()

437:         if (_eventDetails == null) return;
438: 
439: 
440:         if (_eventSessions == null || !_eventSessions.Any())
441:         {
442:             await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
443:                 "Registration unavailable",
444:                 "No sessions are available for this event yet.",
445:                 yesText: "OK");
446:             return;
447:         }
448: 
449: 
450:         if (_eventSessions.Count == 1)
451:         {
452:             await RegisterForSession(_eventSessions.First());
453:         }
454: 
455:         else
456:         {
457:             var parameters = new DialogParameters
458:             {
459:                 { "Sessions", _eventSessions.ToList() }
460:             };
461: 
462:             var options = new DialogOptions
463:             {
464:                 CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
465:                 MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
466:                 FullWidth = true,
467:                 Position = DialogPosition.Center
468:             };
469: 
470:             var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<SessionSelectionDialog>(
471:                 "Select Session",
472:                 parameters,
473:                 options);
474: 
475:             var result = await dialog.Result;
476: 
477:             if (result != null && !result.Canceled && result.Data is List<Guid> selectedSessionIds)
478:             {
479: 
480:                 int successCount = 0;
481:                 foreach (var sessionId in selectedSessionIds)
482:                 {
483:                     var session = _eventSessions.First(s => s.Id == sessionId);
484:                     if (await RegisterForSession(session))
485:                     {
486:                         successCount++;
487:                     }
488:                 }
489: 
490:                 if (successCount > 0)
491:                 {
492: 
493:                     await CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
494:                 }
495:             }
496:         }

503:     {
504:         var parameters = new DialogParameters
505:         {
506:             { "EventSessionId", session.Id },
507:             { "Title", $"Register for {_eventDetails!.Title} - {session.Title}" }
508:         };
509: 
510:         var options = new DialogOptions
511:         {
512:             CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
513:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium,
514:             FullWidth = true,
515:             Position = DialogPosition.Center
516:         };
517: 
518:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EventRegistration>(
519:             "Register",
520:             parameters,
521:             options);
522: 
523:         var result = await dialog.Result;
524: 
525:         if (result != null && !result.Canceled)
526:         {
527:             Logger.LogInformation("Registration completed for session {SessionId}", session.Id);
528: 
529: 
530:             if (_eventSessions != null && _eventSessions.Count == 1)
531:             {
532:                 await CheckRegistrationStatusAsync();
533:             }
534:             return true;
535:         }
536:         return false;
537:     }
````

````razor
 58:                         <MudAvatar Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="mb-4" Style="width: 64px; height: 64px;">
 59:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.DesktopWindows" Size="Size.Large" />
 60:                         </MudAvatar>
 61:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700;">Digital</MudText>
 62:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Join online sessions</MudText>
 63:                     </MudPaper>
 64:                 </MudItem>
 65:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 66:                     <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-6 rounded-xl border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default cursor-pointer hover:mud-elevation-4 transition-all d-flex flex-column align-center text-center h-100" @onclick='() => Nav.NavigateTo("/archive")'>
 67:                         <MudAvatar Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="mb-4" Style="width: 64px; height: 64px;">
 68:                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Download" Size="Size.Large" />
 69:                         </MudAvatar>
 70:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700;">Archive</MudText>
 71:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Watch past recordings</MudText>
 72:                     </MudPaper>
 73:                 </MudItem>
 74:             </MudGrid>
 75:         </div>
 76: 
 77:         <!-- FEATURED EVENTS -->
 78:         <div class="mb-12">
 79:             <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center mb-8">
 80:                 <div>
 81:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 700;">Featured Events</MudText>
 82:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary">Discover upcoming events from our community</MudText>
 83:                 </div>
 84:                 <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward" Href="/events" Class="rounded-pill">View All</MudButton>
 85:             </div>
 86: 
 87:             @if (_isLoading)
 88:             {
 89:                 <div class="d-flex justify-center py-12">
 90:                     <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" />
 91:                 </div>
 92:             }
 93:             else if (_events.Any())
 94:             {
 95:                 <MudCarousel TData="object" AutoCycle="true" CycleInterval="6000" ShowArrows="true" ShowBullets="true" Style="height: 460px;">
 96:                     @foreach (var chunk in Chunk(_events, 3))
 97:                     {
 98:                         <MudCarouselItem Transition="Transition.Slide" Color="Color.Transparent">
 99:                             <div class="d-flex justify-center gap-6 px-12 h-100 align-center">
100:                                 @foreach (var evt in chunk)
101:                                 {
102:                                     <MudCard @key="evt.Id" Elevation="0" Class="border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-xl overflow-hidden d-flex flex-column h-100" Style="flex: 1; max-width: 400px; transition: transform 0.2s;" onclick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo($"/event/detail/{evt.Id}"))">
103:                                         <div style="height: 200px; background-color: var(--mud-palette-background-grey); position: relative;">
104:                                             @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.FeaturedImageUri))
105:                                             {
106:                                                 <MudImage Src="@evt.FeaturedImageUri" ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" Style="width: 100%; height: 100%;" />
107:                                             }
108:                                             else
109:                                             {
110:                                                 <div class="d-flex justify-center align-center h-100">
111:                                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Image" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" />
112:                                                 </div>
113:                                             }
114:                                             <div class="absolute pa-3 d-flex gap-2" style="top: 0; left: 0;">
115:                                                 <MudChip T="string" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">@(evt.EventTypeFullName ?? "Event")</MudChip>
116:                                                 <MudChip T="string" Color="Color.Surface" Size="Size.Small" Variant="Variant.Filled">@(evt.EventFormatFullName ?? "Online")</MudChip>
117:                                             </div>
118:                                         </div>
119:                                         <MudCardContent Class="flex-grow-1 d-flex flex-column pa-4">
120:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-2" Style="font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3;">@evt.Title</MudText>
121:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-4 flex-grow-1" Style="overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;">
122:                                                 @TruncateText(evt.Description, 150)
123:                                             </MudText>
124:                                             <MudDivider Class="my-3" />
125:                                             <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center">
126:                                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2">
127:                                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
128:                                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(evt.ActorDisplayName ?? "Community")</MudText>
129:                                                 </div>
130:                                                 <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1">
131:                                                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
132:                                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@evt.TotalViews</MudText>
133:                                                 </div>
134:                                             </div>
135:                                         </MudCardContent>
136:                                     </MudCard>
137:                                 }
138:                             </div>
139:                         </MudCarouselItem>
140:                     }
141:                 </MudCarousel>
142:             }
143:             else
144:             {
145:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="justify-center">No featured events available at the moment.</MudAlert>
146:             }
147:         </div>
148:     </MudContainer>
149: </div>
150: 
151: @inject NavigationManager Nav
````
