 18:                     <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business" Size="Size.Medium" />
 19:                 </MudAvatar>
 20:                 <div>
 21:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Style="font-weight: 800;">Create Organization</MudText>
 22:                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary">
 23:                         Fill in the details to register your organization.
 24:                     </MudText>
 25:                 </div>
 26:             </MudStack>
 27:         </div>
 28: 
 29:         <div class="pa-6">
 30:             @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(errorMessage))
 31:             {
 32:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg" ShowCloseIcon="true" CloseIconClicked="@(() => errorMessage = string.Empty)">
 33:                     @errorMessage
 34:                 </MudAlert>
 35:             }
 36: 
 37:             @if (submitSuccess)
 38:             {
 39:                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Success" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mb-6 rounded-lg">
 40:                     Organization successfully submitted for review! Redirecting...
 41:                 </MudAlert>
 42:             }
 43: 
 44:             <MudStepper Elevation="0" Rounded="true" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled">
 45:                 <MudStep Title="Basic Info" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Info">
 46:                     <div class="py-6">
 47:                         <MudGrid Spacing="4">
 48:                             <MudItem xs="12" md="4" Class="d-flex flex-column align-center">
 49:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Class="mb-4" Style="font-weight: 700;">Logo</MudText>
 50:                                 <ImageUpload @ref="_imageUpload"
 51:                                              PreviewUrl="@logoPreview"
 52:                                              PreviewUrlChanged="OnLogoPreviewUrlChanged"
 53:                                              FileDataSelected="OnLogoFileDataSelected"
 54:                                              IsProcessing="_isUploadingLogo"
 55:                                              Width="180px"
 56:                                              Height="180px"
 57:                                              PlaceholderText="Select Logo"
 58:                                              Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business" />
 59:                                 @if (_isUploadingLogo)
 60:                                 {
 61:                                     <MudStack Row AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Class="mt-4">
 62:                                         <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Color="Color.Primary" />
 63:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption">Uploading...</MudText>
 64:                                     </MudStack>
 65:                                 }
 66:                                 @if (_logoUploadError != null)
 67:                                 {
 68:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Error" Class="mt-2">@_logoUploadError</MudText>
 69:                                 }
 70:                             </MudItem>
 71:                             <MudItem xs="12" md="8">
 72:                                 <MudStack Spacing="4">
 73:                                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="organization.FullName"
 74:                                                   Label="Organization Name"
 75:                                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 76:                                                   Required
 77:                                                   Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 78:                                                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business" />
 79: 
 80:                                     <MudTextField @bind-Value="organization.WebsiteUrl"
 81:                                                   Label="Website URL (Optional)"
 82:                                                   Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 83:                                                   Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 84:                                                   AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Language" />
 85: 
 86:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Color="Color.Primary">Organization Page Appearance (Optional)</MudText>
 87:                                     <MudGrid Spacing="2">
 88:                                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="4">
 89:                                             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundColor"
 90:                                                           Label="Background Color"
 91:                                                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 92:                                                           InputType="InputType.Color" />
 93:                                         </MudItem>
 94:                                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="8">
 95:                                             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl"
 96:                                                           Label="Background Media URL"
 97:                                                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 98:                                                           Placeholder="https://... (image or GIF)" />
 99:                                         </MudItem>
100:                                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
101:                                             <MudSelect T="string"
102:                                                        Label="Background Effect"
103:                                                        Variant="Variant.Outlined"
104:                                                        @bind-Value="_appearance.BackgroundEffect">
105:                                                 <MudSelectItem Value="@("None")">None</MudSelectItem>
106:                                                 <MudSelectItem Value="@("SoftOverlay")">Soft Overlay</MudSelectItem>
107:                                                 <MudSelectItem Value="@("StrongOverlay")">Strong Overlay</MudSelectItem>
108:                                                 <MudSelectItem Value="@("Blur")">Blur</MudSelectItem>
109:                                             </MudSelect>
110:                                         </MudItem>
111:                                     </MudGrid>
112:                                 </MudStack>
113:                             </MudItem>
114:                         </MudGrid>
115:                     </div>
116:                 </MudStep>
117: 
118:                 <MudStep Title="Contact & Address" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn">
119:                     <div class="py-6">
120:                         <MudGrid Spacing="3">
121:                             <MudItem xs="12">
122:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="organization.Email"
123:                                               Label="Contact Email"
124:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
125:                                               InputType="InputType.Email"
126:                                               Required
127:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
128:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Email" />
129:                             </MudItem>
130: 
131:                             <MudItem xs="12">
132:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="organization.Address"
133:                                               Label="Street Address"
134:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
135:                                               Required
136:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
137:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Home" />
138:                             </MudItem>
139: 
140:                             <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
141:                                 <MudNumericField @bind-Value="organization.Postcode"
142:                                                  Label="Postal Code"
143:                                                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"
144:                                                  Required
145:                                                  HideSpinButtons="true"
146:                                                  Adornment="Adornment.Start"
147:                                                  AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Pin" />
148:                             </MudItem>
149: 
150:                             <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
151:                                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="organization.City"
152:                                               Label="City"
153:                                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
154:                                               Required
155:                                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
156:                                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationCity" />
157:                             </MudItem>
158: 
159:                             <MudItem xs="12" md="4">
160:                                 <MudSelect @bind-Value="organization.Country"
161:                                            Label="Country"
162:                                            Variant="Variant.Outlined"
163:                                            AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter"
164:                                            Required>
165:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("Netherlands")">Netherlands</MudSelectItem>
166:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("Belgium")">Belgium</MudSelectItem>
167:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("Germany")">Germany</MudSelectItem>
168:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("France")">France</MudSelectItem>
169:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("United Kingdom")">United Kingdom</MudSelectItem>
170:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("Spain")">Spain</MudSelectItem>
171:                                     <MudSelectItem Value="@("Other")">Other</MudSelectItem>
172:                                 </MudSelect>
173:                             </MudItem>
174:                         </MudGrid>
175:                     </div>
176:                 </MudStep>
177: 
178:                 <MudStep Title="Review & Submit" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.DoneAll">
179:                     <div class="py-6">
180:                         <MudGrid Spacing="4">
181:                             <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
182:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Style="font-weight: 700;" Class="mb-4">Information Summary</MudText>
183:                                 <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 bg-surface border-solid border-1 mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">
184:                                     <MudStack Spacing="2">
185:                                         <div class="d-flex justify-space-between">
186:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Name:</MudText>
187:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">@organization.FullName</MudText>
188:                                         </div>
189:                                         <div class="d-flex justify-space-between">
190:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Email:</MudText>
191:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">@organization.Email</MudText>
192:                                         </div>
193:                                         <div class="d-flex justify-space-between">
194:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Website:</MudText>
195:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">@(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(organization.WebsiteUrl) ? "N/A" : organization.WebsiteUrl)</MudText>
196:                                         </div>
197:                                         <MudDivider Class="my-2" />
198:                                         <div class="d-flex flex-column">
199:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">Address:</MudText>
200:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">@organization.Address</MudText>
201:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="font-weight: 600;">@organization.Postcode @organization.City, @organization.Country</MudText>
202:                                         </div>
203:                                     </MudStack>
204:                                 </MudPaper>
205:                             </MudItem>
206: 
207:                             <MudItem xs="12" md="6">
208:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle1" Style="font-weight: 700;" Class="mb-4">Confirm Details</MudText>
209:                                 <MudStack Spacing="2">
210:                                     <MudCheckBox @bind-Value="acceptTerms"
211:                                                  Color="Color.Primary"
212:                                                  Label="I agree to the Terms and Conditions" />
213: 
214:                                     <MudCheckBox @bind-Value="confirmInformation"
215:                                                  Color="Color.Primary"
216:                                                  Label="I confirm that all information is accurate" />
217:                                 </MudStack>
218: 
219:                                 <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Class="mt-6 rounded-lg">
220:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
221:                                         Your request will be reviewed by an administrator. This usually takes 1-3 business days.
222:                                     </MudText>
223:                                 </MudAlert>
224:                             </MudItem>
225:                         </MudGrid>
226: 
227:                         <div class="d-flex justify-end mt-8">
228:                             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
229:                                        Color="Color.Primary"
230:                                        Size="Size.Large"
231:                                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Send"
232:                                        OnClick="@HandleSubmit"
233:                                        Disabled="@(!CanSubmit() || isSubmitting)"
234:                                        Class="rounded-pill px-8">
235:                                 @if (isSubmitting)
236:                                 {
237:                                     <MudProgressCircular Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" Class="mr-2" />
238:                                     <span>Submitting...</span>
239:                                 }
240:                                 else
241:                                 {
242:                                     <span>Submit for Review</span>
243:                                 }
244:                             </MudButton>
245:                         </div>
246:                     </div>
247:                 </MudStep>
248:             </MudStepper>
249:         </div>
250:     </MudCard>
251: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/MyEvents.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/myevents"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  5: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event
  7: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  8: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.Virtualization
  9: @rendermode @(new InteractiveAutoRenderMode(prerender: false))
 10: @attribute [Authorize]
 11: 
 12: <PageTitle>My Events</PageTitle>
 13: 
 14: <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge" Class="py-4 py-sm-8 py-md-12">
 15:     <!-- Header -->
 16:     <div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-end justify-space-between gap-4 mb-8">
 17:         <div>
 18:             <MudText Typo="Typo.overline" Class="mud-text-secondary" Style="letter-spacing: 0.18em;">MANAGE</MudText>
 19:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h4">My Events</MudText>
 20:         </div>
 21:         <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-3">
 22:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 23:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 24:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business"
 25:                        OnClick="NavigateToCreateOrganization">
 26:                 Create Organization
 27:             </MudButton>
 28:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
 29:                        Color="Color.Primary"
 30:                        StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add"
 31:                        OnClick="NavigateToCreateEvent">
 32:                 Organize Event
 33:             </MudButton>
 34:         </div>
 35:     </div>
 36: 
 37:     @if (_isLoading)
 38:     {
 39:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 40:             <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
 41:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-4">
 42:                 Loading your events...
 43:             </MudText>
 44:         </div>
 45:     }
 46:     else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
 47:     {
 48:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="my-4">
 49:             @_errorMessage
 50:             <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Inherit" OnClick="RetryLoadAsync" Class="ml-4">
 51:                 Retry
 52:             </MudButton>
 53:         </MudAlert>
 54:     }
 55:     else
 56:     {
 57:         <!-- Filters -->
 58:         <MudGrid Class="mb-8">
 59:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="3">
 60:                 <MudSelect T="Guid?" Value="@_selectedOrganizationId" ValueChanged="@((Guid? v) => OnOrganizationChanged(v))"
 61:                            Label="Organization" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true">
 62:                     <MudSelectItem T="Guid?" Value="@Guid.Empty">All Organizations</MudSelectItem>
 63:                     @foreach (var org in _myOrganizations)
 64:                     {
 65:                         <MudSelectItem @key="org.Id" T="Guid?" Value="@org.Id">@org.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 66:                     }
 67:                 </MudSelect>
 68:             </MudItem>
 69:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="3">
 70:                 <MudSelect T="string" Value="@_selectedCategory" ValueChanged="@((string? v) => OnCategoryChanged(v))"
 71:                            Label="Event Type" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Margin="Margin.Dense" Dense="true" AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter" Clearable="true">
 72:                     <MudSelectItem T="string" Value="@("")">All Types</MudSelectItem>
 73:                     @foreach (var eventType in UniqueEventTypes)
 74:                     {
 75:                         <MudSelectItem T="string" Value="@eventType">@eventType</MudSelectItem>
 76:                     }
 77:                 </MudSelect>
 78:             </MudItem>
 79:             <MudItem xs="12" sm="12" md="6">
 80:                 <MudTextField @bind-Value="_searchString"
 81:                               Placeholder="Search events..."
 82:                               Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 83:                               AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 84:                               Immediate="true"
 85:                               DebounceInterval="300"
 86:                               TextChanged="OnSearch"
 87:                               Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 88:                               Margin="Margin.Dense" />
 89:             </MudItem>
 90:         </MudGrid>
 91: 
 92:         @if (!AllFilteredEvents.Any())
 93:         {
 94:             <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
 95:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Event" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" Style="width: 80px; height: 80px; opacity: 0.2;" />
 96:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mt-4">No events found</MudText>
 97:                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">
 98:                     @if (_events.Any())
 99:                     {
100:                         <span>Try adjusting your filters</span>
101:                     }
102:                     else
103:                     {
104:                         <span>Create an event to get started</span>
105:                     }
106:                 </MudText>
107:             </div>
108:         }
109:         else
110:         {
111:             <!-- Event Cards — Virtualized infinite scroll -->
112:             <MudGrid>
113:                 <Virtualize Items="@AllFilteredEvents" Context="evt" OverscanCount="4">
114:                     <ItemContent>
115:                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
116:                             <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column position-relative">
117:                                 <div style="position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; z-index: 10;">
118:                                     <MudMenu Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MoreVert" AriaLabel="Event options" Dense="true" Color="Color.Default" Variant="Variant.Filled" Size="Size.Small" Style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border-radius: 8px;">
119:                                         @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
120:                                         {
121:                                             <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => EditEvent(evt))">
122:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Edit
123:                                             </MudMenuItem>
124:                                         }
125:                                         <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => ViewEventDetails(evt))">
126:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Visibility" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> View Details
127:                                         </MudMenuItem>
128:                                         @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
129:                                         {
130:                                             <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => ViewRegistrations(evt))">
131:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.People" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Registrations
132:                                             </MudMenuItem>
133:                                             <MudMenuItem OnClick="@(() => DeleteEvent(evt))" Class="text-error">
134:                                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Delete" Class="mr-2" Size="Size.Small" /> Delete
135:                                             </MudMenuItem>
136:                                         }
137:                                     </MudMenu>
138:                                 </div>
139: 
140:                                 <MudCardMedia Image="@GetEventImageUrl(evt)" Height="200" />
141:                                 
142:                                 <MudCardContent Class="flex-grow-1">
143:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.button" Class="mud-text-disabled mb-1">@(evt.EventTypeFullName ?? "Event")</MudText>
144:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="mb-4">@evt.Title</MudText>
145:                                     <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Style="overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;">
146:                                         @evt.Description
147:                                     </MudText>
148:                                     
149:                                     <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2 mt-4">
150:                                         <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Info" Variant="Variant.Outlined" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Business">
151:                                             @(evt.ActorDisplayName ?? "Unknown")
152:                                         </MudChip>
153:                                         <div class="d-flex align-center gap-1 ml-auto">
154:                                             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.LocationOn" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Secondary" />
155:                                             <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Secondary">@(evt.EventFormatFullName ?? "Online")</MudText>
156:                                         </div>
157:                                     </div>
158:                                 </MudCardContent>
159: 
160:                                 <MudCardActions>
161:                                     <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text"
162:                                                Color="Color.Primary"
163:                                                Href="@($"/event/detail/{evt.Id}")"
164:                                                EndIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowForward">
165:                                         Details
166:                                     </MudButton>
167:                                     <MudSpacer />
168:                                     @if (CanEditEvent(evt))
169:                                     {
170:                                         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Secondary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit" OnClick="@(() => EditEvent(evt))">Edit</MudButton>
171:                                     }
172:                                 </MudCardActions>
173:                             </MudCard>
174:                         </MudItem>
175:                     </ItemContent>
176:                     <Placeholder>
177:                         <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
178:                             <MudCard Class="h-100 d-flex flex-column">
179:                                 <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="200px" />
180:                                 <MudCardContent>
181:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="40%" Class="mb-1" />
182:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="80%" Class="mb-4" />
183:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="100%" />
184:                                     <MudSkeleton Width="60%" />
185:                                 </MudCardContent>
186:                             </MudCard>
187:                         </MudItem>
188:                     </Placeholder>
189:                 </Virtualize>
190:             </MudGrid>
191: 
192:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mt-8 mb-8">
193:                 @AllFilteredEvents.Count event(s)
194:             </MudText>
195:         }
196:     }
197: </MudContainer>
````

## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Layout/NavMenu.razor
````razor
  1: @*
  2:     NavMenu Component - BEM Methodology
  3:     Block: navbar
  4:     Elements: __content, __brand, __brand-icon, __brand-text, __brand-highlight,
  5:               __links, __link, __actions, __theme-toggle, __create-event-btn, __login-btn,
  6:               __user-dropdown, __user-btn, __user-avatar, __user-name, __user-arrow,
  7:               __dropdown-menu, __dropdown-header, __dropdown-divider, __dropdown-section-label,
  8:               __dropdown-item, __dropdown-overlay
  9:     Modifiers: __link--active, __dropdown-menu--open, __dropdown-item--danger
 10: *@
 11: 
 12: <div class="navbar">
 13:     <div class="navbar__content">
 14:         <!-- Brand -->
 15:         <a href="/" class="navbar__brand" aria-label="Home">
 16:             @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_brandLogoUrl))
 17:             {
 18:                 <MudImage Src="@_brandLogoUrl" Alt="@_brandDisplayName" Class="navbar__brand-icon" Width="28" Height="28" />
 19:             }
 20:             else
 21:             {
 22:                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Explore" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Class="navbar__brand-icon" />
 23:             }
 24:             <div class="navbar__brand-text">@_brandDisplayName</div>
 25:         </a>
 26: 
 27:         <!-- Global Search -->
 28:         <div class="navbar__search">
 29:             <MudTextField T="string"
 30:                           Placeholder="Search events..."
 31:                           Adornment="Adornment.Start"
 32:                           AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search"
 33:                           IconSize="Size.Medium"
 34:                           Variant="Variant.Outlined"
 35:                           Margin="Margin.Dense"
 36:                           Class="navbar__search-input"
 37:                           @bind-Value="SearchQuery"
 38:                           @onkeyup="@HandleSearchKeyPress" />
 39:         </div>
 40: 
 41:         <!-- Center Navigation -->
 42:         <div class="navbar__links">
 43:             <NavLink href="/events" class="navbar__link" Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix" ActiveClass="navbar__link--active">
 44:                 Events
 45:             </NavLink>
 46: 
 47:             @* Dynamic tenant navigation links *@
 48:             @foreach (var link in _navigationLinks.OrderBy(l => l.Order))
 49:             {
 50:                 var icon = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(link.Icon) ? Icons.Material.Filled.Link : link.Icon;
 51: 
 52:                 @if (link.OpenInNewTab == true)
 53:                 {
 54:                     <a @key="link.Id" href="@link.Url" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="navbar__link" title="@link.Label">

265:                 </MudTabPanel>
266:                 <MudTabPanel Text="@($"Pending ({PendingCount})")">
267:                     <AdminOrganizationTable Items="GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus.Pending)"
268:                                             OnApprove="Approve"
269:                                             OnReject="Reject"
270:                                             OnRevert="RevertToPending"
271:                                             OnViewDetails="ViewDetails"
272:                                             OnClearFilters="ClearFilters" />
273:                 </MudTabPanel>
274:                 <MudTabPanel Text="@($"Approved ({ApprovedCount})")">
275:                     <AdminOrganizationTable Items="GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus.Approved)"
276:                                             OnApprove="Approve"
277:                                             OnReject="Reject"
278:                                             OnRevert="RevertToPending"
279:                                             OnViewDetails="ViewDetails"
280:                                             OnClearFilters="ClearFilters" />
281:                 </MudTabPanel>
282:                 <MudTabPanel Text="@($"Rejected ({RejectedCount})")">
283:                     <AdminOrganizationTable Items="GetFilteredAndSorted(RequestStatus.Rejected)"
284:                                             OnApprove="Approve"
285:                                             OnReject="Reject"
286:                                             OnRevert="RevertToPending"
287:                                             OnViewDetails="ViewDetails"
288:                                             OnClearFilters="ClearFilters" />
289:                 </MudTabPanel>
290:             </MudTabs>
291:         </MudPaper>
292:     }
293: 
294: </MudContainer>

315:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
316:     {
317:         var eventIdStr = RouterState.GetParam("eventId");
318:         if (Guid.TryParse(eventIdStr, out var id))
319:         {
320:             EventId = id;
321:         }
322: 
323:         try
324:         {
325:             isLoading = true;
326: 
327:             var eventTypesTask = AdminService.GetEventTypesAsync();
328:             var eventFormatsTask = AdminService.GetEventFormatsAsync();
329:             var eventStatusesTask = AdminService.GetEventStatusesAsync();
330:             var visibilityTypesTask = AdminService.GetVisibilityTypesAsync();
331:             var madhabsTask = AdminService.GetMadhabsAsync();
332: 
333:             await Task.WhenAll(eventTypesTask, eventFormatsTask, eventStatusesTask, visibilityTypesTask, madhabsTask);
334: 
335:             eventTypes = await eventTypesTask;
336:             eventFormats = await eventFormatsTask;
337:             eventStatuses = await eventStatusesTask;
338:             visibilityTypes = await visibilityTypesTask;
339:             madhabs = await madhabsTask;
340: 
341:             currentEvent = await EventService.GetEventByIdAsync(EventId);
342: 
343:             if (currentEvent != null)
344:             {
345:                 updateDto = new UpdateEventDto
346:                 {
347:                     Id = currentEvent.Id,
348:                     Title = currentEvent.Title,
349:                     Subtitle = currentEvent.Subtitle,
350:                     Description = currentEvent.Description,
351:                     AudienceGenderId = currentEvent.AudienceGenderId,
352:                     AudienceAgeId = currentEvent.AudienceAgeId,
353:                     ActorId = currentEvent.ActorId,
354:                     Price = currentEvent.Price,
355:                     CurrencyCode = currentEvent.CurrencyCode,
356:                     FeaturedImageId = currentEvent.FeaturedImageId,
357:                     IsRegistrationRequired = currentEvent.IsRegistrationRequired,
358:                     ExternalRegistrationUrl = currentEvent.EventUrl,
359:                     EventTypeId = currentEvent.EventTypeId,
360:                     EventFormatId = currentEvent.EventFormatId,
361:                     EventStatusId = currentEvent.EventStatusId,
362:                     VisibilityTypeId = currentEvent.VisibilityTypeId,
363:                     FirstSessionDate = currentEvent.FirstSessionDate,
364:                     LastSessionDate = currentEvent.LastSessionDate,
365:                     MetadataJson = currentEvent.MetadataJson
366:                 };
367:                 _appearance = EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.Parse(currentEvent.MetadataJson);
368: 
369:                 if (currentEvent.FirstSessionDate.HasValue)
370:                 {
371:                     var localStart = currentEvent.FirstSessionDate.Value.LocalDateTime;
372:                     _startDate = localStart.Date;
373:                     _startTime = localStart.TimeOfDay;
374:                 }
375: 
376:                 if (currentEvent.LastSessionDate.HasValue)
377:                 {
378:                     var localEnd = currentEvent.LastSessionDate.Value.LocalDateTime;
379:                     _endDate = localEnd.Date;
380:                     _endTime = localEnd.TimeOfDay;
381:                 }
382: 
383:                 _isOnline = currentEvent.EventFormatId == 2;
384:                 _previewImageUrl = currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri ?? GeneratePlaceholderImage();
385:                 selectedMadhabId = currentEvent.MadhabId;
386:                 selectedTimezone = currentEvent.Timezone;
387: 
388:                 var allCategoriesTask = CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
389:                 var allTagsTask = TagService.GetAllTagsAsync();
390:                 var eventCategoriesTask = CategoryService.GetCategoriesByEventAsync(EventId);
391:                 var eventTagsTask = TagService.GetTagsByEventAsync(EventId);
392:                 var sessionsTask = EventService.GetSessionsByEventAsync(EventId);
393: 
394:                 await Task.WhenAll(allCategoriesTask, allTagsTask, eventCategoriesTask, eventTagsTask, sessionsTask);
395: 
396:                 allCategories = await allCategoriesTask;
397:                 allTags = await allTagsTask;
398:                 existingCategoriesRaw = await eventCategoriesTask;
399:                 existingTagsRaw = await eventTagsTask;
400:                 var eventSessions = await sessionsTask;
401: 
402:                 selectedCategoryIds = new HashSet<Guid?>();
403:                 selectedTagIds = new HashSet<Guid?>();
404: 
405:                 sessions = eventSessions?.Select(s => SessionEditorModel.FromDto(s)).ToList() ?? new List<SessionEditorModel>();
406:             }
407:             else
408:             {
409:                 _errorMessage = "Event not found";
410:             }
411:         }
412:         catch (Exception ex)
413:         {
414:             _errorMessage = $"Error loading event: {ex.Message}";
415:         }
416:         finally
417:         {
418:             isLoading = false;
419:         }
420:     }
421: 
422:     private string GeneratePlaceholderImage()
423:     {
424:         if (currentEvent == null) return string.Empty;
425:         var eventTitle = Uri.EscapeDataString(currentEvent.Title ?? "Event");
426:         return $"https://via.placeholder.com/400x250/607D8B/ffffff?text={eventTitle}";
427:     }
428: 
429:     private async Task HandleValidSubmit()
430:     {
431:         if (updateDto == null) return;
432: 
433:         if (_isUploadingImage)
434:         {
435:             _errorMessage = "Please wait for the image upload to complete.";
436:             return;
437:         }
438: 
439:         try
440:         {
441:             updateDto.FirstSessionDate = DateTimeHelper.CombineDateTimeToUtc(_startDate, _startTime);
442:             updateDto.LastSessionDate = DateTimeHelper.CombineDateTimeToUtc(_endDate, _endTime);
443: 
444:             if (_uploadedStorageObjectId.HasValue)
445:             {
446:                 updateDto.FeaturedImageId = _uploadedStorageObjectId.Value;
447:             }
448: 
449:             updateDto.MetadataJson = EventAppearanceMetadataHelper.Upsert(updateDto.MetadataJson, _appearance);
450: 
451:             if (!updateDto.Id.HasValue)
452:             {
453:                 _errorMessage = "Event ID is missing";
454:                 return;
455:             }
456:             var response = await EventService.UpdateEventAsync(updateDto.Id.Value, updateDto);
457: 
458:             if (response?.Success == true)
459:             {
460:                 Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
461:             }
462:             else
463:             {
464:                 _errorMessage = response?.Message ?? "Failed to update event";
465:             }
466:         }
467:         catch (Exception ex)
468:         {
469:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error updating event");
470:             _errorMessage = $"Error updating event: {ex.Message}";
471:         }
472:     }
473: 
474:     private void NavigateBack()
475:     {
476:         Navigation.NavigateTo("/myevents");
477:     }

479:     private async Task OnImageFileDataSelected(FileUploadData? fileData)
480:     {
481:         _selectedFileData = fileData;
482:         _uploadError = null;
483: 
484:         if (fileData == null)
485:         {
486:             return;
487:         }
488: 
489:         _isUploadingImage = true;
490:         await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
491: 
492:         try
493:         {
494:             var uploadResult = await ImageStorageService.UploadAndCreateRecordFromBytesAsync(fileData);
495: 
496:             if (uploadResult?.Success == true)
497:             {
498:                 _uploadedStorageObjectId = uploadResult.StorageObjectId;
499:                 _uploadError = null;
500:             }
501:             else
502:             {
503:                 _uploadError = uploadResult?.ErrorMessage ?? "Failed to upload image.";
504:                 await ClearUploadState();
505:             }
506:         }
507:         catch (Exception ex)
508:         {
509:             _uploadError = $"Upload error: {ex.Message}";
510:             await ClearUploadState();
511:         }
512:         finally
513:         {
514:             _isUploadingImage = false;
515:             await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
516:         }
517:     }
518: 
519:     private async Task ClearUploadState()
520:     {
521:         try
522:         {
523:             if (_imageUploadComponent != null)
524:             {
525:                 await _imageUploadComponent.RemoveImage();
526:             }
527:         }
528:         catch { }
529: 
530:         _selectedFileData = null;
531:         if (currentEvent != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri))
532:         {
533:             _previewImageUrl = currentEvent.FeaturedImageUri;
534:         }
535:         else
536:         {
537:             _previewImageUrl = GeneratePlaceholderImage();
538:         }
539:     }

541:     private void AddSession()
542:     {
543:         sessions.Add(new SessionEditorModel
544:         {
545:             StartTime = _startDate?.Date.Add(_startTime ?? TimeSpan.Zero) ?? DateTime.Today.AddHours(9),
546:             EndTime = _endDate?.Date.Add(_endTime ?? TimeSpan.Zero) ?? DateTime.Today.AddHours(17)
547:         });
548:     }
549: 
550:     private void RemoveSession(int index)
551:     {
552:         if (sessions.Count > 0 && index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
553:         {
554:             sessions.RemoveAt(index);
555:         }
556:     }
557: 
558:     private void OnSessionChanged(int index, SessionEditorModel session)
559:     {
560:         if (index >= 0 && index < sessions.Count)
561:         {
562:             sessions[index] = session;
563:         }
564:     }
565: 
566:     private string GetCategorySelectionText(List<string> selectedValues)
567:     {
568:         if (selectedValues == null || !selectedValues.Any()) return "Select categories";
569:         return $"{selectedValues.Count} categor{(selectedValues.Count == 1 ? "y" : "ies")} selected";
570:     }
571: 
572:     private string GetTagSelectionText(List<string> selectedValues)
573:     {
574:         if (selectedValues == null || !selectedValues.Any()) return "Select tags";
575:         return $"{selectedValues.Count} tag{(selectedValues.Count == 1 ? "" : "s")} selected";
576:     }
577: }
````

  1: @page "/events"

 42: 
 43:     <MudGrid Spacing="4">

 46:             <!-- Skeleton Loading State -->
 47:             @for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
 48:             {
 49:                 <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4" lg="3">

 68:                             <MudCardMedia Image="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.FeaturedImageUri) ? GetEventImage(evt) : evt.FeaturedImageUri)" Height="200" />
 69: 
 70:                             <MudCardContent Class="d-flex flex-column flex-grow-1 pt-4 pb-2 px-4">
 71:                                 <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center mb-2">
 72:                                     <MudChip T="string" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Text" Class="ml-n1 font-weight-bold">@GetEventTypeName(evt)</MudChip>
 73:                                     @if (evt.IsUserReported == true)
 74:                                     {

 81:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Style="font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; min-height: 2.4em;" Class="mb-1">
 82:                                     @evt.Title

 84:

 88:                                         @evt.Subtitle
 89:                                     </MudText>
 90:                                 }
 91:                                 else
 92:                                 {
 93:                                     <div style="height: 1.25rem;" class="mb-2"></div> <!-- Spacer to keep alignment -->
 94:                                 }
 95: 
 96:                                 <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary" Style="overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; min-height: 4.5em;">
 97:                                     @GetTruncatedDescription(evt.Description)

 99: 
100:                                 <MudDivider Class="mt-auto mb-2" />
101: 
102:                                 <div class="d-flex justify-space-between align-center">

108:                                     </MudText>

133:                             <MudCardContent>

135:                                 <MudSkeleton Width="80%" Height="30px" Class="mb-4" />
136:                                 <MudSkeleton Width="100%" Height="20px" />
137:                                 <MudSkeleton Width="100%" Height="20px" />
138:                             </MudCardContent>
139:                         </MudCard>
140:                     </MudItem>
141:                 </Placeholder>
142:             </Virtualize>
143:         }
144:     </MudGrid>
145: 
146:     @if (_eventsLoaded && _totalCount == 0)
147:     {
148:         <div class="d-flex flex-column align-center justify-center py-16">
149:             <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.EventBusy" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="mb-4" />
150:             <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Color="Color.Secondary" Align="Align.Center">No events found</MudText>
151:             <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Color="Color.Secondary" Align="Align.Center" Class="mt-2">
152:                 Try adjusting your filters or search query
153:             </MudText>
154:         </div>
155:     }
156: 
157:     @if (_totalCount > 0)
158:     {
159:         <MudText Typo="Typo.caption" Align="Align.Center" Color="Color.Secondary" Class="d-block mb-8">
160:             @_totalCount events found
161:         </MudText>
162:     }

164: </MudContainer>
````

  1: # CLAUDE.md — ISLAMU Event Project Reference
  2: 
  3: > **Source of Truth for AI Agents and Team Collaboration**
  4: >
  5: > This document provides comprehensive context for working with the ISLAMU Event codebase.
  6: > This file is the entrypoint. Detailed docs are imported from `docs/`.
  7: > Last Updated: January 2026
  8: 
  9: You are an experienced, pragmatic software engineer. You don’t over-engineer a solution when a simple one works.
 10: 
 11: 
 12: ## Documentation Template System
 13: 
 14: This project uses **project-agnostic documentation** with placeholder syntax `{Placeholder}`.
 15: **Template Glossary**: [docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](docs/TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md) - Defines all placeholders

 17:

 19: - ✅ Core Docs: ARCHITECTURE.md, API.md, BLAZOR.md, GOVERNANCE.md, QUICK_REFERENCE.md
 20: - ✅ Operations: CONTRIBUTING.md, OPERATIONS.md, CONFIGURATION.md, TROUBLESHOOTING.md
 21: - ✅ Domain Reference: DOMAIN.md (project-specific with generic patterns)
 22: - ✅ Skills: blazor-bff-patterns (SKILL.md + 4 resources), and 7 other skills
 23: - ✅ All use "Generic Template + Concrete Example" pattern
 24: 
 25: ## ⚠️ CRITICAL RULES - Quick Reference
 26: 
 27: **MUST READ**: Never violate them.
 28: 
 29: 
 30: > ⚠️ **Rule #1:** Never assume an exception. Get explicit permission from me before breaking or bending any rule.
 31: 
 32: - Only write inside this repo project folder, never in users folder (not in C:\Users\*\.claude\ or anywhere outside this project folder)
 33: - When getting build errors, stop building! Get the errors, fix them, skip building until fixed. Limited retry attempts, then fix without building until confident.
 34: - NEVER run rm -rf commands or delete files/folders unless explicitly instructed - instead report files that should be deleted
 35: - Never write scripts or execute scripts files!
 36: 
 37: **Some Technical API Rules**:
 38: 1. **Repositories Return ENTITIES, Never DTOs** - Map to DTOs in handlers
 39: 2. **Validators Use Manual Instantiation (NOT DI)** - `var validator = new CreateEventDtoValidator(_repo1, _repo2);`
 40: 3. **Navigation Properties Are Readonly** - Use repository for writes: `_memberRepository.Create(member)`
 41: 4. **Use int Instead of long** - Except size/cursor fields or absolutely necessary
 42: 5. **No Default Values in Domain Entities** - Set in handler: `@event.TotalViews = 0;`
 43: 6. **Commands Return BaseCommandResponse<Guid>** - Not just `Guid`
 44: 7. **GET = AllowAnonymous, Write = Authorize, Admin = Roles** - Public read, protected write, role-based for admin operations
 45: 8. **Extract UserId with Fallback** - `sub` → `nameidentifier` → `sid`
 46: 9. **File-Scoped Namespaces** - `namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events;`
 47: 10. **Entities Include Auditing Fields** - CreatedAt, CreatedBy, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy, IsDeleted (soft delete)
 48: 11. **Use Named Query Filters for Soft Delete** - EF Core 10+ `.HasQueryFilter(name: "SoftDelete", predicate: e => !e.IsDeleted)`
 49: **Full Details**: [@docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md](docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md)
 50: 
 51: ---
 52: 
 53: ## 🧱 Foundational Rules
 54: 
 55: - Doing it right is better than doing it fast. You are not in a rush.
 56: - Never skip steps or take shortcuts.
 57: - Tedious, systematic work is often the correct solution. Don't abandon an approach because it's repetitive—only if it's wrong.
 58: - **One question at a time** - When gathering requirements or clarifying design, ask questions individually. Wait for each answer before proceeding to the next question.
 59: - Honesty is a core value. If you're not fully truthful, our collaboration can't continue.
 60: 
 61: ---
 62: 
 63: ## 🤝 Our Relationship
 64: 
 65: - We are colleagues — equals working toward the same goal.
 66: - Speak up immediately when you don’t know something or are over your head.
 67: - Call out bad ideas, mistakes, or unreasonable expectations. I highly depends on this.
 68: - Never agree just to be nice. Honest disagreement is better than fake consensus.
 69: - If you disagree, cite technical reasons. If it’s intuition, say so.
 70: - You have unreliable memory. Use your **journal** (`dev/_journal/journal.md`) to record important facts, insights, and preferences before you forget.
 71: - Search your journal before repeating research or reasoning.
 72: - Discuss all **Important decisions** (refactors...) before implementation **or** before finalizing requirements that assume a particular approach.
 73: - When something is identified as "a major decision" elevate its priority immediately.
 74: 
 75: ---
 76: 
 77: ## 🔧 Starting Work (Critical First Steps)
 78: 
 79: **Before starting ANY task, always build and run tests:**
 80: 
 81: 1. **Build first** (catches compilation errors with clear output):
 82: ```bash
 83: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 84: ```
 85: 
 86: 2. **Run each test project individually** (do NOT use solution-level `dotnet test` — it fails if any project has issues):
 87: ```bash
 88: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 89: dotnet test --project Event.Domain.UnitTests/Event.Domain.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 90: dotnet test --project Event.Architecture.Tests/Event.Architecture.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 91: dotnet test --project Explore.Secrets.UnitTests/Explore.Secrets.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 92: dotnet test --project Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests/Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 93: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 94: dotnet test --project Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests/Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 95: ```
 96: 
 97: 3. **If tests are failing — get detailed failure info:**
 98: ```bash
 99: # Generate TRX report for detailed failure analysis
100: dotnet test --project <ProjectPath> --configuration Release -- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx
101: 
102: # Then search TRX for failed tests (use Grep tool on the TRX file):
103: #   Pattern: outcome="Failed"  → finds failed test entries
104: #   Pattern: className=        → correlate testId to get full Class.Method names
105: #   Pattern: <Message>         → read error messages and stack traces
106: ```
107: 
108: 4. **If tests are failing:**
109:    - **STOP your planned work**
110:    - Fix the failing tests FIRST
111:    - Document what was broken and how you fixed it
112:    - Then resume your planned work
113: 5. **If tests are passing:**
114:    - Proceed with your work
115:    - Run tests frequently during development
116: 
117: **Important notes:**
118: - Always use `--project` flag (positional project arguments don't work reliably)
119: - Use `--verbosity quiet` for clean pass/fail summaries
120: - Use `--verbosity normal` when you need to see error details inline
121: - Solution-level `dotnet test` will fail if any test project has MSBuild issues (e.g., placeholder projects)
122: - On French-locale Windows, `findstr /i` may not work — use exact case patterns instead
123: 
124: **Why this matters:**
125: - Broken tests indicate the codebase is in an unknown state
126: - Your changes built on broken tests compound the problem
127: - It's unclear if YOUR changes break things or if they were already broken
128: - Fixing tests first establishes a known-good baseline
129: 
130: **Example workflow:**
131: ```bash
132: # Start of session — build first
133: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
134: 
135: # Run tests per project
136: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
137: 
138: # ❌ 3 tests failing? Generate TRX for details:
139: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release -- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx
140: 
141: # Search TRX for failures (use Grep tool, not bash grep)
142: # Fix the failing tests FIRST, then resume your work
143: ```
144: 
145: ---
146: 
147: ## 🚀 Proactiveness
148: 
149: When assigned a task, **do it completely**, including obvious follow-ups. However, distinguish between:
150: 
151: **Implementation tasks** (be proactive):
152: - "Fix this bug"
153: - "Add this feature"
154: - "Write tests for X"
155: - "Refactor this code"
156: 
157: **Design/planning tasks** (be systematic, not proactive):
158: - "Let's discuss architecture"
159: - "Help me design X"
160: - "What are the requirements for Y?"
161: - "Let's talk about..."
162: 
163: For design/planning: Pause and ask questions one at a time. Don't create implementations, templates, or code until explicitly requested or requirements are finalized.
164: 
165: Follow the prd skill at .claude/skills/prd/SKILL.md when planning
166: 
167: Pause to ask for confirmation when:
168: - Multiple valid approaches exist and the choice matters.
169: - The action deletes or restructures existing code.
170: - You genuinely don't understand the task.
171: - explicitly asked "how should I approach X?" — answer the question, don't start coding.
172: - You're in **requirements gathering mode** - always wait for explicit direction.
173: 
174: Act autonomously for clear, low-risk tasks. Stop and ask when changes affect architecture, data integrity, or long-term behavior.
175: 
176: ---
177: 
178: ## 📝 Requirements Gathering
179: 
180: When designing new features or systems:
181: 
182: - **One question at a time** - Never batch multiple questions. Wait for answer before proceeding.
183: - **Document as you go** - Capture decisions in real-time in a dedicated requirements document.
184: - **Don't get ahead of yourself** - Resist the urge to implement or create templates before requirements are complete.
185: - **Systematic over ad-hoc** - Work through structured questionnaires methodically.
186: - **I may enhance your options** - Be open to improving or adding to the options you propose.
187: - **Requirements before implementation** - Complete and review all requirements before any coding begins.
188: 
189: ---
190: 
191: ## 🧩 Designing Software
192: 
193: - **YAGNI** – "You Ain't Gonna Need It." The best code is no code.
194: - When possible, architect for **extensibility and flexibility**, but never preemptively.
195: 
196: ---
197: 
198: ## ✅ Test-Driven Development (TDD)
199: 
200: For every new feature or bugfix:
201: 
202: 1. Write a failing test validating the desired behavior.
203: 2. Run it to confirm failure.
204: 3. Write *only* enough code to make the test pass.
205: 4. Run tests to confirm success.
206: 5. Refactor if needed while keeping tests green.
207: 
208: You may skip TDD only with given explicit permission.
209: 
210: ---
211: 
212: ## 💻 Writing Code
213: 
214: - Verify you have followed **all rules** before submitting work.
215: - Make the **smallest reasonable changes** to achieve the desired result.
216: - Prefer simple, clean, maintainable code over clever or complex solutions.
217: - **Eliminate duplication aggressively:**
218:   - Never copy-paste code - extract and import instead
219:   - If the same logic appears twice, prepare to extract on third usage
220:   - Before creating a new file with similar purpose, refactor the existing file
221:   - Search codebase thoroughly before implementing functionality that might already exist
222: - Never throw away or rewrite code without permission (except trivial cleanup or bugfixes).
223: - Get approval before implementing **backward compatibility**.
224: - Match the surrounding code style. Local consistency beats external style guides.
225: - Don't manually adjust whitespace unless necessary; use a formatter instead: `dotnet format`.
226: - Fix broken things immediately when you find them.
227: 
228: **Error handling:** Code must fail fast, log clearly, and handle expected errors gracefully.
229: 
230: ---
231: 
232: ## 🗂️ File Management & Organization
233: 
234: ### Before Creating a New File
235: 
236: **STOP and ask these questions:**
237: 
238: 1. **Does a similar file already exist?**
239:    - Search the codebase thoroughly: `grep -r "class ClassName"`, `find . -name "*keyword*"`
240:    - If similar file exists, **extend it** rather than duplicate
241: 
242: 2. **Will this create duplication?**
243:    - If implementing similar functionality to an existing file, **refactor the existing file** instead
244:    - Never create `FileV2.cs`, `FileEnhanced.cs`, `FileNew.cs` - these indicate you should be editing the original
245:    - Bad: Creating both `WordPressClient.cs` and `WordPressEnhanced.cs`
246:    - Good: Enhancing the existing `WordPressClient.cs`
247: 
248: 3. **Is this a test file?**
249:    - **Ad-hoc test scripts → NO**: Put in proper test project
250:    - **Integration/manual tests → MAYBE**: Only if truly cannot be automated
251:    - **Never** create scripts for unit tests
252: 
253: 4. **Is this a backup or temporary file?**
254:    - Use git branches and history, not backup files
255:    - Add patterns to `.gitignore` immediately
256: 
257: ### Red Flags - Stop and Refactor
258: 
259: If you're writing and notice:
260: 
261: - ⚠️  "This is similar to what this part of the books is about..."
262: - ⚠️  "I'll just copy this from here..."
263: - ⚠️  "There's probably already a chapter or page for this..."
264: - ⚠️  "This feels like I've written it before..."
265: 
266: **STOP** - Search the Book first
267: 
268: ## 🧾 Learning and Memory Management
269: 
270: Use your journal (`dev/_journal/journal.md`) to capture insights, failures, and patterns.
271: 
272: **For major decisions or requirements**, create dedicated documents:
273: - `dev/_journal/MAJOR_DECISIONS.md`
274: - `dev/_journal/journal.md` - General insights, patterns, failures
275: 
276: **Journal format** (`dev/_journal/journal.md`):
277: 
278: ```md
279: ## Failed Approaches
280: - [Date] Tried X approach for Y problem, but it failed because Z.
281: 
282: ## Key Decisions
283: - [Date] Refactored for consistency and fixing logical flow in Bugman X manuscript.
284: 
285: ## Deferred Fixes
286: - [Date] Fix inconsistent character names in Chapter 4.
287: ```
288: 
289: - Each entry must be timestamped and formatted as above.
290: - Review your journal weekly.
291: - Search it before starting complex tasks.
292: - Document architectural decisions and user feedback trends.
293: - Record issues for later rather than fixing unrelated things mid-task.
294: - Before starting complex tasks:
295:   - Search the journal for relevant past experiences.
296:   - Document decisions and their outcomes.
297:   - Track recurring user feedback or collaboration patterns.
298:   - When you find something unrelated but worth fixing, log it instead of fixing it immediately.
299:   - Review the journal weekly to reinforce learning and memory.
300: 
301: ---
302: 
303: ## 🔬 Research and Recommendations
304: 
305: When researching tools, technologies, or approaches:
306: 
307: - **Document comprehensively** - Create dedicated markdown files with findings.
308: - **Provide context** - Executive summary tailored to Author's specific workflow and preferences.
309: - **Compare systematically** - Use tables/matrices for clear comparison.
310: - **Recommendation clarity** - Be explicit about what you recommend and why.
311: - **Ask clarifying questions** - End research with specific questions to guide next steps.
312: - **Don't assume Author's workflow** - Ask about primary tools and preferences before making assumptions.
313: 
314: ---
315: 
316: ### When Replacing/Deprecating Files
317: 
318: If creating a replacement file (e.g., `new-cli.cs` replacing `old-script.cs`):
319: 
320: 1. **Delete the old file in the same PR** - Don't leave both
321: 2. **Update all imports** that referenced the old file
322: 4. **Update documentation** to reference only the new file
323: 5. **Add migration notes** to git commit message
324: 
325: ### Duplication Detection Checklist
326: 
327: Before submitting code, check for these duplication patterns:
328: 
329: - [ ] **Complete file duplication** - Same class name in two files
330: - [ ] **Logic duplication** - Same algorithm copied between files (>20 lines)
331: - [ ] **Constant duplication** - Same constants defined in multiple files
332: 
333: **Rule of Three**: If the same code appears **3 times**, extract it to a shared utility following asp.net core conventions and clean architecture and this repo' convention. If it appears **twice** and you're adding a third, extract **before** adding.
334: 
335: ---
336: 
337: ## 📦 Shared Logic & Abstraction
338: 
339: ### Mandatory Extraction Scenarios
340: 
341: Extract shared logic when:
342: 
343: 1. **Same logic in 2+ files AND you're adding a 3rd usage**
344:    - Extract **before** adding the third copy
345:    - Example: `chunkArray` used in 3 places
346: 
347: 2. **Same class structure in 2+ files** (>100 lines shared)
348:    - Create abstract base class with shared logic
349:    - Example: LocalWhisper + MLXWhisper both traverse directories identically
350: 
351: 3. **Same algorithm repeated** (>20 lines)
352:    - Extract to shared function
353:    - Example: Retry logic, error handling patterns
354: 
355: 4. **Same constants/config in 2+ files**
356:    - Extract to shared file
357:    - Example: `FILE_STATUS` constants, supported file extensions
358: 
359: ### Abstraction Guidelines
360: 
361: - **Base classes** for shared **implementation** (template method pattern)
362: - **Interfaces** for shared **contracts** (dependency inversion)
363: - **Utility functions** for shared **algorithms** (pure functions)
364: - **Never** copy-paste similar code - refactor to share instead
365: 
366: ### Red Flags - Stop and Refactor
367: 
368: If you're writing code and notice:
369: 
370: - ⚠️  "This is similar to what `FileX.cs` does..."
371: - ⚠️  "I'll just copy this logic from here..."
372: - ⚠️  "There's probably already a function for this..."
373: - ⚠️  "This feels like I've written it before..."
374: 
375: **STOP** - Search the codebase first, then extract shared logic.
376: 
377: ---
378: 
379: ## 🧠 Naming
380: 
381: - Names must express **what** code does, not **how** it works or its history.
382: - Don’t reference implementation details unless essential to meaning.
383: - Avoid temporal or comparative names (“NewController”, “LegacyHandler”, “EnhancedService”).
384: - Avoid pattern names unless they improve clarity.
385: 
386: ---
387: 
388: ## 💬 Code Comments
389: 
390: Comments explain **what** or **why**, never **how it changed** or **what used to be**.
391: 
392: - Don’t reference prior implementations (“refactored from…”, “used x instead of…”).
393: - Don’t add meta-comments like “improved”, “better”, “new”, or “enhanced.”
394: - Don’t leave instructional comments (“use this pattern”).
395: - Remove outdated comments only when they describe behavior that no longer exists.
396: - Don’t add temporal context (“recently refactored”, “moved”, “new”).
397: - All files must start with a **two-line summary** beginning with `ABOUTME:` describing what the file does.
398: 
399: **Examples:**
400: ```csharp
401: // BAD: This uses FluentValidator for validation instead of manual checking
402: // BAD: Refactored from old validation system
403: // GOOD: Executes tools with validated arguments
404: ```
405: 
406: If you find yourself writing “new”, “old”, “legacy”, “wrapper”, “unified”, or “enhanced”, stop and find a better description.
407: 
408: ---
409: 
410: ## 🧰 Version Control
411: 
412: - Ask how to handle uncommitted or untracked files before starting work.
413: - If no branch exists for your task, create a **WIP** branch.
414: - Track all non-trivial changes in git.
415: - Commit frequently and atomically, with meaningful messages describing intent.
416: - Never skip or disable pre-commit hooks.
417: - Never use `git add -A` without first running `git status`.
418: - **Never commit backup or temporary files:**
419:   - Use `.gitignore` to prevent accidental commits
420:   - If you see these in git, delete them immediately
421: - **Clean up deprecated code in the same commit:**
422:   - When adding a replacement file, delete the old one in the same PR
423:   - Update all references to point to new implementation
424:   - Remove old exports from barrel files
425: 
426: ---
427: 
428: ## 🧪 Testing
429: 
430: ### Testing Standards
431: 
432: **CRITICAL RULE: Never commit or push with broken tests**
433: 
434: - **All test failures are YOUR responsibility**, even if you didn't cause them
435: - If tests are broken when you start work, fix them FIRST before proceeding
436: - If you break tests during your work, fix them IMMEDIATELY
437: - If tests break during your work for unrelated reasons, fix them before committing
438: - **Never** commit with the intention of "fixing tests in the next commit"
439: - **Never** push broken tests to any branch (including WIP branches)
440: 
441: **Test Quality Standards:**
442: 
443: - Never delete failing tests — raise the issue with me.
444: - Tests must cover all functionality comprehensively.
445: - Never test mocked behavior; test real logic.
446: - Never mock in end-to-end tests — use real APIs and data.
447: - Never ignore logs or output — they often reveal the issue.
448: - Test output must be **pristine** (no unexpected warnings or stack traces).
449: - Intermittent failures count as full failures until proven otherwise.
450: 
451: ---
452: 
453: ## 📋 Issue Tracking
454: 
455: ### GitHub Issues for Work Items
456: 
457: **Use GitHub Issues for all significant work:**
458: 
459: - Create issues for features, bugs, refactors, and technical debt
460: - **Break down to smallest complete unit of work** - each issue should be:
461:   - Completable in a single PR
462:   - Independently testable
463:   - Deployable without dependencies (when possible)
464:   - Estimated at 4 hours or less of work
465: - If a task is larger than 4 hours, break it into multiple issues
466: - Link related issues together (e.g., "Part 1 of 3: Delete duplicate files")
467: 
468: **Good issue breakdown:**
469: - ✅ "Delete duplicate client implementation"
470: - ✅ "Update imports after client deletion"
471: - ✅ "Remove client from barrel exports" (15 min)
472: 
473: **Bad issue breakdown:**
474: - ❌ "Fix all architectural issues" (too large, not specific)
475: - ❌ "Refactor transcribers and fix tests and update docs" (multiple units of work)
476: 
477: 
478: ## 🔍 Systematic Debugging Process
479: 
480: Always find the **root cause** — never patch symptoms or add workarounds.
481: 
482: ### Phase 1: Root Cause Investigation
483: - Read error messages carefully.
484: - Reproduce consistently.
485: - Check recent changes (`git diff`, commits).
486: 
487: ### Phase 2: Pattern Analysis
488: - Find similar working examples.
489: - Compare against reference code.
490: - Identify differences.
491: - Understand dependencies.
492: 
493: ### Phase 3: Hypothesis and Testing
494: 1. Form one hypothesis at a time.
495: 2. Make the smallest possible change to test it.
496: 3. Verify results before continuing.
497: 4. If you don’t know, say “I don’t understand X.”
498: 
499: ### Phase 4: Implementation
500: - Always have a minimal failing test case.
501: - Never add multiple fixes at once.
502: - Never claim to follow a pattern without reading it fully.
503: - Test after every change.
504: - If the first fix fails, re-analyze instead of stacking patches.
505: 
506: ---
507: 
508: ## 🧾 Learning and Memory Management
509: 
510: Use your journal (`dev/active/journal.md`) to capture insights, failures, and patterns.
511: 
512: **For major architectural decisions or requirements**, create dedicated documents:
513: - `docs/REQUIREMENTS_DECISIONS.md` - Structured Q&A format for feature design
514: - `docs/ARCHITECTURAL_DECISIONS.md` - Major system design choices
515: - `docs/journal.md` - General insights, patterns, failures
516: 
517: **Journal format** (`dev/active/journal.md`):
518: 
519: ```md
520: ## Technical Insights
521: - [Date] Learned how to optimize Zapier webhook retries for Xero sync.
522: 
523: ## Failed Approaches
524: - [Date] Tried parsing PDFs with Regex—too brittle, switched to x solution.
525: 
526: ## Architectural Decisions
527: - [Date] Chose x structure for y due to compliance flexibility.
528: 
529: ## User Feedback Patterns
530: - [Date] customers confused by variant naming—need clearer labels.
531: 
532: ## Deferred Fixes
533: - [Date] sync bug with atproto login—log for future fix.
534: ```
535: 
536: - Each entry must be timestamped and formatted as above.
537: - Review your journal weekly.
538: - Search it before starting complex tasks.
539: - Document architectural decisions and user feedback trends.
540: - Record issues for later rather than fixing unrelated bugs mid-task.
541: - Before starting complex tasks:
542:   - Search the journal for relevant past experiences.
543:   - Document architectural decisions and their outcomes.
544:   - Track recurring user feedback or collaboration patterns.
545:   - When you find something unrelated but worth fixing, log it instead of fixing it immediately.
546:   - Review the journal weekly to reinforce learning and memory.
547: 
548: ---
549: 
550: ## 🔬 Research and Recommendations
551: 
552: When researching tools, technologies, or approaches:
553: 
554: - **Document comprehensively** - Create dedicated markdown files with findings.
555: - **Provide context** - Executive summary tailored to CJ's specific workflow and preferences.
556: - **Compare systematically** - Use tables/matrices for clear comparison.
557: - **Recommendation clarity** - Be explicit about what you recommend and why.
558: - **Ask clarifying questions** - End research with specific questions to guide next steps.
559: - **Don't assume CJ's workflow** - Ask about primary tools and preferences before making assumptions.
560: 
561: ---
562: 
563: ## 🗄️ Code Archeology & Cleanup
564: 
565: ### When Making Changes, Look for Obsolete Code
566: 
567: While working in a file, actively search for:
568: 
569: 1. **Unused imports** - Remove immediately
570: 2. **Commented-out code** - Delete (it's in git history)
571: 3. **Dead functions** - Delete if no references found
572: 4. **Backup files** - Never commit
573: 5. **TODO comments older than 3 months** - Convert to GitHub issues or delete
574: 6. **Deprecated patterns** - Refactor to current standards
575: 
576: ### Spotting Obsolete Code Patterns
577: 
578: These patterns indicate obsolete code to delete:
579: 
580: - Files with "old", "legacy", "deprecated" in name
581: - Commented-out imports or functions
582: - Duplicate implementations of same interface
583: - Multiple files exporting the same class name
584: 
585: ### Regular Maintenance (Requested)
586: 
587: Periodically ask to run architectural reviews:
588: 
589: > "Would you like me to scan for duplicate code and obsolete files?"
590: 
591: This prevents accumulation of technical debt.
592: 
593: ---
594: 
595: ## 🏗️ Architectural Hygiene
596: 
597: ### Pre-Implementation Checklist
598: 
599: Before implementing a new feature or significant change:
600: 
601: - [ ] **Search for existing implementations**: `grep -r "class Name"`, `find . -name "*keyword*"`
602: - [ ] **Review similar features**: Understand patterns already in use
603: - [ ] **Identify shared logic**: Will this duplicate any existing functionality?
604: - [ ] **Plan for reuse**: How can this be designed to avoid future duplication?
605: 
606: ### Post-Implementation Checklist
607: 
608: After implementing a feature:
609: 
610: - [ ] **Delete obsolete code**: If replacing functionality, delete old implementation
611: - [ ] **Update all references**: Ensure no dangling imports to deleted code
612: - [ ] **Extract duplicates**: If logic is similar to existing code, refactor to share
613: - [ ] **Clean up test scaffolding**: Delete ad-hoc test scripts if proper tests exist
614: - [ ] **Update documentation**: Remove references to deleted/obsolete files
615: - [ ] **Verify exports**: Remove deleted files from `index.ts` barrel exports
616: 
617: ### Red Flags - Request Architectural Review
618: 
619: If you notice any of these, suggest an architectural review:
620: 
621: - Multiple files with same/similar class names
622: - Same schema/type defined in 2+ places
623: - 3+ test testing similar functionality
624: - Logic duplicated across files (>50 lines)
625: 
626: **Phrase to use:**
627: > "I noticed [pattern]. Would you like me to do an architectural review to identify duplication and suggest consolidation?"
628: 
629: ---

675: ### Build Commands
676: 
677: ```bash
678: # Restore dependencies
679: dotnet restore
680: 
681: # Build (use --verbosity quiet for clean error/warning summary)
682: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
683: 
684: # Run a specific test project (always use --project flag)
685: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
686: 
687: # Generate TRX report for detailed test failure analysis
688: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release -- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx
689: # TRX file location: <ProjectDir>/bin/Release/net10.0/TestResults/results.trx
690: ```
691: 
692: **Do NOT use:**
693: - Positional project path without `--project` flag
694: - `findstr /i` on French-locale Windows (locale issues)

699: # 🛠️ Specialized Tooling (MCP)
700: 
701: ALWAYS use these mcp servers for their specific purposes when applicable! NEVER bypass then when applicable. For example, if you need to work on tests, use Context7 mcp to find TUnit or BUnit documentation:
702: 
703: * **Context7**: Auto-use for documentation!, for libraries docs, setup steps, and complex library configs.
704: * **Sequential Thinking**: Multi-step architecture, debugging, and refining hypotheses.
705: * **Tavily**: Web scraping and data extraction.
706: * **Perplexity**: Broad technical research and modern programming concepts.
707: * **At-Explore**: ATProto integration and debugging.
708: * **Playwrighter**: UI testing and automated web interactions (on request only).
709: * **Chrome-DevTools**: Blazor frontend inspection and CSS/JS troubleshooting (on request only).
710: 
711: ## Context, plans, and task management
712: ALWAYS refer to this file and all the files in @dev/active/ that contain context, plan, tasks...
713: @dev/active/README.md
714: 
715: ALWAYS use the correct tools available for editing files or other actions, never bash or other manual methods when a tool is available.
716: 
717: # SHELL BEHAVIOR RULES
718: 1. **FORBIDDEN COMMANDS:** You are strictly forbidden from using:
719:    - `rm` (remove)
720:    - `rm -rf`
721:    - `mv` (move/overwrite without checking)
722:    - `> ` (overwrite redirection)
723: 
724: Instead: report to user wich files should be removed at the end of your response!
