## File: Explore.Blazor.Client/Pages/Event/EventDetail.razor
````razor
  1: @page "/event/detail/{id}"
  2: @using MudBlazor
  3: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Clients
  4: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services
  5: @using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
  6: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Components.Event
  7: @using Explore.Blazor.Client.Services.Contracts
  8: 
  9: <PageTitle>@(_eventDetails?.Title ?? "Event Detail")</PageTitle>
 10: 
 11: @if (_eventDetails != null)
 12: {
 13:     <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge" Class="py-8">
 14:         <!-- Breadcrumb / Back Navigation -->
 15:         <div class="mb-6">
 16:             <MudButton StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.ArrowBack"
 17:                        Variant="Variant.Text"
 18:                        Color="Color.Default"
 19:                        Href="/events"
 20:                        Class="px-0 hover:bg-transparent text-secondary">
 21:                 Back to Events
 22:             </MudButton>
 23:         </div>
 24: 
 25:         <MudGrid Spacing="6">
 26:             
 27:             <!-- LEFT COLUMN: Main Content (Hero + Details) -->
 28:             <MudItem xs="12" md="8">
 29:                 <MudStack Spacing="6">
 30:                     
 31:                     <!-- Hero Image (Clean, No Overlay) -->
 32:                     <div class="rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm border border-gray-200 position-relative" style="aspect-ratio: 16/9; width: 100%; background-color: @GetEventColor();">
 33:                         @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_eventDetails.FeaturedImageUri))
 34:                         {
 35:                             <MudImage Src="@_eventDetails.FeaturedImageUri" ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" Class="w-100 h-100" />
 36:                         }
 37:                         else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl))
 38:                         {
 39:                             <MudImage Src="@_appearance.BackgroundMediaUrl" ObjectFit="ObjectFit.Cover" Class="w-100 h-100" />
 40:                         }
 41:                         else
 42:                         {
 43:                             <!-- Fallback Placeholder -->
 44:                             <div class="d-flex align-center justify-center h-100 w-100" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, @GetEventColor() 0%, darken(@GetEventColor(), 20%) 100%);">
 45:                                 <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Event" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Surface" Style="font-size: 6rem; opacity: 0.2;" />
 46:                             </div>
 47:                         }
 48:

 75:                             </MudText>

129:                             }
130:                         </div>
131: 
132:                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--mud-palette-text-primary);">

136:

149:                                         }

153:                                         }
154:                                     </MudMenu>

189:                         </div>

192:                 </MudStack>
193:             </MudItem>

200:                         <!-- Registration Card -->

207:                                     </MudText>
208:                                 }

216:                                        Color="GetButtonColor()"

231:                                     <MudLink OnClick="CancelRegistrationAsync" Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Error" Underline="Underline.Always">
232:                                         Cancel registration
233:                                     </MudLink>
234:                                 </div>
235:                             }
236:                         </div>
237: 
238:                         <MudDivider />

240:                         <!-- Event Logistics -->

246:                                     <div>
247:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.subtitle2" Style="font-weight: 700;">Date & Time</MudText>
248:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">@GetDateDisplay()</MudText>
249:                                         <div class="mt-1">

258:                                     <div>

260:                                         <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Color="Color.Secondary">@GetFullLocation()</MudText>
261:                                         @if (_eventDetails.EventFormatId == 2) // Online
262:                                         {

264:                                         }
265:                                         else
266:                                         {
267:                                             <div class="mt-1">
268:                                                 <MudLink Href="#" Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Primary">View Map</MudLink>
269:                                             </div>
270:                                         }
271:                                     </div>
272:                                 </div>
273:                             </MudStack>
274:                         </div>
275: 
276:                         <!-- Footer Actions -->

278:                             <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Share" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Default" Title="Share Event" />
279:                             <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Flag" Size="Size.Small" Color="Color.Default" Title="Report Event" />
280:                         </div>
281: 
282:                     </MudPaper>
283:                 </div>
284:             </MudItem>
285: 
286:         </MudGrid>
287:     </MudContainer>
288: }
289: else if (_isLoading)

292:         <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Indeterminate="true" />
293:         <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mt-4" Color="Color.Secondary">Loading details...</MudText>
294:     </div>

296: else

302:         <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" Href="/events" Size="Size.Large">Browse Events</MudButton>
303:     </MudContainer>
304: }
````

````csharp
410: 
411:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(setupSecret) && httpContext.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)

414:                     ?? httpContext.User.FindFirst(System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;

421:             }

425:                 transformContext.ProxyRequest.Headers.Add("X-Setup-Secret", setupSecret);

659: static string GetSafeReturnUrl(HttpContext ctx, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger logger)
660: {
661:     var returnUrl = ctx.Request.Query["returnUrl"].ToString();
662: 
663:     if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(returnUrl))
664:     {
665:         return "/";
666:     }
667: 
668:     if (returnUrl.StartsWith('/') &&
669:         !returnUrl.StartsWith("//", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
670:         !returnUrl.StartsWith("/\\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
671:     {
672:         return returnUrl;
673:     }
674: 
675:     logger.LogWarning("[AuthEndpoints] Invalid returnUrl '{ReturnUrl}' - defaulting to /", returnUrl);
676:     return "/";
677: }

679: // Authentication endpoints - using /auth/* paths to avoid conflict with Blazor routes.
680: // The Blazor shim components at /login and /logout force-load these server endpoints.
681: app.MapGet("/auth/challenge", async ctx =>
682: {
683:     var returnUrl = GetSafeReturnUrl(ctx, app.Logger);
684: 
685:     var config = ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IConfiguration>();
686:     app.Logger.LogDebug(
687:         "[AuthEndpoints] /auth/challenge - Config check: Authority={Authority}, HasClientId={HasClientId}, HasSecret={HasSecret}",
688:         config["Keycloak:Authority"],
689:         !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config["Keycloak:ClientId"]),
690:         !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config["Keycloak:ClientSecret"]));
691: 
692:     app.Logger.LogInformation(
693:         "[AuthEndpoints] /auth/challenge hit - Url: {Url} ReturnUrl: {ReturnUrl}",
694:         ctx.Request.GetDisplayUrl(),
695:         returnUrl);
696: 
697:     try
698:     {
699:         await ctx.ChallengeAsync(
700:             OpenIdConnectDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,
701:             new AuthenticationProperties
702:             {
703:                 RedirectUri = returnUrl
704:             });
705:     }
706:     catch (Exception ex)
707:     {
708:         app.Logger.LogError(ex, "[AuthEndpoints] Error during login challenge. Authority: {Authority}, ClientId: {ClientId}, HasSecret: {HasSecret}, InnerException: {Inner}",
709:             config["Keycloak:Authority"],
710:             config["Keycloak:ClientId"],
711:             !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config["Keycloak:ClientSecret"]),
712:             ex.InnerException?.Message);
713:         ctx.Response.StatusCode = 500;
714:         await ctx.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new
715:         {
716:             error = "Login failed. Please try again later."
717:         });
718:     }
719: });
720: 
721: app.MapGet("/auth/login", ctx =>
722: {
723:     var returnUrl = Uri.EscapeDataString(GetSafeReturnUrl(ctx, app.Logger));
724:     ctx.Response.Redirect($"/auth/challenge?returnUrl={returnUrl}");
725:     return Task.CompletedTask;
726: });
727: 
728: app.MapGet("/auth/signout", async ctx =>

732:     app.Logger.LogInformation(

734:         ctx.Request.GetDisplayUrl(),
735:         returnUrl);
736: 
737:     try

739:         await ctx.SignOutAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);

800:             else
801:             {
802:                 result["discoveryError"] = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
803:             }
804:         }
````
